title: Do Robotic World Models Really Follow Actions? Diagnosing and Aligning Action-Conditioned Generation for Policy Learning
title_zh: 机器人世界模型真的能遵循动作指令吗？面向策略学习的动作条件生成诊断与对齐
authors: Sixiang Chen, Jiaming Liu, Jixian Wu, Yichen Guo, Tinghao Wang, Siyuan Qian, Hao Chen, Jiajun Cao, Jian Tang, Shanghang Zhang
abstract: Action-conditioned world models are increasingly used as learned simulators for policy evaluation and improvement, yet their effectiveness rests on an unverified assumption: generated futures faithfully reflect arbitrary valid actions. Existing benchmarks are typically confined to expert demonstrations, leaving off-expert action following inadequately evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce WorldEcho, which probes action following over a broader action distribution using visual integrity and SE(3) trajectory alignment. Our diagnosis shows that current world models reasonably execute expert actions but struggle with diverse off-expert trajectories, either ignoring the commanded actions or producing visually invalid rollouts. We further propose WorldSync, which strengthens action following along three complementary axes: distributional coverage, representational grounding, and intervention-effect alignment. It broadens the training distribution over action consequences, grounds intermediate video representations in action-induced robot dynamics through an Action-Forcing Expert, and aligns predicted changes under action interventions with the corresponding changes in ground-truth futures. Experiments on RoboTwin benchmarks and real-robot tasks show that WorldSync improves WorldEcho metrics and serves as a more reliable simulator for iterative policy improvement, enabling policies to achieve higher success rates.
summary_zh: 动作条件世界模型正越来越多地被用作学习得到的模拟器，用于策略评估与优化，但其有效性依赖一个未经验证的假设：生成的未来状态能够忠实地反映任意有效动作。现有基准通常局限于专家演示场景，对非专家动作的遵循能力评估不足。为填补这一空白，本文提出WorldEcho（世界回声诊断框架），通过视觉完整性校验与SE(3)（三维特殊欧几里得群）轨迹对齐，在更广泛的动作分布上测试模型的动作遵循能力。诊断结果表明，当前主流世界模型可以合理执行专家动作，但难以处理多样化的非专家轨迹，要么忽略输入的动作指令，要么生成视觉上无效的推演结果。本文进一步提出WorldSync（世界同步对齐框架），从三个互补维度强化动作遵循能力：分布覆盖度、表征 grounding 以及干预-效果对齐。该框架拓宽了动作后果的训练分布范围，通过Action-Forcing Expert（动作强制专家）将中间视频表征锚定在动作诱导的机器人动力学中，并将动作干预下的预测变化与真实未来的对应变化对齐。在RoboTwin（机器人孪生基准）和真实机器人任务上的实验表明，WorldSync提升了WorldEcho的各项指标，可作为更可靠的模拟器支撑迭代式策略优化，使训练得到的策略实现更高的成功率。

title: From Seeing to Acting: Smart Glasses as First-Person Intelligence Platforms
title_zh: 从感知到执行：作为第一人称智能平台的智能眼镜
authors: Jiangning Zhang, Haojun Chen, Yong Liu
abstract: Smart glasses are evolving from capture and display accessories into first-person intelligence platforms that connect human perception, persistent context, and digital or physical action. Their on-body viewpoint aligns with the wearer's vision, audition, motion, and hand-object interaction, but must operate under tight energy, thermal, privacy, and feedback constraints. Despite rapid progress in augmented reality, egocentric vision, multimodal models, human-computer interaction, and embodied intelligence, the literature remains fragmented across devices, tasks, and benchmarks. \textit{The key challenge is not whether a model can recognize, answer, remember, or act in isolation, but whether a complete system can sustain a reliable, temporally valid, correctable, and governable perception-state-interaction-action loop.} This survey is \textit{the \textbf{first} to systematically study smart glasses through such a unified framework}. We formalize first-person data flow and constrained task utility, characterize devices along eight verifiable hardware capability axes, organize the literature around seven interdependent foundational capabilities, and introduce an L0-L5 framework spanning capture, reactive perception, contextual assistance, persistent state, governed action, and embodied coupling. Across nine application scenes, we connect tasks with datasets, systems, products, stakeholders, failure consequences, and evidence gaps. We further present a nine-dimensional deployment framework, a claim-conditioned evaluation protocol, and an evidence ladder from controlled measurement to longitudinal field validation and audit. Together, these elements make smart glasses more comparable, deployable, and reproducibly evaluated, while outlining a roadmap toward trustworthy first-person intelligence.
summary_zh: 智能眼镜正从拍摄与显示配件演进为连接人类感知、持久上下文与数字/物理动作的第一人称智能平台。其佩戴端视角与佩戴者的视觉、听觉、运动、手物交互完全对齐，但必须在严格的能耗、散热、隐私与反馈约束下运行。尽管增强现实、第一人称视觉、多模态模型、人机交互与具身智能领域已取得快速进展，现有研究仍分散在不同设备、任务与基准中。核心挑战并非模型能否在孤立场景下完成识别、问答、记忆或执行任务，而是完整系统能否维持可靠、时间一致、可校正、可管控的感知-状态-交互-执行闭环。本综述是首个通过该统一框架系统研究智能眼镜的工作：我们形式化定义了第一人称数据流与约束任务效用，从8个可验证的硬件能力维度对设备进行特征刻画，围绕7个相互关联的基础能力梳理现有文献，并提出覆盖采集、反应式感知、上下文辅助、持久状态、可管控执行、具身耦合的L0-L5分级框架。在9类应用场景中，我们将任务与数据集、系统、产品、利益相关方、故障后果及证据缺口关联起来，进一步提出九维部署框架、基于声明的评估协议，以及从受控测量到长期现场验证与审计的证据阶梯。上述要素共同推动智能眼镜的可比性、可部署性与可复现评估，同时为可信第一人称智能的发展指明了路线图。

title: LeFlow: Generative Latent Flow Planning for World Models
title_zh: LeFlow：面向世界模型的生成式潜流规划方法
authors: Hsiang-Wei Huang, Jianxu Shangguan, Junbin Lu, Jenq-Neng Hwang
abstract: Latent world models are inherently strong encoders that transform image pixel to latent embedding, yet existing world models still rely on online trajectory optimization for action planning: for every state-goal pair, an iterative optimizer is run from scratch to search for optimal action sequences, treating the world model as a black-box simulator. This approach pays the full iterative optimization cost anew at every replanning step and reuses no planning experience across queries. In this work, we ask whether planning itself can be amortized once a latent world model has been learned. We present LeFlow, which learns a reusable latent trajectory prior operating directly in the latent dynamics space from the world model. LeFlow recasts planning as conditional latent trajectory generation: a rectified-flow model imagines a future latent path between the current and goal embeddings, an inverse dynamics decoder turns latent transitions into action chunks, and the frozen world model verifies each candidate by autoregressive rollout. Across four major goal-conditioned pixel-control benchmarks, LeFlow replaces iterative action-space optimization with amortized latent planning and fixed-budget rollout selection, achieving consistent success-rate gains with an order-of-magnitude reduction in planning time. Our results argue that latent world models should support not only prediction but reusable planning priors. Our code is available at https://github.com/hsiangwei0903/LeFlow.
summary_zh: 潜世界模型本身是性能优异的编码器，可将图像像素转换为潜空间嵌入，但现有世界模型仍依赖在线轨迹优化完成动作规划：针对每一组状态-目标对，都需要从零运行迭代优化器搜索最优动作序列，将世界模型视为黑盒模拟器。该方法在每一次重规划步骤都需要重新承担全部迭代优化成本，且无法跨查询复用规划经验。本研究探讨在潜世界模型训练完成后，规划过程本身能否实现 amortized（摊销化）优化。我们提出LeFlow（生成式潜流规划模型），可直接在世界模型的潜动力学空间中学习可复用的潜轨迹先验。LeFlow将规划重构为条件潜轨迹生成任务：整流流模型生成当前嵌入与目标嵌入之间的未来潜路径，逆动力学解码器将潜转换结果转换为动作块，冻结的世界模型通过自回归推演验证每一个候选方案。在4个主流的目标条件像素控制基准上，LeFlow用摊销化潜规划与固定预算推演选择替代了迭代动作空间优化，在实现一致的成功率提升的同时，将规划耗时降低了一个数量级。研究结果表明，潜世界模型不仅应当支持预测任务，还应当支撑可复用的规划先验。相关代码已开源至https://github.com/hsiangwei0903/LeFlow。

title: LAION-BVD: A 10-Million-Hour Open Video Dataset for Multimodal Pre-training
title_zh: LAION-BVD：面向多模态预训练的1000万小时开源视频数据集
authors: Andreas Hochlehnert, Marianna Nezhurina, Mehdi Cherti, Andrej Radonjic, Thadd\"aus Wiedemer, Christoph Schuhmann, Romain Beaumont, Wieland Brendel, Bernhard Sch\"olkopf, A. Sophia Koepke, Jenia Jitsev, Matthias Bethge
abstract: We present LAION-BVD, a large-scale open video dataset for multimodal learning, which contains 1.3B platform-specific video URLs collected from CommonCrawl. From these, we download 80M videos with a total duration of 10 million hours. The dataset is designed for multimodal pre-training across the video, audio, and image modalities. Using content-aware scene detection, we extract clips for which we synthetically generate video and audio captions. Models trained on these data achieve competitive performance on standard video-text and audio-text benchmarks, with consistent improvements as training or model scale increases. Additionally, we explore video frames as an alternative source of image-text data by extracting scene-changing frames. These frames exhibit a visual distribution distinct from standard web image corpora, and models trained on this dataset achieve strong image-text retrieval performance. We release LAION-BVD to the research community. It significantly expands open access to multimodal videos at an unprecedented scale.
summary_zh: 本文提出LAION-BVD，一个面向多模态学习的大规模开源视频数据集，包含从CommonCrawl（通用爬虫数据集）采集的13亿条平台专属视频URL。我们从中下载了8000万条视频，总时长达到1000万小时。该数据集专为跨视频、音频、图像模态的多模态预训练设计：通过内容感知场景检测提取视频片段，并为这些片段自动生成合成的视频与音频描述。基于该数据集训练的模型在标准视频-文本、音频-文本基准上取得了极具竞争力的性能，且性能随训练规模或模型规模的扩大持续提升。此外，我们通过提取场景切换帧，探索将视频帧作为图像-文本数据的替代来源：这些帧的视觉分布与标准网络图像语料存在明显差异，基于该数据集训练的模型在图像-文本检索任务上表现优异。我们向研究社区开放LAION-BVD数据集，该数据集以前所未有的规模大幅拓展了多模态视频的开放获取渠道。

title: EMFE: A lightweight, explainable machine learning framework for malaria cell classification
title_zh: EMFE：面向疟疾细胞分类的轻量可解释机器学习框架
authors: Md Abdullah Al Kafi, Walayat Hussain, Mousumi Karmakar, Sumit Kumar Banshal, Ahmed Al Marouf
abstract: Automated malaria diagnosis from stained blood-smear microscopy is dominated by deep convolutional neural networks that are accurate but computationally expensive, poorly interpretable, and rarely validated with patient-level rigor. We present EMFE (Efficient Mathematical Feature Extraction), a five-feature framework for classifying single red-blood-cell images as parasitized or uninfected using Gray World color normalization, adaptive green-channel thresholding, morphological spot detection, and classical machine learning. Using the NIH LHNCBC malaria dataset (27,558 images from 200 patients), we evaluate Random Forest, Histogram Gradient Boosting, and Support Vector Machine classifiers under patient-grouped nested cross-validation (K_outer=20, K_inner=3), ensuring that cells from each patient remain within a single fold. The optimized Random Forest achieves 94.6% pooled out-of-fold accuracy (95% CI [93.6, 95.7]), corroborated by an untouched 40-patient holdout test (94.3%) and a patient-level permutation test (p<0.001, 1,000 permutations). Ablation experiments quantify the contribution of individual features and pipeline stages. Hardware-matched comparisons with retrained DenseNet121, ResNet50, and MobileNetV2 models assess the accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Synthetic perturbations characterize three failure modes, while explainability analysis identifies spot saturation as the dominant discriminative feature. Patient-level aggregation further quantifies sensitivity-specificity trade-offs and false-positive accumulation. These results demonstrate a statistically rigorous, interpretable, and computationally lightweight alternative to deep learning, while explicitly quantifying its limitations.
summary_zh: 基于染色血涂片显微图像的自动疟疾诊断目前以深度卷积神经网络为主，这类方法精度高但计算成本高、可解释性差，且极少经过严格的患者级验证。本文提出EMFE（高效数学特征提取框架），一个包含5个特征的分类框架，可通过灰度世界颜色归一化、自适应绿色通道阈值分割、形态学斑点检测与经典机器学习方法，对单张红细胞图像完成是否被寄生虫感染的二分类。基于NIH LHNCBC疟疾数据集（包含来自200名患者的27558张图像），我们在患者分组嵌套交叉验证（外折数K_outer=20，内折数K_inner=3）设置下评估随机森林、直方图梯度提升与支持向量机分类器，确保同一患者的所有细胞样本仅属于单一折。优化后的随机森林模型实现了94.6%的合并折外精度（95%置信区间[93.6,95.7]），该结果在未参与训练的40名患者留出测试集（精度94.3%）与患者级置换检验（p<0.001，共1000次置换）中得到验证。消融实验量化了各特征与流水线各阶段的贡献。在硬件匹配条件下与重新训练的DenseNet121、ResNet50、MobileNetV2模型的对比，评估了方法的精度-效率权衡关系。通过合成扰动分析总结了三类故障模式，可解释性分析发现斑点饱和度是最核心的判别特征。患者级聚合进一步量化了灵敏度-特异度权衡与假阳性累积规律。上述结果表明，该框架是深度学习的统计严谨、可解释且计算轻量的替代方案，同时明确量化了其局限性。

title: MoE-based Feature Adapter for Prompt-free Binary Coronary Artery Segmentation in X-ray Angiography
title_zh: 基于MoE（混合专家模型）特征适配器的X线血管造影无提示冠状动脉二分类分割
authors: Lin Xi, Yingliang Ma
abstract: Accurate segmentation of coronary arteries in X-ray angiography videos is essential for quantitative coronary analysis and image-guided interventions. However, accurate segmentation remains challenging because coronary vessels are thin and exhibit low contrast, while the presence of catheters, guidewires, and complex anatomical background structures can further interfere with vessel delineation. Existing U-Net- and Transformer-based models provide strong baselines, but their shared feature-adaptation pathways may be insufficient for heterogeneous angiographic appearances. In this paper, we propose a prompt-free mixture-of-experts (MoE) feature adapter for binary coronary artery segmentation. Built upon parameter-efficient Vision Transformer adapters, the proposed method uses multiple lightweight experts with input-dependent top-$k$ routing to adaptively refine vessel-related features while limiting active computational cost. Experiments on MOSXAV and external evaluation on XACV show that the proposed method outperforms representative baselines and improves cross-dataset generalisation. These results suggest that MoE-based adapter learning is effective for robust coronary artery segmentation in X-ray angiography videos.
summary_zh: X线血管造影视频中冠状动脉的精准分割对冠状动脉定量分析与图像引导介入操作至关重要。但由于冠状动脉血管纤细、对比度低，同时导管、导丝与复杂解剖背景结构的存在会进一步干扰血管轮廓的提取，精准分割任务仍面临诸多挑战。现有基于U-Net与Transformer的模型提供了性能优异的基线方案，但其共享的特征适配路径难以适配异质性极强的血管造影外观。本文提出一种无需提示的MoE（混合专家）特征适配器，用于冠状动脉二分类分割。该方法基于参数高效的视觉Transformer适配器架构，采用多个轻量专家与输入依赖的top-k路由机制，在限制激活计算成本的前提下自适应优化血管相关特征。在MOSXAV基准上的实验与XACV数据集上的外部评估表明，所提方法性能优于代表性基线模型，且跨数据集泛化能力得到显著提升。研究结果表明，基于MoE的适配器学习方法可有效实现X线血管造影视频中鲁棒的冠状动脉分割。

title: Image Difference Quantification Using Autoencoder-Based Latent Representations
title_zh: 基于自编码器潜表征的图像差异量化方法
authors: Manish Sharma, Timothy Yim, Clifton Forlines
abstract: Traditional image similarity metrics such as Mean Squared Error (MSE), Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), and the Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) rely on pixel-level comparisons and often fail to capture perceptually meaningful differences between images. In contrast, latent representations learned by deep neural networks encode high-level semantic information that is more closely aligned with human visual perception. This paper proposes a convolutional autoencoder-based framework for quantifying image differences using cosine similarity in latent space. The learned compact embeddings enable robust differentiation between visually distinct images under variations in illumination, pose, and background. Extensive evaluation on dog-cat images and additional cross-domain datasets demonstrates clear class-wise clustering and strong inter-class separability in the latent space, with 98.4% of dog-cat image pairs exhibiting similarity scores below 0.5. Further validation using the TID2013 dataset shows that latent-space distance correlates positively with human Mean Opinion Scores (MOS), demonstrating sensitivity to perceptually relevant image distortions. The proposed approach provides a computationally efficient and semantically grounded alternative to conventional pixel-based similarity metrics, with potential applications in content-based retrieval, perceptual quality assessment, and semantic similarity analysis.
summary_zh: 传统图像相似性指标如MSE（均方误差）、PSNR（峰值信噪比）与SSIM（结构相似性指数）依赖像素级对比，通常无法捕捉图像之间符合人类感知的有效差异。与之相比，深度神经网络学习得到的潜表征编码了与人类视觉感知高度对齐的高层语义信息。本文提出一种基于卷积自编码器的框架，通过潜空间中的余弦相似性量化图像差异。学习得到的紧凑嵌入可在光照、姿态与背景变化条件下，对视觉上存在差异的图像实现鲁棒区分。在猫狗图像数据集与多个跨域数据集上的大量评估表明，潜空间中存在清晰的类内聚类与极强的类间可分性，98.4%的猫狗图像对的相似性得分低于0.5。基于TID2013数据集的进一步验证表明，潜空间距离与人类平均意见得分（MOS）呈正相关，对符合人类感知的图像失真高度敏感。所提方法是传统基于像素的相似性指标的计算高效、语义锚定的替代方案，可应用于基于内容的检索、感知质量评估与语义相似性分析等场景。

title: Ensemble of Convolutional Neural Networks for StrokePrediction: Towards Improved Diagnostic Accuracy
title_zh: 面向脑卒中预测的卷积神经网络集成方法：提升诊断准确率
authors: Md Shahriar Sajid
abstract: Brain stroke, known for its high mortality and incidence rates, poses significant health risks and requires rapid intervention for survival. Early diagnosis and preventive measures can greatly reduce life loss and disabilities. Recent advancements in deep learning have led to novel computer-aided diagnostic techniques for early stroke detection. This study proposes an intelligent system that predicts potential strokes using eleven features, evaluated through seven supervised machine learning algorithms. The process includes a literature review, dataset visualization, data preprocessing, and model evaluation. Ensemble methods like Random Forest, Stacking Classifier, and Bagging Classifier achieved high accuracies of 99.52%, while Decision Tree reached 98.24%. Other models, including KNN and TabNet, demonstrated reliable performance, achieving accuracies of 96.73% and 96.49%, respectively. The custom feedforward model achieved 94.91%, while SVC and logistic regression had lower accuracies at 88.06% and 77.03%. The results highlight the effectiveness of ensemble methods in stroke classification.
summary_zh: 脑卒中具有高死亡率与高发病率的特点，会带来严重的健康风险，只有快速干预才能提升患者生存率。早期诊断与预防性干预可大幅降低死亡与残疾风险。深度学习领域的最新进展催生了用于脑卒中早期检测的新型计算机辅助诊断技术。本研究提出一种智能系统，基于11项特征预测潜在脑卒中风险，通过7种监督机器学习算法完成评估。研究流程包括文献综述、数据集可视化、数据预处理与模型评估。随机森林、堆叠分类器与装袋分类器等集成方法实现了99.52%的高准确率，决策树模型准确率达到98.24%。KNN与TabNet等其他模型也表现出可靠性能，准确率分别为96.73%与96.49%。自定义前馈模型准确率为94.91%，而支持向量分类器与逻辑回归的准确率相对较低，分别为88.06%与77.03%。研究结果验证了集成方法在脑卒中分类任务中的有效性。

title: Score-Based Ideal Observer Approximation via Denoising Score Matching for Signal-Known-Exactly Detection Tasks
title_zh: 面向精确已知信号检测任务的基于去噪得分匹配的理想观测者近似方法
authors: Weimin Zhou
abstract: The Bayesian Ideal Observer (IO) establishes the theoretical upper bound on task performance for binary detection tasks. However, analytical computation of the IO test statistic is generally intractable. Numerical approaches based on Markov-chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods, including their recent deep generative model-based extensions, typically require extensive posterior sampling for each test image. Supervised learning has also been investigated to approximate the IO performance. However, such methods are typically trained for a specific detection task and signal and may require retraining when the task or signal changes. The score function, defined as the gradient of the log probability density, encodes the local geometry of the data distribution and is a fundamental quantity in modern score-based generative modeling. This work reformulates the IO test statistic in terms of the score function and introduces a score-based ideal observer (SIO). The proposed SIO uses a denoising convolutional neural network trained exclusively on signal-absent images to estimate the signal-absent score function. Once trained, the resulting score model can be used to approximate the IO test statistic for detection tasks involving arbitrary additive signals, without per-image posterior sampling or signal-specific retraining. Numerical studies consider a signal-known-exactly (SKE) detection task with a stochastic lumpy-background model. The results demonstrate that the proposed SIO can closely approximate the IO performance.
summary_zh: 贝叶斯理想观测者（IO）定义了二分类检测任务的理论性能上界，但IO检验统计量的解析计算通常难以实现。基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）的数值方法（包括近年基于深度生成模型的扩展方法）通常需要为每一张测试图像执行大量后验采样。现有研究也探索了通过监督学习近似IO性能的方案，但这类方法通常针对特定检测任务与信号训练，当任务或信号发生变化时需要重新训练。得分函数定义为对数概率密度的梯度，编码了数据分布的局部几何特征，是现代基于得分的生成建模中的核心要素。本研究基于得分函数重构IO检验统计量，提出基于得分的理想观测者（SIO）。所提SIO使用仅在无信号图像上训练的去噪卷积神经网络估计无信号得分函数。训练完成后，该得分模型可用于近似任意加性信号检测任务的IO检验统计量，无需逐张图像执行后验采样，也无需针对特定信号重新训练。数值研究采用随机块状背景模型完成精确已知信号（SKE）检测任务，结果表明所提SIO可高度近似IO的性能表现。

title: MoTE: Mixture of Task Experts for Multi-Task Video Understanding
title_zh: MoTE（任务专家混合模型）：面向多任务视频理解的任务专家混合架构
authors: Muhammad Asad Ali, Umar Khan, Nadia Robertini, Didier Stricker
abstract: Procedural video-language models must solve heterogeneous tasks from the same visual evidence, including action recognition, forecasting, and procedure prediction. Dense transformer decoders share the same feed-forward networks across tasks, which can entangle task behavior and make controlled capability expansion difficult. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) decoders provide conditional computation, but token-level learned routing is not naturally aligned with task-level procedural objectives. We propose MoTE (Mixture of Task Experts), a decoder architecture that converts large language model feed-forward networks into task-specific experts while keeping the multimodal backbone shared. Each example follows one sample-level task route, so active task-expert computation remains independent of the number of stored task experts. We instantiate this design as VideoLLM-MoTE and evaluate it on five COIN benchmarks using explicit task routes. The five-expert model activates ~2B LLM parameters per sample and achieves higher average top-1 accuracy than recent VideoLLM baselines. Under the same expert topology, it improves over dense all-expert activation and learned sparse-routing controls. These results show that task-structured routing provides an interpretable and compute-efficient decoder alternative for multi-task video-language learning.
summary_zh: 过程式视频-语言模型需要基于同一视觉证据完成动作识别、预测、过程推理等异质性任务。密集Transformer解码器在所有任务间共享相同的前馈网络，会导致任务行为相互纠缠，难以实现可控的能力扩展。稀疏混合专家（MoE）解码器可提供条件计算能力，但在令牌层级学习得到的路由机制天然无法与任务级的过程式目标对齐。本文提出MoTE（任务专家混合模型），一种将大语言模型前馈网络转换为任务专属专家、同时保持多模态骨干网络共享的解码器架构。每一个样本仅遵循一条样本级任务路由，因此激活的任务专家计算量与存储的任务专家总数无关。我们基于该架构实现了VideoLLM-MoTE，在5个COIN基准上使用显式任务路由完成评估。包含5个专家的模型为每个样本激活约20亿个大语言模型参数，相比近年的VideoLLM基线模型实现了更高的平均top-1准确率。在相同专家拓扑下，该模型的性能优于全专家激活的密集模型与基于学习的稀疏路由对照模型。研究结果表明，任务结构化路由是面向多任务视频-语言学习的可解释、计算高效的解码器替代方案。

title: IDeaL: Data-Free Multi-Teacher Distillation via Improved Dead Leaves
title_zh: IDeaL：基于改进死叶（Dead Leaves）模型的无数据多教师蒸馏
authors: Feyza Yavuz, Mert B\"ulent Sar{\i}y{\i}ld{\i}z, Diane Larlus
abstract: Multi-teacher distillation has emerged as a way to combine complementary teacher models into a single student model that exhibits the strengths of all its teachers. The student is trained to mimic the output of the teachers on a set of images, typically the union of the individual teacher's training sets, assuming this data is available. In this paper, we question that assumption and explore alternative options. We first study how far one can go when distilling from teachers fed with different types of noise. Then, we show that information contained in the teachers can be leveraged to tailor the noise for multi-teacher distillation: we propose a method that, thanks to decorrelation losses at both patch and image levels, generates teacher-specific, improved samples optimized for data-free distillation. Experiments show that our most effective samples, IDeaL, lead to strong students that successfully capture complementary information from the teachers, yielding surprisingly competitive results that substantially narrow the gap with students distilled from real images. Moreover, given a limited budget of 1K images for distillation, students distilled using our IDeaL samples match or surpass the performance of those distilled using a 1K-image subset of ImageNet.
summary_zh: 多教师蒸馏可将多个互补的教师模型整合为单个学生模型，使学生模型继承所有教师的优势。现有方法通常假设可获取用于训练的图像集（一般为各教师训练集的并集），学生通过在该数据集上模拟教师的输出完成训练。本文对该假设提出质疑并探索替代方案：首先研究向教师输入不同类型噪声时蒸馏效果的上限，随后证明可利用教师模型包含的信息为多教师蒸馏定制噪声分布，进而提出一种新方法——通过图像块和图像两个层级的去相关损失，生成针对无数据蒸馏优化的、适配不同教师的改进样本。实验表明，本文生成的最优样本IDeaL可训练出性能优异的学生模型，成功提取多个教师的互补信息，得到的结果极具竞争力，大幅缩小了与使用真实图像蒸馏得到的学生模型的性能差距。此外，在仅使用1000张图像的蒸馏预算下，采用IDeaL样本训练的学生模型性能与使用1000张ImageNet子集蒸馏的模型相当甚至更优。

title: Weakly Supervised Seafloor Segmentation for Seagrass Habitat Mapping in Side-Scan Sonar Imagery
title_zh: 面向侧扫声呐图像海草栖息地制图的弱监督海底分割方法
authors: Hayat Rajani, Nuno Gracias, Rafael Garcia
abstract: Seagrass meadows are crucial blue-carbon habitats, and mapping their extent is a prerequisite for coastal management and carbon inventory. Optical satellite sensors cover large areas but cannot reach deep or turbid water, whereas side-scan sonar (SSS) images the seabed at high resolution and at any depth. Interpreting SSS, however, still relies on dense manual annotation, which is slow and costly. We address this by adapting a weakly supervised semantic segmentation framework to SSS benthic habitat mapping, so that pixel-level maps are learned from image-level labels alone. The framework couples a ViT-based encoder-decoder with a classification branch, extracts class activation maps, and refines them into pseudo-labels with a dense conditional random field that we tune for the noise and weak boundaries of acoustic imagery. It follows an iterative self-training scheme, together with a sampling strategy to cope with the strong class imbalance of the data. We also study the effect of different loss functions on segmentation quality, finding Lov\'asz-Softmax loss the most effective. On a held-out transect, the refined pseudo-labels reached an mIoU of 89.3\% against the ground truth, and the segmentation branch, trained without any pixel-level labels, reached 87.6\%. Self-supervised pretraining on unlabelled SSS added a further 3\% in mean intersection-over-union. Field trials further demonstrate the generalizability of the trained model. These results show that accurate and label-efficient benthic habitat mapping from side-scan sonar is feasible at the scale needed for coast-wide seagrass monitoring.
summary_zh: 海草床是至关重要的蓝碳栖息地，明确其分布范围是海岸带管理和碳储量核算的前提。光学卫星传感器可覆盖大范围区域，但无法穿透深水或浑浊水体；而侧扫声呐（Side-Scan Sonar, SSS）可在任意深度下获取高分辨率海底图像。但侧扫声呐图像的解译目前仍依赖人工逐像素标注，效率低且成本高。针对该问题，本文将弱监督语义分割框架适配到侧扫声呐海底栖息地制图场景，仅使用图像级标签即可训练得到像素级分割结果。该框架采用基于视觉Transformer（ViT）的编解码器结构并耦合分类分支，提取类激活图后，使用针对声学图像噪声和弱边界特性优化的稠密条件随机场将其细化为伪标签，同时采用迭代自训练方案和采样策略解决数据的严重类别不平衡问题。本文还研究了不同损失函数对分割质量的影响，发现Lovász-Softmax损失的效果最优。在预留的测线数据集上，细化后的伪标签与真值的平均交并比（mIoU）达89.3%，完全不使用像素级标签训练的分割分支mIoU达87.6%；在未标注侧扫声呐数据上进行自监督预训练可进一步将mIoU提升3%。野外试验进一步验证了训练后模型的泛化能力。上述结果表明，该方法可在覆盖全海岸海草监测所需的尺度下，实现高精度、低标注成本的侧扫声呐海底栖息地制图。

title: TorchMorph: CUDA-accelerated Morphological Transforms
title_zh: TorchMorph：支持CUDA加速的形态学变换库
authors: Kai Zhao
abstract: Morphological transforms are long-standing tools for shape and mask processing, but the de facto reference implementation in the Python ecosystem, i.e. scipy.ndimage, is CPU-only, single-array, and therefore unusable inside a GPU training loop without an expensive device-to-host round trip. GPU vision libraries built on PyTorch cover a narrow subset of these operators, typically restricted to two spatial dimensions and flat structuring elements. We present TorchMorph, a lightweight PyTorch extension that closes this gap. TorchMorph exposes 22 public operators covering binary morphology, greyscale morphology, exact and approximate distance transforms, and entropy-regularised optimal transport, all implemented as fused CUDA kernels that operate directly on (B, C, Spatial...) CUDA tensors with up to eight spatial dimensions. The API deliberately mirrors scipy.ndimage argument-for-argument, including border modes, structuring-element origins and pre-allocated outputs, so that existing pipelines port with a change of import. We describe the layered architecture and the kernel designs behind each operator family. Against single-threaded CPU references, batched execution reaches up to 1.1e3 times the throughput of scipy.ndimage on greyscale morphology and up to 350x on exact Euclidean distance transforms, while the Sinkhorn solver runs up to 42x faster than POT. Binary and chamfer operators reproduce their SciPy counterparts exactly, and every float-valued operator agrees with the CPU reference to within 1.8e-6 absolute error. TorchMorph is released under the MIT licence at https://intcomp.github.io/tm.
summary_zh: 形态学变换是形状和掩码处理领域的经典工具，但Python生态中的事实标准实现scipy.ndimage仅支持CPU运算、单数组处理，若要在GPU训练循环中调用，必须进行开销极大的设备-主机数据往返传输。基于PyTorch构建的GPU视觉库仅覆盖了形态学算子的一小部分，通常局限于二维空间和扁平结构元。本文提出TorchMorph，一款轻量级PyTorch扩展库，填补了这一空白。TorchMorph提供22个公开算子，覆盖二值形态学、灰度形态学、精确与近似距离变换、熵正则化最优传输，所有算子均以融合CUDA内核实现，可直接处理维度最高达8维空间的(B, C, 空间维度)格式CUDA张量。其API在参数层面完全对齐scipy.ndimage，包括边界模式、结构元原点、预分配输出等设置，现有工作流仅需修改导入语句即可完成迁移。本文还介绍了各算子系列的分层架构和内核设计。与单线程CPU参考实现相比，批处理模式下灰度形态学的吞吐量最高可达scipy.ndimage的1100倍，精确欧氏距离变换最高可达350倍，Sinkhorn求解器的运行速度比POT库快42倍。其二值算子和倒角算子与SciPy的对应实现结果完全一致，所有浮点算子与CPU参考实现的绝对误差均低于1.8e-6。TorchMorph基于MIT许可证开源，项目地址为https://intcomp.github.io/tm。

title: Interpretable Fundus Image Classification via Ring-Based Retinal Vasculature Features
title_zh: 基于环结构视网膜血管特征的可解释眼底图像分类
authors: Xiaoyan Li, Shixin Xu, Arvind Gupta, Huaxiong Huang
abstract: Retinal fundus photography is widely used for screening and monitoring ocular diseases, but many modern classification pipelines rely on deep latent representations and provide limited interpretability. This study develops an interpretable fundus image classification framework based on a ring-structured representation of the retinal vasculature centered on the optic disc. The method quantifies vessel geometry, color appearance, oxygenation-related vascular appearance, and vessel--background entropy within concentric retinal regions. These physiologically motivated descriptors are derived from vessel masks, image intensities, and optical-density measurements and aggregated across rings to capture spatial variation in vascular properties. Using only quantitative vascular descriptors, the proposed method achieved strong classification performance across three public fundus datasets. On HRF, it achieved 91.1\% accuracy using automatically generated vessel masks, matching RETFound, a vision transformer pretrained on large-scale retinal fundus image data, under the same evaluation setting. Additional analyses suggest that pretrained image models are sensitive to acquisition-related spatial cues, including fundus scale and retinal position within the field of view, as well as broader non-vessel image characteristics. This framework may support interpretable disease classification, quantitative retinal phenotyping, and retinal biomarker discovery without requiring large task-specific training datasets.
summary_zh: 视网膜眼底摄影被广泛用于眼部疾病的筛查和监测，但现有多数分类流程依赖深度隐层表示，可解释性极差。本研究提出一种以视盘为中心、基于视网膜血管环结构表示的可解释眼底图像分类框架。该方法在视网膜同心区域内量化血管几何形态、颜色外观、与氧合相关的血管特征以及血管-背景熵值，这些符合生理机制的描述符从血管掩码、图像强度和光密度测量结果中提取，在不同环区域聚合以捕捉血管属性的空间变化。仅使用定量血管描述符，本文提出的方法在三个公开眼底数据集上均取得了优异的分类性能：在HRF数据集上，使用自动生成的血管掩码达到91.1%的准确率，与在大规模视网膜眼底图像数据上预训练的视觉Transformer模型RETFound在相同评估设置下的性能持平。进一步分析表明，预训练图像模型对采集相关的空间线索（包括眼底尺度、视野内的视网膜位置）以及非血管的全局图像特征较为敏感。该框架无需大规模任务专属训练数据集，即可支撑可解释的疾病分类、定量视网膜表型分析和视网膜生物标志物挖掘工作。

title: Deep Learning Super Resolution for Satellite Cloud Mask Downscaling
title_zh: 面向卫星云掩码降尺度的深度学习超分辨率方法
authors: Angelos Georgakis, Valentina Kanaki, Giorgos Giannopoulos, Stella Girtsou, Ioannis Kontogiorgakis, Charalampos Kontoes, Kostas Philippopoulos
abstract: A vast amount of optical satellite data is being transmitted to Earth-based servers every day, and more than half of this data is affected by haze or clouds. Additionally, this data suffers from the fundamental trade-off between spatial and temporal resolution, which remains largely unresolved, making the acquisition of continuous high-resolution satellite observations of clouds an ongoing challenge. This work addresses this challenge by proposing two Deep Learning super-resolution methods for the accurate downscaling of SEVIRI cloud mask products, as well as a novel cross-sensor cloud mask dataset called SEVMOD-CM, created by spatially and temporally matching MODIS and SEVIRI satellite observations. The two proposed models are a CNN-based (SpatialCNN) and a GAN-based (SpatialGAN) Neural Network. Trained on the SEVIRI spectral and cloud mask products, the proposed methods predict the corresponding MODIS Cloud masks, achieving a 4x spatial enhancement across sensor domains. Both approaches are evaluated experimentally, and compared against the standard bicubic interpolation upsampling technique. The experimental results demonstrate the value of the proposed models and dataset for the remote sensing community, highlighting the benefits of applying super-resolution techniques to geostationary-derived cloud mask products for applications such as atmospheric monitoring, weather forecasting, disaster risk reduction, solar energy forecasting, and climate research.
summary_zh: 每天有海量光学卫星数据下传到地面服务器，其中超过一半的数据受雾霾或云的影响。此外，这类数据普遍存在空间分辨率与时间分辨率的固有矛盾，该问题至今未得到有效解决，导致获取连续的高分辨率云观测数据始终面临挑战。针对该问题，本文提出两种深度学习超分辨率方法，可实现SEVIRI云掩码产品的高精度降尺度，同时构建了全新的跨传感器云掩码数据集SEVMOD-CM，该数据集通过时空匹配MODIS和SEVIRI卫星观测结果生成。提出的两个模型分别为基于卷积神经网络的SpatialCNN和基于生成对抗网络的SpatialGAN，在SEVIRI光谱和云掩码产品上训练后可预测对应的MODIS云掩码，实现跨传感器域4倍空间分辨率提升。本文对两种方法开展了实验评估，并与标准双三次插值上采样技术进行对比。实验结果证明了所提模型和数据集对遥感领域的应用价值，验证了将超分辨率技术应用于地球静止卫星云掩码产品，可有效支撑大气监测、天气预报、灾害风险防控、太阳能发电预测和气候研究等场景。

title: Game2World Engine: Unlocking In-the-Wild Gameplay Videos for World Model Training
title_zh: Game2World引擎：解锁野外游戏玩法视频用于世界模型训练
authors: Wenxuan Shen, Dongna Jin, Dongping Chen
abstract: Video games provide a scalable source of training data for video world models, offering diverse environments, complex interactions, and abundant in-the-wild gameplay videos. However, raw gameplay footage entangles the game world with screen-space interfaces, introducing game-specific biases and irrelevant dynamics that hinder world-model training. To address this problem, we introduce GameUI-Taxonomy and G2WEngine, a full-stack framework that formalizes gameplay UI grounding and removal. G2WEngine automatically extracts reusable UI assets from real gameplay videos and synthesizes temporally coherent UI overlays on clean footage. Using this engine, we construct Game2World, comprising 96K synthetic paired videos with precise reconstruction targets and 1,079 in-the-wild clips from 303 games for realistic evaluation. Its asset library contains 5,132 verified UI elements across 21 taxonomy categories, collected from 1,010 representative gameplay frames. Based on Game2World, we propose GameCleaner, a mask-free gameplay UI removal model that combines multimodal semantic understanding with video editing capabilities. Unlike mask-based methods, GameCleaner directly identifies and removes diverse HUD elements while preserving the underlying scene content and temporal dynamics. In a controlled pilot, world models trained on UI-free gameplay improve overall VideoReward by 6.83% over those trained on UI-overlaid data. On UI-removal evaluation, GameCleaner achieves an average AAR of 95.36 on synthetic videos, outperforming the strongest temporal mask baseline by 57.3%, and obtains the best in-the-wild AAR of 80.05 with 99.8 background preservation. These results demonstrate the scalable potential of transforming Internet gameplay videos into high-quality world-model training data. Code, dataset, and model will be available at https://github.com/Dongping-Chen/Game2World.
summary_zh: 电子游戏可为视频世界模型提供可规模化的训练数据源，包含多样化的环境、复杂的交互行为和海量的野外游戏玩法视频。但原始游戏画面将游戏世界与屏幕界面元素混杂在一起，引入了大量游戏专属偏差和无关动态，会阻碍世界模型的训练效果。针对该问题，本文提出GameUI-Taxonomy分类体系和G2WEngine全栈框架，对游戏玩法的UI（用户界面）定位与移除任务进行规范化定义。G2WEngine可从真实游戏玩法视频中自动提取可复用的UI资源，并在干净的游戏画面上合成时间维度连贯的UI叠加层。基于该引擎，本文构建了Game2World数据集，包含9.6万组带精确重建目标的合成配对视频，以及来自303款游戏的1079段野外真实片段用于真实场景评估。其资源库包含从1010个代表性游戏帧中收集的、分属21个分类的5132个经过验证的UI元素。基于Game2World数据集，本文进一步提出GameCleaner，一款无需掩码的游戏UI移除模型，融合多模态语义理解与视频编辑能力。与基于掩码的方法不同，GameCleaner可直接识别并移除各类平视显示元素（HUD），同时保留底层场景内容和时间动态。在对照实验中，使用无UI游戏画面训练的世界模型，整体VideoReward指标比使用叠加UI数据训练的模型提升6.83%。在UI移除任务评估中，GameCleaner在合成视频上的平均AAR指标达95.36，比最优的时序掩码基线方法性能高57.3%，在野外真实片段上的AAR达80.05，背景保留率达99.8%。上述结果证明，将互联网游戏玩法视频转化为高质量世界模型训练数据具备可规模化落地的潜力。相关代码、数据集和模型将开源至https://github.com/Dongping-Chen/Game2World。

title: TurboT2VA: Fast Large-Scale Text-to-Video-Audio Generation via Score-Regularized Consistency Distillation
title_zh: TurboT2VA：基于分数正则化一致性蒸馏的快速大规模文本-视频-音频生成
authors: Xiaoda Yang, Yuxiang Liu, Kaiwen Zheng, Yuan Liu, Yibo Lai, Shengpeng Ji, Kai Jiang, Jianfei Chen, Xiaobin Hu, Shuicheng Yan, Jintao Zhang, Jun Zhu, Zhou Zhao
abstract: Joint text-to-video-audio generation produces synchronized visual and acoustic content, but the long sampling trajectories and heterogeneous multimodal computation of large models make inference prohibitively expensive. We present TurboT2VA, a distillation and inference framework for accelerating a 19B-parameter joint video-audio model. Large-scale T2VA distillation is challenged by modality-imbalanced optimization, the difficulty of continuous-time consistency training at scale, and the quality--diversity trade-off. TurboT2VA addresses these issues with per-modality normalization and a progressive curriculum comprising discrete consistency warm-up, continuous consistency refinement, and joint consistency--distribution matching. The curriculum first establishes a stable, diverse generation trajectory and only then introduces distribution-level refinement. On LTX-2, four-step distillation reduces generator latency from 50.52s to 2.51s at the standard evaluation resolution of 512$\times$768, achieving a 20.1$\times$ speedup while maintaining strong visual quality, audio fidelity, diversity, and video-audio synchronization. We further develop an architecture-aware inference stack that combines guarded W8A8 and fused operators, padded-text compaction, and modality-aware sparse attention while preserving dense cross-modal and text-conditioning paths. Under the high-resolution deployment setting at 1024$\times$1792, the complete stack reduces generator latency from 318.74s to 5.83s on one NVIDIA H20, achieving a 54.67$\times$ generator-only speedup. Inference code and generation demos are available at https://github.com/thu-ml/TurboDiffusion/tree/main/turbot2va.
summary_zh: 文本-视频-音频联合生成可输出音视频同步的内容，但大模型的长采样轨迹和异构多模态计算特性导致推理成本极高。本文提出TurboT2VA，一款蒸馏与推理框架，用于加速参数量达190亿的音视频联合生成模型。大规模文本-视频-音频（T2VA）蒸馏面临三大挑战：模态不平衡优化、大规模连续时间一致性训练难度大、质量与多样性难以兼顾。TurboT2VA通过分模态归一化和递进式课程学习方案解决上述问题，课程学习流程依次包含离散一致性预热、连续一致性优化、一致性-分布匹配联合优化三个阶段，先建立稳定且多样化的生成轨迹，再引入分布层面的细化优化。在LTX-2数据集上，在标准评估分辨率512×768下，4步蒸馏可将生成器延迟从50.52秒降至2.51秒，实现20.1倍的加速，同时保持优异的视觉质量、音频保真度、生成多样性和音视频同步性。本文进一步开发了架构感知推理栈，融合防护式W8A8量化、融合算子、填充文本压缩、模态感知稀疏注意力技术，同时保留完整的跨模态路径和文本条件路径。在1024×1792的高分辨率部署场景下，在单张NVIDIA H20显卡上，完整推理栈可将生成器延迟从318.74秒降至5.83秒，仅生成器部分的加速比达54.67倍。推理代码和生成演示已开源至https://github.com/thu-ml/TurboDiffusion/tree/main/turbot2va。

title: ReGround-Surg: Reliability-Guided Anchor Grounding for Referring Surgical Video Segmentation
title_zh: ReGround-Surg：面向参考手术视频分割的可靠性引导锚定框架
authors: Jiaxin Wen, Ming Yin, Lu Liu, Zeyu Fu
abstract: Referring surgical video segmentation requires segmenting a target instrument or tissue region across video frames according to a natural language expression. Recent Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) based two-stage methods (e.g., ReSurgSAM2) first ground the referred target in an initial or selected frame, then propagate the selected mask via tracking. Although effective, their performance is highly sensitive to the quality of the initial grounded mask: once an incorrect anchor is selected, subsequent tracking tends to propagate the error. This issue is especially challenging in surgical videos due to visually similar instruments, occlusion, and complex tissue-tool interactions. To address this issue, we propose ReGround-Surg, a lightweight reliability-guided anchor grounding framework to improve SAM2-based referring surgical video segmentation. It first predicts a text-conditioned spatial reliability map from the referring expression and current-frame visual features. The map is then reused in two complementary branches: a Gated Side Adapter enhances expression-relevant visual regions before text-to-vision fusion, while a Reliability-Weighted Vision-to-Text Attention module suppresses off-target visual evidence during prompt-token aggregation. Experiments on Ref-EndoVis17 and Ref-EndoVis18 show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods across three evaluation splits with negligible speed reduction. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/JiaxinWen1/ReGround-Surg.
summary_zh: 参考手术视频分割任务要求根据自然语言描述，在视频帧序列中分割出目标器械或组织区域。近期基于Segment Anything Model 2（SAM2）的两阶段方法（如ReSurgSAM2）先在初始帧或选定帧中定位描述对应的目标，再通过掩码传播得到后续帧的分割结果。这类方法虽然有效，但性能高度依赖初始定位掩码的质量：一旦选中错误的锚点，后续跟踪过程会持续传播误差。手术视频中器械视觉特征相似、存在遮挡、组织与器械交互复杂，进一步放大了该问题的影响。针对该问题，本文提出ReGround-Surg，一款轻量级可靠性引导锚定框架，用于提升基于SAM2的参考手术视频分割性能。该框架首先根据参考表达式和当前帧的视觉特征预测文本条件空间可靠性图，该可靠性图在两个互补分支中复用：门控侧适配器在文本-视觉融合前增强与描述相关的视觉区域，可靠性加权视觉-文本注意力模块则在聚合提示令牌时抑制偏离目标的视觉证据。在Ref-EndoVis17和Ref-EndoVis18数据集上的实验表明，该方法在三个评估划分下均比现有最优方法取得一致的性能提升，且推理速度几乎没有下降。代码已开源至https://github.com/JiaxinWen1/ReGround-Surg。

title: On-Policy Self-Distillation in Diffusion Models
title_zh: 扩散模型中的同策略自蒸馏
authors: Wei Zhou, Xiongwei Zhu, Lingdong Kong, Bo Chen, Lei Zhang, Yongyuan Liang, Xiaoxia Hou, Ye Tian, Xian Sun, Yingshuo Wang, Linfeng Li, Shengqiong Wu, Leigang Qu, Feng Li, Wei Liu, Julian McAuley, Tat-Seng Chua
abstract: Reinforcement learning can align diffusion models with human preferences and task-specific objectives, but endpoint rewards do not specify how an intermediate denoising prediction should change. We introduce DiffusionOPSD as an on-policy self-distillation framework that converts image-level reward guidance into explicit targets for clean-output predictions at sampled queries. At each outer iteration, a frozen behavior policy generates trajectories and supplies query states and anchors. Reward gradients construct bounded positive and negative targets around each anchor. The trainable policy fits these targets as detached supervision through finite fitting before an exponential moving average update refreshes the behavior policy. This setup lets us measure target construction and finite realization separately. Controlled same-query experiments show that larger target-construction gains do not necessarily translate into larger realized gains after a single fitting update. Across SD 3.5-M and the step-distilled Z-Image-Turbo, our approach achieves the best final held-out scores in 19 of 20 reward-matched settings across two backbones and ten evaluators. It outperforms the strongest competing method by up to 44.0% and reduces training GPU-hours relative to DiffusionNFT by 40% on SD 3.5-M and 63% on Z-Image-Turbo. These results support on-policy self-distillation as an efficient and analyzable approach to diffusion post-training by converting image-level reward guidance into explicit and continually refreshed intermediate supervision, thereby opening a path toward more efficient and diagnosable alignment.
summary_zh: 强化学习可将扩散模型与人类偏好和任务特定目标对齐，但端点奖励无法明确指示中间去噪预测应当如何调整。本文提出DiffusionOPSD，一种同策略自蒸馏框架，将图像级奖励引导转化为采样查询点下干净输出预测的显式目标。每次外层迭代中，冻结的行为策略生成轨迹并提供查询状态和锚点，奖励梯度在每个锚点周围构建有界的正负目标，可训练策略通过有限次拟合将这些目标作为独立监督信号学习，之后通过指数移动平均更新刷新行为策略。该设置可将目标构建过程和有限拟合过程的效果分开度量。控制变量的同查询实验表明，单次拟合更新后，目标构建阶段的增益并不一定能完全转化为最终的性能增益。在SD 3.5-M和经过步蒸馏的Z-Image-Turbo两个骨干模型上，本文方法在20个奖励匹配设置中的19个上取得了最优的留出集得分，性能比最优对比方法最高高出44.0%，与DiffusionNFT相比，在SD 3.5-M上训练GPU耗时降低40%，在Z-Image-Turbo上降低63%。上述结果证明，同策略自蒸馏是一种高效、可分析的扩散模型后训练方法，通过将图像级奖励引导转化为显式且持续更新的中间监督信号，为实现更高效、可诊断的模型对齐提供了新路径。

title: Towards Reliable AI-Based Histological Staining: A Systematic Study of Scaling and Uncertainty in Unpaired Generative Models
title_zh: 面向可靠人工智能组织学染色：非配对生成模型的缩放与不确定性系统性研究
authors: Qasim Siddiqui, Adrian Friebel, Maiju Myllys, Zaynab Hobloss, Daniela Gonzalez, Ahmed Ghallab, Stefan Hoehme
abstract: Liver fibrosis, the principal predictor of long-term outcome in chronic liver disease, is staged from histological estimates of collagen content. Sirius Red (SR) provides the standard quantitative readout (collagen proportionate area, CPA) but is not acquired at every clinical centre and consumes tissue, time, and reagent cost beyond the routine Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) stain. AI-based virtual staining can generate SR directly from H&E, yet systematic benchmarks of unsupervised models are scarce and their predictive uncertainty has not been quantified, even though visually plausible outputs may not faithfully reproduce the underlying tissue structure. We therefore benchmark six unsupervised image-to-image architectures (GAN-based and diffusion-based) across 54 scaling configurations on a newly released paired H&E to SR mouse liver dataset, the first open resource for this translation task. Each configuration is evaluated jointly on perceptual, distributional, and task-specific axes plus a blinded expert reader study; the best per family is then retrained as a deep ensemble, the first systematic comparison of epistemic uncertainty across unsupervised stain-to-stain architectures. Across families, perceptual quality, task-specific error, and ensemble agreement measure largely independent axes of model fitness: GAN-based methods cluster tightly on perceptual metrics yet differ substantially on task error and ensemble agreement, while the diffusion-based method (CycleDiffusion) is qualitatively different on all three. No single metric captures these differences, so reliable virtual staining requires reporting and selecting on all three jointly. The dataset, tiling pipeline, models, and evaluation code are released publicly.
summary_zh: 肝纤维化是慢性肝病长期预后的核心预测指标，其分期通过组织学胶原含量评估确定。天狼星红（Sirius Red, SR）染色可提供标准的定量读数（胶原比例面积，CPA），但并非所有临床中心都能开展该染色流程，且相比常规苏木精-伊红（Hematoxylin and eosin, H&E）染色，其会消耗更多组织样本、时间和试剂成本。基于人工智能的虚拟染色技术可直接从H&E染色切片生成SR染色结果，但目前针对无监督模型的系统性基准研究十分匮乏，其预测不确定性也未得到量化——即便视觉上看似合理的输出，也可能无法忠实还原底层组织结构。为此，本文在新发布的配对H&E-SR小鼠肝脏数据集（该任务首个公开资源）上，对6种无监督图像到图像架构（包含基于GAN和基于扩散的两类）的54种缩放配置开展基准测试。所有配置均从感知质量、分布一致性、任务特定性能三个维度联合评估，同时辅以双盲专家阅片研究；每类架构中性能最优的模型进一步训练为深度集成模型，这也是首个针对无监督染色迁移架构认知不确定性的系统性对比研究。研究发现，感知质量、任务特定误差、集成一致性是表征模型性能的三个几乎相互独立的维度：基于GAN的方法在感知指标上分布高度集中，但在任务误差和集成一致性上差异极大；而基于扩散的方法CycleDiffusion在三个维度上的表现均与前者存在显著差异。没有任何单一指标可以捕捉这些差异，因此可靠的虚拟染色需要同时基于三个维度的指标进行评估和筛选。本研究的数据集、切片分块流程、模型和评估代码均已公开。

title: Comparative Assessment of Deep Learning Architectures for Underwater Subsurface Kelp Forest Segmentation with The Kelp-o-Tron
title_zh: 基于Kelp-o-Tron的水下次表层海带林分割深度学习架构对比评估
authors: Sundarabalan Balasubramanian, C\'esar Borja, Ana C. Murillo, Lexi N. Wilkes, Meredith L. McPherson, Kira A. Krumhansl, Jennifer A. Dijkstra, Jarrett E. K. Byrnes
abstract: Submerged kelp forests are vital coastal ecosystems that support marine biodiversity and ecosystem dynamics, yet accurate underwater kelp segmentation remains challenging due to optical degradation, illumination variability, turbidity, overlapping vegetation, and complex benthic backgrounds. We systematically evaluated three deep learning semantic segmentation frameworks, ResNet34-U-Net, ResNet50-DeepLabV3, and a hybrid ResNet50-ASPP-Transformer architecture, for kelp detection using high-resolution underwater RGB imagery collected from northeastern U.S. coastal waters. A dataset of 3,395 SSeg assisted annotated image-mask pairs was developed for model training and validation, while geographically independent sites were used for quantitative and qualitative evaluation. All models used consistent preprocessing, augmentation, and evaluation protocols. On independent test data, ResNet50-DeepLabV3 achieved the highest Dice (0.7120) and Intersection over Union (IoU; 0.6267), followed by ResNet34 U Net (Dice 0.6868; IoU 0.5978). The hybrid ASPP Transformer achieved the highest pixel accuracy (0.8528) but lower Dice (0.6437) and IoU (0.5746). External qualitative evaluation further showed that DeepLabV3 produced more consistent segmentation across varying environmental conditions, image qualities, and benthic habitats. Overall, ResNet50-DeepLabV3, termed Kelp-O-Tron, provided the best balance of segmentation accuracy, robustness, and generalization. The dataset, annotation workflow, and comparative evaluation provide resources for advancing automated underwater habitat mapping and ecological monitoring.
summary_zh: 水下海带林是支撑海洋生物多样性与生态系统动态的关键海岸生态系统，但受光学衰减、光照多变、水体浑浊、植被重叠、复杂底质背景等因素影响，水下海带的精准分割始终存在挑战。本研究使用美国东北海岸采集的高分辨率水下RGB影像，系统评估了3种深度学习语义分割框架：ResNet34-U-Net、ResNet50-DeepLabV3、以及混合ResNet50-ASPP-Transformer架构的海带检测性能。研究构建了包含3395组经语义分割（SSeg）辅助标注的图像-掩膜对数据集用于模型训练与验证，同时采用地理独立站点完成定量与定性评估。所有模型均采用统一的预处理、数据增强与评估协议。在独立测试集上，ResNet50-DeepLabV3取得了最高的Dice系数（0.7120）与交并比（IoU，0.6267），其次是ResNet34-U-Net（Dice系数0.6868，IoU 0.5978）。混合ASPP-Transformer架构取得了最高的像素精度（0.8528），但Dice系数（0.6437）与IoU（0.5746）更低。外部定性评估进一步表明，DeepLabV3在不同环境条件、图像质量与底栖生境下的分割结果一致性更高。总体而言，被命名为Kelp-O-Tron的ResNet50-DeepLabV3在分割精度、鲁棒性与泛化性之间实现了最优平衡。本研究发布的数据集、标注工作流与对比评估结果可为推进自动化水下生境制图与生态监测提供资源支撑。

title: Human-Inspired Social Engagement Analysis via Interpretable Mutual Visual Attention
title_zh: 基于可解释互视觉注意力的仿人社交参与度分析
authors: Urwa Fatima, Mohammad Zohaib, Francesca Odone, Nicoletta Noceti
abstract: Understanding social interactions from non-verbal visual data is important for behavior analysis and activity monitoring. We propose an interpretable computational model of social engagement inspired by psychological theories of mutual visual attention. Rather than learning interaction patterns end-to-end, our framework explicitly models dyadic visual attention and aggregates these cues into interpretable measures of individual and group engagement. The resulting modular framework combines state-of-the-art head orientation estimation with lightweight geometric reasoning, producing explanations that remain accessible to non-technical users. We evaluate the proposed approach on a variety of data through quantitative experiments and demonstrate its practical usefulness with qualitative visualizations designed to support teachers, caregivers, and social workers in understanding group interaction dynamics.
summary_zh: 从非视觉数据中理解社交互动对行为分析与活动监测具有重要意义。受互视觉注意力相关心理学理论启发，本文提出了一种可解释的社交参与度计算模型。该框架并非端到端学习交互模式，而是显式建模二元视觉注意力，并将这些线索聚合为可解释的个体与群体参与度度量指标。最终得到的模块化框架将当前最优的头部朝向估计技术与轻量级几何推理相结合，生成的解释结果对非技术用户也友好易懂。本文通过多类数据上的定量实验对所提方法进行评估，并通过面向教师、护理人员与社工设计的定性可视化方案，验证了该方法在理解群体互动动态方面的实际应用价值。

title: X-MULTI: VLM-based Imaging Factor Disentanglement for Factor-Aware Image Synthesis
title_zh: X-MULTI：基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的成像因子解耦方法用于因子感知图像生成
authors: Sonali Godavarthy, Matthias Neuwirth-Trapp, Tim-Felix Faasch, Maarten Bieshaar, Michael Moeller, Kristof Van Laerhoven, Danda Pani Paudel
abstract: Imaging factor disentanglement in text-to-image generation aims to independently control image acquisition properties such as types of camera lenses, sensor types, viewpoints, and domains to enable combinatorial generalization. This should let the model synthesize novel factor combinations unobserved in the training data, such as pairing a fisheye lens with an event sensor never observed in training data. Recent work, MULTI, introduced learnable, factor-specific embeddings to disentangle imaging factors, along with the Factor Alignment Accuracy (FAA) metric to evaluate disentanglement quality. We identify and address two independent limitations. First, MULTI's pixel-level reconstruction objective supervises the model only on observed imaging factor combinations, providing no direct training signal for novel combinations. We therefore propose X-MULTI, which uses a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) to supervise novel factor combinations synthesized during training. Second, we show the FAA metric exhibits severe cross-factor correlation leakage, misrepresenting true disentanglement quality. We therefore propose Improved-FAA (I-FAA), which employs factor-specific augmentation strategies to break these correlations and enables more rigorous evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that X-MULTI achieves improved factor alignment on novel combinations compared to MULTI. Moreover, we show that correlation leakage in FAA distorts the evaluation of true factor disentanglement and I-FAA reduces this leakage and therefore provides a more robust assessment of factor alignment.
summary_zh: 文生图领域的成像因子解耦目标是独立控制相机镜头类型、传感器类型、视角、领域等图像采集属性，实现组合泛化，让模型能够合成训练数据中从未观测到的全新因子组合，例如将鱼眼镜头与事件传感器配对生成训练中不存在的图像。近期的相关工作MULTI引入了可学习的因子专属嵌入实现成像因子解耦，同时提出了因子对齐精度（FAA）指标用于评估解耦质量。本文识别并解决了MULTI的两个独立缺陷：第一，MULTI的像素级重建目标仅针对已观测到的成像因子组合进行监督，无法为全新组合提供直接训练信号，因此本文提出X-MULTI，使用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）对训练过程中合成的全新因子组合进行监督；第二，本文发现FAA指标存在严重的跨因子相关性泄露问题，无法真实反映解耦质量，因此提出改进版FAA（I-FAA），通过因子专属增强策略打破上述相关性，实现更严格的评估。实验结果表明，与MULTI相比，X-MULTI在全新因子组合上的因子对齐效果更优；同时FAA中的相关性泄露确实会扭曲真实因子解耦效果的评估结果，而I-FAA可有效降低该泄露，为因子对齐提供更鲁棒的评估结果。

title: KLTNet: Learning Sparse Feature Tracking for Robust and Accurate Monocular Visual-Inertial Odometry
title_zh: KLTNet：面向鲁棒精准单目视觉惯性里程计的稀疏特征跟踪学习
authors: Renbiao Jin, Danping Zou, Wenxian Yu
abstract: Many feature-based visual-inertial odometry (VIO) systems rely on sparse feature tracking, whose accuracy and robustness directly affect state estimation. Classical KLT trackers rely primarily on local image patches and can become unreliable under rapid motion or in low-texture environments. We propose KLTNet, a lightweight learning-based, plug-and-play sparse feature tracker designed to replace classical KLT trackers in KLT-based VIO front ends. KLTNet follows a coarse-to-fine, dense-to-sparse architecture that combines low-resolution dense optical flow for robust global motion initialization with triplet-patch refinement for accurate and temporally consistent tracking. A fixed reference patch provides a stable anchor throughout each feature track and helps reduce accumulated tracking drift. In addition, KLTNet predicts anisotropic confidence weights supervised through differentiable multi-view triangulation, which can be used as observation weights in compatible VIO estimators. Experiments with VINS-Mono and OpenVINS on public benchmarks and a self-collected low-texture dataset demonstrate improved tracking and odometry accuracy over classical KLT, while maintaining real-time performance on an embedded platform.
summary_zh: 大量基于特征的视觉惯性里程计（VIO）系统依赖稀疏特征跟踪，其精度与鲁棒性直接影响状态估计效果。经典KLT跟踪器主要依赖局部图像块，在快速运动或低纹理环境下可靠性会显著下降。本文提出KLTNet，这是一种轻量级、即插即用的基于学习的稀疏特征跟踪器，可直接替换基于KLT的VIO前端中的经典KLT跟踪器。KLTNet采用由粗到细、由密到疏的架构，结合低分辨率稠密光流实现鲁棒的全局运动初始化，同时通过三元组图像块优化实现高精度、时间一致的跟踪。固定参考图像块可在整个特征跟踪过程中提供稳定锚点，有助于降低跟踪累积漂移。此外，KLTNet通过可微多视图三角化的监督预测各向异性置信权重，可作为兼容VIO估计器中的观测权重使用。在公开基准数据集与自行采集的低纹理数据集上，基于VINS-Mono与OpenVINS开展的实验表明，与经典KLT相比，KLTNet的跟踪效果与里程计精度均有提升，同时可在嵌入式平台上保持实时性能。

title: Hierarchical Prototype-Memory Adaptation of SAM for Surgical Instrument Segmentation
title_zh: 面向手术器械分割的SAM分层原型记忆自适应方法
authors: Xinning Yao, Jingjing Wang, Jinghua Yue, Xiaoyan Luo, Fugen Zhou, Bo Liu
abstract: Surgical instrument segmentation (SIS) is fundamental for computer-assisted surgery, where reliable instrument masks enable precise scene understanding and clinical assistance. Recently, adapting foundation models like the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to the surgical domain via prompt-learning has shown encouraging results. However, the performance of these adapted models under challenging surgical conditions is constrained by suboptimal adaptation mechanisms. Specifically, optimizing prompts or prototypes purely via downstream segmentation loss tends to cause them to degenerate into task-specific parameters rather than serving as persistent, stable category memory, thereby degrading their robustness against complex intraoperative variations. Moreover, routing multi-scale visual cues through a single prompt pathway creates a bottleneck that hinders effective scale-matched coupling. To address these limitations, we propose HPMA, a Hierarchical Prototype-Memory Adaptation framework for SAM. Specifically, HPMA constructs a frozen, multi-scale visual prototype memory bank from annotated surgical scenes and integrates it into SAM's feature space using lightweight adapters to preserve stable category evidence. To maximize the utility of multi-scale cues, we introduce a scale-matched coupling mechanism where global prototypes calibrate class-level prompt features, structural prototypes guide decoder object queries, and local prototypes align high-resolution feature maps through a local alignment objective. Extensive experiments on the public EndoVis2017 and EndoVis2018 datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing foundation model adaptation methods.
summary_zh: 手术器械分割（SIS）是计算机辅助手术的基础，可靠的器械掩膜可实现精准的场景理解与临床辅助。近期通过提示学习将任意分割基础模型（SAM）适配到手术领域的相关研究已经取得了不错的效果，但在复杂手术条件下，这类适配模型的性能仍受限于不够优化的适配机制。具体而言，仅通过下游分割损失优化提示或原型，容易导致其退化为任务专属参数，无法作为持久稳定的类别记忆，进而降低模型对复杂术中变化的鲁棒性；此外，通过单提示通路路由多尺度视觉线索会产生瓶颈，阻碍有效的尺度匹配耦合。为解决上述缺陷，本文提出HPMA：面向SAM的分层原型记忆自适应框架。具体而言，HPMA从标注手术场景中构建冻结的多尺度视觉原型记忆库，并通过轻量级适配器将其集成到SAM的特征空间中，保留稳定的类别证据。为最大化多尺度线索的利用率，本文引入尺度匹配耦合机制：全局原型校准类级提示特征，结构原型引导解码器对象查询，局部原型通过局部对齐目标实现高分辨率特征图对齐。在公开EndoVis2017与EndoVis2018数据集上开展的大量实验表明，所提方法取得了当前最优性能，优于现有所有基础模型适配方法。

title: VizAnchor: Decoding Manipulation Intent from Tampering Visualizations via Dual-Anchor Reasoning
title_zh: VizAnchor：基于双锚点推理从篡改可视化中解码操纵意图
authors: Xiaotian Zhang, Huayuan Ye, Haiyang Zhang, Chenhui Li, Changbo Wang, Sicheng Song
abstract: Data visualizations are widely used for communicating information, but they are also vulnerable to intentional manipulations that induce misleading interpretations. Existing methods focus on locating tampered regions or recovering hidden information, without explaining how the visualization has been manipulated or why the resulting changes may mislead viewers. We propose \textbf{VizAnchor}, a framework for visualization manipulation understanding through dual-anchor evidence construction and VLM-based reasoning. In the first stage, VizAnchor constructs a semantic anchor to recover authentic chart information and a spatial anchor to localize tampered regions. In the second stage, three specialized agents decode the manipulation. The misleader grounding agent analyzes a four-panel visual prompt to predict the misleader information. The chart narrative reconstruction agent takes the original and tampered charts as inputs and reconstructs their respective visual narratives. Finally, the intent inferring agent integrates the visual evidence and misleader information to infer the misleading intent. We further construct a dataset for tampering localization and a dataset for misleading intent inferring. Evaluation shows that VizAnchor accurately localizes manipulations and produces faithful explanations of their manipulation, misleaders, and misleading intents.
summary_zh: 数据可视化被广泛用于信息传递，但也容易受到人为故意操纵，导致受众产生误导性解读。现有方法主要聚焦于定位篡改区域或恢复隐藏信息，无法解释可视化被操纵的方式，也无法说明修改结果为何会误导受众。本文提出VizAnchor框架，通过双锚点证据构建与基于VLM的推理实现可视化操纵理解。第一阶段，VizAnchor构建语义锚点恢复真实图表信息，同时构建空间锚点定位篡改区域；第二阶段，三个专用智能体完成操纵解码：误导源定位智能体分析四面板视觉提示预测误导源信息，图表叙事重建智能体将原始图表与篡改后图表作为输入，分别重建二者的视觉叙事，最后意图推断智能体整合视觉证据与误导源信息，推断出误导意图。本文进一步构建了篡改定位数据集与误导意图推断数据集，评估结果表明VizAnchor可准确定位操纵行为，并生成关于操纵方式、误导源与误导意图的可信解释。

title: It depends: Incorporating correlations for joint aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties of high-dimensional output spaces
title_zh: 视情况而定：融合相关性用于高维输出空间的联合随机不确定性与认知不确定性计算
authors: Leonhard F. Feiner, Manuel Nickel, Martin Menten, Laurin Lux, Rickmer Braren, Daniel Rueckert, Georgios Kaissis, Raphael Rehms, Johannes Paetzold
abstract: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) plays a vital role in enhancing the reliability of deep learning model predictions, especially in scenarios with high-dimensional output spaces. This paper addresses the dual nature of uncertainty -- aleatoric and epistemic -- focusing on their joint integration in high-dimensional regression tasks. For example, in applications like medical image segmentation or restoration, aleatoric uncertainty captures inherent data noise, while epistemic uncertainty quantifies the model's confidence in unfamiliar conditions. Modeling both jointly enables more reliable predictions by reflecting both unavoidable variability and knowledge gaps, whereas modeling only one limits transparency and robustness. We propose a novel approach that approximates the resulting joint uncertainty using a low-rank plus diagonal covariance structure, capturing essential output correlations while avoiding the computational burdens of full covariance matrices. Unlike prior work, our method explicitly combines aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties into a unified second-order distribution that supports robust downstream analyses like sampling and log-likelihood evaluation. We further introduce stabilization strategies for efficient training and inference, achieving superior UQ in the tasks of image inpainting, colorization, optical flow, and depth estimation.
summary_zh: 不确定性量化（UQ）对提升深度学习模型预测可靠性至关重要，在高维输出空间场景下作用尤为突出。本文针对不确定性的双重属性——随机不确定性与认知不确定性展开研究，重点探索二者在高维回归任务中的联合集成方案。例如在医学图像分割、图像恢复等应用中，随机不确定性表征数据的固有噪声，认知不确定性则量化模型对陌生场景的置信度。联合建模两类不确定性可同时反映不可避免的数据变异性与模型知识缺口，得到更可靠的预测结果，而仅建模单一不确定性会限制模型的透明度与鲁棒性。本文提出一种新型方法，采用低秩加对角协方差结构近似联合不确定性，在捕获核心输出相关性的同时避免了全协方差矩阵的高计算负担。与现有工作不同，本文方法显式将随机不确定性与认知不确定性整合为统一的二阶分布，可支持采样、对数似然评估等鲁棒下游分析任务。本文进一步引入了稳定化策略实现高效训练与推理，在图像修复、图像上色、光流估计、深度估计任务中均实现了更优的不确定性量化效果。

title: Model Effect or Label Effect? Refined Annotations and a Human-Referenced Benchmark for Pulmonary Embolism Segmentation
title_zh: 模型效应还是标签效应？面向肺栓塞分割的精细化标注与人类参考基准
authors: Qihang Sun, Zhongxiao Liu, Bailiang Jian, Shenman Qiu, Jingyuan Wang, Lei Zhang, Lixiang Xie, Jiazhen Pan, Christian Wachinger
abstract: Conclusion: Evaluation annotations affected measured PE segmentation performance at least as much as model training choices. A human-referenced evaluation framework is publicly available for future study.
summary_zh: 研究结论：评估标注对肺栓塞（PE）分割性能测量结果的影响程度至少不低于模型训练选择。本研究公开了一套人类参考评估框架，可支持后续相关研究开展。

title: Low-Rank Ternary Adaptation for Fine-Tuning Transformers
title_zh: 面向Transformer微调的低秩三值自适应方法
authors: Alexandru-Dragos Manolache, Yunqiang Li, Jan van Gemert
abstract: Ternary transformers offer extreme memory and compute efficiency, but existing low-bit LoRA-based methods cannot directly fine-tune ternary weights. Current approaches either require dequantization, restoring low-bit base weights to higher precision to merge with adaptation weight, or update only quantization parameters, preventing a merged model that remains ternary. We propose ternary multiplicative adaptation, which represents discrete updates of ternary weights such as sign flips or zeroing through a low-rank Kronecker factorization into two small ternary matrices applied element-wise to ternary weights. This design is parameter-efficient and expressive, preserves the ternary domain, and supports direct merging without dequantization. Experiments on six models across language and vision, including ternarized LLaMA-3 1B and 3B and a ternary ViT-B/16, demonstrate that our method recovers much of the performance lost to quantization and outperforms strong low-bit and ternary baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/alexmanoo/ternary_adaptation.
summary_zh: 三值Transformer具备极高的内存与计算效率，但现有基于低比特低秩适配（LoRA）的方法无法直接对三值权重进行微调。当前的方案要么需要反量化，将低比特基础权重恢复为更高精度后再与自适应权重合并，要么仅更新量化参数，无法得到保持三值属性的合并后模型。本文提出三值乘法自适应方法，通过低秩Kronecker分解将三值权重的离散更新（例如符号翻转、置零）分解为两个小型三值矩阵，逐元素作用于三值权重。该设计参数效率高、表达能力强，可保留三值域属性，无需反量化即可直接合并。在语言与视觉领域的6个模型（包括三值化LLaMA-3 1B、3B与三值ViT-B/16）上开展的实验表明，本文方法可大幅恢复因量化损失的性能，优于当前主流的低比特与三值基线方法。代码开源地址为https://github.com/alexmanoo/ternary_adaptation。

title: DoublesEval: Diagnosing Multi-Agent Tactical Reasoning in Vision-Language Models via Professional Doubles Badminton
title_zh: DoublesEval：基于专业羽毛球双打开展视觉语言模型多智能体战术推理诊断
authors: Jintao Cheng, Weibin Li
abstract: Visual Language Models (VLMs) excel at describing visible scene content but struggle to reason about dynamic multi-agent interactions, where action semantics depend on coordinated roles and spatial-temporal dependencies. We formalize this capability as \textbf{multi-agent tactical reasoning} and introduce \textbf{DoublesEval}, a diagnostic evaluation framework that leverages professional doubles badminton as a structurally tractable testbed. DoublesEval employs a key-moment-based protocol that decomposes rallies into tactically salient instants and probes models across four interpretable dimensions: atomic recognition, intra-segment composite understanding, cross-segment causal reasoning, and high-level tactical abstraction. This design isolates \emph{where} reasoning fails, rather than merely measuring answer correctness. To address observed failure modes, we propose \textbf{TacticCheck}, a lightweight constraint-guided test-time consistency checker that reranks candidate answers using the model's own lower-level tactical predictions, requiring no parameter updates or ground-truth labels at inference time. Evaluating four representative open-source VLMs on 60 curated rallies (yielding $\sim$9.6K structured instances) via a zero-shot protocol, we find that models remain weak across all diagnostic levels, with especially clear bottlenecks in spatial state, interaction binding, and terminal evidence. TacticCheck delivers consistent gains across all evaluated models, while still leaving a substantial gap to robust tactical reasoning. These results highlight the need for structured, interaction-aware evaluation paradigms for next-generation VLMs. The source code is available in \href{https://github.com/Chengjt1999/DoublesEval}{\textcolor{blue}{our GitHub repository}}.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）擅长描述可见场景内容，但在动态多智能体交互推理任务上表现不佳，这类任务的动作语义依赖角色协同与时空依赖关系。本文将该能力正式定义为多智能体战术推理，并提出DoublesEval诊断评估框架，以专业羽毛球双打作为结构可控的测试床开展相关评估。DoublesEval采用基于关键帧的协议，将回合拆解为战术显著时刻，从4个可解释维度探测模型能力：原子识别、段内复合理解、跨段因果推理、高层战术抽象。该设计可定位推理失败的具体环节，而非仅测量答案的正确率。针对观测到的模型失效模式，本文提出TacticCheck轻量级约束引导测试时一致性检查器，利用模型自身输出的低层战术预测对候选答案重排序，推理过程无需参数更新也无需真值标签。在60个精心筛选的回合（共约9.6K结构化样本）上对4个代表性开源VLM开展零样本评估，结果表明所有模型在全部诊断维度上的表现都较差，在空间状态、交互绑定、终端证据维度上的瓶颈尤为明显。TacticCheck可在所有评估模型上实现一致的性能提升，但距离鲁棒的战术推理能力仍有较大差距。上述结果表明下一代VLM需要构建结构化、交互感知的评估范式。相关源码已开源至https://github.com/Chengjt1999/DoublesEval。

title: Vision Language Model Fusion for Explainable Face Recognition
title_zh: 面向可解释人脸识别的视觉语言模型融合
authors: Ana Estrada-Real, Lydia Alapatt, Christoph Busch, Christian Rathgeb
abstract: Overall, the findings suggest that the value of multi-VLM fusion extends beyond recognition performance. VLMs can provide complementary justifications and perspectives that enable richer explanations of face recognition decisions, supporting greater transparency, auditability, and error analysis. This is relevant to the development of responsible explainable face verification systems, where users and operators should be able to understand not only the final decision but also the evidence and potential sources underlying it. The proposed multimodal VLM, which combines decision scores, explanations, and face images, achieves higher recognition accuracy than state-of-the-art VLMs and domain-specific face recognition models, while also providing fused explanations that are expected to be more robust than those generated by individual VLMs.
summary_zh: 总体而言，研究结果表明多视觉语言模型（Vision Language Model, VLM）融合的价值不止于提升识别性能。VLM可提供互补的依据与视角，为人脸识别决策生成更丰富的解释，支撑更高的透明度、可审计性与错误分析能力。这对构建负责任的可解释人脸验证系统具有重要意义，这类系统要求用户和操作人员不仅能够理解最终决策，还能掌握决策背后的证据与潜在来源。本文提出的融合决策分数、解释信息与人脸图像的多模态VLM，识别精度优于当前最先进的VLM和面向人脸识别的专用领域模型，同时生成的融合解释相比单个VLM生成的解释具备更强的鲁棒性。

title: Joint Distribution Alignment for Universal Domain Adaptation
title_zh: 面向通用域适应的联合分布对齐
authors: Shizhe Li, Hongshan Pu, Mengying Xie, Yi Xiang, Xiaowei Yang
abstract: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) has been widely concerned in the fields of machine learning, pattern recognition, and computer vision. Traditional UDA learning usually assumes that the label spaces of the source and target domains are exactly the same and only needs to solve the problem of sample distribution drift existing between two domains. However, in real world applications, the label spaces between two domains may be different. In this case, there are both sample distribution drift and class spatial difference between domains, namely Universal Domain Adaptation (UniDA) learning scenario. At present, existing works rarely offer theoretical analysis for universal domain adaptation. In this paper, we provide an upper bound of the generalization error for universal domain adaptation. According to the proposed generalization error bound, we propose a novel UniDA algorithm called Joint Distribution Alignment for Universal Domain Adaptation (JAUA), which aligns the joint distributions by minimizing the distribution discrepancy calculated by Chi-Square divergence. Furthermore, we propose a progressive pseudo-labeling method to assign the pseudo labels to unlabeled target samples. The experiment results on six public image datasets demonstrate the superiority of JAUA in handling the UniDA problem.
summary_zh: 无监督域适应（Unsupervised Domain Adaptation, UDA）是机器学习、模式识别与计算机视觉领域的研究热点。传统UDA学习通常假设源域与目标域的标签空间完全一致，仅需解决两个域之间存在的样本分布漂移问题。但在实际应用场景中，两个域的标签空间可能存在差异，此时域间同时存在样本分布漂移与类别空间差异，该场景即为通用域适应（Universal Domain Adaptation, UniDA）学习场景。目前现有研究很少针对通用域适应提供理论分析。本文推导了通用域适应的泛化误差上界，基于提出的泛化误差边界，进一步提出一种名为JAUA（Joint Distribution Alignment for Universal Domain Adaptation）的新型UniDA算法，该算法通过最小化卡方散度计算得到的分布差异实现联合分布对齐。此外，本文还提出一种渐进伪标签方法，可为无标注目标样本分配伪标签。在6个公开图像数据集上的实验结果证明了JAUA处理UniDA问题的优越性能。

title: ZODIAC: Zero-shot Octree-based Diffusion for Anatomical Completion
title_zh: ZODIAC：基于零样本八叉树的解剖结构补全扩散模型
authors: Miruna-Alexandra Gafencu, Vlad Bratulescu, Yordanka Velikova, Mohammad Farid Azampour, Nassir Navab
abstract: Recovering the full 3D spine anatomy from intraoperative ultrasound is an ill-posed inverse problem, as the complete structure must be inferred from incomplete and noisy observations. Acoustic occlusions and limited field of view create large unobserved regions, while view-dependent artifacts lead to variability in expert annotations of the visible anatomy. Current supervised ultrasound shape completion methods rely on synthetically generated incomplete-complete paired data to learn conditional mappings under a predefined distribution of simulated occlusions. However, real intraoperative occlusions do not necessarily follow this distribution, which can limit generalization to patient data. As a result, accurate and robust completion from noisy partial observations remains an unsolved problem. We propose a zero-shot shape completion framework that reconstructs the entire lumbar spine from partial ultrasound observations without relying on simulated training data. To accommodate unseen and irregular patterns of missing structures, we introduce blended completion, a mechanism that integrates the learned anatomical prior with incoming partial geometry at inference time. The method learns a generative diffusion prior over full anatomical shapes represented in an adaptive octree structure, enabling efficient modeling of the complete spine in a single forward pass. Validation on phantom and volunteer data shows that decoupling completion from a predefined corruption distribution improves generalisation under real occlusions, outperforming a fully supervised variant by 22% on HD95 completion error. Code and data are available at https://github.com/miruna20/ZODIAC.
summary_zh: 从术中超声图像中恢复完整的3D脊柱解剖结构是一个不适定逆问题，需要从不完整、带噪声的观测结果中推断出完整结构。声学遮挡与有限视场会产生大量未观测区域，而与视角相关的伪影会导致可见解剖结构的专家标注结果存在差异。现有有监督超声形状补全方法依赖合成生成的不完整-完整配对数据，在预定义的模拟遮挡分布下学习条件映射关系，但实际术中遮挡并不一定符合该分布，会限制模型对患者数据的泛化能力，因此从带噪声的局部观测结果中实现准确鲁棒的结构补全仍是尚未解决的难题。本文提出一种零样本形状补全框架，无需依赖模拟训练数据即可从局部超声观测结果中重建完整腰椎。为适配未见过的、不规则的缺失结构模式，本文引入融合补全机制，该机制可在推理阶段将学习到的解剖先验与输入的局部几何信息相融合。该方法在自适应八叉树结构表示的完整解剖形状上学习生成式扩散先验，仅需单次前向传播即可实现完整脊柱的高效建模。在体模与志愿者数据上的验证结果表明，将补全过程与预定义的损坏分布解耦，可提升模型在真实遮挡场景下的泛化能力，其HD95补全误差相比全监督基线方法性能提升22%。代码与数据集可访问https://github.com/miruna20/ZODIAC获取。

title: MRI-based Deep Radiomic Phenotyping of Neuromuscular Disorders: A Topology-driven Characterization
title_zh: 基于MRI的神经肌肉疾病深度影像组学表型分析：拓扑驱动的表征方法
authors: Martyna \.Zur, {\L}ukasz Pi\'orecki, Marek Socha, Jordi Diaz-Manera, Jose Verdu Diaz, Volker Straub, Rossella Tupler, Joanna Pola\'nska
abstract: Quantitative assessment of muscle MRI is crucial for monitoring neuromuscular disorders (NMD). This study introduces an automated radiomic phenotyping framework based on original features engineered across five main architectural domains: quantitative morphometry, spatial distribution, geometric shape, interactions between progressive fat replacement stages, and graph-based topology. Utilizing 1184 MRI scans from the CoMPaSS-NMD project, we map the complex 3D architecture of heterogeneous intramuscular lipodegeneration into objective, morphologically interpretable biomarkers. We introduce a graph-based skeletonization of fat infiltrates to quantify muscle architectural changes, establishing a multi-dimensional extension of traditional, spatially-agnostic volume metrics by mapping topological networks across the entire 3D muscle volume. Statistical screening via non-parametric Kruskal-Wallis analysis confirmed the discriminative power of these novel descriptors across the genetic hierarchy. Notably, topological network metrics (e.g., SF1_Skel_Nodes, $\epsilon^2$ = 0.2656) and interface dynamics metrics (e.g., SF2_To_SF1_Dist_Min, $\epsilon^2$ = 0.2092) demonstrated substantial effect sizes, providing deeper structural insights than classical volumetric assessments. Post-hoc pairwise evaluations and UMAP projections further indicated the capability of these topological and 3D geometric invariants to capture disease-specific macroscopic infiltration patterns. These results demonstrate that global architectural features represent a highly promising class of biomarkers for differential diagnosis, offering new avenues for tracking longitudinal disease dynamics in neuromuscular diagnostics. The developed automated feature extraction pipeline is integrated and available within the MUSCAT (MUSCle fAt Topology) library.
summary_zh: 肌肉MRI的定量评估对神经肌肉疾病（Neuromuscular Disorders, NMD）的监测至关重要。本研究提出一种自动化影像组学表型分析框架，基于五大核心架构域设计原始特征：定量形态测量、空间分布、几何形状、渐进脂肪替换阶段间的交互作用、基于图的拓扑结构。研究使用CoMPaSS-NMD项目的1184份MRI扫描数据，将异质性肌内脂肪变性的复杂3D架构映射为可客观解释形态学特征的生物标志物。本文提出脂肪浸润的基于图骨架化方法，用于量化肌肉架构变化，通过在整个3D肌肉体积上映射拓扑网络，实现了传统空间无关体积指标的多维扩展。基于非参数Kruskal-Wallis分析的统计筛选验证了这些新型描述符在遗传层级上的区分能力。值得注意的是，拓扑网络指标（例如SF1_Skel_Nodes，ε²=0.2656）与界面动态指标（例如SF2_To_SF1_Dist_Min，ε²=0.2092）表现出显著的效应量，相比传统体积评估方法可提供更深入的结构洞察。事后成对评估与UMAP投影结果进一步证明，这些拓扑与3D几何不变量可捕获疾病特异性的宏观浸润模式。上述结果表明全局架构特征是一类极具潜力的生物标志物，可用于鉴别诊断，为神经肌肉诊断领域的纵向疾病动态追踪提供了新方向。本研究开发的自动化特征提取流水线已集成至MUSCAT（MUSCle fAt Topology，肌肉脂肪拓扑）库中，可公开使用。

title: Markerless Pose Estimation for Resistance Training Technique Assessment
title_zh: 用于抗阻训练动作技术评估的无标记位姿估计
authors: Joseph Turner, Jeff Clark, Nawid Keshtmand
abstract: Resistance training can be a high risk activity, and safe form is essential to avoiding injury. Laboratory-based movement analysis provides quantitive technique assessment, yet is not easily accessible. Markerless pose estimation infers body landmarks from images or video without physical markers and could offer a feasible alternative for technique assessment. We present a pose estimation framework to evaluate resistance-training technique from ordinary video footage. Using BlazePose, anatomical landmarks were extracted from squat, bench press, and deadlift videos and converted into joint-angle trajectories, with the squat serving as the primary case study. Trajectories were assessed against a defined reference repetition using root mean square error (RMSE). Results show that the framework recovers meaningful kinematic patterns for the squat and deadlift, enabling quantitative comparison between repetitions and identification of technique variability within a set. Performance depended strongly on camera orientation and visual occlusion, with non-sagittal views distorting 2D joint-angle estimates. The findings demonstrate that markerless pose estimation can support accessible biomechanical assessment outside laboratory environments.
summary_zh: 抗阻训练属于高风险活动，保持规范动作形态是避免受伤的核心要求。基于实验室的动作分析可提供定量的技术评估，但普及性较差。无标记位姿估计无需物理标记即可从图像或视频中推断人体关键点，可为动作技术评估提供可行的替代方案。本文提出一种位姿估计框架，可从普通视频片段中评估抗阻训练动作技术。研究使用BlazePose从深蹲、卧推与硬拉视频中提取解剖关键点，将其转换为关节角度轨迹，其中深蹲作为核心案例开展研究。研究使用均方根误差（Root Mean Square Error, RMSE）将得到的轨迹与定义的标准重复动作轨迹进行对比，结果表明该框架可提取深蹲与硬拉的有效运动学模式，支持不同重复动作之间的定量对比，识别同一组训练内的动作技术差异。框架性能高度依赖相机朝向与视觉遮挡情况，非矢状面视角会扭曲2D关节角度估计结果。研究结果证明无标记位姿估计可在实验室环境外支撑可普及的生物力学评估。

title: Bridging Adversarial and Collaborative Learning for AI-Generated Image Quality Assessment
title_zh: 衔接对抗学习与协作学习的AI生成图像质量评估方法
authors: Baoliang Chen, Qing Lin, Sijie Mai
abstract: AI-generated image quality assessment (AIGIQA) requires jointly reasoning about perceptual fidelity and prompt alignment, two quality dimensions that are often treated as independent in existing AIGIQA models. However, by re-examining human ratings, we uncover a previously overlooked phenomenon: the two dimensions are interdependent and exhibit both competitive and cooperative interactions during human rating. This observation suggests that a unified model should neither collapse the two dimensions nor rigidly separate them, but rather adaptively negotiate their interplay. Motivated by this insight, we introduce an interaction-aware learning framework that models perception-alignment relations through adversarial and collaborative inference pathways. Instead of designing a rigid dual-branch architecture, our method employs a gated interaction module that dynamically routes features according to the inferred relationship between the two dimensions. Task-aware prompts further modulate the gating behaviour, enabling the model to switch between competition and cooperation when necessary. Experiments across multiple AIGIQA benchmarks demonstrate that our approach not only achieves state-of-the-art accuracy but also yields interpretable interaction patterns, offering a more faithful approximation of human judgment. The codes are available at https://github.com/LQAMEI/ACL-IQA.
summary_zh: AI生成图像质量评估（AI-Generated Image Quality Assessment, AIGIQA）需要同时对感知保真度与提示对齐度两个质量维度进行推理，现有AIGIQA模型通常将这两个维度视为相互独立的维度。但通过重新审视人类评分数据，本文发现了一个此前被忽略的现象：两个维度相互依赖，在人类评分过程中同时存在竞争与协作交互关系。该观察结果表明，统一模型既不应将两个维度合并，也不应生硬地将二者分离，而应自适应地协调二者的交互关系。受该洞察启发，本文提出一种交互感知学习框架，通过对抗与协作推理路径对感知-对齐关系进行建模。本文没有设计刚性的双分支架构，而是采用门控交互模块，可根据两个维度之间推断出的关系动态路由特征。任务感知提示进一步调节门控行为，使模型可在必要时在竞争与协作模式之间切换。在多个AIGIQA基准数据集上开展的实验表明，本文提出的方法不仅取得了当前最先进的精度，还可生成可解释的交互模式，能够更忠实地还原人类判断过程。代码可访问https://github.com/LQAMEI/ACL-IQA获取。

title: Variance-Guided Spatial Attention Fusion for Robust End-to-End Driving under Asymmetric Sensor Degradation
title_zh: 非对称传感器退化场景下基于方差引导的空间注意力融合的鲁棒端到端自动驾驶方法
authors: Weizhi Tao, Zengwang Jin, Xiao Wang, Hailong Huang
abstract: End-to-end multimodal driving has progressed rapidly by fusing camera and LiDAR streams. Existing pipelines remain fragile under asymmetric sensor degradation, where either an entire modality or only a localized region is corrupted while other regions remain useful. The key difficulty is not simply to add an uncertainty head, but to obtain dense reliability supervision, calibrate this reliability against physical fault severity, and use it before unreliable features bias the planner. We propose Variance-Guided Spatial Attention Fusion (VG-SAF), in which dense heteroscedastic reliability estimates act as interpretable spatial gates. The framework couples three components. First, a physically grounded augmentor simulates representative camera and LiDAR failures and emits a continuous spatial mask, providing dense supervision without additional annotation. Second, modality-specific experts predict per-pixel reliability scales through cross-branch dense distillation in log space, enforcing a monotone severity-to-scale response. Third, calibrated reliability maps drive a hybrid attention mechanism that suppresses unreliable cells with a local spatial gate and arbitrates between modalities through a cross-modal trust softmax. A Laplace uncertainty head emits a systemic waypoint uncertainty scale that signals severe or combined sensor degradation, including severities outside the training ranges. On the CARLA Longest6 benchmark, VG-SAF consistently improves closed-loop robustness over the baselines across camera-only, LiDAR-only, and joint degradation regimes, as measured by driving score, route completion, and infraction score.
summary_zh: 通过融合相机与激光雷达数据流，端到端多模态自动驾驶技术已取得快速进展。但现有流水线在非对称传感器退化场景下仍十分脆弱，该场景下某一模态整体或仅局部区域被损坏，其余区域仍可正常使用。该场景的核心难点并非简单添加不确定性输出头，而是获取密集的可靠性监督信息，结合物理故障严重程度对可靠性进行校准，并在不可靠特征影响规划器之前完成过滤。本文提出VG-SAF（Variance-Guided Spatial Attention Fusion，方差引导空间注意力融合）方法，其中密集异方差可靠性估计可作为可解释的空间门控。该框架包含三个核心组件：第一，基于物理原理的增强器可模拟典型的相机与激光雷达故障，输出连续空间掩码，无需额外标注即可提供密集监督；第二，模态专属专家通过对数空间的跨分支密集蒸馏预测逐像素可靠性尺度，实现严重程度到尺度的单调响应；第三，校准后的可靠性图驱动混合注意力机制，通过局部空间门控抑制不可靠单元，通过跨模态信任softmax完成不同模态之间的仲裁。拉普拉斯不确定性输出头可输出系统性的航点不确定性尺度，可提示严重或复合传感器退化情况，包括训练覆盖范围之外的退化程度。在CARLA Longest6基准数据集上，以驾驶得分、路线完成率与违规得分为评价指标，VG-SAF在纯相机、纯激光雷达与联合退化场景下的闭环鲁棒性均持续优于基线方法。

title: MaST: Motion-aware Sparse Pipeline for Lightweight Object Tracking
title_zh: MaST：面向轻量目标跟踪的运动感知稀疏流水线
authors: Qingmao Wei, Fagui Liu, Dengke Zhang, Qingze He, Quan Tang
abstract: while running at 152 FPS on Jetson Nano, nearly twice as fast as AsymTrack-S at 88 FPS. Code is available at https://github.com/TsingWei/MaST.
summary_zh: 该方法在Jetson Nano设备上运行速度可达152 FPS，几乎是AsymTrack-S（88 FPS）运行速度的两倍。代码可访问https://github.com/TsingWei/MaST获取。

title: B-MIM: Biased Masked Image Modeling for Generalizable Segmentation of Fine-Grained Anatomical Structures
