title_zh: B-MIM：面向细粒度解剖结构泛化分割的偏置掩码图像建模方法
authors: Sebasti\'an Gonz\'alez, Karen Sanchez, Jos\'e M. Saavedra, Marcelo Pizarro, Bernard Ghanem
abstract: Self-supervised pretraining enables transferable representations for medical imaging, yet most CT encoders remain biased toward coarse semantic understanding, limiting their sensitivity to fine-grained anatomical structures such as vessels or small tumors. In this paper, we introduce Biased Masked Image Modeling (B-MIM), a modification of the iBOT objective that stochastically reduces global semantic alignment to prioritize local patch reconstruction. This bias encourages the encoder to capture high-frequency morphological details and structural continuity. We curate a multi-institutional CT abdominal dataset of 9,955 filtered studies from 17 public sources and pretrain a 3D Swin Transformer backbone using B-MIM. Across inter-dataset experiments on liver vessel segmentation, the proposed encoder improves topological fidelity (clDice) and achieves competitive Dice scores in tumor segmentation, compared to fully fine-tuned baselines, despite updating only a fraction of the parameters. Our results suggest that reducing global semantic pressure during pretraining enhances generalization to intricate anatomical structures.
summary_zh: 自监督预训练可为医学图像生成可迁移的表示，但多数CT编码器仍偏向粗粒度语义理解，限制了其对血管、小肿瘤等细粒度解剖结构的敏感度。本文提出B-MIM（Biased Masked Image Modeling，偏置掩码图像建模）方法，该方法是对iBOT目标函数的改进，可随机降低全局语义对齐权重，优先完成局部补丁重建。该偏置机制可引导编码器捕获高频形态细节与结构连续性。本文从17个公开数据源中筛选得到9955份CT腹部研究数据，构建多机构数据集，使用B-MIM对3D Swin Transformer骨干网络进行预训练。在肝脏血管分割的跨数据集实验中，本文提出的编码器在仅更新少量参数的情况下，拓扑保真度（clDice）表现优于基线方法，在肿瘤分割任务中也取得了有竞争力的Dice得分，性能超过全微调基线方法。研究结果表明，在预训练阶段降低全局语义约束，可提升模型对复杂解剖结构的泛化能力。

title: Metadata-Aware Adaptation of a Generative Foundation Model for Conditional CMR Synthesis
title_zh: 面向条件心脏磁共振合成的生成基础模型元数据自适应方法
authors: Marc Rodr\'iguez, Grzegorz Skorupko, Nay Aung, Steffen E Petersen, Karim Lekadir, Polyxeni Gkontra
abstract: Synthetic image generation is a promising strategy to address data scarcity and the underrepresentation of clinically important phenotypes in medical imaging, yet generating images that faithfully reflect meaningful patient characteristics remains challenging. In this work, we investigate metadata-conditioned cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) synthesis using a pretrained latent diffusion model, encoding structured clinical metadata and slice position as textual prompts to guide CMR generation. To improve metadata adherence and address the imbalance of clinical attributes, we integrate three strategies: Metadata-Free Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), Contrastive Batching, and Inverse-Frequency Sampling. The framework was fine-tuned and evaluated on 59,058 short-axis CMR from the UK Biobank using paired image similarity, distributional fidelity, and subgroup-level analyses. The combined approach achieved a Fr\'echet Inception Distance (FID) of 37.47, improving by 57.04\% over the same model fine-tuned without these strategies and by 28.68\% over a previous text-conditioned CMR diffusion baseline requiring cardiac geometry as additional input, while relying solely on patient metadata. This distributional gain, driven mainly by Metadata-Free CFG, came with a modest reduction in paired similarity, suggesting that the model prioritizes population-level realism over exact image reproduction. Subgroup analyses demonstrated improved alignment across demographic and acquisition-related metadata, with disease-specific conditioning being the most challenging task. These findings demonstrate the potential of generative foundation models for clinically meaningful CMR synthesis while highlighting the need for more effective metadata-aware conditioning strategies. Our code is available at https://github.com/rodriguezmarc/conditional-cmr.
summary_zh: 合成图像生成是解决医学影像领域数据稀缺、临床重要表型代表性不足问题的极具前景的方案，但生成能够忠实反映患者核心特征的图像仍存在挑战。本研究基于预训练潜扩散模型开展元数据条件引导的心脏磁共振（Cardiac Magnetic Resonance, CMR）合成研究，将结构化临床元数据与切片位置编码为文本提示，引导CMR生成。为提升元数据贴合度、解决临床属性不平衡问题，本文整合了三种策略：无元数据的无分类器引导（Classifier-Free Guidance, CFG）、对比批量采样与逆频率采样。研究使用英国生物银行（UK Biobank）的59058份短轴CMR数据对框架进行微调与评估，评估维度包括配对图像相似度、分布保真度与亚组层面分析。整合上述策略的方法取得了37.47的弗雷歇 inception距离（Fréchet Inception Distance, FID），相比未使用上述策略微调的同模型性能提升57.04%，相比此前需要额外输入心脏几何信息的文本条件CMR扩散基线方法性能提升28.68%，且仅依赖患者元数据即可实现。该分布性能提升主要由无元数据CFG策略贡献，仅伴随配对相似度的小幅下降，表明模型优先保障群体层面的真实感而非精确的图像复刻。亚组分析结果表明，模型在人口统计学与采集相关元数据维度的对齐效果得到提升，其中疾病特异性条件引导是最具挑战性的任务。上述结果证明生成基础模型具备生成符合临床需求的CMR图像的潜力，同时也表明后续需要开发更高效的元数据感知条件引导策略。代码可访问https://github.com/rodriguezmarc/conditional-cmr获取。

title: Mind the Student: Behavioral and Contextual Cues for Automated Engagement Prediction in Online Learning
title_zh: 关注学习者：面向在线学习自动投入度预测的行为与上下文线索
authors: Alperen Kantarci, Visvanathan Ramesh, Gemma Roig
abstract: The prediction of student engagement from the online tutoring videos is difficult because engagement is a multidimensional construct comprising distinct behavioral, emotional, and cognitive states. A reliable prediction requires bringing together different types of behavioral signals as well as expressive cues. Through our analysis of the CASED dataset, it is clear that engagement prediction gets even harder due to the high inter-person variability as well as the subjectivity of the engagement annotation. To tackle these challenges, we develop a multimodal framework that integrates the implicit spatiotemporal features extracted from pretrained video, audio, and image encoders along with structured behavioral modalities like head pose, gaze, facial action units, emotion, and wavelet-based audio features. We integrate these modalities via a Perceiver IO latent bottleneck. Moreover, student and instructor personalities are modeled as variational posteriors over learnable embeddings to enable partial pooling across participants. We employ evidential regression and spectral-normalized Gaussian process classification heads for uncertainty-aware prediction to further improve robustness and calibration. Benchmark on the CASED challenge test set shows that all participating methods converge near random-chance performance, revealing the difficulty of the dataset. In this highly ambiguous regime, our framework achieves competitive performance while uniquely offering well-calibrated uncertainty metrics, demonstrating that reliable risk-quantification is an essential prerequisite for deploying engagement models in real-world educational tools.
summary_zh: 从在线辅导视频中预测学生投入度难度较高，因为投入度是一个包含不同行为、情感和认知状态的多维度构念。可靠的预测需要整合不同类型的行为信号与表达线索。通过对CASED数据集的分析可以发现，人际间的高异质性以及投入度标注的主观性进一步提升了投入度预测的难度。为应对上述挑战，本研究开发了一个多模态框架，整合从预训练视频、音频、图像编码器中提取的隐式时空特征，以及头部姿态、视线、面部动作单元、情绪、基于小波的音频特征等结构化行为模态。研究通过Perceiver IO（感知器IO）潜在瓶颈模块整合上述多模态信息，此外将学生与教师的人格建模为可学习嵌入上的变分后验，实现跨参与者的部分特征池化。本研究采用证据回归与谱归一化高斯过程分类头实现感知不确定性的预测，进一步提升模型鲁棒性与校准性能。在CASED挑战赛测试集上的基准测试结果显示，所有参赛方法的性能都接近随机水平，凸显了该数据集的挑战性。在这种高度模糊的场景下，本框架取得了具有竞争力的性能，同时独家提供了校准良好的不确定性指标，证明可靠的风险量化是将投入度预测模型部署到真实教育工具中的必要前提。

title: SeMoCo: A Semantic-First Motion Codec for Motion Language Modeling
title_zh: SeMoCo：面向运动语言建模的语义优先运动编解码器
authors: Tianlv Huang, Hetian Guo, Ziyi Cai, Song Wang, Yanping Zhang, Zipei Fan, Xuan Song, Guangming Wu, Xin Zheng
abstract: Discrete motion representations have substantially advanced autoregressive text-to-motion generation. However, most motion tokenizers are optimized for reconstruction and do not explicitly allocate capacity according to semantic role. Action-level meaning and fine-grained kinematic detail must therefore be encoded through the same reconstruction-driven hierarchy. We introduce SeMoCo, a semantic-first motion codec, together with a dual-axis motion generator for language-conditioned motion generation. Each motion token contains one semantic token and a residual sequence of kinematic tokens. The generator models semantic progression across time and autoregressively refines the residual entries. We also construct $\Omega$-MotionVerse, a large-scale, multi-source human-motion dataset unified under the SOMA representation. Across the reported comparisons, SeMoCo achieves the best reconstruction accuracy among the compared codecs, while strong text-to-motion results demonstrate the effectiveness of its motion tokens for downstream generation.
summary_zh: 离散运动表征极大推动了自回归文本到运动生成任务的发展，但现有大多数运动分词器都针对重建任务优化，并未根据语义角色显式分配模型容量，因此动作层面的语义信息与细粒度的运动学细节必须通过同一套面向重建的层级结构完成编码。本文提出SeMoCo——一种语义优先的运动编解码器，以及配套的面向语言条件运动生成的双轴运动生成器。每个运动令牌包含1个语义令牌和1个运动学令牌的残差序列，生成器对跨时间的语义演进过程建模，并自回归地优化残差条目。本文还构建了Ω-MotionVerse，这是一个在SOMA表征下统一的大规模多源人体运动数据集。在所有对比实验中，SeMoCo在所有对比编解码器中取得了最高的重建精度，同时优异的文本到运动生成结果也证明了其生成的运动令牌用于下游生成任务的有效性。

title: Keep-or-Drop? Adaptive Tokenizer for Compact Video Representation
title_zh: 保留还是丢弃？面向紧凑视频表征的自适应分词器
authors: Yeonkyeong Lee, Hyunsung Go, Jongmin Kim, Sewoong Lim, Donghoon Lee
abstract: Latent diffusion models have emerged as a dominant framework for high-fidelity image and video synthesis, operating in compact latent spaces with variational autoencoders (VAEs) to enhance computational efficiency without compromising visual quality. However, conventional VAEs are suboptimal for video data as they employ fixed compression ratios that cannot adapt to the varying complexity of spatio-temporal content. We present KATok (Keep-or-Drop? Adaptive Tokenizer for Compact Video Representation), a transformer-based VAE that incorporates an adaptive token selector which is jointly learned with latent tokens. By evaluating each token's content-richness as keep-or-drop probability, the token selector effectively discards uninformative tokens, naturally allowing data-dependent compression. Applying adaptive tokenization to diffusion models may cause spatial misalignment, as token dropping can disturb the original spatio-temporal structure. To alleviate this issue, we propose two position-prediction strategies: cascaded and joint generation, to ensure spatial consistency. We empirically show that our model achieves strong reconstruction and generation quality at a state-of-the-art compression ratio. Further analysis on video data reveals that this improvement is primarily achieved by reducing spatio-temporal redundancy and removing uninformative tokens, as supported by both quantitative and qualitative results.
summary_zh: 隐扩散模型已经成为高保真图像与视频合成的主流框架，这类模型依托变分自编码器（VAE）在紧凑的隐空间中运行，在不损失视觉质量的前提下提升计算效率。但传统VAE对视频数据并非最优，因为其采用固定压缩比，无法自适应适配时空内容的不同复杂度。本文提出KATok（Keep-or-Drop? Adaptive Tokenizer for Compact Video Representation，面向紧凑视频表征的自适应分词器），这是一种基于Transformer的VAE，内置与隐令牌联合学习的自适应令牌选择器。令牌选择器通过评估每个令牌的内容丰富度得到保留/丢弃概率，有效丢弃无信息令牌，自然实现适配数据特征的压缩。将自适应分词应用到扩散模型中可能引发空间错位问题，因为令牌丢弃会破坏原始时空结构。为缓解该问题，本文提出两种位置预测策略：级联生成与联合生成，保障空间一致性。实验结果表明，本文模型在当前最优的压缩比下取得了优异的重建与生成质量。针对视频数据的进一步分析显示，该性能提升主要通过降低时空冗余、移除无信息令牌实现，定量与定性结果均验证了这一结论。

title: CARE: Camera-Residual Reserves for First Sightings in Adaptive LiDAR Sensing
title_zh: CARE：面向自适应激光雷达传感首次目标发现的相机残差预留机制
authors: Jiachen Gong, Yun Li, Ehsan Javanmardi, Wencan Mao, Manabu Tsukada
abstract: Adaptive LiDAR scanning concentrates a limited sensing budget on regions of interest predicted from past object tracks, lowering data volume in autonomous driving while maintaining detection accuracy. However, existing scanning policies face three challenges. First, history-driven approaches depend on past tracks, so unseen objects are detected late or missed. Second, random or uniform sampling outside the predicted regions has no awareness of where new objects appear. Third, camera-guided alternatives spend budget on all camera detections, resampling objects already covered, costing recall in crowded scenes and range when budgets are scarce. This paper introduces the CAmera-REsidual reserve (CARE), a training-free allocation rule that reserves part of a fixed ray budget for the directions of current camera detections that the track forecasts cannot explain; the rest follows the base history policy, and unused reserve returns to a random floor. The paper makes three contributions. First, a leakage-free ray-budget evaluation on nuScenes (150 scenes, 4,148 events) measuring the first-sighting loss of history-driven scanning, with a strict-causal variant using the preceding keyframe. Second, CARE raises first-sighting recall by 5.2, 5.2, and 4.3 points at 10%, 20%, and 35% budgets over the history policy, with paired intervals excluding zero; the camera cue drives this gain, and the first-sighting versus overall trade-off is a budget-dependent Pareto choice. Third, a safety-bounded forgetting module that releases budget from receding or static tracks beyond a speed-dependent guard distance; at tight budgets, forgetting without the guard significantly harms near-field recall, so the guard is what keeps it safe. The pipeline runs end to end on a real vehicle and, in closed-loop simulation, detects an occluded pedestrian earlier and brakes more reliably than history-driven scanning.
summary_zh: 自适应激光雷达扫描将有限的传感预算集中在从历史目标轨迹预测出的感兴趣区域，可在保持检测精度的同时降低自动驾驶场景的数据量。但现有扫描策略存在三大挑战：第一，基于历史的方法依赖过往轨迹，对未见过的目标检测滞后甚至漏检；第二，在预测区域外进行随机或均匀采样无法感知新目标的出现位置；第三，相机引导的替代方案会将预算分配给所有相机检测结果，对已覆盖的目标重复采样，在拥挤场景下损失召回率，在预算不足时损失探测距离。本文提出CAmera-REsidual reserve（CARE，相机残差预留）机制，这是一种无需训练的分配规则，将固定射线预算的一部分分配给轨迹预测无法解释的当前相机检测方向，剩余部分遵循基础历史策略，未使用的预留预算会返还给随机采样基线。本文的贡献有三点：第一，在nuScenes数据集（150个场景，4148个事件）上实现了无泄漏的射线预算评估，测量基于历史的扫描策略的首次发现损失，配套使用前一关键帧的严格因果变体；第二，在10%、20%、35%预算条件下，CARE相比历史策略将首次发现召回率分别提升5.2、5.2、4.3个百分点，配对区间不包含零，该性能提升由相机线索驱动，首次发现性能与整体性能的权衡是依赖预算的帕累托最优选择；第三，提出安全边界遗忘模块，可释放超出与速度相关的防护距离的远去或静态轨迹占用的预算，在预算紧张时，无防护机制的遗忘会严重损害近场召回率，防护机制保障了操作安全性。该流水线可在真实车辆上端到端运行，在闭环仿真中相比基于历史的扫描策略，可更早检测到被遮挡的行人，实现更可靠的制动操作。

title: Example-based Robust Abnormality Detection with Minimal Annotations using Exemplar Med-DETR
title_zh: 基于Exemplar Med-DETR的最小标注条件下鲁棒异常检测方法
authors: Sheethal Bhat, Bogdan Georgescu, Awais Mansoor, Mathias Zinnen, Pranjal Sahu, Florin C. Ghesu, Sasa Grbic, Andreas Maier
abstract: Reducing annotation requirements remains a key challenge in developing robust medical object detectors. To address this, Vision-Language (VL) object detection methods leverage grounding text information to enable powerful zero-shot and few-shot object detectors in the natural image domain [1, 2, 3, 4]. However, transferring these methods to the medical domain is challenging due to the absence of comparable quality and quantity of the grounding data. Regardless, significant contextual and non-imaging information exists in medical images that remains underutilized. Few-shot learning (FSL) techniques partially address this limitation but struggle to general ize to unseen medical findings and require extensive retraining when new findings are introduced [5, 6]. To overcome these challenges, we extend our prior EM-DETR framework [7] and introduce a scalable FS detection approach designed for efficient abnormality detection in Chest X-Ray (CXR) images under minimal supervision. The proposed architecture incorporates exemplar-based feature generation and domain-aware contrastive optimization, enabling effective adaptation to novel disease findings without exhaustive retraining. Our method achieves near state-of-the-art (SOTA) detection performance using less than 10% of the annotated data, demonstrating its potential for practical, annotation-efficient clinical deployment across both proprietary and public CXR datasets.
summary_zh: 降低标注需求是开发鲁棒医学目标检测器的核心挑战。为解决该问题，视觉语言（VL）目标检测方法利用 grounding 文本信息，在自然图像域实现了性能优异的零样本与少样本目标检测器。但由于医学域缺乏质量与数量相当的grounding数据，将这类方法迁移到医学域难度较高。尽管如此，医学图像中仍存在大量未被充分利用的上下文与非成像信息。少样本学习（FSL）技术部分缓解了该局限，但难以泛化到未见过的医学征象，且引入新征象时需要大量重新训练。为克服上述挑战，本文扩展了此前提出的EM-DETR框架，提出一种可扩展的少样本检测方法，在极少监督条件下实现胸片（CXR）图像的高效异常检测。所提出的架构集成了基于示例的特征生成与域感知对比优化，无需大量重新训练即可有效适配新的疾病征象。在仅使用不到10%标注数据的条件下，本文方法取得了接近当前最优（SOTA）的检测性能，在私有与公开胸片数据集上均展现出面向实际、标注高效的临床部署潜力。

title: Real-World Knowledge-Guided Change Data Synthesis for Remote Sensing
title_zh: 面向遥感领域的真实世界知识引导变化数据合成方法
authors: Yaoyi Qi, Xingxing Weng, Chao Pang, Yongkang Cui, Xiangyu Hao, Xiaokang Zhang, Guibo Zhu, Gui-Song Xia
abstract: Change data synthesis provides a cost-effective solution for expanding training data and improving the performance of change detection models. However, existing synthesis methods typically rely on handcrafted rules to simulate changes, where limited coverage of class transitions restricts the diversity of synthesized data, while predefined transition designs limit their flexibility in accommodating varied change types. In this work, we introduce KnowChange, a knowledge-guided change data synthesis framework that leverages pretrained vision-language models as knowledge sources to reason about plausible change locations and class transitions from pre-change scenes and desired change types. By integrating knowledge-guided change simulation with generalizable synthesis models, KnowChange enables flexible synthesis of diverse change types within a unified framework. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KnowChange-generated data consistently outperforms existing synthetic datasets in both synthetic-to-real transfer and synthetic data augmentation, despite being generated at a compact scale. Further analyses show that the knowledge-guided change simulation can be seamlessly integrated into existing synthesis pipelines and enhance the downstream utility of synthesized data.
summary_zh: 变化数据合成是扩展训练数据、提升变化检测模型性能的高性价比方案。但现有合成方法通常依赖人工设计规则模拟变化，类别转移的覆盖范围有限，限制了合成数据的多样性，同时预定义的转移设计限制了其适配不同变化类型的灵活性。本文提出KnowChange，一种知识引导的变化数据合成框架，利用预训练视觉语言模型作为知识源，从变化前场景与期望变化类型中推理出合理的变化位置与类别转移。通过将知识引导的变化模拟与可泛化合成模型相结合，KnowChange可在统一框架内灵活合成多样化的变化类型。大量实验表明，尽管生成规模紧凑，KnowChange生成的数据在合成到真实迁移任务与合成数据增强任务中的表现始终优于现有合成数据集。进一步分析显示，知识引导的变化模拟可无缝集成到现有合成流水线中，提升合成数据的下游任务效用。

title: Event-Based Motion Estimation via Oriented Distance Fields
title_zh: 基于定向距离场的事件相机运动估计
authors: Lei Sun, Yuqin Ma, Weilun Li, Haoran Liang, Runyi Yang, Kaiwei Wang, Danda Pani Paudel, Luc Van Gool
abstract: Event-based motion estimation is central to tasks that demand high temporal resolution and robustness to fast motion. Existing methods typically rely on iterative optimization or repeated hypothesis comparison, offsetting the sensor's low-latency advantage. We propose Oriented Distance Field Motion Estimation (ODF Motion Estimation), which replaces this optimization with a single averaging step over a precomputed field of event distance vectors, combined with an adaptive event-count selection strategy and a parameter-free trail filter. On public and self-collected datasets, ODF motion estimation reaches sub-pixel accuracy at the lowest latency among compared methods. We validate its generality on two downstream applications rather than treating them as separate contributions. First, the estimated trajectory is converted into a blur kernel and paired with a compact iterative-unfolding network, trained on simulated motion-estimation noise, for real-time non-blind image deblurring, attaining competitive or superior PSNR/SSIM with under 1M parameters. Second, the same precomputed field is repurposed for directional event filtering in a low-power asynchronous pupil and glint tracker, sustaining stable tracking for tens of seconds while lowering a near-eye module's power draw.
summary_zh: 事件相机运动估计是高时间分辨率、高快速运动鲁棒性任务的核心技术。现有方法通常依赖迭代优化或重复假设对比，抵消了事件相机传感器的低延迟优势。本文提出Oriented Distance Field Motion Estimation（ODF运动估计）技术，用预计算事件距离向量场上的单次平均步骤替代原有优化流程，搭配自适应事件数量选择策略与无参数轨迹滤波器。在公开数据集与自采集数据集上，ODF运动估计在所有对比方法中以最低延迟实现了亚像素级精度。本文在两个下游应用中验证了其通用性，并未将下游应用作为独立贡献：第一，将估计得到的轨迹转换为模糊核，搭配在模拟运动估计噪声上训练的紧凑迭代展开网络，实现实时非盲图像去模糊，在参数量低于1M的条件下取得了具有竞争力甚至更优的峰值信噪比（PSNR）与结构相似性（SSIM）指标；第二，复用同一预计算场，在低功耗异步瞳孔与反光点跟踪器中实现定向事件滤波，可在降低近眼模块功耗的同时维持数十秒的稳定跟踪。

title: Beauty is in the ELBO of the Beholder: A Variational Account of Processing Fluency in Face Perception
title_zh: 美存在于观测者的ELBO中：人脸感知加工流畅性的变分解释
authors: Francisco M. L\'opez, Jochen Triesch
abstract: Facial attractiveness has been linked to statistical regularities such as symmetry and averageness, suggesting that beauty may depend on the ease with which a face is perceived. We empirically test this hypothesis by training variational autoencoders on four face datasets without attractiveness supervision and evaluating their representations on the 597 faces from the Chicago Face Database. Across models, human attractiveness ratings closely aligns with the direction defined by the VAE evidence lower bound (ELBO) in rate-distortion space. Independently learned latent spaces contain an attractiveness direction that transfers strongly across random initializations and training data. We also find that attractive faces are more prototypical in both shape and latent space. Our results connect classic accounts of aesthetics with learned generative models and provide empirical support for a variational interpretation of the processing fluency theory of aesthetic pleasure.
summary_zh: 人脸吸引力与对称性、平均性等统计规律相关，表明美感可能取决于人脸感知的难易程度。本文通过在四个人脸数据集上训练无吸引力监督的变分自编码器（VAE），在芝加哥人脸数据库的597张人脸上评估其表征，对该假设进行实证检验。在所有模型中，人类的吸引力评分与率失真空间中由VAE证据下界（ELBO）定义的方向高度吻合。独立学习得到的隐空间中存在一个吸引力方向，该方向在随机初始化与训练数据之间具有强迁移性。研究还发现，有吸引力的人脸在形状空间与隐空间中都更具原型性。本研究结果将经典美学理论与学习生成模型关联，为审美愉悦加工流畅性理论的变分解释提供了实证支撑。

title: NeoWorld-Pro: Programming Interactive Scenes from Monocular Images for Embodied Simulation
title_zh: NeoWorld-Pro：面向具身仿真的单目图像交互式场景编程
authors: Yumeng He, Yichen Song, Xiaotian Yang, Weijia Zhang, Zanwei Zhou, Junru Gong, Xiaokang Yang, Yunbo Wang
abstract: The advancement of Embodied AI necessitates high-quality simulation assets that faithfully mirror the real world. However, transforming raw visual observations into simulation-ready scenes remains challenging due to the lack of physical grounding and scene-level interactivity in current image-to-URDF methods. We propose NeoWorld-Pro, a framework that reformulates monocular scene reconstruction as procedural programming for interactive 3D environments. Leveraging the zero-shot reasoning and code synthesis capabilities of MLLMs, NeoWorld-Pro converts a single RGB image into executable programs specifying object geometry, articulation, and physical properties. A physics-in-the-loop mechanism then iteratively refines the generated programs by validating their execution in a physics engine, enforcing physically plausible articulations, valid object compositions and interactions, and accurate spatial relationships. Experiments show that NeoWorld-Pro outperforms open-loop and prior monocular reconstruction methods, while enabling complex downstream tasks such as stable stacking and fine-grained manipulation.
summary_zh: 具身人工智能的发展需要能够真实还原现实世界的高质量仿真资产。但现有图像到统一机器人描述格式（URDF）方法缺乏物理 grounding 与场景级交互性，将原始视觉观测转换为可用于仿真的场景仍存在挑战。本文提出NeoWorld-Pro框架，将单目场景重建重构为面向交互式3D环境的过程式编程任务。依托多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的零样本推理与代码合成能力，NeoWorld-Pro将单张RGB图像转换为可执行程序，指定物体的几何结构、关节活动度与物理属性。随后通过物理在环机制，在物理引擎中验证生成程序的执行效果，迭代优化程序，确保关节活动符合物理规律、物体组成与交互有效、空间关系准确。实验结果表明，NeoWorld-Pro性能优于开环方法与现有单目重建方法，可支持稳定堆叠、细粒度操作等复杂下游任务。

title: Amortized Set Prediction for Inverse IFS Reconstruction from Density Maps
title_zh: 基于摊销集预测的密度图逆迭代函数系统重建
authors: Yutaka Yamaguti
abstract: Iterated Function Systems (IFS) generate self-similar fractals from a few contractive affine maps. The forward map from parameters to images is computationally inexpensive and well understood, whereas the inverse problem of estimating maps from an image is difficult and is typically handled by per-image optimization. We replace this loop with a single forward pass of a learned estimator that predicts the affine-map set directly from a visit-frequency density map, thereby amortizing the inverse problem. The design follows two constraints. First, density maps do not uniquely identify IFS parameters, so evaluation is based on reconstruction rather than parameter recovery; unordered map sets are handled by Hungarian matching, and ground-truth parameters provide a stable training surrogate. Second, the fully known forward model lets us generate exact synthetic training pairs and also supports image-only test-time refinement. On in-distribution tests, amortized initialization plus a few refinement steps lies on a better quality--speed frontier than equal-budget random-initialized per-image optimization, and a 30-step refinement (about $0.56$ s per sample) remains better than a doubled-budget baseline. Extending optimization to 1000 steps shows that the benefit is not only speed: amortized initialization reaches high-quality reconstructions more frequently than random starts. On real images (MNIST and Fashion-MNIST), it improves density metrics on average over a published per-image optimizer while being roughly 12 to 2600 times faster.
summary_zh: 迭代函数系统（IFS）通过少量压缩仿射映射生成自相似分形，从参数到图像的前向映射计算成本低且机制明确，但从图像估计映射的逆问题难度较高，通常采用逐图像优化的方式求解。本文用学习得到的估计器的单次前向传播替代原有循环，直接从访问频率密度图预测仿射映射集合，从而摊销逆问题的计算成本。该设计遵循两项约束：第一，密度图无法唯一确定IFS参数，因此评估基于重建效果而非参数恢复效果，通过匈牙利匹配处理无序映射集合，真实参数提供稳定的训练代理；第二，完全已知的前向模型支持生成精确的合成训练对，也支持仅基于图像的测试时优化。在分布内测试中，摊销初始化搭配少量优化步骤，在质量-速度权衡边界上优于同等预算下随机初始化的逐图像优化方法，30步优化（单样本耗时约0.56秒）的性能仍优于预算翻倍的基线方法。将优化扩展到1000步后发现，该方法的优势不仅体现在速度上：摊销初始化比随机初始化更频繁地得到高质量重建结果。在MNIST与Fashion-MNIST真实图像数据集上，该方法相比已发表的逐图像优化器平均提升了密度指标，速度提升12~2600倍。

title: SandwichQuant: Which Parameters Matter Before and After Quantization?
title_zh: SandwichQuant（三明治量化框架）：量化前后哪些参数对性能起关键作用？
authors: Peng Xia, Junbiao Pang
abstract: Quantization correction methods usually optimize weights, quantization parameters, or reconstruction objectives, while the underlying parameter subspaces responsible for effective correction remain unclear. In this work, we study quantization correction from a parameter subspace perspective and reveal that correction capability is highly non-uniform across parameter groups. By decomposing trainable parameters into backbone weights, normalization-affine parameters, and quantization parameters, we show that the low-dimensional normalization-affine subspace provides a highly efficient correction direction under matched budgets. Based on this finding, we propose SandwichQuant, a two-stage normalization-affine correction framework that performs adaptation before and after quantization. The pre-stage improves quantization robustness, while the post-stage compensates residual errors after the quantized graph is fixed. Extensive experiments on vision models and large language models demonstrate consistent improvements under various low-bit quantization settings, validating the effectiveness of subspace-aligned correction.
summary_zh: 量化校正方法通常针对权重、量化参数或重构目标进行优化，但负责实现有效校正的底层参数子空间仍不明确。本研究从参数子空间视角出发对量化校正展开分析，发现不同参数组的校正能力存在高度非均匀性。通过将可训练参数分解为骨干网络权重、归一化仿射参数和量化参数三类，研究证明在匹配的计算预算下，低维归一化仿射子空间可提供效率极高的校正方向。基于该发现，本文提出SandwichQuant，一种两阶段归一化仿射校正框架，可分别在量化前和量化后执行自适应操作：前置阶段提升量化鲁棒性，后置阶段在量化计算图固定后补偿残差误差。针对视觉模型和大语言模型开展的大量实验证明，该方法在各类低位量化设置下均能实现稳定性能提升，验证了子空间对齐校正的有效性。

title: ViSculpt: Visual-Centric Agentic Geometry Editing
title_zh: ViSculpt：以视觉为中心的智能体几何编辑
authors: Bo Pang, Jiaqi Pan, Xiaocheng Zhang, Jiacheng Xu, Guoping Wang, Peng-Shuai Wang
abstract: 3D geometry editing is a critical yet labor-intensive part of the graphics pipeline, requiring artists to translate creative intent into precise operations in complex professional software. Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for script-based 3D creation, but script generation is less suited to perception-driven editing of arbitrary existing meshes, where execution must remain visually grounded and untouched regions should be preserved. We present a \emph{visual-centric}, training-free multi-agent system that edits existing 3D meshes directly in Blender by emulating the iterative workflow of human artists. Rather than generating scripts or regenerating geometry, our system operates through the Blender GUI: multimodal LLM agents observe the viewport, reason about the current mesh state, and execute localized edits through simulated user interactions. Experiments on a curated benchmark provide initial evidence that this agentic approach can follow natural language instructions, perform representative localized mesh edits, and preserve the overall identity of the input asset. Our results highlight a complementary regime for language-driven 3D editing: direct in-place modification of existing meshes within the native 3D editing workflow. We view this work as an exploratory step toward visual-centric agentic geometry editing in professional graphics software.
summary_zh: 3D几何编辑是图形流水线中至关重要但劳动密集度极高的环节，要求艺术家在复杂专业软件中将创作意图转化为精确操作。大语言模型（LLM）在基于脚本的3D创作领域已展现出应用潜力，但脚本生成方案并不适配面向任意现有网格的感知驱动编辑场景——这类场景要求编辑操作完全基于视觉反馈，同时保留未修改区域的原有特征。本文提出一种以视觉为中心、无需额外训练的多智能体系统，通过模拟人类艺术家的迭代工作流，直接在Blender中对现有3D网格进行编辑。该系统不生成脚本也不重新生成几何结构，而是通过Blender图形用户界面运行：多模态大语言模型智能体观察视口内容，推理当前网格状态，再通过模拟用户交互执行局部编辑。在精心构建的基准测试集上开展的实验初步证明，该智能体方案可遵循自然语言指令，完成各类代表性局部网格编辑操作，同时保留输入资产的整体特征。研究结果展示了语言驱动3D编辑的全新互补范式：在原生3D编辑工作流内对现有网格进行直接原位修改，本工作是面向专业图形软件中以视觉为中心的智能体几何编辑方向的探索性研究。

title: Decoupling candidate dual AGN from chance superpositions in the GOTHIC survey via a deep-learning framework
title_zh: 基于深度学习框架从GOTHIC巡天的偶然叠加信号中分离候选双活动星系核
authors: Bhavesh Mukheja, Snehanshu Saha, Anwesh Bhattacharya, Mousumi Das, Fran\c{c}oise Combes, Sudhanshu Barway
abstract: Dual active galactic nuclei (DAGN) mark a critical phase in the evolution of merging galaxies and the pairing of supermassive black holes, yet they remain difficult to identify in large imaging surveys because of projection effects and limited spatial resolution. Compact foreground stars and unresolved substructure can mimic dual nuclei through chance superposition, complicating automated detection. We revisit the 46,061 galaxies flagged but rejected as DAGN candidates by the GOTHIC pipeline, primarily because the two nuclei fell within the SDSS fibre aperture or exceeded its separation threshold. We train a supervised deep-learning framework based on the YOLOv11 oriented-bounding-box architecture on annotated SDSS imaging to separate genuine dual nuclei from foreground stellar contaminants and other spurious alignments. The final model attains a validation precision of 0.919, recall of 0.905, and $F_1$ of 0.912 for the dual-nuclei class, and yields 29,605 dual-nucleus candidates after removing star-dominated and blended detections. Structured visual inspection indicates that $54.5$--$62\%$ are consistent with genuine dual nuclei, implying $\sim(1.4$--$1.8)\times10^{4}$ plausible systems. Cross-calibrating the YOLO separation against the deterministic GOTHIC centroid measurement and restricting to the compact regime ($d \le 6.87''$) gives a conservative subset of $\sim 13{,}672$ candidates, reaching calibrated separations of $\sim 0.56''$. Spectroscopy of the most compact ($\le 1$~kpc) systems shows they are dominated by passive, absorption-line galaxies with no resolved double-peaked emission, so confirmation requires higher-resolution follow-up. The catalogue is a statistically refined list of candidates, not confirmed DAGN. Nonetheless, deep-learning detection substantially reduces contamination and expands the plausible DAGN census.
summary_zh: 双活动星系核（DAGN）是并合星系演化与超大质量黑洞配对过程中的关键阶段，但受投影效应和空间分辨率限制，在大成像巡天中始终难以识别。致密前景恒星和未解析子结构可通过偶然叠加模拟出双核特征，给自动检测带来极大干扰。本研究重新分析了GOTHIC流水线标记为DAGN候选但最终被剔除的46061个星系样本，这类样本被剔除的主要原因是两个核均落在斯隆数字巡天（SDSS）光纤孔径范围内，或间距超过了预设阈值。研究基于YOLOv11定向边界框架构，在标注的SDSS影像上训练有监督深度学习框架，从前景恒星污染和其他伪对齐信号中分离出真实双核。最终模型在双核分类任务上的验证集精确率为0.919、召回率为0.905、F1值为0.912，剔除恒星主导和混合检测结果后共得到29605个双核候选样本。结构化人工目视检查显示其中54.5%~62%的样本符合真实双核特征，对应约1.4×10^4~1.8×10^4个可信系统。将YOLO输出的间距测量结果与确定性GOTHIC质心测量结果交叉校准，并限定在间距d≤6.87角秒的致密区间后，得到包含约13672个候选样本的保守子集，校准后间距可达约0.56角秒。对间距≤1千秒差距的最致密系统开展光谱分析发现，这类系统以无解析双峰发射线的被动吸收线星系为主，需更高分辨率的后续观测才能完成确认。本目录是经过统计优化的候选样本列表，并非已确认的双活动星系核集合，但深度学习检测大幅降低了样本污染率，拓展了可信双活动星系核的样本库规模。

title: Rethinking Pre-Training and Augmentation for Zero-Shot Cross-City Object Detection
title_zh: 面向零样本跨城目标检测的预训练与数据增强方法再思考
authors: Long Hoang Pham, Quoc Pham-Nam Ho, Huy-Hung Nguyen, Duong Nguyen-Ngoc Tran, Ngoc Doan-Minh Huynh, Cu Quoc Le, Hoang-Khang Nguyen, Hyung-Min Jeon, Chi Dai Tran, Son Hong Phan, Duong Khac Vu, Trinh Le Ba Khanh, Jae Wook Jeon
abstract: Real-world deployment of traffic surveillance systems is bottlenecked by geographic domain shift, in which models trained in one city underperform when applied to an unseen target city. Conventional domain adaptation relies on hyperparameter-sensitive architectures or direct profiling of target data. Both are fundamentally precluded in privacy-conscious ecosystems that require completely blind training and evaluation loops. In this setting, we explore the effects of pre-training and augmentation in addressing the domain shift problem. Specifically, we propose a new modular training pipeline for object detection structured around two core orthogonal pillars: (1) a multi-dataset pre-training strategy featuring a class-agnostic objectness distillation to decouple structural vehicle geometry from semantic taxonomies, and (2) a domain-resilient augmentation stream featuring a novel Grayworld transformation that forces global attention heads to strip volatile chromatic shortcuts in favor of robust shape priors. When evaluated with the real-time transformer-based detector RF-DETR, our framework bridges cross-city distribution gaps while using limited GPU memory (16GB). Our optimized variants, RF-DETR-HR and RF-DETR-Grayworld, deliver a substantial empirical gain of +24.29 over the baseline, achieving 1st place (47.53 mAP) on the AI City Challenge Track 6 leaderboard. Code and data are available at: \href{https://github.com/SKKUAutoLab/aic26_cross_city}{SKKUAutoLab/aic26\_cross\_city}.
summary_zh: 交通监控系统的实际部署受地理域偏移问题制约：在某一城市训练的模型迁移到未见过的目标城市时性能会出现明显下降。传统域自适应方法依赖对超参数敏感的架构，或需要直接采集目标数据的特征，二者均无法适配要求完全闭环盲训练与盲评估的隐私保护场景。针对该场景，本文探索了预训练和数据增强在解决域偏移问题中的作用，提出一种面向目标检测的模块化训练流水线，其核心由两个相互正交的支柱构成：（1）多数据集预训练策略，采用类别无关的目标性蒸馏方法，将车辆的结构几何特征与语义分类体系解耦；（2）域鲁棒增强流，提出全新的Grayworld（灰世界）变换方法，迫使全局注意力头剥离不稳定的色彩捷径特征，转而学习鲁棒的形状先验知识。在基于实时Transformer的检测器RF-DETR上开展的评估显示，该框架仅需16GB GPU显存即可弥合跨城分布差距。优化得到的RF-DETR-HR和RF-DETR-Grayworld模型相比基线性能大幅提升24.29个百分点，在AI City挑战赛第6赛道排行榜上以47.53 mAP的成绩位列第一。相关代码和数据已开源至：https://github.com/SKKUAutoLab/aic26_cross_city。

title: What Does Prompt Learning Change? -A Natural-Language Concept Analysis of Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 提示学习改变了什么？——面向视觉语言模型的自然语言概念分析
authors: Ryo Kamiya, Hiroshi Kera, Kazuhiko Kawamoto
abstract: Prompt learning adapts vision-language models such as CLIP by optimizing continuous prompt vectors, but the learned prompts are difficult to interpret in natural language. We present PromptSpLiCE, a post-hoc method that expresses each class-conditioned text embedding as a sparse combination of concepts from a fixed natural-language dictionary. Using the same dictionary before and after prompt learning allows us to compare changes in their concept profiles. We evaluate PromptSpLiCE on CoOp, a representative prompt-learning method, across 11 image-classification datasets. The concept profiles change substantially: on average, only 1.6 of the initial top-10 concepts remain in the top 10 after learning. Across datasets, profile change is positively associated with accuracy gain. We also derive a local gradient expression that provides geometric intuition for why image-aligned concept directions distinct from the current prompt can have greater loss sensitivity.
summary_zh: 提示学习通过优化连续提示向量实现对CLIP等视觉语言模型的自适应，但学习得到的提示很难用自然语言解释。本文提出PromptSpLiCE，一种事后分析方法，可将每个类别条件文本嵌入表示为固定自然语言字典中概念的稀疏组合。通过在提示学习前后使用同一字典，可对比二者的概念分布差异。研究在11个图像分类数据集上针对代表性提示学习方法CoOp开展PromptSpLiCE评估，发现提示学习后的概念分布发生显著变化：平均而言，初始排名前10的概念中仅有1.6个在学习完成后仍保留在前10位。跨数据集统计显示，概念分布变化程度与精度提升呈正相关。本文还推导了局部梯度表达式，从几何层面解释了为何与当前提示方向不同的图像对齐概念方向具备更高的损失敏感度。

title: Rubrics as Visual-Repair Context for Self-Evolving UI-to-Code Generation
title_zh: 以评分细则作为视觉修复上下文的自进化UI转代码生成方法
authors: Tianyi Xiong, Zhengyuan Yang, Xiaofei Wang, Chung-Ching Lin, Ruichun Ma, Kevin Lin, Zhendong Wang, Linjie Li, Chenxi Liu, Ruibo Chen, Ramani Duraiswami, Heng Huang, Lijuan Wang
abstract: Large vision-language models have shown strong progress in UI-to-code generation, yet their test-time self-evolution remains unstable. We first identify a fundamental obstacle, termed visual repair coupling: a local code edit may propagate through layout, style, and component dependencies, correcting one visual mismatch while degrading regions that were previously faithful. To address this issue, we present RubSE, a Rubric-guided Self-Evolution framework that uses rubrics to represent visual feedback as a structured visual-repair context. At each refinement round, RubSE generates typed candidate rubrics, selects one prioritized repair target, and stores previously selected rubrics as history, thereby steering each revision toward a well-scoped visual repair while discouraging repeated or over-broad changes. Evaluations across six VLMs and three UI-to-code benchmarks demonstrate that RubSE substantially outperforms na\"ive self-evolution in final-round and best-round settings, achieving more stable refinement trajectories and a higher trajectory-level performance ceiling. Further analysis shows that RubSE mitigates trajectory collapse by improving recovery from severe visual regressions, and that stronger rubric generators can transfer effective visual-repair guidance to weaker code improvers.
summary_zh: 大视觉语言模型在UI转代码生成领域已取得显著进展，但测试阶段的自进化过程仍不稳定。本研究首先识别出一个核心障碍，命名为视觉修复耦合：局部代码编辑可能通过布局、样式和组件依赖关系传导，在修正某一处视觉不匹配的同时，导致原本正确的区域出现性能退化。针对该问题，本文提出RubSE，一种基于评分细则（Rubric）引导的自进化框架，利用评分细则将视觉反馈表示为结构化的视觉修复上下文。在每一轮优化迭代中，RubSE生成带类型标注的候选评分细则，选择一个优先级最高的修复目标，并将之前选中的评分细则存储为历史记录，从而引导每一次修订都聚焦于范围明确的视觉修复，避免重复修改或修改范围过宽的问题。在6个视觉语言模型和3个UI转代码基准上开展的评估显示，RubSE在最终轮和最优轮设置下的性能均显著优于朴素自进化方法，可实现更稳定的优化轨迹和更高的轨迹级性能上限。进一步分析表明，RubSE可通过提升严重视觉退化场景下的恢复能力缓解轨迹崩溃问题，且性能更强的评分细则生成器可将有效的视觉修复指导迁移给性能较弱的代码优化器。

title: EgoErrorVQA: Assess Egocentric Comprehension Capabilities through Procedural Errors for Ego-Agentic AI
title_zh: EgoErrorVQA：面向自主体人工智能的基于过程错误评估第一视角理解能力的方法
authors: Junlong Li, Junxi Li, Jianjun Gao, Chen Cai, Lap-Pui Chau, Yi Wang
abstract: The majority of our everyday activities are procedural and consist of sequences of interdependent steps. However, existing benchmarks for Visual Agents and Visual Language Models (VLMs) overlook the evaluation of their procedural comprehension ability from an egocentric visual perspective, particularly for detecting procedural errors, a critical capability for everyday assistance. To bridge this gap, the EgoErrorVQA task is firstly proposed for egocentric procedural comprehension with explicit procedural errors modeling. Besides, we develop a user-friendly evaluator agent based on the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, enabling rigorous and standardized evaluation of visual agents through VQA-based interaction. A range of models are evaluated using both open-ended and multiple-choice questions, revealing persistent weaknesses in handling procedural errors and error types. Moreover, we introduce Ego-ADR, an Adaptive Decoupled Reasoning framework that decouples complex procedural reasoning to enhance models' understanding of procedural errors. It achieves consistent performance gains over the selected baselines and attains state-of-the-art results on several metrics under comparable settings. Code: https://github.com/z1oong/EgoErrorVQA
summary_zh: 人类日常活动大多是过程性的，由一系列相互关联的步骤组成。但现有的视觉智能体和视觉语言模型（VLM）基准均未从第一视角视觉维度评估其过程理解能力，尤其是检测过程错误的能力——这是日常辅助场景下的核心能力。为填补这一空白，本文首次提出EgoErrorVQA任务，通过显式建模过程错误实现第一视角过程理解评估。此外，本文基于Agent2Agent（A2A）协议开发了易用的评估智能体，可通过基于VQA的交互对视觉智能体开展严格标准化评估。研究使用开放式问题和选择题对一系列主流模型开展测试，结果显示现有模型在处理过程错误和错误类型识别方面存在持续的性能短板。本文进一步提出Ego-ADR，一种自适应解耦推理框架，通过解耦复杂过程推理提升模型对过程错误的理解能力，在可比设置下相比基线模型实现了稳定性能提升，在多个指标上达到当前最优水平。代码开源地址：https://github.com/z1oong/EgoErrorVQA。

title: PlaceSeek: Human-Centered Geospatial Retrieval of Urban Outdoor Places via Semantic Grounding and Affective Alignment
title_zh: PlaceSeek：基于语义 grounding 和情感对齐的以人为中心的城市户外场所地理空间检索
authors: Ziqi Cui, Shangyu Lou
abstract: People search for urban outdoor places not only by category or function, but also by what activities a place can support and how it is perceived. Existing geospatial retrieval remains largely POIcentric and metadata-driven, making it difficult to satisfy openended, affective, or activity-oriented needs. We present PlaceSeek, a human-centered outdoor place retrieval framework that maps natural-language queries to geolocated street-view imagery. PlaceSeek introduces an intent-aware retrieval mechanism that decomposes user queries into functional and affective sub-intents. A Semantic Grounding Module verifies whether candidate street-view results contain the physical evidence needed to support the intended activity, while an Affective Alignment Module re-ranks physically valid candidates using a LoRA-adapted vision-language model trained on human urban perception judgments. We evaluate PlaceSeek on 31,956 street-view locations in Milan across 10 naturallanguage queries annotated by five human evaluators. PlaceSeek achieves 88.0% Precision@5, a mean match score of 3.39/4.0, and 0.920 nDCG@5, outperforming CLIP, fine-tuned CLIP, SigLIP, and a VQA-based baseline. Ablation results show that physical grounding is essential for retrieval validity, while affective alignment improves ranking quality among physically valid candidates. These findings highlight that complex urban spatial queries require modeling both verifiable visual evidence and human perceptual preferences. PlaceSeek provides a potential framework for human-centered nextgeneration geospatial retrieval systems.
summary_zh: 用户检索城市户外场所时不仅依据类别或功能，还会参考场所可支持的活动类型和自身对场所的感知体验。现有地理空间检索方法大多以兴趣点（POI）为中心、依赖元数据驱动，难以满足开放式、情感化或面向活动的检索需求。本文提出PlaceSeek，一种以人为中心的户外场所检索框架，可将自然语言查询映射到带地理坐标的街景图像。PlaceSeek引入意图感知检索机制，将用户查询分解为功能子意图和情感子意图：语义接地模块验证候选街景结果中是否存在支撑目标活动的物理证据，情感对齐模块使用在人类城市感知标注数据上训练的LoRA自适应视觉语言模型，对通过物理有效性验证的候选结果进行重排序。研究在米兰市31956个街景点位上，针对由5名标注人员标注的10条自然语言查询开展评估，结果显示PlaceSeek的Precision@5达到88.0%，平均匹配得分为3.39/4.0，nDCG@5为0.920，性能超过CLIP、微调CLIP、SigLIP和基于VQA的基线方法。消融实验结果表明，物理接地是保证检索有效性的核心要素，而情感对齐可提升物理有效候选集内的排序质量。上述发现说明复杂城市空间检索需要同时对可验证的视觉证据和人类感知偏好进行建模，PlaceSeek可为下一代以人为中心的地理空间检索系统提供可行的框架参考。

title: Syn2RealTrack: Bridging the Gap Between Synthetic and Real-World Datasets for Online Multi-View Multi-Target Tracking
title_zh: Syn2RealTrack：弥合合成数据集与真实世界数据集差距的在线多视角多目标跟踪方法
authors: Duong Nguyen-Ngoc Tran, Ngoc Doan-Minh Huynh, Cu Quoc Le, Hoang-Khang Nguyen, Long Hoang Pham, Huy-Hung Nguyen, Quoc Pham-Nam Ho, Trinh Le Ba Khanh, Chi Dai Tran, Duong Khac Vu, Son Hong Phan, Hyung-Min Jeon, Jae Wook Jeon
abstract: Multi-camera 3D perception systems for warehouse scenes are trained largely on synthetic data and evaluated on physically captured environments. The resulting synthetic-to-real gap, which corrupts ground-plane localization and cross-camera identity association, is usually treated as one deficiency for a single domain-adaptation module to absorb; we argue instead that it enters the pipeline at three separable points: the camera calibration, the object shape prior, and the assumption that the object census is known, each admitting a different local remedy. Our online pipeline, Syn2RealTrack, follows this decomposition: lens distortion is recovered from images alone under a calibration that provides none, detections are fused across views by a visibility-weighted part-based descriptor that abstains on occluded parts rather than guessing, person height is measured in closed form from calibration instead of copied from a synthetic prior, and a closed-world cardinality prior is paired with a causal filter that removes the phantom boxes the prior manufactures. The system therefore adapts by reallocating trust between geometry and appearance without retraining a feature extractor. On the AI City Challenge 2026 Track~1 evaluation server it reaches a 3D Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA) of 52.0118%. The code will be released at https://github.com/SKKUAutoLab/aic26_mc3dp
summary_zh: 面向仓库场景的多相机3D感知系统大多基于合成数据训练，在真实采集环境下评估，由此产生的合成到真实域差距会破坏地面定位精度和跨相机身份关联效果，现有方法通常将其视为单一域自适应模块即可解决的缺陷。本文指出该域差距会在流水线的三个独立节点产生影响：相机标定环节、目标形状先验环节、目标总数已知的假设环节，每个节点都可采用针对性的局部优化方案。本文提出的在线跟踪流水线Syn2RealTrack遵循该分解思路：在无标定参数的条件下仅从图像中恢复镜头畸变，通过可见性加权的部件描述子跨视角融合检测结果，对被遮挡部件不做强行推测，直接从标定结果中闭式计算行人高度而非复用合成数据先验，将闭世界基数先验与因果滤波器结合，消除先验引入的虚检框。该系统无需重新训练特征提取器，仅通过在几何特征和外观特征之间重新分配置信度即可完成自适应。在AI City挑战赛2026年第1赛道评估服务器上，该系统的3D高阶跟踪精度（HOTA）达到52.0118%。代码将开源至：https://github.com/SKKUAutoLab/aic26_mc3dp。

title: Graph-Supervised Hierarchical Clinical Alignment for Radiology Report Generation with Large Language Models
title_zh: 面向大语言模型放射报告生成的图监督分层临床对齐方法
authors: Yingshu Li, Yunyi Liu, Zhanyu Wang, Zailong Chen, Lingqiao Liu, Lei Wang, Luping Zhou
abstract: Radiology report generation (RRG) has recently benefited from large language models, which substantially improve report fluency. However, clinically faithful generation remains challenging because current supervision is still imposed mostly at the report level. This creates a granularity mismatch: radiology reports are composed of disease-grounded findings, while existing methods are trained mainly with whole-report objectives. To address this problem, we propose Graph-Supervised Hierarchical Clinical Alignment, which reformulates image-report supervision as a hierarchical clinical alignment problem. Our method structures this alignment as a disease-conditioned process, where supervision is decomposed into two levels: Disease-Centric Alignment for fine-grained disease-specific correspondence, and Global Clinical Semantic Alignment for report-level semantic coherence. A clinical knowledge graph is used as a training-time-only structural prior that defines disease-specific supervision units and their clinical relationships, introducing no additional overhead at inference. Because standard contrastive alignment could produce false negatives when studies share overlapping pathologies, we combine instance-conditioned discriminative matching with disease-conditioned soft regularization, enabling fine-grained yet clinically consistent cross-modal representations. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR, IU-Xray, and COV-CTR show that our method consistently improves performance on both conventional and clinical metrics. Notably, our 3B model surpasses several prior systems with larger 7B/13B backbones, suggesting that improving supervision structure, rather than increasing model size, can be more effective for RRG.
summary_zh: 近年来放射报告生成（RRG）任务受益于大语言模型的发展，报告流畅度得到显著提升，但临床层面的生成准确性仍面临挑战，原因是当前监督信号大多仅施加在报告整体层面，存在粒度不匹配问题：放射报告由多个基于真实病灶的发现组成，而现有方法主要采用全报告目标训练。针对该问题，本文提出图监督分层临床对齐方法，将图像-报告监督重构为分层临床对齐问题。该方法将对齐过程建模为病灶条件下的处理流程，监督信号分解为两个层级：面向细粒度病灶对应关系的以疾病为中心的对齐，以及面向报告整体语义一致性的全局临床语义对齐。系统将临床知识图作为仅在训练阶段使用的结构先验，定义病灶专属的监督单元及其临床关联关系，推理阶段不会引入额外开销。考虑到标准对比对齐方法在样本存在重叠病理时容易产生假阴性问题，本文将实例条件判别匹配与病灶条件软正则化相结合，生成兼具细粒度特性和临床一致性的跨模态表示。在MIMIC-CXR、IU-Xray和COV-CTR三个数据集上开展的实验表明，该方法在常规指标和临床指标上的性能均得到持续提升。值得注意的是，本文训练的3B参数模型性能超过多个采用7B/13B更大骨干网络的现有系统，说明优化监督结构而非盲目扩大模型规模是提升放射报告生成性能的更有效路径。

title: TransPhy: Visual In-Context Learning for Physically Grounded Image Editing
title_zh: TransPhy：面向物理约束图像编辑的可视化上下文学习方法
authors: Siyi Xie, Xuanke Shi, Jinsheng Quan, Haoran Tang, Zukai Chen, Lei Yang, Quan Wang
abstract: Visual demonstrations provide a natural interface for specifying image transformations that are difficult to describe exhaustively with text. However, existing visual in-context learning (VICL) methods primarily focus on appearance-level relation transfer and provide limited support for physically grounded transformations, whose outcomes depend on material properties, geometry, object interactions, and environmental conditions. Given a source--target exemplar pair and a query image, physically grounded VICL requires a model to infer the demonstrated transformation, adapt its effects to the query-specific scene context, and preserve rule-irrelevant content. We introduce PhysVICL-74, comprising 74 physically grounded transformation rules and 5,240 source--target image pairs that form nearly 75K training and evaluation contexts. Its benchmark split separately evaluates novel-instance transfer and unseen-rule generalization. We further propose TransPhy, a framework that decomposes physically grounded VICL into physical-rule induction and transition-aligned rendering. TransPhy first predicts the demonstrated rule and an explicit query-specific target-state description, and then synthesizes the target image through token-wise mixture-of-experts adaptation, with expert routing guided by localized transition cues. Experiments show that TransPhy improves physical-rule adherence, query consistency, and unseen-rule generalization over existing visual in-context editing methods.
summary_zh: 视觉演示为指定图像变换提供了一种自然接口，这类变换很难用文本进行详尽描述。但现有视觉上下文学习（Visual In-Context Learning, VICL）方法主要聚焦外观层面的关系迁移，对物理约束变换的支持十分有限，这类变换的输出结果取决于材料属性、几何特征、物体交互关系与环境条件。给定一组源-目标示例对和一张查询图像，面向物理约束的VICL要求模型推断出演示的变换规则，将变换效果适配到查询图像对应的场景上下文，同时保留与规则无关的内容。本文构建了PhysVICL-74数据集，包含74项物理约束变换规则、5240组源-目标图像对，可生成近7.5万个训练与评估上下文，其基准划分方案可分别评估新实例迁移能力与未见规则泛化能力。本文进一步提出TransPhy框架，将面向物理约束的VICL任务分解为物理规则归纳与变换对齐渲染两个模块：TransPhy首先预测演示的规则与明确的查询专属目标状态描述，再通过逐标记混合专家适配生成目标图像，专家路由过程由局部变换线索引导。实验结果表明，与现有视觉上下文编辑方法相比，TransPhy在物理规则遵循度、查询一致性与未见规则泛化能力上均有提升。

title: ExMesh++: From Multi-View Images to Relightable UV-PBR Mesh Assets via Topology-Adaptive Reconstruction and Decomposition
title_zh: ExMesh++：通过拓扑自适应重建与分解实现从多视图图像到可重光照UV-PBR网格资产的生成
authors: Chuanjin Fan, Lifan Wu, Wenjie Chang, Hanzhi Chang, Wenfei Yang, Tianzhu Zhang
abstract: Multi-view reconstruction extends beyond surface recovery to editable and relightable mesh assets. Such assets require well-formed topology, valid UV parameterization, and explicit PBR material maps. Existing surface reconstruction approaches optimize implicit fields, Gaussian primitives, or other intermediate representations. Converting them into such assets often requires surface extraction and texture baking. Inverse-rendering methods estimate materials and illumination, yet these components often remain tied to neural fields or point-based primitives rather than the final mesh. Joint optimization of geometry, materials, and lighting may also allow these variables to compensate for one another, leading to ambiguous decomposition. To address these limitations, we present ExMesh++, a staged framework for reconstructing relightable UV-PBR mesh assets from multi-view images. The first stage refines explicit mesh geometry and topology through adaptive vertex splitting and merging, while maintaining UV consistency as the topology changes. The second stage fixes the resulting mesh-UV carrier and optimizes UV-space PBR maps together with environment lighting. Building on this stable carrier, ExMesh++ models one-bounce diffuse indirect illumination through secondary-ray tracing with shared UV-PBR materials. Experiments demonstrate competitive geometry accuracy, strong relighting performance, and direct usability of the exported assets in standard DCC workflows.
summary_zh: 多视图重建的目标已经从表面恢复延伸到可编辑、可重光照的网格资产生成，这类资产要求具备结构合理的拓扑、有效的UV参数化结果与明确的基于物理渲染（Physically Based Rendering, PBR）材质图。现有表面重建方法通常优化隐式场、高斯基元或其他中间表示，将这类表示转换为符合要求的资产往往需要执行表面提取与纹理烘焙操作。逆渲染方法可以估计材质与光照信息，但这类组件通常仍绑定在神经场或点基元上，无法直接关联最终网格。对几何、材质与光照的联合优化还可能导致不同变量之间互相补偿，最终得到歧义的分解结果。为解决上述局限，本文提出ExMesh++，一个从多视图图像重建可重光照UV-PBR网格资产的分阶段框架：第一阶段通过自适应顶点分裂与合并优化显式网格的几何与拓扑，同时在拓扑变化过程中保持UV一致性；第二阶段固定生成的网格-UV载体，在UV空间内联合优化PBR图与环境光照。基于该稳定载体，ExMesh++通过共享UV-PBR材质的二次光线追踪建模单次漫反射间接光照。实验证明该方法的几何精度表现优异，重光照性能突出，导出的资产可直接在标准数字内容创作（Digital Content Creation, DCC）工作流中使用。

title: MatReplace: A Reference-Free, Conditioning-Aligned Benchmark for Material Replacement in Interior Scenes
title_zh: MatReplace：面向室内场景材质替换的无参考、条件对齐基准测试集
authors: Mingzhe Du, Thong Thanh Nguyen, Nguyen Tran Cong Duy, See-Kiong Ng, Luu Anh Tuan
abstract: Material replacement is a common interior-design operation: changing the material of a selected surface while preserving its geometry, surroundings, and illumination. Despite its commercial relevance, no public benchmark isolates this task, and evaluating it is challenging. Reference-based metrics penalize valid outputs in this inherently one-to-many setting, favor the style of the reference generator, and cannot fairly compare editors that receive different forms of guidance. We introduce MatReplace, a reference-free benchmark that evaluates edits along four verifiable dimensions: local material correctness, global lighting harmony, outside preservation, and inside structure. It defines three tracks that vary one conditioning signal at a time: (A) instruction only, (B) instruction plus region mask, and (C) material reference image instead of instruction. Our results reveal a clear divide between naming and visually grounding materials. In Track A, leading closed-source editors achieve exemplar-level material rendering and surpass the exemplar anchor under our primary aggregate. In Track B, masks help only mask-compatible models with weak scene preservation, with task-paired, single-seed effects ranging from +0.137 to -0.090 across aligned model families. In Track C, reference-image conditioning degrades every family under both aggregates, by -0.031 to -0.508; in the worst cases, models repaint the reference image itself and perform worse than returning the input unchanged. Thus, named-material rendering is largely solved by the strongest closed editors on this distribution, but grounding materials from pixels remains an open challenge. Expert ratings validate our ranking (Kendall's tau = 0.68) and align with our aggregates more closely than GT-referenced or CLIP-based baselines.
summary_zh: 材质替换是室内设计领域的常见操作：在保留选中表面的几何特征、周边环境与光照条件的前提下，替换该表面的材质。尽管该任务具备很高的商业价值，但目前尚无公开基准专门对其进行隔离评测，该任务的评估工作也存在诸多难点：在这类天然一对多的任务场景下，基于参考的评测指标会惩罚合理的输出结果，偏向参考生成器的风格，也无法公平对比接收不同引导形式的编辑模型。本文提出MatReplace，一个无参考基准测试集，从四个可验证维度评估编辑效果：局部材质正确性、全局光照协调性、非编辑区域保留度、内部结构完整性。该基准设置了三个赛道，每次仅改变一类条件信号：（A）仅输入指令、（B）输入指令加区域掩码、（C）输入材质参考图像替代指令。实验结果清晰展现了材质命名与材质视觉落地能力之间的差距：在A赛道，头部闭源编辑模型可实现示例级的材质渲染效果，在本文的核心聚合指标下表现超过示例锚点；在B赛道，掩码仅对场景保留能力较弱的掩码兼容型模型有增益，同系列对齐模型的任务配对单种子效果波动范围为+0.137到-0.090；在C赛道，参考图像条件会导致所有模型系列的两类聚合指标均出现下降，降幅范围为-0.031到-0.508，最差情况下模型会直接重绘参考图像本身，表现甚至不如直接返回输入图像。上述结果说明，在该数据分布下，最强的闭源编辑模型已经基本解决了命名材质渲染问题，但从像素信息中落地材质属性仍是尚未解决的开放挑战。专家评分结果验证了本文评测排名的有效性（Kendall相关系数为0.68），相比基于真值参考或CLIP的基线指标，本文提出的聚合指标与专家评分的一致性更高。

title: DRRG: A Discrete Diffusion Framework for Radiology Report Generation
title_zh: DRRG：面向放射学报告生成的离散扩散框架
authors: Shaoyang Zhoua, Yingshu Li, Yunyi Liu, Lijun Pu, Lingqiao Liu, Lei Wang, Luping Zhou
abstract: Conclusion: Discrete diffusion provides an effective alternative to autoregressive radiology report generation by enabling iterative, bidirectional report refinement. Incorporating clinically focused masking and image-derived concept conditioning improves report quality and clinical consistency.
summary_zh: 研究结论：离散扩散通过支持迭代式双向报告优化，为自回归放射学报告生成提供了一种有效替代方案。融入面向临床的掩码机制与图像衍生概念条件约束，可提升生成报告的质量与临床一致性。

title: Joint-Embedding Prediction of Masked Point Tubes for Self-Supervised Learning on 4D Point Cloud Videos
title_zh: 面向4D点云视频自监督学习的掩码点管联合嵌入预测方法
authors: Jheng-Ling Lee, Shang-Tse Chen
abstract: Self-supervised representation learning for 4D point cloud videos is challenging because annotations are costly and reconstruction-based pretraining can overemphasize low-level geometric details. We propose a JEPA-style framework that learns from unlabeled spatiotemporal point clouds through latent point-tube prediction. Instead of reconstructing raw coordinates, the model masks spatiotemporal regions and predicts their target representations from visible context representations in feature space. To stabilize latent prediction, we incorporate Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization, which encourages non-collapsed embeddings without relying on explicit reconstruction targets. This formulation aims to capture both spatial structure and temporal dynamics while keeping the pretraining objective aligned with downstream semantic recognition. Experiments on action and gesture recognition benchmarks show that the learned representations improve downstream fine-tuning, limited-label learning, and cross-dataset transfer. These results suggest that JEPA-style latent prediction is a promising alternative to reconstruction-centered pretraining for 4D point cloud videos.
summary_zh: 4D点云视频的自监督表征学习任务存在诸多挑战：标注成本高昂，且基于重建的预训练方法会过度强调底层几何细节。本文提出一种类JEPA框架，通过潜在点管预测从无标注时空点云中学习特征。该模型不重建原始坐标，而是对时空区域执行掩码操作，在特征空间中从可见上下文表征预测掩码区域的目标表征。为稳定潜在预测过程，本文引入草图化各向同性高斯正则化方法，无需依赖显式重建目标即可避免表征坍缩。该方法可同时捕捉空间结构与时间动态特征，且预训练目标与下游语义识别任务保持对齐。在动作与手势识别基准上的实验结果表明，学习得到的表征可提升下游微调、少标签学习与跨数据集迁移的性能。上述结果证明，类JEPA的潜在预测方法是4D点云视频领域中，以重建为核心的预训练方案的极具潜力的替代方向。

title: ORBITALIF: An Efficient Spiking Federated Learning Framework for Onboard Cloud Removal
title_zh: ORBITALIF：面向星上去云的高效脉冲联邦学习框架
authors: Bohan Zhang, Chenyu Xu, Yijie Mao, Yuanming Shi
abstract: Low-earth-orbit (LEO) satellites enable high-resolution, large-scale Earth observation for applications such as disaster monitoring and environmental surveillance. However, cloud coverage often obscures the Earth's surface, and conventional cloud-removal pipelines that download cloudy images to ground stations for processing suffer from limited contact windows, constrained satellite-to-ground bandwidth, and high latency. In this work, we propose a novel satellite federated learning framework for cloud removal across LEO constellations, named orbital attention leaky integrate-and-fire (OrbitALIF). OrbitALIF performs both onboard training and inference using a compact 2.30,M-parameter spiking neural network (SNN) backbone with an adaptive gated fusion module (AGFM) and a spectral-spatial hybrid attention module (SHAM), combined with a decentralized federated learning strategy that shares model weights via inter-satellite links. Our experiments show that OrbitALIF achieves competitive cloud removal quality while consuming only 0.287,mJ per inference on neuromorphic hardware, a 72.3 times (98.6%) energy reduction versus an equivalent artificial neural network (ANN).
summary_zh: 低轨（Low-Earth-Orbit, LEO）卫星可实现高分辨率大规模地球观测，支撑灾害监测、环境巡检等应用场景。但云覆盖经常遮挡地表信息，传统去云流水线需要将含云图像下载到地面站处理，存在卫星接触窗口有限、星地带宽不足、延迟高等问题。本文提出一种面向低轨星座跨卫星去云的新型联邦学习框架，命名为轨道注意力泄漏积分放电（Orbital Attention Leaky Integrate-and-Fire, OrbitALIF）。OrbitALIF采用参数量仅2.30M的轻量脉冲神经网络（Spiking Neural Network, SNN）作为骨干网络，搭配自适应门控融合模块（AGFM）与空谱混合注意力模块（SHAM），结合去中心化联邦学习策略，通过星间链路共享模型权重，可同时支持星上训练与推理。实验结果表明，OrbitALIF可达到与现有方法相当的去云质量，在神经形态硬件上单次推理仅消耗0.287mJ能量，相比同等性能的人工神经网络（Artificial Neural Network, ANN）能耗降低72.3倍（98.6%）。

title: Representation Learning in Diffusion and Flow-based Model: An Application Aspect
title_zh: 扩散与流基模型中的表征学习：应用视角综述
authors: Yanchen Xu, Sida Huang, Zhenyu Gu, Ruishu Zhu, Yilan Gao, Hongyuan Zhang
abstract: Diffusion models and flow-based models have recently become the dominant paradigms in generative modeling, largely due to their ability to learn rich, multi-level visual representations through large-scale training. This creates a bidirectional relationship between generative models and representation learning: improving representation learning enhances generation quality, while the learned representations can be leveraged for broader understanding tasks. This survey systematically explores this interplay with a focus on applications. We propose a three-tier progressive framework that organizes existing works from three perspectives: using representation learning to improve generative capabilities, exploiting generative models to extract representations for perception tasks, and ultimately moving toward general-purpose unified applications. We systematically categorize representative methods across a wide range of downstream tasks, including image classification, dense visual prediction, instance-level perception, and annotation-scarce scenarios. By providing a unified taxonomy and identifying key challenges, this survey aims to clarify the underlying logic of current research and suggest promising directions for future exploration. We hope this work can serve as a valuable reference for researchers interested in harnessing the representation power of generative models for applications beyond generation.
summary_zh: 扩散模型与流基模型近年来已成为生成建模领域的主流范式，这类模型通过大规模训练可学习到丰富的多层级视觉表征，这也催生了生成模型与表征学习之间的双向促进关系：优化表征学习可提升生成质量，而学习得到的表征可被用于更广泛的理解类任务。本综述聚焦应用场景，系统梳理了二者的交互关系，提出一个三层递进框架，从三个维度对现有研究进行归类：利用表征学习提升生成能力、利用生成模型为感知任务提取表征、最终面向通用统一应用。本文针对图像分类、稠密视觉预测、实例级感知、标注稀缺场景等各类下游任务的代表性方法进行了系统分类，通过构建统一分类体系、梳理核心挑战，厘清当前研究的底层逻辑，指出未来值得探索的潜在方向。本综述可为希望利用生成模型表征能力实现生成以外应用的研究者提供有价值的参考。

title: VisCache: Visual KV Cache Pruning for Efficient Vision Large Language Model Inference
title_zh: VisCache：面向高效视觉大语言模型推理的视觉KV缓存剪枝方法
authors: Lyuke Wang, Zhuo Li, Guangxu Zhu
abstract: While Vision Large Language Models (VLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in multimodal reasoning, their long-context inference remains prohibitively expensive due to the massive computation and memory overhead of visual Key-Value (KV) caches. Existing KV compression methods often apply uniform pruning across visual tokens and layers, leading to substantial information loss and degraded performance.To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{VisCache}, a plug-and-play framework for coarse-to-fine \textbf{Vis}ual KV \textbf{Cache} pruning without training, which consists of two synergistic stages. First, a lightweight VLM filters temporal redundancy by selectively forwarding semantically informative keyframes. Second, we introduce {PruneKV}, a surgical KV compression algorithm tailored to the attention dynamics of VLLMs. Unlike rigid pruning strategies, PruneKV adopts a parabolic layer-wise budget allocation together with an asymmetric update mechanism that selectively prunes keys while fusing values, thereby preserving critical contextual information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VisCache substantially improves inference efficiency, achieving up to {2.35$\times$ speedup} and significant memory reduction while maintaining competitive performance with only {19--28\%} KV cache retention. VisCache consistently outperforms existing baselines, establishing a new Pareto frontier between efficiency and performance for long-context VLLM inference. Code is available at https://github.com/Wlklk/VisCache
summary_zh: 视觉大语言模型（Vision Large Language Model, VLLM）在多模态推理任务上取得了优异表现，但由于视觉键值（Key-Value, KV）缓存会带来极高的计算与内存开销，其长上下文推理成本仍高到难以接受。现有KV压缩方法通常对所有视觉标记与层执行统一剪枝，会造成大量信息损失，导致模型性能下降。为解决该问题，本文提出VisCache，一款即插即用的无需训练的由粗到细视觉KV缓存剪枝框架，包含两个协同工作的阶段：第一阶段采用轻量级视觉大模型筛选语义信息丰富的关键帧，过滤时间冗余；第二阶段提出PruneKV，一款针对VLLM注意力动态特性定制的精细化KV压缩算法。与刚性剪枝策略不同，PruneKV采用抛物线型分层预算分配方案与非对称更新机制，选择性剪枝键的同时融合值，可保留关键上下文信息。大量实验结果表明，VisCache可大幅提升推理效率，仅保留19%~28%的KV缓存即可实现最高2.35倍的推理加速与显著的内存占用降低，同时保持极具竞争力的性能表现。VisCache的表现始终优于现有基线方法，为长上下文VLLM推理构建了效率与性能之间的新帕累托最优边界。代码开源地址为：https://github.com/Wlklk/VisCache

title: WeMM-Embedding: WeChat Multi-Modal Embedding Technical Report
title_zh: WeMM-Embedding：微信多模态嵌入技术报告
authors: Junjie Zhou, Ke Mei, Lei Li, Tianyi Wang, Fengyun Rao, Jing Lyu
abstract: Universal multimodal embeddings are becoming a core component of modern AI systems, enabling heterogeneous content to be represented in a shared space for applications such as retrieval, recommendation, classification, and agentic systems. In this report, we present WeMM-Embedding, a family of universal multimodal embedding models supporting text, images, videos, visual documents, and arbitrarily interleaved multimodal inputs with flexible output dimensions. The family comprises 2B, 4B, and 9B variants and is trained in two stages: a large-scale multimodal alignment stage, followed by a refinement stage using curated data, fine-grained relevance supervision, and cross-scale knowledge transfer. Across extensive evaluations, WeMM-Embedding achieves leading performance on multiple public benchmarks. Notably, the 2B variant already surpasses the previously leading 8B open-source baseline on MMEB-v2, while the 9B variant further achieves a new state-of-the-art overall score of 80.6. WeMM-Embedding also demonstrates strong practical performance across WeChat applications, with substantial gains on a 26-task in-house benchmark and consistent improvements across 14 online A/B tests. It has been deployed at scale across recommendation and search applications, including WeChat Channels, Official Accounts, Moments, and e-commerce services. We have released the model weights and code to facilitate future research at https://github.com/Tencent/WeMM-Embedding.
summary_zh: 通用多模态嵌入正在成为现代AI系统的核心组件，可将异构内容映射到共享特征空间，支撑检索、推荐、分类、智能体系统等各类应用。本报告介绍WeMM-Embedding，一套通用多模态嵌入模型系列，支持文本、图像、视频、视觉文档与任意交错的多模态输入，输出维度灵活可调。该模型系列包含2B、4B、9B三个参数版本，采用两阶段训练流程：第一阶段执行大规模多模态对齐训练，第二阶段基于精选数据、细粒度相关性监督与跨尺度知识迁移完成模型优化。大量评测结果显示，WeMM-Embedding在多个公开基准上取得领先性能：其中2B版本在MMEB-v2基准上的表现已经超过此前领先的8B开源基线，9B版本更是取得了80.6的当前最优总得分。WeMM-Embedding在微信各类业务场景中也展现出优异的实际性能，在26项内部评测任务上取得显著提升，在14个线上A/B测试中均获得一致收益。目前该模型已经在微信视频号、公众号、朋友圈、电商服务等推荐与搜索场景中大规模部署。我们已开源模型权重与代码，助力后续相关研究，开源地址为：https://github.com/Tencent/WeMM-Embedding

title: ConsensusTAS: Self-Supervised Temporal Action Segmentation for Long-Horizon Construction Videos
title_zh: ConsensusTAS：面向长时序施工视频的自监督时序动作分割方法
authors: Xiaoshan Zhou, Yafei Sun
abstract: Recognizing sequential construction activities is important for collaborative human-robot work; for example, robots are able to understand workers' current and upcoming actions and provide timely tool delivery or physical support. However, despite extensive research on construction worker activity recognition, existing studies have been limited to classifying activity categories, such as climbing, lifting, and walking, instead of recognizing fine-grained activity transitions from long-horizon sequences. Addressing this problem is challenging because annotating action temporal boundaries in long construction videos is time-consuming. In this study, we propose ConsensusTAS, a label-free, self-supervised learning approach to segment continuous video streams into distinct activity phases by exploiting the internal consensus of candidate segmentations. We evaluated our algorithm on three public datasets, where it outperformed state-of-the-art methods, achieving an F1@10 of 73.08 on GTEA, an F1@10 of 64.33 on Breakfast, and an F1@50 of 33.50 on static-camera videos from Assembly101. We also tested it on real-world construction videos, where post-hoc evaluation showed that the model successfully recognized and segmented actions within the composite activity of bricklaying, such as spreading mortar on a brick, placing the brick, pressing, and aligning. Compared with other temporal action segmentation models that require computationally intensive large vision-language models, our method can run on a CPU, which provides practical value for video surveillance and human-robot collaboration on mobile robotic platforms.
summary_zh: 识别连续施工活动对人机协同作业至关重要：例如机器人可理解工人当前与后续的动作，及时提供工具递送或物理支持。但现有施工人员动作识别相关研究大多局限于对攀爬、举升、行走等动作类别进行分类，无法从长时序视频序列中识别细粒度的动作切换过程。解决该问题存在明显挑战：对长施工视频的动作时间边界进行标注十分耗时。本研究提出ConsensusTAS，一种无标注自监督学习方法，通过挖掘候选分割结果的内部一致性，将连续视频流分割为不同的活动阶段。我们在三个公开数据集上对算法进行评测，其表现超过现有最优方法：在GTEA数据集上F1@10指标为73.08，在Breakfast数据集上F1@10指标为64.33，在Assembly101的静态相机视频子集上F1@50指标为33.50。我们还在真实施工视频上开展测试，事后评估结果显示该模型可成功识别并分割砌砖复合活动中的各类动作，包括在砖面上铺砂浆、放置砖块、按压砖块、对齐砖块等。与其他需要占用大量计算资源的大视觉语言模型的时序动作分割方法相比，本文提出的方法可在CPU上运行，对移动机器人平台上的视频监控与人机协同场景具备很高的实用价值。

title: Phase-Aligned Finite-Fourier Periodic Deformation for 4D Medical Image Interpolation
title_zh: 面向4D医学图像插值的相位对齐有限傅里叶周期形变方法
authors: Haojin Li, Hengzhuo Wang, Zhiheng Ma, Mingyang Ou, Heng Li, Jiang Liu
abstract: 4D medical image interpolation aims to recover missing volumes from sparsely observed time points and is important for dynamic anatomical analysis in applications such as cardiac MRI and thoracic CT, where motion is often repetitive or near-periodic over clinically relevant intervals. A key challenge is that this structure is not always encoded directly in deformation representations for interpolation. In addition, physiological motion is often non-uniform, so equal temporal intervals do not necessarily correspond to equal amounts of anatomical change. To address these issues, we formulate interpolation as learning a continuous deformation process with a phase-structured prior. Given two endpoint volumes, we parameterize a phase-conditioned velocity field with a finite Fourier basis, which embeds near-periodic motion patterns directly into the deformation space and supports continuous querying at arbitrary target times. We further introduce a phase-aligned temporal reparameterization that maps normalized within-interval time to a latent motion phase according to deformation variation intensity, thereby better modeling non-uniform motion progression. Intermediate volumes are then synthesized by continuously warping both endpoints, followed by bidirectional fusion and lightweight residual refinement. Experiments on ACDC and 4D-Lung show that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance over existing baselines while producing anatomically plausible and coherent intermediate volumes from sparse observations.
summary_zh: 4D医学图像插值旨在从稀疏观测的时间点中恢复缺失的体数据，在心脏MRI、胸部CT等动态解剖分析场景中具有重要价值，这类场景下的运动在临床相关时间区间内通常是重复或近周期的。该领域的核心挑战在于，这类近周期运动结构往往无法直接编码到插值所用的形变表示中；此外，生理运动通常是非均匀的，相等的时间间隔并不一定对应等量的解剖结构变化。为解决上述问题，本文将插值任务建模为基于相位结构先验的连续形变过程学习。给定两个端点体数据，我们使用有限傅里叶基对相位条件速度场进行参数化，直接将近周期运动模式嵌入形变空间，支持在任意目标时间点进行连续查询。本文进一步提出相位对齐的时间重参数化方法，根据形变变化强度将区间内归一化时间映射到潜在运动相位，从而更好地建模非均匀运动的演进过程。最终通过对两个端点体数据进行连续扭曲，结合双向融合与轻量残差细化合成中间体数据。在ACDC和4D-Lung数据集上的实验结果表明，所提方法相比现有基线取得了当前最优性能，能够从稀疏观测中生成解剖结构合理、内容连贯的中间体数据。

title: Low-Rank Velocity Fields as a Structural Prior for Unsupervised 4D Medical Image Interpolation
title_zh: 低秩速度场作为无监督4D医学图像插值的结构先验
authors: Haojin Li, Hengzhuo Wang, Chang Liu, Zhiheng Ma, Heng Li, Jiang Liu
abstract: Endpoint-only unsupervised 4D medical image interpolation synthesizes intermediate volumes from sparsely sampled sequences with only the start and end volumes available for training; however, this weakly constrained setting often yields intermediates with unstable boundaries and non-physiological motion, limiting interpretability and downstream analysis. We propose low-rank velocity fields as a structural prior, constraining motion to a structured Tucker low-rank velocity field space that decomposes motion into globally shared spatial bases and a compact sample-specific core, thereby encouraging spatially correlated, anatomy-consistent deformation while suppressing voxel-wise high-frequency artifacts. To capture global coordination and local non-rigid details, we model motion in a coarse-to-fine multi-scale scheme and compose scale-wise deformations at inference to synthesize volumes at arbitrary times. We further provide a theoretical analysis showing that, under Tucker parameterization, low-rank parameters control the smoothness energy of the velocity field, explaining why low-rank modeling promotes smoother motion. Experiments on ACDC and 4D-Lung demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, remaining competitive with methods trained with intermediate-frame supervision, and producing intermediates with improved structural coherence and more stable anatomical contours.
summary_zh: 仅使用端点数据的无监督4D医学图像插值任务，仅能获取序列的起始和终止体数据用于训练，从稀疏采样序列中合成中间体数据；但这类弱约束设置生成的中间结果往往存在边界不稳定、运动不符合生理规律的问题，限制了结果的可解释性与下游分析能力。本文提出将低秩速度场作为结构先验，将运动约束在结构化的Tucker（塔克）低秩速度场空间中，将运动分解为全局共享的空间基与紧凑的样本专属核心，在鼓励空间相关、解剖结构一致的形变的同时，抑制体素级高频伪影。为同时捕捉全局运动协调性与局部非刚性细节，本文采用由粗到细的多尺度方案对运动建模，在推理阶段组合不同尺度的形变以合成任意时间点的体数据。本文进一步提供理论分析，证明在Tucker参数化下，低秩参数可控制速度场的平滑能量，解释了低秩建模能够生成更平滑运动的内在机制。在ACDC和4D-Lung数据集上的实验表明，所提方法取得了当前最优性能，性能可与使用中间帧监督训练的方法相竞争，生成的中间结果结构连贯性更强，解剖轮廓更稳定。

title: IterCAD: Iterative Program Repair for CAD Code Generation from Orthographic Views
title_zh: IterCAD：面向正交视图CAD代码生成的迭代程序修复框架
authors: Yuchuan Wu, Ke Niu, Haiyang Yu, Zhuofan Chen, Xiangyang Xue, Bin Li
abstract: Generating executable parametric CAD code from dimension-annotated orthographic drawings is a challenging task requiring geometric understanding, procedural reasoning, and precise numerical prediction. Existing vision-language approaches typically formulate this problem as one-shot generation, preventing the model from inspecting intermediate CAD results and correcting early mistakes, often leading to non-executable code or geometrically inconsistent outputs. In this paper, we propose IterCAD, an iterative framework that reformulates orthographic-view-to-CAD generation as a progressive program repair process. Instead of predicting the final CAD code in a single pass, IterCAD repeatedly analyzes the current CAD result, reasons about its discrepancy with the target views, and explicitly decides whether to REVISE the code or STOP the refinement process. To make iterative repair learnable, we further construct IterCAD-RS, a structured revise-or-stop supervision set containing both repairable intermediate CAD states and already-correct states, and develop a three-stage training strategy for initial generation, revision learning, and multi-turn RL optimization. By closing the loop between visual understanding, geometric verification, and code refinement, IterCAD progressively corrects structural and parametric errors. Experiments on CADExpert show that IterCAD consistently improves code executability and geometric fidelity over strong one-shot baselines.
summary_zh: 从带尺寸标注的正交工程图生成可执行参数化CAD代码是一项极具挑战性的任务，需要模型具备几何理解能力、过程推理能力与精确的数值预测能力。现有视觉语言方法通常将该任务建模为一次性生成任务，导致模型无法检查中间CAD结果、修正早期错误，往往生成不可执行的代码或几何结构不一致的输出。本文提出IterCAD这一迭代框架，将正交视图转CAD生成任务重构为渐进式程序修复过程。IterCAD不会一次性预测最终CAD代码，而是反复分析当前CAD结果，推理其与目标视图的差异，显式决定是对代码进行REVISE（修正）还是终止优化过程。为了让迭代修复过程可学习，本文进一步构建了IterCAD-RS结构化“修正或终止”监督集，包含可修复的中间CAD状态与已经正确的状态，并设计了初始生成、修正学习、多轮强化学习优化的三阶段训练策略。通过打通视觉理解、几何验证与代码优化的闭环，IterCAD可以逐步修正结构错误与参数错误。在CADExpert数据集上的实验表明，相比性能优异的一次性生成基线方法，IterCAD可以持续提升代码的可执行性与几何保真度。

title: Absorbing Gradient Conflicts: Modeling Semantic Variance via Kent Distributions for Cross-Modal Hashing
title_zh: 吸收梯度冲突：基于Kent分布的跨模态哈希语义方差建模
authors: Hengjie Zhu, Dayan Wu, Zihao Zhang, Xinze Liu, Jingxuan Yu, Peng Fu, Zheng Lin, Weiping Wang
abstract: Supervised proxy-based deep cross-modal hashing has become the dominant paradigm for large-scale retrieval. However, prevalent methods model class proxies as deterministic points in the embedding space. This rigid assumption causes severe gradient conflicts in multi-label scenarios, where gradient conflicts arising from label co-occurrence lead to severe gradient contention and optimization collapse. To resolve this, we propose Kent-based Distributional Proxy Hashing (KDPH), a novel framework that shifts proxy representation from static points to flexible anisotropic Kent distributions on the hypersphere. Unlike point proxies that must shift their positions to accommodate conflicting gradients, KDPH absorbs these conflicts by dynamically adjusting its directional variance. This allows the proxy to maintain a stable semantic mean direction while stretching to cover diverse label correlations. Furthermore, to ensure stable training of these geometric parameters, we derive a tailored loss function incorporating the Cayley transform to enforce strict orthogonality. To the best of our knowledge, KDPH is the first framework to successfully introduce the Kent distributions into cross-modal hashing. Experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that KDPH mitigates proxy collapse and chaotic oscillation, significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Senmo996/KDPH-official-code.
summary_zh: 基于监督代理的深度跨模态哈希已经成为大规模检索任务的主流范式。但现有主流方法将类别代理建模为嵌入空间中的确定性点，这种刚性假设在多标签场景下会引发严重的梯度冲突：标签共现带来的梯度冲突会导致剧烈的梯度竞争，最终引发优化崩溃。为解决该问题，本文提出基于Kent分布的分布式代理哈希框架KDPH，将代理表示从静态点转换为超球面上灵活的各向异性Kent分布。与必须移动位置以适配冲突梯度的点代理不同，KDPH通过动态调整方向方差吸收梯度冲突，让代理在保持稳定语义均值方向的同时，通过延展覆盖多样的标签关联关系。此外，为保证这类几何参数的训练稳定性，本文设计了结合Cayley（凯莱）变换的定制损失函数，强制满足严格正交性要求。据我们所知，KDPH是首个将Kent分布成功引入跨模态哈希领域的框架。在三个基准数据集上的实验表明，KDPH可以缓解代理崩溃与训练震荡问题，性能显著优于现有最优方法。代码开源地址为https://github.com/Senmo996/KDPH-official-code。

title: Source-Face Authenticity Detection for 3D Gaussian Heads Reconstructed from a Single Portrait: A Benchmark and Dedicated Detector
title_zh: 单张肖像重建3D高斯头部的源人脸真实性检测：基准数据集与专用检测器
authors: Yujie Gao, Zijian Yu, Yan Hong, Jun Lan, Jianfu Zhang
abstract: Recent advances in single-image 3D Gaussian head reconstruction have enabled highly realistic and freely renderable digital heads from a single portrait. However, reconstruction and rendering can weaken the forgery traces in the source portrait, making the resulting 3D face difficult to classify whether its underlying face is real or fake, and thereby posing risks to identity authentication and face privacy. To study this problem, we introduce the first large-scale benchmark for this task by collecting real portraits and fake portraits from multiple sources and evaluate representative existing detectors on this benchmark, revealing their lack of explicit mechanisms for retaining fine-grained information and maintaining feature consistency across rendered views. To directly address these two limitations, we propose a detector trained with a two-stage strategy. In Stage I, masked autoencoding encourages the visual backbone to retain the fine-grained appearance information required for local reconstruction, while multi-view contrastive learning enforces feature consistency across rendered views of the same head. Since CLS tokens at different depths exhibit complementary spatial attention patterns, Stage II freezes the adapted backbone and concatenates low-, middle-, and high-level CLS tokens for classification. Experiments show that our method achieves the highest accuracy and ranks first across all reported metrics among the evaluated detectors.
summary_zh: 单图像3D高斯头部重建技术的最新进展支持从单张肖像生成高度逼真、可自由渲染的数字头部。但重建与渲染过程会弱化源肖像中的伪造痕迹，导致生成的3D人脸难以判定其底层人脸是真实还是伪造，给身份认证与人脸隐私安全带来风险。为研究该问题，本文构建了该任务的首个大规模基准数据集，收集了多来源的真实肖像与伪造肖像，并在该基准上对现有代表性检测器进行评估，发现现有方法缺乏保留细粒度信息、维持不同渲染视图间特征一致性的显式机制。针对这两个缺陷，本文提出采用两阶段策略训练的专用检测器：第一阶段通过掩码自编码鼓励视觉骨干网络保留局部重建所需的细粒度外观信息，同时通过多视图对比学习强制同一头部不同渲染视图的特征保持一致；由于不同深度的CLS token具备互补的空间注意力模式，第二阶段冻结适配后的骨干网络，拼接低层、中层、高层的CLS token完成分类。实验结果表明，所提方法在所有评估指标中均取得最高准确率，在所有参与对比的检测器中排名第一。

title: When Seeing Is Not Enough: Benchmarking Interactive Visual Grounding in LVLMs
title_zh: 当视觉信息不足时：大视觉语言模型交互式视觉定位基准测试
authors: Zhengxiang Wang, Owen Rambow
abstract: Visual grounding is typically evaluated as a one-shot mapping from an informative referring expression to a visual target. This formulation misses a central property of real-world reference: target information is often incomplete, ambiguous, and established through interaction. We introduce a controlled evaluation framework for interactive visual grounding in large vision-language models (LVLMs), varying how much target information is provided upfront and how much must be acquired through dialogue. Across four human-grounded visual contexts and four interaction protocols, current LVLMs perform significantly below task-level human baselines. Interaction can help when follow-up questions refine or repair an initial target description. Performance is lowest when no initial description is provided and target information must be acquired through questions, indicating that proactive question-driven grounding remains difficult. LVLMs are also poorly calibrated, often reporting confidence that exceeds their empirical accuracy. Follow-up studies confirm these patterns across varied description sources (human versus AI), reasoning efforts, repeated interactions, description providers, and visual contexts. Overall, interactive visual grounding remains an important challenge, requiring visual matching, information seeking and synthesis.
summary_zh: 视觉定位任务通常被建模为从信息完备的指代表达式到视觉目标的一次性映射，这种建模方式忽略了真实世界指代场景的核心属性：目标信息往往是不完备、模糊的，需要通过交互过程逐步明确。本文针对大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的交互式视觉定位任务提出了一套可控评估框架，可调整初始提供的目标信息量与需要通过对话获取的目标信息量。在4个人类标注的视觉场景与4种交互协议下的测试结果表明，当前大视觉语言模型的性能远低于人类任务基线：当后续提问可以优化或修正初始目标描述时，交互可以带来性能提升；当初始完全不提供描述、所有目标信息都需要通过提问获取时，模型性能降至最低，说明主动提问驱动的视觉定位仍然是当前模型的难点。此外大视觉语言模型的校准能力较差，输出的置信度往往高于其实际准确率。后续对照实验验证了上述规律在不同描述来源（人类生成/AI生成）、推理投入程度、交互轮次、描述提供方、视觉场景下均成立。总体而言，交互式视觉定位仍是极具挑战性的任务，需要模型同时具备视觉匹配、信息检索与信息整合能力。

title: Boot-and-Feedback Framework for Generalist-Expert Model Collaboration in Breast Ultrasound Diagnosis
title_zh: 面向乳腺超声诊断的通用-专家模型协作Boot-and-Feedback框架
authors: Ming Cheng, Hongyu Sun, Zhaolin Chen, Jun Liu, Hossein Rahmani, Qiuhong Ke
abstract: Breast ultrasound (BUS) is widely used for breast cancer diagnosis yet remains operator-dependent. While deep learning shows promise, ensuring diagnostic reliability and interpretability is challenging.
