Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often generate spurious descriptions due to limited domain knowledge, which mislead downstream expert models and compromise clinical validity. To address these challenges, we propose the Boot-and-Feedback (BooF) model collaboration framework for synergistic MLLM-expert interaction. Specifically, in the Boot Stage, the MLLM is guided by the BI-RADS lexicon and preliminary benign-malignant vision-expert predictions, enabling it to transfer general reasoning to BUS analysis while avoiding hallucinations. Subsequently, the Feedback Stage integrates these descriptions with visual features via a lightweight Attention-Gated Cross-Modality Fusion Module. This allows the expert to leverage textual feedback while adaptively filtering noise. Extensive experiments on multiple BUS datasets demonstrate that BooF substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of diagnostic accuracy and interpretability.
summary_zh: 乳腺超声（BUS）是乳腺癌诊断中应用最广泛的技术，但诊断结果高度依赖操作者经验。深度学习技术在该领域展现出应用潜力，但如何保证诊断结果的可靠性与可解释性仍是难点。近期多模态大语言模型（MLLM）由于领域知识不足，经常生成错误的伪描述，误导下游专家模型，损害结果的临床有效性。为解决上述挑战，本文提出Boot-and-Feedback（BooF）模型协作框架，实现多模态大语言模型与专家模型的协同交互。具体而言，在引导（Boot）阶段，利用BI-RADS乳腺影像报告与数据系统词典与视觉专家模型输出的初步良恶性预测结果引导多模态大语言模型，使其将通用推理能力迁移到乳腺超声分析任务中，同时避免生成幻觉内容。随后在反馈（Feedback）阶段，通过轻量注意力门控跨模态融合模块将生成的文本描述与视觉特征融合，让专家模型可以利用文本反馈信息，同时自适应过滤噪声。在多个乳腺超声数据集上的大量实验表明，BooF框架在诊断准确率与可解释性上均显著优于现有最优方法。

title: Luce: Relightable Gaussians for 3D Asset Generation
title_zh: Luce：面向3D资产生成的可重光照高斯表示
authors: Mayank Singh, Michele Stoppa, Alvise Memo, Rui Yu, Harsha Kalli, Srimanth Gunturi, Muhammad Ahmed Riaz, Behrooz Shahsavari, Waleed Abdulla, David E. Jacobs
abstract: High-fidelity image-to-3D generation requires a 3D representation that captures both geometry and appearance. To support relighting and integration into standard rendering pipelines, the representation should include physically based rendering (PBR) modalities such as albedo, metallic-roughness, and surface normals. We propose Luce, a 3D representation that unifies geometry and PBR materials within a voxelized multimodal Gaussian cloud, using dedicated Gaussian primitives for each modality. A variational autoencoder compresses this representation into a unified material-aware latent space. A rectified-flow transformer generates this latent from a single image, conditioned on multi-layer features from a pretrained image encoder that preserve both semantic context and fine spatial detail. The latent then decodes into relightable PBR Gaussians and an optional textured mesh with a tangent-space normal map. On Toys4K, Luce achieves state-of-the-art single-image-to-3D generation, improving FID by 28% over the strongest baseline. We further introduce a benchmark of AI-generated images, on which Luce improves the CLIP image-alignment score over the best baseline (0.8519 vs. 0.8299). Luce generates relightable, geometrically accurate, and materially faithful assets that preserve fine details such as text, logos, and inscriptions.
summary_zh: 高保真图像转3D生成任务需要同时捕获几何信息与外观信息的3D表示。为了支持重光照操作、适配标准渲染管线，这类表示需要包含基于物理渲染（PBR）的多种模态信息，如反照率、金属粗糙度、表面法向量等。本文提出Luce这一3D表示，将几何信息与PBR材质信息统一到体素化多模态高斯点云中，为每个模态设计专用的高斯基元。通过变分自编码器将该表示压缩到统一的材质感知隐空间中，再通过整流流Transformer从单张图像生成该隐空间向量，生成过程以预训练图像编码器输出的多层特征为条件，同时保留语义上下文与精细空间细节。随后隐空间向量可解码为支持重光照的PBR高斯点云，还可选择输出带切空间法向图的纹理网格。在Toys4K数据集上，Luce取得了当前最优的单图像转3D生成性能，相比最强基线方法FID指标提升28%。本文进一步构建了一个AI生成图像基准数据集，在该数据集上Luce的CLIP图像对齐得分相比最优基线方法从0.8299提升到0.8519。Luce生成的3D资产支持重光照，几何精度高、材质保真度好，可保留文字、标识、铭文等精细细节。

title: SceneReGen: Generative Reconstruction of 3D Scenes from a Single Image
title_zh: RefineRank：面向手术时空定位的联合边界框优化与排序
authors: Zefan Tian, Yuteng Ye, Yiheng Zhang, Yuhang Yang, Xueqiang Lv, Shizhou Zhang, Le Liu, Di Xu
abstract: Single-image 3D scene reconstruction must complete partially observed objects and place them coherently in a shared observation-aligned scene frame. Object-level generative priors offer strong completion ability, but their centered, scale-normalized outputs are typically expressed in an object frame, creating a fundamental representation gap between object generation and scene reconstruction. We introduce SceneReGen, a generative reconstruction framework that reinterprets scene reconstruction as the generation and assembly of complete object assets in a shared observation-aligned scene frame. SceneReGen addresses the generation-reconstruction gap through selective pose factorization: each object's observed orientation is encoded directly in the generated mesh, while translation and scale are estimated from instance-level and global scene evidence. Given a scene image and instance masks, a geometry encoder extracts dense cues; learnable shape queries condition a pretrained DiT-based 3D generator to produce complete meshes in their observed orientations, while position queries fuse object and scene features to assemble them in the shared frame. On the 3D-FUTURE evaluation subset, SceneReGen achieves the best scene-level CD, scene-level F-Score, and 3D bounding-box IoU among the evaluated methods, ties the best object-level CD, and ranks second in object-level F-Score. Qualitative outputs in autonomous-driving and embodied-AI scenes further illustrate the potential of asset-centric reconstruction beyond indoor furniture.
summary_zh: 手术时空定位（STG）任务要求在程序性问题指定的每个视频时间点，定位出问题所指代的目标物体。现有方法存在固有权衡：视觉语言模型可以理解问题上下文，但输出的坐标精度不足；而开集检测器可以输出定位候选框，但候选框的置信度无法反映该框是否匹配问题的指代目标。本文提出RefineRank方法，在候选框层面打通上述两个模块的能力边界。该方法包含一个紧凑的可训练模块RefineNet，将冻结参数的医学视觉语言模型的语言特征与区域特征，和冻结参数的开集检测器输出的候选框结合，为每个候选框预测有界的坐标修正值与质量得分，再通过固定解码规则返回得分最高的原始框或优化后框。在MedVidBench官方验证排行榜上，RefineRank的STG mIoU指标达到0.421，为公开的最高STG得分，全局多指标排名为第11位。在训练集与测试集完全分离的对照评估中，坐标修正将候选框的oracle上界从0.6772提升到0.7302，通过RefineNet得分对原始候选框与优化后候选框的合并池进行排序，可将STG mIoU从0.2719提升到0.4534，而在同一候选池上单独训练的选择器最高仅能达到0.4186。上述结果表明，仅使用一个轻量的框级模块，无需重新训练任意骨干网络，即可同时实现问题理解与精确定位的能力融合。代码开源地址为https://github.com/linzhe001/RefineRank。

title: RefineRank: Joint Box Refinement and Ranking for Surgical Spatio-Temporal Grounding
title_zh: SceneReGen：单图像驱动的3D场景生成式重建
authors: Linzhe Jiang, Jiayuan Huang, Changhao Zhang, Chunyang Jiang, Zhehua Mao, Mobarak I. Hoque
abstract: Surgical spatio-temporal grounding (STG) requires locating, at each video time specified by a procedural question, the object that the question asks about. Existing approaches face a trade-off: vision language models understand the question context but produce imprecise coordinates, whereas open-set detectors provide localized candidate boxes whose confidence does not reflect which box answers the question. We introduce RefineRank, which closes this gap at the candidate-box level. A compact trainable module, RefineNet, combines the language and regional features of a frozen medical vision language model with the proposals of a frozen open-set detector: it predicts a bounded coordinate correction and a quality score for every candidate box, and a fixed decoding rule returns the original or refined box with the highest score. On the MedVidBench Official Rankings (Verified), RefineRank records 0.421 STG mIoU, the highest displayed STG score, while its global multi-metric rank is 11. In a controlled evaluation on separate training and evaluation videos, coordinate correction raises the candidate oracle upper bound from 0.6772 to 0.7302, and ranking the joint pool of original and refined candidates by their RefineNet scores improves STG mIoU from 0.2719 to 0.4534, whereas separately trained selectors over the same pool reach at most 0.4186. These results show that a small box-level module can reconcile question understanding with precise localization without retraining either backbone. Code is available at [https://github.com/linzhe001/RefineRank](https://github.com/linzhe001/RefineRank).
summary_zh: 单图像3D场景重建任务需要补全部分观测到的物体，并将所有物体在与观测对齐的共享场景坐标系中进行连贯排布。物体级生成先验具备很强的补全能力，但这类先验输出的结果是以物体自身为中心、尺度归一化的，处于物体局部坐标系中，导致物体生成与场景重建之间存在本质的表示鸿沟。本文提出SceneReGen生成式重建框架，将场景重建任务重新定义为在与观测对齐的共享场景坐标系中生成并组装完整物体资产的过程。SceneReGen通过选择性位姿分解解决生成与重建之间的鸿沟：每个物体的观测朝向直接编码到生成的网格中，而平移与尺度参数则从实例级与全局场景信息中估计。给定场景图像与实例掩码，几何编码器提取密集特征线索，可学习的形状查询引导基于预训练DiT的3D生成器生成朝向与观测一致的完整网格，位置查询则融合物体与场景特征，将所有物体组装到共享坐标系中。在3D-FUTURE评估子集上，SceneReGen的场景级倒角距离（CD）、场景级F值、3D边界框交并比（IoU）均为所有对比方法中的最优水平，物体级CD与最优方法持平，物体级F值位列第二。在自动驾驶与具身智能场景中的定性结果进一步证明，以资产为核心的重建方案在室内家具场景之外也具备广阔应用潜力。

title: GlanceWAM: Sparse Test-Time Imagination for World-Action Models
title_zh: GlanceWAM：面向世界动作模型（World-Action Models, WAMs）的稀疏测试时刻想象方法
authors: Linhan Wang, Zijian An, Mingyuan Zhang, Chen Dai, Yi Xu, Can Cui, Zichong Yang, Yinlin Chen, Lifeng Zhou, Chang-Tien Lu
abstract: Video generative models provide rich physical priors for robot learning, yet existing world-action models (WAMs) face a fundamental trade-off: synchronous video generation at control rate is latency-prohibitive, while abandoning test-time visual imagination sacrifices task success. We show that visual imagination achieves both real-time inference and superior success rates when generated asynchronously off the critical path and consumed directly in latent space. We introduce GlanceWAM, which decouples imagination from control within a single video DiT: an asynchronous proposer glances ahead on a slow clock to imagine a single lookahead frame seconds into the future in the background, while an action head decodes action chunks at control rate (48 ms) purely in latent space without blocking. Enabled by a non-interfering attention mask that isolates video representations and staleness-robust horizon training that accommodates asynchronous lookahead aging, GlanceWAM breaks the speed-success dilemma. Trained purely on demonstrations, it attains 72.2% on the 24-task RoboCasa kitchen benchmark (surpassing synchronous Cosmos Policy at 67.1% and imagination-free co-training at 64.4%) and 99.0% on LIBERO, executing at 48 ms per chunk on an NVIDIA A100 GPU (24x faster than synchronous baselines). Code is available at https://github.com/linhanwang/GlanceWAM.
summary_zh: 视频生成模型可为机器人学习提供丰富的物理先验，但现有世界动作模型（WAMs）面临一个根本性的权衡问题：以控制速率同步生成视频的延迟高到无法接受，而放弃测试时刻视觉想象又会牺牲任务成功率。本文研究表明，若将视觉想象设置为非关键路径上的异步生成模式、并直接在潜空间中调用生成结果，可同时实现实时推理与更优的任务成功率。本文提出GlanceWAM，在单个视频扩散Transformer（Video DiT）框架内将想象过程与控制过程解耦：异步提议器以低速时钟在后台提前预判数秒后的未来帧，而动作头全程仅在潜空间内以48ms的控制速率解码动作块，二者互不阻塞。通过可隔离视频表征的无干扰注意力掩码、以及适配异步预判时效衰减的鲁棒性时域训练机制，GlanceWAM打破了速度与成功率的两难困境。该模型仅通过演示数据训练，在包含24项任务的RoboCasa厨房基准测试中达到72.2%的成功率（超过同步Cosmos Policy的67.1%与无想象协同训练方法的64.4%），在LIBERO数据集上达到99.0%的成功率，在NVIDIA A100 GPU上每动作块的执行延迟为48ms，速度是同步基线方法的24倍。代码开源地址：https://github.com/linhanwang/GlanceWAM。

title: ROI-Gated SAHI: Content-Adaptive Slicing-Based Inference for Efficient Object Detection
title_zh: ROI-Gated SAHI：基于内容自适应切片推理的高效目标检测方法
authors: Rashid Riyadh, Abd Ullah Khan, Imad Gohar, Muzammil Behzad
abstract: Slicing-Aided Hyper Inference (SAHI) improves small object detection in high-resolution images but often spends substantial compute on background tiles. We propose region-of-interest (ROI)-Gated SAHI, an inference-time framework that introduces a lightweight proposer to localize foreground regions and restrict sliced refinement to informative areas. We evaluate the framework in two settings. On the COCO128 full split dataset comprising 128 images, static ROI-gating is slower on average than Full SAHI, achieving a speed ratio of 0.88, and yields a lower mAP@0.5 of 0.6602 compared with 0.7569 for Full SAHI. A simple adaptive routing policy with $\tau =$ 0.4 educes the mean latency, achieving a slight gain of 1.02$\times$ over Full SAHI. On a three-image sparse-to-dense case study, ROI-gating achieves speedups ranging from 0.96$\times$ to 6.90$\times$ with a mean speedup of 3.41$\times$. These results show that ROI-gating is most beneficial in sparse scenes and requires policy-based routing for robust average behavior.
summary_zh: 切片辅助超推理（Slicing-Aided Hyper Inference, SAHI）可提升高分辨率图像中的小目标检测性能，但往往会在无意义的背景切片上消耗大量计算资源。本文提出感兴趣区域门控SAHI（region-of-interest Gated SAHI, ROI-Gated SAHI）这一推理框架，引入轻量级提议器定位前景区域，将切片细化操作限制在包含有效信息的区域内。本文在两种设置下对该框架进行评估：在包含128张图像的COCO128完整划分数据集上，静态ROI门控的平均速度略低于全SAHI，速度比为0.88，mAP@0.5为0.6602，低于全SAHI的0.7569；当采用阈值τ=0.4的简单自适应路由策略时，平均延迟有所降低，速度比全SAHI快1.02倍。在3张图像的稀疏到密集场景案例研究中，ROI门控的加速比范围为0.96倍至6.90倍，平均加速比达3.41倍。上述结果表明，ROI门控在稀疏场景下收益最高，且需要基于策略的路由机制才能保证稳定的平均性能。

title: HAP: Head-Adaptive Visual Token Pruning via Cross-Modal Alignment
title_zh: HAP：基于跨模态对齐的头部自适应视觉令牌剪枝方法
authors: Yuanhao Sun, Huawei Ji, Yuan Jin, Cheng Deng, Luoyi Fu, Xinbing Wang
abstract: Across 18 benchmarks, our method delivers state-of-the-art trade-offs. Specifically, on LLaVA-1.5-7B (9 tasks), retaining only \textbf{5.6\%} tokens preserves \textbf{99.1\%} of the original performance, surpassing the strongest baseline AutoPrune by 4.2 points. Code is available in https://github.com/baokou-fw2/HAP.
summary_zh: 在18个基准测试集上，本文提出的方法实现了当前最优的性能-开销权衡效果。具体而言，在LLaVA-1.5-7B模型的9项任务中，仅保留5.6%的视觉令牌即可保留原始模型99.1%的性能，性能表现超过当前最优基线方法AutoPrune达4.2个百分点。代码开源地址：https://github.com/baokou-fw2/HAP。

title: Wontopos Tablet 2: Measuring Multilingual and Multimodal Memory Retrieval Without Lexical Matching
title_zh: Wontopos Tablet 2：无需词汇匹配的多语言多模态记忆检索能力评测
authors: Sunwoo Kim
abstract: Three results run against us and are reported at equal weight: low-resource languages degrade sharply (Swahili 53.0%, Telugu 64.0%), attaching captions lowers cross-lingual retrieval by 11.4 points, and one setting omitted into one stage of our own retrieval cost 37 points of Korean top-1 accuracy while leaving nine languages untouched.
summary_zh: 本文报告了三项不符合预期的同等权重实验结果：低资源语言的检索性能出现大幅下降（斯瓦西里语为53.0%，泰卢固语为64.0%），为图像附加字幕会使跨语言检索性能降低11.4个百分点，而在检索流程的某一阶段省略某一设置会使韩语的top-1准确率损失37个百分点，其余9种语言的性能则完全不受影响。

title: Continual Visual Learning under Evolving Semantic Concept Shift
title_zh: 演化语义概念漂移场景下的持续视觉学习
authors: Ismail Lamaakal, Chaymae Yahyati, Yassine Maleh, Khalid El Makkaoui, Ibrahim Ouahbi
abstract: Visual foundation models are commonly adapted under the assumption that the appearance of incoming data may change while the semantic meaning of the prediction task remains fixed. In long-lived visual systems, however, taxonomies, policies, and concept definitions can themselves evolve, causing the same visual evidence to require a different interpretation. We study this setting as evolving semantic concept shift and introduce SemReWrite, a framework for selectively updating obsolete visual--semantic mappings while preserving knowledge that remains valid. SemReWrite represents changes between old and revised semantic specifications, combines semantic discrepancy with sparse revised supervision to localize affected visual regions, and uses an input-dependent low-rank rewriting mechanism together with structured semantic memory, preservation, and obsolete-decision suppression. We further introduce EvoShift-Bench, spanning ImageNet, iNaturalist, CUB-200-2011, and DomainNet, with semantic transitions including class split, merge, boundary revision, insertion, partial redefinition, recurrence, and mixed semantic--appearance shift. To explicitly evaluate selective semantic revision, we introduce Rewrite Accuracy (RA) and Preservation Accuracy (PA) for affected and unaffected regions, respectively, Obsolete Retention (OR) for measuring residual outdated semantic associations, and the Selective Revision Score (SRS), which jointly summarizes rewriting and preservation performance. Experiments show that SemReWrite achieves a stronger balance between learning revised semantics and retaining unaffected knowledge than prompt replacement, conventional fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, and continual-learning strategies.
summary_zh: 当前视觉基础模型的适配通常基于如下假设：输入数据的外观可能发生变化，但预测任务的语义含义保持固定。然而在长期运行的视觉系统中，分类体系、策略规则与概念定义本身可能发生演化，导致相同的视觉证据需要被赋予不同的解释。本文将该场景定义为演化语义概念漂移，提出SemReWrite框架，可在保留有效知识的同时选择性更新过时的视觉-语义映射。SemReWrite对旧语义规范与新语义规范之间的差异进行表征，结合语义差异与稀疏修正监督定位受影响的视觉区域，采用输入依赖的低秩重写机制，搭配结构化语义记忆、知识保留与过时决策抑制模块。本文进一步构建了覆盖ImageNet、iNaturalist、CUB-200-2011与DomainNet的基准数据集EvoShift-Bench，包含类别拆分、合并、边界修正、插入、部分重定义、复现、语义-外观混合漂移等多种语义转换场景。为显式评估选择性语义修正的性能，本文分别针对受影响区域与未受影响区域提出重写准确率（Rewrite Accuracy, RA）与保留准确率（Preservation Accuracy, PA），用于衡量残留过时语义关联的过时保留率（Obsolete Retention, OR），以及综合表征重写与保留性能的选择性修正得分（Selective Revision Score, SRS）。实验结果表明，与提示替换、传统微调、参数高效适配及其他持续学习策略相比，SemReWrite在学习新语义与保留未受影响知识之间实现了更优的平衡。

title: Native-Space 3D CarveMix for Multi-Site T1w Stroke Segmentation
title_zh: 面向多站点T1加权脑卒中分割的原生空间3D CarveMix数据增强方法
authors: Dexter Wen Jie Teo, Kumaradevan Punithakumar
abstract: Segmenting ischemic stroke lesions on T1-weighted (T1w) MRI acquired across different scanners and protocols without intensity standardization is difficult because lesions are subtle and share intensity characteristics with cerebrospinal fluid. Standard deep learning architectures trained across multiple centers plateau around Dice 0.66, with acute lesions ($\le 7$ days post-stroke) performing substantially worse due to severe sample scarcity. We combine a MedNeXt-L ($k=5$) backbone with on-the-fly 3D CarveMix augmentation that pastes real lesion patches into healthy brain regions during training. By generating synthetic lesion placements dynamically within each fold with subject-level split isolation, the model sees more diverse lesion patterns without requiring pre-generated copies on disk. We evaluate on 1,453 native T1w scans from 55 clinical centers in the ISLES 2026 challenge. Our method achieves a mean 5-fold cross-validation Dice of 0.648 at 500 epochs, a +0.018 improvement over the MedNeXt-L backbone at a matched training budget (0.630)
summary_zh: 在未进行强度标准化的前提下，对不同扫描仪、不同协议采集的T1加权（T1w）磁共振成像中的缺血性脑卒中病灶进行分割难度极高，原因是病灶特征十分微弱，且强度特征与脑脊液高度相似。在多中心数据集上训练的标准深度学习架构的Dice系数性能通常停滞在0.66左右，发病后7天以内的急性病灶因样本稀缺性问题性能表现更差。本文将MedNeXt-L（k=5）骨干网络与实时3D CarveMix增强方法相结合，在训练过程中将真实病灶块粘贴到健康脑区域中。通过在每个折内以受试者级拆分隔离的方式动态生成合成病灶位置，模型无需在磁盘上存储预生成的副本即可观测到更多样化的病灶模式。本文在ISLES 2026挑战赛的55个临床中心采集的1453份原生T1w扫描数据上进行评估，所提方法在训练500轮时的5折交叉验证平均Dice系数为0.648，在相同训练开销下比MedNeXt-L骨干网络（0.630）提升了0.018。

title: LG-GER: Language-Guided Group Emotion Recognition via Multimodal Evidence Distillation
title_zh: LG-GER：基于多模态证据蒸馏的语言引导群体情绪识别方法
authors: Ahmed Shehab Khan, Zhiyuan Li, Yan Tong
abstract: Inferring the collective emotional state of a group of people from a single image, a task known as group emotion recognition (GER), requires integrating spatially distributed cues such as faces, poses, interactions, and scene context. Current methods rely on detector-driven multi-stream pipelines. These are trained with only image-level supervision that lacks guidance on which regions matter or how strongly each contributes. We propose LG-GER, a language-guided distillation framework that uses a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to generate dense, spatially grounded evidence, i.e., bounding boxes paired with emotion signals and confidence scores, for the training images. This structured evidence is distilled into a single vision-language model (VLM) backbone through four complementary losses: classification, region-text grounding, spatial emotion, and spatial confidence regression. At inference, LG-GER requires no detectors, no MLLM, and no multi-stream fusion, making GER practical for real-time and resource-constrained deployment. LG-GER has been evaluated on two benchmark GER datasets (GroupEmoW and GAF~3.0) and achieves competitive or superior results compared to state-of-the-art methods that require detection and multi-stream processing at inference.
summary_zh: 从单张图像中推断一群人的集体情绪状态的任务被称为群体情绪识别（Group Emotion Recognition, GER），需要整合人脸、姿态、交互关系与场景上下文等空间分布线索。现有方法依赖检测器驱动的多流流水线，仅使用图像级监督训练，缺乏关于哪些区域重要、各区域贡献度高低的引导信息。本文提出LG-GER这一语言引导的蒸馏框架，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）为训练图像生成稠密的、空间锚定的证据，即与情绪信号和置信度得分配对的边界框。该结构化证据通过分类、区域-文本对齐、空间情绪、空间置信度回归四个互补损失函数蒸馏到单个视觉语言模型（VLM）骨干网络中。在推理阶段，LG-GER无需检测器、无需MLLM、无需多流融合，使得GER任务可在实时、资源受限的部署场景下落地。LG-GER已在两个GER基准数据集（GroupEmoW与GAF 3.0）上完成评估，与推理阶段需要检测和多流处理的当前最优方法相比，其性能达到同等或更优水平。

title: Spatiotemporal Distillation via Recurrent Bottlenecks for Aortic Tracking
title_zh: 基于循环瓶颈的时空蒸馏主动脉跟踪方法
authors: Dexter Wen Jie Teo, Nairouz Shehata, Herve Lombaert
abstract: Cardiac cine-MRI serves as a direct visual indicator of cardiovascular hemodynamics by capturing the continuous wall motion of the aorta. Quantifying these dynamic structural changes across the cardiac cycle is essential for measuring aortic distensibility, a primary marker of arterial stiffness. However, standard 2D segmentation networks focus on each frame independently. Consequently, when rapid systolic flow temporarily obscures the aorta's boundaries, this lack of continuous context results in frame-to-frame tracking dropouts and boundary inconsistencies. Spatiotemporal ($2\text{D}+t$) networks can enforce temporal consistency across the sequence but suffer from a scarcity of expert annotations. To address this, we present a semi-supervised spatiotemporal ($2\text{D}$ to $2\text{D}+t$) knowledge distillation framework exploiting the cardiac cycle. The framework distills a spatial teacher's expertise into a spatiotemporal student network by executing a dynamic latent interception, pairing a recurrent spatiotemporal bottleneck with a residual spatial bypass. Our model selection strategy applies a baseline validation threshold ($\text{DSC} \ge 0.50$) prior to selecting the epoch that maximizes anatomical consistency. This strategy enables the spatiotemporal student model to achieve superior surface tracking accuracy ($\text{NSD@1mm} = 92.3\% \pm 0.2\%$) and high structural reliability ($\text{Frac}_{2\text{CC}} = 99.2\% \pm 0.6\%$), reducing population-wide structural anomalies by over 56\% compared to a 2D nnU-Net baseline.
summary_zh: 心脏电影磁共振成像（cine-MRI）可捕捉主动脉的连续壁运动，是心血管血流动力学的直接可视化指标。量化心动周期内的动态结构变化是测量主动脉扩张性的核心需求，而主动脉扩张性是动脉僵硬度的主要标志物。但标准2D分割网络独立处理每一帧图像，当快速收缩期血流暂时遮挡主动脉边界时，由于缺乏连续上下文信息，会出现帧间跟踪丢失与边界不一致的问题。时空（2D+t）网络可在序列层面强制实现时间一致性，但面临专家标注数据稀缺的问题。为解决该问题，本文提出一种利用心动周期特性的半监督时空（2D到2D+t）知识蒸馏框架，通过执行动态潜变量拦截操作，将循环时空瓶颈与残差空间旁路配对，把空间教师模型的专业知识蒸馏到时空学生网络中。本文的模型选择策略在选择最大化解剖一致性的训练轮次前，先应用基线验证阈值（DSC≥0.50）。该策略使时空学生模型实现了更优的表面跟踪精度（NSD@1mm=92.3%±0.2%）与高结构可靠性（Frac₂CC=99.2%±0.6%），与2D nnU-Net基线相比，全人群的结构异常占比降低了56%以上。

title: Gen2Physics: Grounding Generated 3D Meshes in Physics via Multi-View Material Decomposition
title_zh: Gen2Physics：通过多视图材质分解将生成3D网格与物理属性绑定的框架
authors: Mauro Comi, Jordi Serrano Berbel, Kevis-Kokitsi Maninis, Philipp Henzler, Manuel Sanchez
abstract: While state-of-the-art generative models produce high-fidelity 3D meshes, these outputs lack the physical properties required for interactive simulation, gaming, or robotics. We introduce Gen2Physics, a unified and automated framework that grounds generated meshes in physics by automatically decomposing them into their constituent material components. Unlike prior approaches, which focus on volumetric representations incompatible with standard physics engines, Gen2Physics operates directly on meshes to produce immediately simulation-ready assets. Our pipeline integrates a fine-tuned Vision Transformer for dense material segmentation, a robust 2D-to-3D consistency projection, and a Vision-Language Model (VLM) guided refinement that leverages contextual reasoning to assign physical properties and infer internal geometry (solid vs. hollow). By converting surface patches into volumes with distinct densities, our method enables physically plausible dynamic simulations. Experimental results on the ABO-500 and PartNet-Material benchmarks demonstrate that Gen2Physics more than doubles the material segmentation accuracy of prior physics-grounding pipelines (15.6 to 48.3 mIoU), while matching the mass-estimation accuracy of volumetric methods and being the only approach to output watertight per-material sub-meshes.
summary_zh: 当前最优生成模型可生成高保真3D网格，但这类输出缺乏交互式仿真、游戏或机器人场景所需的物理属性。本文提出Gen2Physics这一统一自动化框架，通过将生成的3D网格自动分解为其组成材质分量，为网格赋予物理属性。与此前聚焦于无法兼容标准物理引擎的体素表征的方法不同，Gen2Physics直接在网格上操作，输出可直接用于仿真的资产。该流水线集成了用于稠密材质分割的微调视觉Transformer、鲁棒的2D到3D一致性投影模块，以及视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的细化模块，可利用上下文推理分配物理属性并推断内部几何结构（实体/空心）。通过将表面面片转换为具有不同密度的体素，本文方法可生成物理合理的动态仿真结果。在ABO-500与PartNet-Material基准上的实验结果表明，Gen2Physics的材质分割精度是此前物理属性绑定流水线的两倍以上（mIoU从15.6提升至48.3），与体素方法的质量估算精度相当，且是唯一可输出水密性单材质子网格的方法。

title: AffineTok: Semantic Affine Consistency for Diffusion-Friendly Visual Tokenizer
title_zh: AffineTok：面向扩散模型友好的视觉分词器的语义仿射一致性方法
authors: Junqiu Yu, Pandeng Li, Yikai Wang, Jiaxing Zhao, Yujie Wei, Kaixun Jiang, Quanhao Li, Hongtao Yu, Zhihang Liu, Zhaohe Liao, Junjie Zhou, Yun Zheng, Yu Liu, Yanwei Fu
abstract: Visual tokenizers increasingly inject semantic supervision into latent spaces to make downstream diffusion easier. Yet how these semantics should be organized to facilitate denoising remains underexplored. In this paper, we define the semantic recovery objective: the denoising process should recover the semantic content of the clean image from noisy latent, and a good tokenizer should make it easier. Existing approaches train a projector to predict the semantics directly from the noisy latent. We argue that this predicts the average of clean-image semantics, whereas what really needs to be aligned is the semantics of averaged clean latents. More importantly, we demonstrate that the semantic recovery error orthogonally decomposes into the error of the optimal semantic prediction directly from the noisy latent and the error between these two predictions. We therefore identify their consistency as the missing requirement and call it Semantic Affine Consistency (SAC). To examine whether this overlooked requirement is closely related to downstream generation, we introduce M_SAC, a tokenizer-side proxy for SAC. Across the evaluated tokenizers and diffusion model scales, M_SAC closely tracks generation quality, reaching a Pearson correlation of 0.960 with SiT-XL gFID, thereby motivating SAC-guided tokenizer training. We then introduce AffineTok, which promotes SAC through two complementary, training-only components. Global Semantic Coordination Token (GSCT) coordinates the semantic organization of clean latents, keeping semantic averaging meaningful, while Posterior-Mean Semantic Alignment (PMSA) predicts posterior-mean latents from noisy inputs and supervises their semantics. On ImageNet 256, compared with the baseline, AffineTok reduces gFID by 26% at 20 epochs and, with continued training, achieves a new state-of-the-art gFID of 1.21 without classifier-free guidance and 1.10 with guidance.
summary_zh: 视觉分词器越来越多地将语义监督注入潜空间，以降低下游扩散模型的训练难度，但目前学界尚未明确探索应如何组织这类语义信息以促进去噪过程。本文定义了语义恢复目标：去噪过程应从含噪潜变量中恢复出干净图像的语义内容，而性能优异的分词器应能降低该恢复过程的难度。现有方法训练投影器直接从含噪潜变量中预测语义信息，本文指出这类方法预测的是干净图像语义的平均值，而真正需要对齐的是平均干净潜变量的语义。更重要的是，本文证明语义恢复误差可正交分解为两部分：直接从含噪潜变量进行最优语义预测的误差，以及上述两种预测结果之间的误差。因此本文将二者的一致性确定为此前被遗漏的要求，命名为语义仿射一致性（Semantic Affine Consistency, SAC）。为验证该被忽略的要求与下游生成质量的强相关性，本文提出分词器侧的SAC代理指标M_SAC。在所有测试的分词器与扩散模型规模下，M_SAC与生成质量高度相关，与SiT-XL的gFID的皮尔逊相关系数达到0.960，验证了SAC引导分词器训练的合理性。随后本文提出AffineTok，通过两个仅在训练阶段生效的互补组件实现SAC：全局语义协调令牌（Global Semantic Coordination Token, GSCT）协调干净潜变量的语义组织，保证语义平均操作的有效性；后验均值语义对齐（Posterior-Mean Semantic Alignment, PMSA）从含噪输入中预测后验均值潜变量，并对其语义进行监督。在ImageNet 256数据集上，与基线方法相比，AffineTok在训练20轮时将gFID降低了26%，经过后续训练后，在无分类器引导的情况下实现了当前最优的1.21的gFID，在启用分类器引导的情况下gFID为1.10。

title: LUX: A Lesion-Aware Graph-Conditioned Visual - Language Architecture for Explainable Endoscopic Captioning
title_zh: LUX：面向可解释内窥镜图像描述的病灶感知图条件视觉-语言架构
authors: Alexis Ivan Escamilla-Lopez, Gilberto Ochoa-Ruiz, Salvador Hinojosa, Sharib Ali
abstract: LUX outperforms strong baseline and state-of-the-art medical captioning models across BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE-L, and CIDEr, with particularly strong gains in CIDEr. It also reduces hallucinated clinical findings and improves lesion-level grounding through stronger correspondence between generated tokens and localized pathological regions.
summary_zh: 在BLEU、METEOR、ROUGE-L和CIDEr指标上，LUX的表现均优于现有强基线模型和当前最先进的医学图像描述模型，其中CIDEr指标的提升尤为显著。该模型还通过增强生成文本与定位病理区域之间的对应关系，减少了幻觉性临床发现，提升了病灶级别的对齐能力。

title: DDMS: Discriminative Distillation of Multi-view Foundational Features into Single-view Models
title_zh: DDMS：多视图基础特征向单视图模型的判别式蒸馏方法
authors: Jeong-gi Kwak, Sho Kagami, Yuki Ono, Kwang Moo Yi
abstract: Foundational visual features such as DINO have played a critical role across modern computer vision, and have recently become key components in multi-view feed-forward geometry estimators. In this work, we demonstrate that by re-distilling these multi-view models---their internal knowledge of 3D geometry---into a single-view estimator, we can obtain enhanced 3D consistent foundational features. Our key idea is to construct a multi-view teacher by fusing pretrained 2D foundation features with multi-view geometric features, and refining the fused representation with a discriminative ranking objective. Through our discriminative distillation framework, we enforce the learned features to be both 3D consistent and locally distinctive, while keeping them aligned with the feature space of the original foundation model to preserve the semantic structure of the pretrained representation. Consistency and local discriminability are critical for 3D computer vision problems such as forming semantic and geometric correspondences across images. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, we perform comprehensive experiments spanning multiple angles: direct feature analysis, dense prediction transfer, and explicit 3D lifting and rendering. Across these evaluations, our method consistently produces stronger 3D-aware foundation features that improve multi-view consistency and local discriminability while preserving the semantic transferability of the original representation.
summary_zh: DINO等基础视觉特征在现代计算机视觉领域发挥了关键作用，近期更成为多视图前馈几何估计器的核心组件。本研究证明，通过将多视图模型掌握的3D几何内部知识重新蒸馏到单视图估计器中，可获得具备更强3D一致性的基础特征。本方法的核心思路是：将预训练2D基础特征与多视图几何特征融合构建多视图教师模型，再通过判别式排序目标优化融合后的表征。通过该判别式蒸馏框架，我们约束学习到的特征同时满足3D一致性与局部区分性，同时保持与原始基础模型的特征空间对齐，保留预训练表征的语义结构。一致性与局部区分性对于跨图像构建语义和几何对应关系等3D计算机视觉问题至关重要。为验证所提方法的有效性，我们从多维度开展了全面实验：直接特征分析、密集预测迁移、显式3D升维和渲染。所有评估结果表明，本方法生成的3D感知基础特征性能始终更优，在保留原始表征语义迁移性的同时，提升了多视图一致性与局部区分性。

title: Object Counting Across Modalities: Taxonomies, Benchmarks, Applications, and Open Challenges
title_zh: 跨模态目标计数：分类体系、基准数据集、应用与开放挑战
authors: Joana Konadu Owusu, Shivanand Venkanna Sheshappanavar
abstract: Object-counting methods have rapidly shifted from class-specific density regression to open-vocabulary, foundation-model-backed counters. These methods now enumerate instances from various visual and textual prompts. While this shift marks major conceptual progress, our survey argues that claims of universal generality have outpaced the evaluative infrastructure. Most progress metrics rely on a few saturated benchmarks that models exploit for statistical regularities. Newly introduced diagnostic datasets reveal systematic failures in semantic grounding, temporal identity, and spatial reasoning with occlusion. To address these failures, we introduce a five-axis taxonomy (modality, mechanism, prompting, supervision level, and generalization setting). We use this taxonomy to audit the literature across application domains, including microscopy, remote sensing, crowd counting, and agriculture. This formalizes prevailing challenges into six structural contradictions. From these, we propose a roadmap for compositional scene understanding, active counting agents, and unified multimodal evaluation protocols. The main imperative is to build a robust evaluation infrastructure to distinguish open-world generalization from benchmark-specific optimization, rather than simple incremental engineering.
summary_zh: 目标计数方法已快速从类别特定的密度回归方案转向由基础模型支撑的开放词汇计数器，这类方法可基于各类视觉和文本提示枚举目标实例。尽管该转变代表了领域的重大概念进步，但本综述指出，当前关于方法普适通用性的宣称已经远超评估体系的发展水平：多数进展度量依赖于少量已被充分探索的饱和基准数据集，模型会利用其中的统计规律获得虚高的性能。新发布的诊断数据集揭示了现有方法在语义对齐、时序身份一致性、存在遮挡时的空间推理等方面存在系统性缺陷。为解决这些问题，本文提出了五维分类体系（模态、机制、提示方式、监督级别、泛化场景），基于该体系对显微镜成像、遥感、人群计数、农业等多个应用领域的现有研究进行了梳理，将当前普遍存在的挑战归纳为6类结构性矛盾，最终提出了面向组合场景理解、主动计数智能体、统一多模态评估协议的发展路线图。本领域的核心要务是构建鲁棒的评估体系，区分开开放世界泛化能力与针对特定基准的过优化行为，而非仅开展简单的增量式工程迭代。

title: Infant Care Video Dataset for Classification of Interventions Using Transformers
title_zh: 基于Transformer的干预分类婴儿护理视频数据集
authors: Igor Bogdanov, James Green
abstract: Healthcare documentation in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) presents significant challenges, with nurses spending approximately 25\% of their time on record-keeping, while up to 60\% of interventions remain undocumented. Motivated by the need to detect interventions from video automatically, we present the Infant Care Video Dataset (ICVD), a collection of 4,144 videos spanning 12 simulated intervention classes designed for developing automated documentation systems. Our manikin-based approach systematically varies conditions, such as camera angle and clinician skin tone, while ensuring privacy compliance. Using video transformer architectures (TimeSformer and MotionFormer), we establish strong baseline performance (93.97\% and 93.17\% top-1 accuracy) among the 12 infant care classes. Our ablation study comparing temporal models with a framewise approach (23.17\% accuracy) demonstrates a 70.80\% performance gap, validating the need for temporal modeling. The ICVD provides a foundation for developing automated documentation systems to reduce clinical burden in neonatal care environments and improve existing practices.
summary_zh: 新生儿重症监护室（NICU）的医疗文档工作面临显著挑战：护士约25%的工作时间用于记录，而最多60%的护理干预未被记录。为实现从视频中自动检测护理干预的目标，本文发布了婴儿护理视频数据集（ICVD），该数据集包含4144段视频，覆盖12类模拟干预场景，专为开发自动文档系统设计。本研究采用基于人体模型的采集方案，系统调整相机角度、临床人员肤色等变量，同时满足隐私合规要求。基于视频Transformer架构TimeSformer和MotionFormer，我们在12类婴儿护理分类任务上取得了93.97%和93.17%的Top-1基线准确率。将时序模型与逐帧方法（准确率仅23.17%）进行的消融实验显示二者性能差距达70.80%，验证了时序建模的必要性。ICVD数据集可为开发自动文档系统提供基础，助力降低新生儿护理场景的临床负担、优化现有工作流程。

title: Predicting Radiologist Expertise from 3D Gaze Patterns During CT Interpretation
authors: Leila Khaertdinova, Anna Anikina, Claudia Mello-Thoms, Bulat Ibragimov
abstract: Accurate interpretation of volumetric CT requires efficient navigation of 3D image volumes and attention to diagnostically relevant regions. While eye-tracking has been widely studied in 2D medical imaging, its use for expertise assessment in CT settings remains limited. We propose a gaze-informed transformer framework for expertise classification in thoracic CT. Using a DINOv2 backbone, radiologist fixation patterns are integrated into volumetric feature learning through (1) a learnable log-space bias in self-attention and (2) gaze-weighted pooling of patch embeddings. We trained and evaluated our approach on 182 CT reading sessions from five radiologists with varying levels of experience. On a held-out test set, the model achieves an ROC-AUC of 0.91 and F1 score of 0.86, outperforming adapted methods. These findings suggest that incorporating visual search behavior into transformers may support objective, process-based expertise assessment in radiology. Code is available via https://github.com/leiluk1/GazeToSkill.

title: LUCAID: Agentic Multimodal AI for Lung Cancer Precision Pathology
title_zh: LUCAID：面向肺癌精准病理的智能体多模态人工智能系统
authors: Marie-Lisa Eich, Kai Standvoss, Timo Milbich, Alexander M\"ollers, Miriam H\"agele, Philipp Anders, Lars Tharun, Hanna Kontradiuk, Sebastian Kons, Nader Aldoj, Recepcan Adig\"uzel, Adam Narai, Lukas H\"onig, Jonathan Striebel, Binru Yang, Mihnea P. Dragomir, Marvin Sextro, Philipp Keyl, Philipp Jurmeister, Rosemarie Krupar, Evelyn Ramberger, James Wells, Julika Ribbat-Idel, Andreas Kunft, Hussam Shuaib, Christian Groh\'e, Reinhard B\"uttner, David Horst, Klaus-Robert M\"uller, Lukas Ruff, Maximilian Alber, Frederick Klauschen, Simon Schallenberg
abstract: Lung cancer tissue diagnostics is complex, as therapy decisions in precision oncology rely on the integration of histomorphological, immunohistochemical, and molecular features. Yet pathological assessment remains largely visual and semi-quantitative and shows interobserver variability, while existing artificial intelligence (AI) tools cover only selected tasks, rarely reach generalizable expert-level performance, and lack prospective clinical validation. To address these challenges, we developed and clinically validated LUCAID, an agentic AI system for precision lung cancer pathology. An integrative agent couples diagnostic reasoning with nine modules that cover the full routine workflow, from quality control, tumor detection and segmentation, histological subtyping, tumor microenvironment profiling, tumor cellularity quantification, and predictive biomarker scoring (PD-L1, MET, TROP-2) to automated structured report generation. LUCAID enables users to interactively query the module outputs and generate reports that contextualize the results. Against large-scale expert ground-truth annotations, the analysis modules achieved F1 scores of 0.82-0.95. In prospective clinical validation, LUCAID reached 93.0% concordance with an expert-panel adjudicated reference standard across clinically actionable decisions, compared with 68.3-81.1% for five experienced thoracic pathologists.
summary_zh: 肺癌组织诊断流程十分复杂，精准肿瘤学的治疗决策依赖于组织形态学、免疫组化和分子特征的融合分析，但当前病理评估仍以人工视觉半定量方式为主，不同观察者间结果差异大；而现有人工智能工具仅能覆盖部分特定任务，极少能达到可泛化的专家级性能，且缺乏前瞻性临床验证。为解决上述挑战，本文开发了智能体AI系统LUCAID并完成临床验证，用于肺癌精准病理分析。该集成智能体将诊断推理与9个功能模块耦合，覆盖全常规工作流：从质量控制、肿瘤检测与分割、组织学分型、肿瘤微环境分析、肿瘤细胞定量，到预测性生物标志物（PD-L1、MET、TROP-2）评分、自动结构化报告生成。LUCAID支持用户交互式查询各模块输出，生成可对结果进行上下文关联的报告。在大规模专家标注的真值数据集上，各分析模块的F1得分达0.82~0.95。在前瞻性临床验证中，LUCAID的临床可操作决策结果与专家小组裁定的参考标准的一致性达93.0%，而5名经验丰富的胸科病理医生的一致性仅为68.3%~81.1%。

title: Restoring Without Forgetting: Continual Learning Across Image Degradations
title_zh: 复原且不忘却：面向图像退化场景的持续学习方法
authors: Alif Ashrafee, Bartosz Krawczyk
abstract: Recent progress in image restoration has converged on all-in-one architectures that jointly handle multiple degradations within a single network. These methods are effective on static benchmarks but target a closed-world setting that assumes simultaneous access to every target degradation at training time. In practice, degradations are encountered sequentially as field-deployed systems progressively face new environmental conditions, and historical training data is often unavailable due to privacy or storage constraints. Accommodating a new degradation then requires either retraining on the union of all prior data, which is often costly or infeasible, or fine-tuning, which causes catastrophic forgetting. We formulate multi-degradation image restoration as a continual domain-incremental learning problem, in which degradations arrive incrementally and prior data is unavailable. Our proposed Restoring without Forgetting (RwF) framework learns a lightweight adapter for each new degradation, eliminating forgetting by construction at a fraction of the cost of dedicated per-domain networks. To isolate degradation learning from dataset variation, we construct a benchmark spanning five degradation domains under shared image content. At test time, an unsupervised routing mechanism identifies the appropriate restoration path for unknown inputs without requiring domain labels. Across the five-domain sequence, RwF improves final average PSNR over naive sequential fine-tuning by 15.25 dB and 11.83 dB on the Restormer and NAFNet backbones, respectively. The framework transfers to eleven canonical real-degradation benchmarks (3,465 images) at 89.5% routing accuracy with only a +0.94 dB oracle PSNR gap, establishing, to our knowledge, the first systematic baseline for continual multi-degradation image restoration.
summary_zh: 图像复原领域近期的进展集中于全合一架构，可在单个网络内联合处理多种退化类型。这类方法在静态基准上表现优异，但面向的是闭集场景，假设训练时可同时获取所有目标退化类型的数据。实际部署场景中，系统会随着环境变化依次遇到新的退化类型，且受隐私或存储限制，历史训练数据通常无法获取。此时若要适配新的退化类型，要么需要在所有历史数据的并集上重新训练，成本极高甚至不可行；要么直接微调模型，会引发灾难性遗忘。本文将多退化图像复原任务定义为持续域增量学习问题：退化类型按顺序出现，且历史数据不可用。所提出的RwF（复原不忘却）框架为每类新退化学习一个轻量级适配器，从机制上避免了遗忘，且计算成本远低于为每个域单独训练专用网络。为隔离退化学习与数据集差异的影响，本文构建了在共享图像内容下覆盖5类退化域的基准数据集。测试阶段，无监督路由机制可为未知输入识别适配的复原路径，无需域标签信息。在5个域的顺序学习场景下，基于Restormer和NAFNet骨干网络，RwF相比朴素顺序微调方案的最终平均PSNR分别提升15.25dB和11.83dB。该框架在11个真实退化基准数据集（共3465张图像）上的路由准确率达89.5%，仅存在0.94dB的Oracle PSNR差距，据我们所知，这是首个面向持续多退化图像复原任务的系统性基线方案。

title: Mixture of Channel Experts: Static Sparse Supports with Input-Adaptive Mixing for Pointwise Projections
title_zh: 通道专家混合：用于逐点投影的静态稀疏支持与输入自适应混合机制
authors: Elian Iluk, Gil Ben-Artzi
abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales language models by routing each input through a small set of independently parameterized experts. We show that copying this design into convolutional networks fails for a structural reason: parallel convolutional experts that read the same input channels learn nearly identical filters. We therefore move the expert axis from operator duplication to channel selection. We introduce Mixture of Channel Experts (MoCE), a structured sparse channel-mixing layer, inspired by MoE, that replaces pointwise (1x1) channel-reduction projections. In MoCE, an expert is a single output channel with a learned sparse support of k << C input channels. The selected channels are combined by a softmax whose temperature is predicted per input, so each expert can move between mean-like and max-like aggregation. A residual expert summarizes the unselected channels, and a load-balancing loss keeps channel coverage complete. MoCE replaces a dense projection whose cost is quadratic in C with a mechanism whose relative cost scales as k/C, and the predicted savings hold in measured wall-clock time. Across ResNet backbones on ImageNet-1K and CIFAR-100, transfer learning, EfficientViT, and a strong modern training recipe, MoCE matches or exceeds dense baselines and prior channel-selection methods while reducing MACs by 16.7% and end-to-end latency.
summary_zh: 混合专家（MoE）技术通过为每个输入路由少量独立参数化的专家来扩展语言模型规模。本文发现将该设计直接迁移到卷积网络会存在结构性缺陷：读取相同输入通道的并行卷积专家会学习到几乎完全相同的滤波器。因此本文将专家维度从算子复制转向通道选择，提出MoCE（通道专家混合）：一种受MoE启发的结构化稀疏通道混合层，用于替换逐点（1x1）通道降维投影操作。在MoCE中，每个专家对应单个输出通道，对应k远小于C个输入通道的稀疏支持集。选中的通道通过softmax进行聚合，softmax的温度由每个输入单独预测，因此每个专家可在类均值聚合和类最大值聚合之间动态切换。残差专家用于汇总未被选中的通道，同时通过负载均衡损失保证所有通道都被覆盖。MoCE将计算复杂度随通道数C呈二次方增长的密集投影替换为相对计算复杂度仅为k/C的机制，实测端到端运行时延也验证了理论上的性能收益。在ImageNet-1K、CIFAR-100数据集的ResNet骨干网络、迁移学习任务、EfficientViT架构以及主流现代训练策略下，MoCE的性能匹配或超过密集基线方法和现有通道选择方法，同时将乘加运算量（MACs）降低16.7%，端到端时延也有所减少。

title: Primate vision reveals a missing principle for robust dynamic AI
title_zh: 灵长类视觉揭示鲁棒动态人工智能的缺失原理
authors: Matteo Dunnhofer, Christian Micheloni, Kohitij Kar
abstract: How does an intelligent visual system combine what objects look like with how they move while remaining robust as appearance changes? We addressed this question by comparing human perception and neural activity in macaque inferior temporal cortex with representations from image- and video-based neural networks spanning recognition, segmentation, optic-flow processing and predictive world modeling. Temporal integration improved object representations, but most video recognition models generalized poorly when appearance was disrupted while motion structure was preserved. Humans and macaque IT remained robust. Notably, predictive world models combined strong cross-appearance generalization with the closest correspondence to IT, outperforming other video-modeling approaches in neural fidelity. Yet no model reproduced the cortical transformation from early appearance-dominated responses toward later appearance-invariant motion coding. These results identify progressive integration of motion into object representations as a principle of robust dynamic vision and implicate predictive learning as a promising route toward realizing this computation in artificial systems.
summary_zh: 智能视觉系统如何在外观发生变化时，仍能鲁棒地融合物体外观特征与运动特征？本文通过对比人类感知、猕猴下颞叶皮层的神经活动，以及覆盖识别、分割、光流处理、预测世界建模任务的图像/视频神经网络的表征，对上述问题展开研究。研究发现时序整合可提升物体表征质量，但多数视频识别模型在运动结构保留、外观被干扰的场景下泛化性能很差，而人类和猕猴下颞叶皮层的表现仍保持鲁棒性。值得注意的是，预测世界模型兼具极强的跨外观泛化能力，与下颞叶皮层表征的相似度最高，在神经保真度上优于其他视频建模方法。但目前没有模型可以复现从早期外观主导响应到后期外观不变运动编码的皮层转换过程。上述结果表明，将运动特征逐步整合到物体表征中是鲁棒动态视觉的核心原理，预测学习是在人工系统中实现该计算过程的极具前景的方向。

title: Too much of a good thing -- when knowledge distillation promotes overfitting, and how to avoid it
title_zh: 过犹不及：知识蒸馏何时会引发过拟合及规避方案
authors: Irene Trigueros-Lorca, Leonardo Concepci\'on, Christian Wagner, Isaac Triguero, Daniel Molina
abstract: The growing size of Convolutional Neural Networks has led to increasingly large and costly models. Knowledge Distillation (KD) addresses this by transferring knowledge from a large network (teacher) to a small one (student), also reducing the training data required. KD is traditionally applied only at the network's final output. However, its behaviour when applied at intermediate network layers has received little attention. This raises the question of whether intermediate block-wise KD, which provides supervision throughout the network, could offer an advantage under specific conditions, such as few instances per class, which is common in fine-grained datasets. This work proposes a student design based on simple, homogeneous blocks mirroring those of the teacher, distilling knowledge between corresponding blocks. Across eleven datasets, we show that on classic datasets, distilling only the last block is sufficient -- and often best--, whereas fine-grained, data-scarce settings benefit substantially from intermediate supervision, with even a single additional distillation point narrowing the gap considerably. We further study how this supervision should be guided, exploring configurations of varying granularity and informed by an explainability analysis based on attention maps, Centered Kernel Alignment, and Grad-CAM, alongside the impact of teacher and student fine-tuning strategies. This work shows that intermediate block-wise distillation, guided appropriately, is key to building compact data-efficient models without sacrificing accuracy.
summary_zh: 卷积神经网络的规模不断增长，模型体积与训练成本也持续攀升。知识蒸馏（KD）技术将知识从大的教师网络迁移到小的学生网络，同时可降低所需的训练数据量，是解决该问题的主流方案。传统知识蒸馏仅在网络的最终输出层施加监督，但针对网络中间层开展蒸馏的行为特性尚未得到充分研究。这引发了一个值得探讨的问题：在整个网络中逐层提供监督的中间块级知识蒸馏，是否能在每类样本数极少这类细粒度数据集常见的场景下获得性能优势？本文提出一种学生网络设计方案，采用与教师网络对应块结构完全一致的简单同构块，在对应块之间开展知识蒸馏。在11个数据集上的实验结果表明，在经典数据集上仅对最后一个块开展蒸馏就足够且往往效果最优，而在细粒度、数据稀缺场景下，中间层监督可带来显著性能提升，仅增加一个蒸馏点就可大幅缩小与教师模型的性能差距。本文进一步研究了中间层监督的引导方案，探索了不同粒度的配置，结合基于注意力图、中心核对齐、Grad-CAM的可解释性分析，以及教师和学生模型微调策略的影响。研究表明，经过合理引导的中间块级蒸馏是构建紧凑、数据高效模型且不损失精度的核心方法。

title: CRISP: Calibration-Aware Visual State Space Duality for Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation
title_zh: CRISP：面向遥感语义分割的校准感知视觉状态空间对偶框架
authors: Kangning Wang, Haopeng Zhang, Zhiguo Jiang
abstract: State space models, especially Visual State Space Duality (VSSD), have emerged as efficient linear-time alternatives to Transformers for dense visual tasks. However, we observe that VSSD compresses spatial context into a global aggregation that suppresses high-frequency responses, causing excessive boundary smoothing in remote sensing semantic segmentation. To address this, we propose CRISP, a calibration framework with two components. Its core, the Duality Calibration Operator (DCO), restores local contrast and boundary responses through residual injection and frequency calibration within the VSSD backbone, without altering its linear complexity. To retain the recovered detail, an Orthogonal Multi-Prototype (OMP) head assigns multiple orthogonally constrained prototypes per class to model large intra-class variance. Extensive experiments on Potsdam, Vaihingen, and LoveDA show that, with approximately 30M parameters, CRISP achieves consistent gains in mean F1 (mF) and mIoU while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/crazylifeha/CRISP.
summary_zh: 状态空间模型，尤其是视觉状态空间对偶（Visual State Space Duality, VSSD），已成为密集视觉任务中Transformer的高效线性时间替代方案。但研究发现，VSSD会将空间上下文压缩为全局聚合结果，抑制高频响应，导致遥感语义分割任务中出现边界过度平滑问题。为解决该问题，本文提出包含两个核心组件的校准框架CRISP：其核心模块对偶校准算子（Duality Calibration Operator, DCO）在不改变VSSD主干网络线性复杂度的前提下，通过残差注入和频率校准恢复局部对比度与边界响应；为保留恢复得到的细节信息，本文设计正交多原型（Orthogonal Multi-Prototype, OMP）检测头，为每个类别分配多个受正交约束的原型，对大的类内方差进行建模。在Potsdam、Vaihingen和LoveDA数据集上开展的大量实验表明，仅使用约30M参数的CRISP在平均F1值（mF）和平均交并比（mIoU）指标上均取得稳定提升，性能与当前最优方法相当。代码开源地址：https://github.com/crazylifeha/CRISP。

title: Multi-Stage Prompt-Guided Feature Modulation for Generalizable Brain Tumor Segmentation
title_zh: 面向泛化性脑肿瘤分割的多阶段提示引导特征调制方法
authors: Mohammad Mahdi Danesh Pajouh, Sara Saeedi
abstract: Accurate brain tumor segmentation from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for diagnosis, treatment planning, surgical guidance, and disease monitoring. However, developing automated segmentation models that generalize across diverse tumor characteristics, imaging protocols, acquisition sites, and patient populations remains challenging. Variations in tumor morphology and imaging distributions can substantially degrade performance outside the training domain. Consequently, improving the robustness and generalization of deep learning-based segmentation models has become a key objective in medical image analysis. To improve segmentation robustness, we propose Multi-Stage Dynamic Prompt nnU-Net, a prompt-conditioned extension of nnU-Net. Three independent dynamic prompt modules are inserted into the deepest encoder stages. Each module contains a learnable bank of ten 256-dimensional prompt vectors and uses globally pooled encoder features to generate image-specific prompt representations. These representations are projected into feature-wise scaling $(\gamma)$ and shifting $(\beta)$ parameters that modulate encoder feature maps through Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM), enabling adaptive feature conditioning at multiple semantic levels. Evaluation on the BraTS GOAT validation dataset demonstrated that the proposed Multi-Stage Dynamic Prompt nnU-Net outperformed the baseline nnU Net across the majority of evaluated metrics and tumor subregions. The proposed model achieved average lesion-wise Dice scores of 76.16% (ET), 80.04% (TC), and 86.42% (WT), compared with 74.38%, 78.14% and 84.01% for the baseline model. The results demonstrate that multi-stage dynamic prompt conditioning improves segmentation accuracy and boundary delineation for brain tumor segmentation.
summary_zh: 从磁共振成像（MRI）中实现精准脑肿瘤分割对疾病诊断、治疗规划、手术引导和病情监测至关重要。但开发可在不同肿瘤特征、成像协议、采集站点和患者群体下泛化的自动分割模型仍存在较大挑战：肿瘤形态和成像分布的差异会大幅降低模型在训练域外的性能，因此提升基于深度学习的分割模型的鲁棒性与泛化性已成为医学图像分析领域的核心目标。为提升分割鲁棒性，本文提出多阶段动态提示nnU-Net，这是nnU-Net的提示条件扩展版本：三个独立的动态提示模块被插入编码器的最深层阶段，每个模块包含一个由10个256维提示向量组成的可学习库，利用全局池化后的编码器特征生成图像专属的提示表示，再将这些表示投影为特征级缩放参数(γ)和偏移参数(β)，通过特征级线性调制（Feature-wise Linear Modulation, FiLM）调整编码器特征图，实现多语义层级的自适应特征条件化。在BraTS GOAT验证数据集上的评估结果显示，本文提出的多阶段动态提示nnU-Net在绝大多数评估指标和肿瘤子区域上的表现均优于基线nnU-Net：该模型的病灶级平均Dice得分分别为76.16%（增强肿瘤区ET）、80.04%（肿瘤核心区TC）和86.42%（全肿瘤区WT），而基线模型对应得分仅为74.38%、78.14%和84.01%。实验结果证明，多阶段动态提示条件化策略可有效提升脑肿瘤分割的精度与边界勾勒效果。

title: More Motion Is Not Always Better Motion: Corpus Composition Governs Whether Augmentation Helps SMPL-Based Parkinsonian Gait Severity Estimation
title_zh: 运动并非越多越好：语料组成决定数据增强是否有助于基于SMPL的帕金森步态严重程度估计
authors: Michael Caiola, Andrew C. Weitz
abstract: We grade MDS-UPDRS gait severity from SMPL motion using three frozen MotionAGFormer encoders as featurizers, reaching macro-F1 0.58 on a hidden, multi-site test set. Because the system's members differ only in their lifting corpus, evaluating encoders singly on that test set isolates what that corpus contributes. Six pools drawn from one inertial dataset, varying only in which walking tasks they include, score between 0.32 and 0.53, and just one of them beats the 0.51 of an encoder given no outside motion at all. What separates them is not how much data they hold but whether they carry a contrast in walking speed, the variation this representation appears to depend : a further pool adding a third collection site at fixed task composition does worse still. The same rule explains why exact synthetic motion and monocularly reconstructed web video both fail to help. Modifying the learned representation itself, rather than the corpus behind it, cost every variant that attempted it.
summary_zh: 本文使用三个冻结的MotionAGFormer编码器作为特征提取器，从SMPL人体参数化模型的运动数据中预测MDS-UPDRS统一帕金森病评定量表的步态严重程度，在隐藏的多站点测试集上取得了0.58的宏F1得分。由于系统中不同编码器的差异仅来自其预训练所用的动作提取语料，在该测试集上单独评估编码器即可分离出语料本身的贡献。本文从单一惯性数据集中抽取6个仅包含不同行走任务的语料池，对应模型得分分布在0.32到0.53之间，其中仅1个语料池的表现超过完全不使用外部运动数据训练的编码器的0.51得分。决定性能差异的并非语料的数据量，而是语料中是否包含行走速度的差异——该特征正是当前表示学习的依赖项；进一步实验显示，在任务组成固定的前提下新增第三个采集站点的数据集反而会导致性能下降。该规律同样可以解释为什么精确合成运动数据、单目重建的网络视频数据都无法带来性能提升：所有尝试直接修改学习到的表示本身而非调整背后语料组成的方案，均出现了性能损失。

title: Velocity-coupled Representation Refinement for Satellite Orbit Prediction
title_zh: 面向卫星轨道预测的速度耦合表示优化方法
authors: Yue Yang, Zhiqiang Wu, Saiyu Qi, Fan Ma
abstract: Satellite orbit prediction, which aims to forecast future orbital trajectories from historical observations, is important for collision warning and safe space operations. With advances in time-series forecasting, learning-based methods have emerged as a promising solution for satellite prediction. In orbital dynamics, a satellite state is typically described by position and velocity, where position characterizes trajectory geometry and velocity reflects its instantaneous direction and rate of change. However, most existing methods mainly focus on temporal dependencies within position sequences while rarely exploiting the intrinsic coupling between position and velocity, which is essential for modeling satellite motion. To this end, we propose OrbitNet, a velocity-aware representation learning method for accurate satellite orbit prediction. It lifts conventional position-sequence forecasting to a position-velocity coupled representation learning paradigm by exploiting relationships among satellite state variables. Specifically, we develop a velocity-coupled representation refinement strategy to enhance positional representations through cross-variable interactions between position and velocity. We further introduce orbital segment modeling, which partitions historical trajectories into temporal segments and performs segment-level temporal learning to capture local motion variations and long-range evolution patterns. Extensive experiments show that OrbitNet outperforms large time-series foundation models and representative general forecasting methods under both in-domain evaluation on Starlink and zero-shot evaluation across six unseen satellite constellations. We expect this work to encourage further exploration of satellite-aware representation learning for trajectory time-series forecasting.
summary_zh: 卫星轨道预测旨在基于历史观测数据预报未来轨道轨迹，对碰撞预警和太空安全运行具有重要意义。随着时间序列预测技术的发展，基于学习的方法已成为卫星轨道预测的极具潜力的解决方案。在轨道动力学中，卫星状态通常由位置和速度共同描述：位置表征轨迹的几何特征，速度则反映卫星运动的瞬时方向和变化率。但现有大多数方法仅关注位置序列内部的时间依赖关系，很少利用位置和速度之间的内在耦合关系，而该耦合关系是建模卫星运动的核心要素。针对该问题，本文提出面向精准卫星轨道预测的速度感知表示学习方法OrbitNet，将传统的位置序列预测范式升级为位置-速度耦合表示学习范式，充分挖掘卫星状态变量之间的关联关系。具体而言，本文提出速度耦合表示优化策略，通过位置与速度的跨变量交互增强位置表示；进一步引入轨道段建模模块，将历史轨迹划分为多个时间片段，在片段层级开展时间序列学习，捕捉局部运动变化和长程演化模式。大量实验结果表明，无论是在Starlink数据集上的域内评估，还是在6个未见过的卫星星座上的零样本评估场景下，OrbitNet的性能均优于大型时间序列基础模型和代表性通用预测方法。本研究有望推动面向轨迹时间序列预测的卫星专属表示学习领域的进一步探索。

title: DriftAD: Visually-Guided Text Drift for Few-Shot Industrial Anomaly Detection
title_zh: DriftAD：面向小样本工业异常检测的视觉引导文本漂移框架
authors: Wenyang Liu, Tianyi Liu, Dongshuo Zhang, Kejun Wu, Adams Wai-Kin Kong
abstract: Few-shot anomaly detection (FSAD) has recently benefited from vision-language models such as CLIP, which enable anomaly de?tection by aligning visual features with text descriptions of normal and abnormal states. However, existing methods typically rely on static text prompts that are applied uniformly across the entire feature hierarchy and spatial dimensions. This rigid global-to-local matching fails to capture the highly localized and scale-dependent physical variations of industrial defects. To address this, we propose DriftAD, a FSAD framework built on three key modules. First, an Anomaly Signal Amplification (ASA) module enhances subtle defect signals through spatial and frequency branches before text-visual matching. Second, Visually-Guided Text Drift (VGTD) dynamically transforms frozen CLIP text embeddings, steering them into layer?wise, spatially-adaptive anomaly descriptors conditioned on local visual context at each encoder depth. Third, Drift-Guided Spatial Gating (DGSG) uses the drifted abnormal descriptor as a spatial probe to selectively enhance anomaly-relevant visual features. Addi?tionally, a drift separation loss prevents representational collapse of the drifted descriptors, and a gate supervision loss enforces spatially discriminative gating in DGSG. Extensive experiments on MVTec?AD and VisA demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across all 1-, 2-, and 4-shot settings on both image-level and pixel-level metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/wenyang001/DriftAD.
summary_zh: 近年来小样本异常检测（FSAD）领域受益于CLIP等视觉语言模型，这类模型通过将视觉特征与正常、异常状态的文本描述对齐实现异常检测。但现有方法通常依赖静态文本提示，在整个特征层级和空间维度上统一应用，这种刚性的全局-局部匹配机制无法捕捉工业缺陷高度局部化、依赖尺度的物理变化特征。针对该问题，本文提出由三个核心模块组成的小样本异常检测框架DriftAD：第一，异常信号放大（Anomaly Signal Amplification, ASA）模块在图文匹配前通过空间分支和频率分支增强微弱的缺陷信号；第二，视觉引导文本漂移（Visually-Guided Text Drift, VGTD）模块动态变换冻结的CLIP文本嵌入，基于每个编码器深度的局部视觉上下文，将其转换为层级化、空间自适应的异常描述符；第三，漂移引导空间门控（Drift-Guided Spatial Gating, DGSG）模块使用漂移后的异常描述符作为空间探针，选择性增强与异常相关的视觉特征。此外，本文设计的漂移分离损失可避免漂移后描述符的表示坍缩，门控监督损失可推动DGSG生成空间判别性门控。在MVTec AD和VisA数据集上开展的大量实验表明，该框架在1样本、2样本、4样本所有设置下的图像级和像素级指标均达到当前最优性能。代码开源地址：https://github.com/wenyang001/DriftAD。

title: Platonic Representation Hypothesis on World Models
title_zh: 世界模型中的柏拉图表示假说
authors: Wenhow Li (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology), Chengwei MA (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology), Hui Xiong (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology), Ying-Cong Chen (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology), Lei Zhang (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology)
abstract: World models have demonstrated significant potential for perceiving and simulating complex environments. Despite their strong performance, the fundamental nature of their learned representations remains poorly understood. In this paper, we investigate the Platonic Representation Hypothesis within this domain by proposing the Predictive Consistency Assumption: we posit that the optimization of a shared state transition objective acts as a selective pressure that encourages heterogeneous models to converge toward a shared latent structure. Through systematic experiments with the DINO World Model (DINO-WM), in which we vary visual encoders to create heterogeneous models, we find that capable world models evolve toward geometrically similar internal structures. Moreover, via model stitching, we show that the internal features of one world model can be mapped to another with limited performance degradation, providing evidence of functional compatibility. Our findings suggest that the pursuit of predictive consistency can promote shared, transition-compatible latent structure across world models.
summary_zh: 世界模型在感知和模拟复杂环境方面已展现出巨大潜力，但目前学界对其学习得到的表示的本质特性仍缺乏深入理解。本文针对该领域开展柏拉图表示假说研究，提出预测一致性假设：共享状态转移目标的优化过程会形成选择压力，推动异构模型收敛到共享的潜在结构。本文使用DINO世界模型（DINO-WM）开展系统实验，通过更换视觉编码器生成多组异构模型，发现性能优异的世界模型会逐步演化出几何结构高度相似的内部特征。此外，通过模型拼接实验证明，一个世界模型的内部特征可以映射到另一个世界模型，且仅会产生有限的性能下降，为功能兼容性提供了证据。研究结果表明，对预测一致性的追求可以推动不同世界模型生成共享的、转移兼容的潜在结构。

title: Scaling Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models via Velocity Matching
title_zh: 基于速度匹配的扩散模型强化学习缩放方法
authors: Jaemoo Choi, Wei Guo, Yuchen Zhu, Arash Vahdat, Molei Tao, Julius Berner, Yongxin Chen
abstract: Reward fine-tuning is becoming an important tool for adapting diffusion models to human preferences and task-specific objectives, but existing methods largely inherit policy-gradient machinery from large language models. Unlike autoregressive models, diffusion models do not provide tractable likelihoods for generated samples. As a result, current approaches either construct trajectory likelihoods from stochastic denoising transitions or approximate endpoint likelihoods with evidence lower bound, introducing additional computation and algorithmic complexity. We demonstrate that this likelihood-based machinery is not necessary for effective diffusion reward fine-tuning. We propose reward-based velocity matching (RVM), a simple trajectory-free update that acts directly on the velocity field. RVM reinforces directions associated with high-reward generations, suppresses those with low reward, and involves an optional anchor term controlling drift from a reference velocity. Notably, it provides a general framework that recovers recent fine-tuning methods, including RAM and DiffusionNFT, as special cases. Across various large-scale diffusion models reward fine-tuning tasks, RVM is competitive with or outperforms trajectory-based policy-gradient methods under substantially reduced training cost. We further find that, once the velocity update is simplified, the particular loss variant matters less than reward and anchor design. For video generation, standard preference rewards can favor visually clean but nearly static outputs; introducing a new dynamic-tracking reward that substantially improve motions while improving overall VBench performance. These results suggest that scalable reward fine-tuning for diffusion models is better posed in the native velocity representation than as likelihood-based policy optimization.
summary_zh: 奖励微调已成为让扩散模型适配人类偏好和任务专属目标的重要工具，但现有方法大多继承了大语言模型的策略梯度机制。与自回归模型不同，扩散模型无法为生成样本提供可计算的似然，因此现有方案要么基于随机去噪转移过程构建轨迹似然，要么使用证据下界近似端点似然，引入了额外的计算开销和算法复杂度。本文证明这类基于似然的机制并非实现扩散模型有效奖励微调的必要条件，提出基于奖励的速度匹配（Reward-based Velocity Matching, RVM）方法，这是一种直接作用于速度场的无轨迹简单更新策略：RVM会强化与高奖励生成结果相关的方向，抑制低奖励对应的方向，还包含一个可选的锚定项，用于控制与参考速度的漂移幅度。值得注意的是，该方法提供了一个通用框架，可将近期提出的RAM、DiffusionNFT等微调方法作为特殊情况统一覆盖。在多个大规模扩散模型奖励微调任务中，RVM的性能与基于轨迹的策略梯度方法相当甚至更优，同时训练成本大幅降低。进一步研究发现，当速度更新被简化后，具体的损失变体的重要性低于奖励和锚定项的设计：在视频生成任务中，标准偏好奖励倾向于生成视觉清晰但几乎静止的输出，本文提出的全新动态跟踪奖励可在大幅提升运动效果的同时，提升VBench的整体性能。上述结果表明，面向扩散模型的可扩展奖励微调更适合在原生速度表示下实现，而非采用基于似然的策略优化范式。

title: Cross-Generation Optimization of YOLOv26, YOLOv11, and YOLOv8 for Fine-Grained Small-Object Detection and Instance Segmentation in Complex Orchards
title_zh: 面向复杂果园细粒度小目标检测与实例分割的YOLOv26、YOLOv11、YOLOv8跨代优化研究
authors: Ranjan Sapkota, Manoj Karkee
abstract: Small-object detection and instance segmentation remain challenging in orchard environments because of green-on-green similarity, occlusion, and limited pixel representation of fine fruit anatomy. This study presents a cross-generation benchmark of Ultralytics YOLOv8, YOLOv11, and YOLOv26 for detecting and segmenting apple fruitlet, calyx, and peduncle structures for robotic orchard perception. Five model scales (n, s, m, l, and x) were evaluated under conventional 640 x 640 and small-object focused 960 x 960 training configurations, yielding 30 experiments. Increasing model capacity did not consistently improve accuracy. YOLOv11s-960 achieved the highest observed mask mAP@50:95 (0.402) and box mAP@50:95 (0.426), while YOLOv26s-960 achieved comparable values of 0.397 and 0.425 with only 10.37 M parameters and 34.1 GFLOPs. Peduncle remained the most challenging class. Overall, compact-to-moderate YOLO models with small-object-focused training provided favorable accuracy efficiency trade-offs, establishing a practical benchmark for fine-grained agricultural robotics and orchard perception. Github Link: https://github.com/rnjnspkt/Optimizing-and-Comparing-Ultralytics-YOLOv26-YOLOv11-and-YOLOv8-for-Small-Object-Detection-and-Seg
summary_zh: 受绿色物体间相似性、遮挡、精细果实解剖结构的像素占比极低等因素影响，果园环境下的小目标检测与实例分割任务仍极具挑战性。本研究针对果园机器人感知场景，开展Ultralytics YOLOv8、YOLOv11、YOLOv26的跨代基准测试，目标是检测和分割苹果幼果、花萼和果柄三类结构。研究共设置30组实验，在常规640×640训练配置和面向小目标优化的960×960训练配置下，评估5种不同模型规模（n、s、m、l、x）的性能。实验结果显示，提升模型容量并不能持续提升精度：YOLOv11s-960取得了最高的掩码mAP@50:95（0.402）和边界框mAP@50:95（0.426），而YOLOv26s-960仅使用10.37M参数和34.1GFLOPs算力，就取得了0.397和0.425的可比性能，其中果柄始终是最难识别的类别。总体而言，经过小目标专属训练的紧凑到中等规模YOLO模型可实现优异的精度-效率权衡，为细粒度农业机器人和果园感知领域建立了实用基准。代码开源地址：https://github.com/rnjnspkt/Optimizing-and-Comparing-Ultralytics-YOLOv26-YOLOv11-and-YOLOv8-for-Small-Object-Detection-and-Seg。

title: The Blending Ratio Is Not Where the Performance Is: Diagnosing Prototype Blending for Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 性能瓶颈不在混合比：面向视觉语言模型小样本适配的原型混合方法诊断
authors: Liangzhi Li, Bowen Wang, Yiming Qian, Thorsten Neumann, Xia Xie, Guangshun Li
abstract: Many few-shot adaptation methods for vision-language models classify with a convex combination of the zero-shot text prototype and the mean of the K labelled image features, with a single blending ratio routinely tuned on held-out labels, often on the test set itself. We ask what the family's own bias-variance justification invites: what is the right ratio, can it be estimated without validation data, and is finding it where the performance is? First, the ratio minimising prototype mean-squared error has a closed form whose support-set plug-in is exactly a positive-part James-Stein coefficient shrinking towards the text prototype. Across 4,800 cells (ten datasets, five backbones including SigLIP, five shot counts, five seeds, four prompt tiers) this theoretically optimal ratio is a reliable estimate of the wrong quantity: on the 950 primary-tier cells where it is defined it trails a test-set-oracle ratio by 8.5 points. It saturates near 1, discarding the text prior for a nearest-class-mean classifier, because 78% of the text-image prototype distance it treats as bias is a class-independent offset that the arg max largely cancels. We prove the mechanism and bound its share of the damage at 26% by a counterfactual. Second, leave-one-out on the support set alone sets a ratio landing within 0.9 points of the oracle blend, so it is estimable without validation data. Third, validation-free linear probes beat even the oracle-tuned blend: CLAP by +1.9 points and LP++ by +1.5 on average, and at K >= 4 all four validation-free baselines sit above the oracle, the linear probes by margins excluding zero. These results locate the ceiling in the model class, not the hyperparameter: the ratio can be set near-optimally for free, and it is still not where the performance is. Code, cached features, per-cell records: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Liangzhi-Li/clipbench-blending
summary_zh: 很多视觉语言模型的小样本适配方法使用零样本文本原型与K个标注图像特征均值的凸组合实现分类，通常会在留出标签集甚至测试集上调优单一混合比。本文针对该类方法的偏差-方差合理性展开研究，回答三个核心问题：最优混合比是什么？能否在不使用验证数据的前提下估计得到？调优混合比是否是性能提升的核心来源？首先，最小化原型均方误差的混合比存在闭式解，其支持集插入结果恰好是向文本原型收缩的正部James-Stein系数。在覆盖10个数据集、5种包含SigLIP在内的骨干网络、5种样本数、5种随机种子、4种提示层级的共4800组实验中，该理论最优混合比估计的是错误的目标量：在其可定义的950组主层级实验中，性能比测试集最优混合比低8.5个百分点，且会收敛到接近1的数值，丢弃文本先验退化为最近类均值分类器，原因是其视为偏差的78%的图文原型距离是与类别无关的偏移量，会被argmax操作大幅抵消。本文证明了该机制的存在，并通过反事实实验量化其对性能损失的贡献占比为26%。其次，仅在支持集上执行留一法得到的混合比，与最优混合比的性能差距仅为0.9个百分点，说明无需验证数据即可估计得到近似最优的混合比。第三，无需验证的线性探针方法性能甚至超过了经过最优调优的混合方法：CLAP平均性能高出1.9个百分点，LP++平均性能高出1.5个百分点，当样本数K≥4时，所有4种无需验证的基线方法性能均超过最优混合方法，线性探针的性能优势显著不为零。上述结果表明该类方法的性能天花板来自模型类别本身，而非超参数：混合比可以免费设置到接近最优的水平，但它本身并不是性能提升的核心来源。代码、缓存特征和逐组实验记录开源地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/Liangzhi-Li/clipbench-blending。

title: Fidelity Preference, Not Demographic Preference: A Pixel-Level Attribute-Sensitivity Audit of Image Aesthetic/Preference Scorers
title_zh: 保真度偏好而非人口统计偏好：图像美学/偏好评分器的像素级属性敏感性审计
authors: Mingyang Xu
abstract: Text-to-image systems use learned aesthetic scorers to filter training data and guide generation, but whether these scores encode demographic attributes as objective quality is unclear. We audit four scorers (LAION-Aesthetics, PickScore, ImageReward, HPSv2) using pixel-level interventions on skin tone and body type in synthetic and real images. Our key finding is that along skin-lightness, the dominant effect is fidelity preference: unaltered images score highest, and perturbations in either direction are penalized (inverted-U). Placebo arms show this penalty is not an artifact of the skin operator, as applying the same CIELAB L* shift to non-skin regions yields similar penalty magnitudes. However, the penalty is operator-dependent and holds for all operators only for LAION-Aes. Critically, audits on synthetic images alone are misleading: LAION-Aes shows strong preference for darker skin on synthetic faces, but on 1470 real faces the preference reverses and becomes much smaller, and amplification becomes non-significant. Across scorers, synthetic results do not transfer -- reversing for LAION-Aes and HPSv2, attenuating for PickScore. We contribute a reproducible benchmark with artifact control and synthetic/real cross-validation, and an auditability criterion for pixel-level causal isolation (valid for skin tone, not for body type due to deformation). Population-stratified analysis shows fidelity-penalty asymmetry is not robust across groups after FDR correction except for HPSv2. Our findings show naive synthetic audits misjudge bias direction and magnitude, and only within-image causal isolation on real data can distinguish true demographic bias from fidelity preference.
summary_zh: 文生图系统使用学习得到的美学评分器过滤训练数据、引导生成过程，但目前学界尚不明确这类评分是否将人口统计属性编码为客观质量。本文通过对合成图像和真实图像的肤色、体型属性执行像素级干预，对LAION-Aesthetics、PickScore、ImageReward、HPSv2四款评分器开展审计。核心发现是，在肤色亮度维度上，评分器的主导效应是保真度偏好：未被修改的原始图像得分最高，向任意方向的扰动都会受到惩罚，呈现倒U型分布。安慰剂对照实验证明该惩罚并非肤色操作的人为产物：对非皮肤区域施加相同的CIELAB L*亮度偏移，也会得到幅度相近的惩罚。但该惩罚效应与操作算子相关，仅LAION-Aes对所有操作算子都表现出该特性。关键结论是，仅在合成图像上开展审计会产生误导：LAION-Aes在合成人脸数据集上表现出对深色皮肤的强烈偏好，但在1470张真实人脸数据集上该偏好反转且幅度大幅降低，放大效应不再显著。不同评分器的合成数据集实验结果均无法迁移到真实场景：LAION-Aes和HPSv2的偏好发生反转，PickScore的偏好效应衰减。本文贡献了一套经过伪影控制、支持合成/真实交叉验证的可复现基准，以及一套用于像素级因果隔离的审计标准（该标准适用于肤色属性，因形变问题不适用于体型属性）。经过FDR校正后的群体分层分析显示，除HPSv2外，保真度惩罚的不对称性在不同人群组间并不稳健。研究结果表明，简单的合成图像审计会误判偏差的方向和幅度，只有在真实数据上开展图像内因果隔离，才能区分真正的人口统计偏差和保真度偏好效应。

title: InfoDPP-PAC: Principled Patch Selection for Whole Slide Image Analysis
title_zh: InfoDPP-PAC：面向全切片图像分析的原则性斑块选择方法
authors: Prateek Mittal, Ayush Srivastava, Joohi Chauhan
abstract: Each WSI slide contains thousands of candidate tissue patches, while supervision is usually available only at slide level. Existing bag-construction strategies like Uniform extraction and handcrafted heuristics do not control redundancy while attention-based multiple-instance models couple patch importance to a particular downstream classifier, and coreset methods optimise embedding-space coverage without modelling task-relevant patch quality. We introduce InfoDPP-PAC, a principled patch-selection framework that combines teacher-seeded Gaussian process relevance modelling, determinantal log-determinant diversity,submodular greedy optimisation, and a concentration-based adaptive stopping rule. The main theoretical result shows that the log-determinant diversity term used in DPP-style selection is the Gaussian process mutual information between a selected subset and the latent relevance function. We further derive a PAC-style certificate for residual information gain, allowing the number of retained patches to vary by slide rather than being fixed a priori. The empirical study evaluates whether the selected subset is diverse, spatially and morphologically covering, non-redundant, and enriched for the teacher-derived relevance signal. It does not claim end-to-end diagnostic improvement after retraining a downstream MIL model. On 202 HISTAI gastrointestinal whole-slide images, the adaptive rule uses 83.7% fewer patches on average than a fixed full budget while retaining 97.9% of full-budget composite selection quality. At a matched budget, InfoDPP-PAC achieves the highest mean teacher-derived relevance score among fourteen baselines, with diversity and composite scores close to the strongest coreset methods. The results support InfoDPP-PAC as a controlled quality-diversity-cardinality selection framework, rather than as a downstream clinical predictor.
summary_zh: 每张全切片图像（WSI）包含数千个候选组织斑块，而监督信号通常仅在切片层级可用。现有的包构建策略（如均匀提取和人工启发式规则）无法控制冗余度，基于注意力的多实例模型将斑块重要性与特定下游分类器绑定，而核心集方法仅优化嵌入空间覆盖度，未对任务相关的斑块质量进行建模。本文提出InfoDPP-PAC这一原则性斑块选择框架，融合教师引导的高斯过程相关性建模、行列式对数多样性、次模贪心优化以及基于集中度的自适应停止规则。核心理论结果表明，DPP类选择方法中使用的对数行列式多样性项，等价于所选子集与潜在相关性函数之间的高斯过程互信息。本文进一步推导了剩余信息增益的PAC风格保证，允许不同切片保留的斑块数量存在差异，无需预先设定固定值。实证研究对所选子集的多样性、空间与形态覆盖度、非冗余性以及教师导出相关性信号的富集程度进行了评估，本研究并未声称重新训练下游多实例学习（MIL）模型后可实现端到端诊断性能提升。在202张HISTAI胃肠道全切片图像上，该自适应规则相比固定全预算方法平均减少83.7%的斑块使用量，同时保留全预算组合选择质量的97.9%。在相同预算下，InfoDPP-PAC在14个基线方法中取得最高的平均教师导出相关性得分，其多样性与综合得分接近性能最优的核心集方法。实验结果表明，InfoDPP-PAC是一种可控的质量-多样性-数量权衡选择框架，而非下游临床预测器。

title: A Human-Factors Guided Cognitive Model of Visuospatial Complexity in Embodied Active Vision
title_zh: 具身主动视觉中视觉空间复杂度的人因引导认知模型
authors: Vasiliki Kondyli, Jakob Suchan, Mehul Bhatt
abstract: We propose a novel framework for the analysis of multimodal data -- encompassing visual, auditory, and spatial stimuli -- foregrounding the role of complexity in embodied perception and interaction in dynamic, naturalistic settings. Grounded in theories of embodied cognition and active vision, we argue that embodied perceptual complexity emerges from an agent's dynamic engagement with the environment and must be analyzed holistically, as a combination of qualitative and quantitative attributes pertaining to, for instance, visuospatial and auditory features. Building on previous work on visual complexity, we expand this into a categorization of diverse complexity attributes -- quantitative, structural, dynamic, auditory, and interactional -- that together characterize multimodal complexity. We demonstrate how this model provides a theoretical framework for characterizing aspects of visuospatial complexity and their interactions, specifically in the context of everyday driving. We also discuss practical applications of the proposed model for creating and evaluating benchmark datasets (e.g., in driving) that centralize cognitive human factors, as well as applications aimed at systematically investigating the effect of visuospatial complexity on human active vision from the viewpoint of visual perception research. The proposed framework lays the foundation for automated methods that interpret complexity in 3D dynamic environments from a human-centered perspective, serving as a semantic template for explainable computational analysis of visuospatial complexity with a categorical focus on cognitive human factors.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于多模态数据分析的全新框架，分析对象涵盖视觉、听觉与空间刺激，重点关注动态自然场景下具身感知与交互过程中复杂度的作用。基于具身认知与主动视觉理论，本文认为具身感知复杂度源自智能体与环境的动态交互，必须结合视觉空间、听觉特征等定性与定量属性进行整体分析。在现有视觉复杂度研究的基础上，本文将其拓展为涵盖定量、结构、动态、听觉与交互属性的多维度复杂度分类体系，共同表征多模态复杂度。本文验证了该模型可作为理论框架，用于刻画视觉空间复杂度的各维度属性及其交互关系，尤其面向日常驾驶场景。本文还探讨了该模型的实际应用场景：构建与评估以人因认知为核心的基准数据集（如驾驶场景数据集），以及从视觉感知研究视角系统探究视觉空间复杂度对人类主动视觉的影响。该框架为从以人为本的视角解读3D动态环境复杂度的自动化方法奠定了基础，可作为聚焦认知人因的视觉空间复杂度可解释计算分析语义模板。

title: Latent Action as Intention Enables Efficient Future Imagination for World Action Models
title_zh: 以潜在动作作为意图实现世界动作模型的高效未来想象
authors: Xiang Li, Yupeng Zheng, Songen Gu, Huailiang Ma, Feng Yu, Xian Nie, Shanshuai Yuan, Yujie Zang, Weize Li, Shuai Tian, Moyang Liu, Ya-Qin Zhang, Wenchao Ding
abstract: World action models (WAMs) improve robot control by modeling how observations evolve, but generating future observations at test time incurs substantial latency. Fast-WAM removes this process for efficiency; however, our matched implementations show lower generalization for Fast-WAM than for future-aware alternatives, especially with scarce robot demonstrations and in out-of-distribution scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce **LAWA**, a WAM architecture that uses compact latent actions as an operational representation of future intentions, enabling efficient test-time future imagination without generating future observations. Specifically, a discrete tokenizer enhanced by action-free pre-training produces manipulation-centric codebook targets. LAWA jointly denoises a continuous latent state anchored to these targets with executable action chunks while omitting the future-video branch at inference. On RoboCasa, LAWA achieves state-of-the-art average success rates of 65.6% and 80.8% in the few-shot and full data settings, improving over the matched Fast-WAM baseline by 9.6 and 4.5 points, respectively. It also preserves the performance level of the matched Joint-WAM variant while requiring 42.9% lower inference latency. LAWA also demonstrates competitive zero-shot robustness on LIBERO-Plus and superior performance on real-world tasks. These results show that future imagination need not be discarded: retaining it with compact latent actions yields an effective trade-off among performance, generalization, and latency. Code and models will be released.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）通过对观测值的演化过程建模提升机器人控制性能，但测试阶段生成未来观测值会带来极高的延迟。Fast-WAM为提升效率省略了该生成过程，但本文的对照实现结果显示，Fast-WAM的泛化性能低于具备未来感知能力的同类方法，在机器人演示数据稀缺与分布外场景下表现尤为明显。为弥补这一缺陷，本文提出LAWA这一WAM架构，将紧凑的潜在动作作为未来意图的操作化表征，无需生成未来观测值即可实现高效的测试阶段未来想象。具体而言，经无动作预训练增强的离散分词器生成面向操作任务的码本目标，LAWA将锚定到上述目标的连续潜在状态与可执行动作块联合去噪，同时在推理阶段省略未来视频分支。在RoboCasa数据集上，LAWA在少样本与全数据设置下分别取得65.6%和80.8%的当前最优平均成功率，相比对照Fast-WAM基线分别提升9.6和4.5个百分点，同时保持与对照Joint-WAM变体相当的性能水平，推理延迟降低42.9%。LAWA在LIBERO-Plus数据集上也展现出极具竞争力的零样本鲁棒性，在真实世界任务中表现更优。上述结果表明无需舍弃未来想象机制：通过紧凑潜在动作保留该机制可在性能、泛化性与延迟之间实现有效权衡，相关代码与模型将开源发布。

title: $(\text{DNN})^2$: Doubly Non-Negative Relaxations for Deep Neural Networks
title_zh: (DNN)²：面向深度神经网络的双重非负松弛方法
authors: Hanna Jiamei Zhang, Alan Papalia, Michael Everett, David M. Rosen
abstract: Existing linear program (LP) and semidefinite program (SDP) relaxations for rectified linear unit (ReLU) neural network (NN) verification yield overly-conservative safety guarantees due to significant relaxation gaps. While the completely positive program (CPP) formulation closes this gap, it is NP-hard to solve. Its cheapest tractable relaxation, the doubly non-negative program (DNN), retains critical constraints as an SDP, but one whose size exceeds the reach of interior-point methods at practical scale. While Burer-Monteiro (BM) factorization has been applied to make SDP-based verification scalable, no such result exists for the strictly tighter DNN formulation. A key obstacle is that additional non-negativity constraints in the DNN cause dual multipliers for optimality certification to be non-unique, making standard certification methods inapplicable. We propose a novel eigenvalue maximization procedure that searches the non-unique multiplier space for a valid certificate, i.e. a global optimality guarantee. Experiments demonstrate that our approach $(\text{DNN})^2$ produces bounds consistently tighter than the standard SDP method, often matching the exact solution, and that our certification procedure confirms global optimality when a valid certificate exists. These results are a key step toward providing tight, certifiable, and computationally scalable verification guarantees needed to deploy neural network controllers and perception modules in safety-critical autonomous systems.
summary_zh: 现有用于整流线性单元（ReLU）神经网络验证的线性规划（LP）与半定规划（SDP）松弛方法因松弛间隙过大，生成的安全保证过于保守。完全正规划（CPP）公式可缩小该间隙，但求解属于NP难问题。其最易处理的低成本松弛方案即双重非负规划（DNN）将关键约束保留为SDP形式，但在实际应用规模下其维度已超出内点法的求解能力。Burer-Monteiro（BM）分解已被用于提升基于SDP的验证方法的可扩展性，但目前尚无研究将其应用于精度更高的DNN公式。核心障碍在于DNN中额外的非负约束会导致最优性证明的对偶乘子不唯一，使得标准证明方法无法适用。本文提出一种全新的特征值最大化流程，可在非唯一乘子空间中搜索有效证明即全局最优性保证。实验结果表明，本文提出的(DNN)²方法生成的边界始终比标准SDP方法更紧，多数情况下与精确解持平，且在存在有效证明时可通过本文的证明流程确认全局最优性。该研究为面向安全关键自主系统部署神经网络控制器与感知模块提供了兼具紧致性、可证明性与计算可扩展性的验证保障，是该领域的关键进展。

title: One-Shot Learning from Demonstration of Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation by Identifying Physical Interactions
title_zh: 基于物理交互识别的富接触机器人操作演示单样本学习方法
authors: A. H. G. Overbeek, H. van der Kooij, M. Vlutters
abstract: Learning from Demonstration (LfD) allows robots to learn manipulation tasks directly from humans, thereby supporting the versatile application of robots. Most LfD methods do not explicitly model the physical interactions between a robot and its environment, such as the making and breaking of contact, while these are crucial during manipulation tasks. Because the same basic physical interactions recur often, they can be a basis for robust, generalizable, and adaptive task reproduction. We propose an LfD method that explicitly uses what physical interactions take place where and when. Using that information, a hybrid position-force controller tracks demonstrated trajectories until contact-based transition conditions from the demonstrations are met. We evaluate our method in real robot experiments consisting of opening doors and locks, bolt picking and screwing, dislodging, and surface contouring. We show that explicitly modeling physical interactions benefits LfD in four ways. First, by allowing reproduction of complex, sequential, and contact-rich manipulation tasks using only a single demonstration and no prior knowledge of the task.
