Second, by facilitating robustness to unknown geometric variations in the environment. Third, by facilitating generalization when geometric variations are known. Fourth, by facilitating online adaptation using geometric information explored during task reproduction. We discuss how robustness, generalization, and adaptivity can be explicitly implemented, which is generally lacking in the LfD literature. Thereby, our work aims to close a gap in interpretable few-shot LfD of robotic manipulation.
summary_zh: 演示学习（LfD）可让机器人直接从人类演示中学习操作任务，为机器人的多样化应用提供支撑。多数LfD方法未显式建模机器人与环境之间的物理交互（如接触的建立与断开），而这类交互在操作任务中至关重要。由于相同的基础物理交互会反复出现，可将其作为实现鲁棒、可泛化、自适应任务复现的基础。本文提出一种LfD方法，显式利用物理交互的发生位置与时间信息，基于该信息，混合位置-力控制器跟踪演示轨迹，直至满足演示中提取的基于接触的转移条件。本文通过开门与开锁、螺栓拾取与拧入、物体松动、表面轮廓跟踪等真实机器人实验对方法进行评估。研究表明，显式建模物理交互可从四个方面优化LfD性能：第一，仅需单条演示数据且无需任务先验知识即可复现复杂、序列式的富接触操作任务；第二，提升对环境未知几何变化的鲁棒性；第三，在几何变化已知时提升泛化能力；第四，利用任务复现过程中探索的几何信息实现在线自适应。本文探讨了鲁棒性、泛化性与自适应性的显式实现方式，这是现有LfD研究普遍缺失的内容，旨在填补机器人操作可解释少样本演示学习领域的空白。

title: Fiber Bragg Grating Whiskers for Bioinspired Hydrodynamic Perception on Underwater Robots
title_zh: 面向水下机器人仿生流体力学感知的光纤布拉格光栅触须
authors: Hao Li, Tianyu Tu, Siyue Yao, Ziyang Chang, Juhyun Jung, Xiaochi Xie, Long Yin Chung, Tian-Ao Ren, Genliang Chen, Mark Cutkosky
abstract: Harbor seals track hydrodynamic trails with their vibrissae, enabling passive perception of moving targets in dark or turbid water. Inspired by this capability, we present compact fiber Bragg grating (FBG) whiskers for underwater robots. Like seal whiskers, they have a non-uniform taper and elliptical cross-section. Controlled towing experiments show a monotonic relative-flow response from 0.1 to 0.6 m/s, a strong reduction of self-induced oscillation relative to a cylindrical baseline, and a pronounced dependence on angle of attack. Experiments with a pitching foil show that the whiskers can detect the characteristic vortices shed by a stationary or moving source, detectable several seconds after the source has passed. Using this information, a single front-mounted whisker enabled a small underwater robot to distinguish between continuing straight and executing a turn, selecting the correct branch in 17 of 20 trials (85.0%) from whisker signals alone. These results connect bioinspired hydrodynamic sensing to robot action and suggest the utility of whiskers for tracking underwater objects.
summary_zh: 港海豹可通过触须追踪流体尾迹，在黑暗或浑浊水域中被动感知移动目标。受该能力启发，本文研发了用于水下机器人的紧凑型光纤布拉格光栅（FBG）触须，该触须与海豹触须类似，采用非均匀锥度与椭圆截面设计。受控拖曳实验表明，该触须在0.1至0.6 m/s流速区间内对相对流速呈单调响应，相比圆柱基线结构大幅降低了自激振荡，且响应特性与攻角显著相关。摆翼实验表明，该触须可检测静止或移动源释放的特征涡旋，在源经过数秒后仍可实现检测。基于该感知能力，仅在小型水下机器人前端安装单根触须，即可仅通过触须信号判断机器人应保持直行还是转向，20次试验中17次选择正确分支，准确率达85.0%。该研究将仿生流体力学感知与机器人动作关联，验证了触须在水下目标追踪场景的应用价值。

title: GaussianWAM: Distilling Geometry and Semantics from 3D Gaussian Fields into World-Action Models
title_zh: GaussianWAM：从3D高斯场中提取几何与语义信息蒸馏至世界动作模型
authors: Zijian Zhang, Yuqing Jiang, Weitao Zhou, Minglei Li, Jinhao Zhang, Yao Mu, Xiaofan Li, Hao Zhao, Haibao Yu
abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) jointly learn future visual prediction and action generation, using video dynamics as a representation-learning signal for robotic manipulation. However, their video latents are primarily optimized for visual prediction and are not explicitly encouraged to preserve cross-view geometric structure or spatially localized, object-relevant semantics. We propose \textbf{GaussianWAM}, a training-time representation-enhancement framework that organizes geometric and semantic supervision through a 3D Gaussian field. Given synchronized multi-view observations, frozen geometry and vision foundation models provide depth, camera parameters, and dense semantic features. GaussianWAM binds these heterogeneous signals to shared Gaussian primitives and renders spatially aligned semantic, depth, and coverage targets, which are distilled into the current-observation representations of the WAM. All teacher models, Gaussian components, and auxiliary prediction heads are removed after training, leaving the original WAM inference path without additional modules or forward computation. On LIBERO-Plus, GaussianWAM improves FastWAM from 52.05\% to 71.29\% and Cosmos Policy from 71.52\% to 77.30\%. Direct CLIP and VGGT distillation already establishes a strong FastWAM baseline of 69.37\%, while Gaussian-field unification further improves it to 71.29\%, supporting the benefit of spatially organizing heterogeneous teacher signals. GaussianWAM also improves performance on standard LIBERO and shows positive transfer trends on RoboTwin and real-world manipulation. These results suggest that training-time Gaussian distillation provides a practical way to inject geometry- and semantics-related supervision into WAM representations without changing their deployment architecture.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）联合学习未来视觉预测与动作生成，将视频动力学作为机器人操作的表征学习信号。但其视频潜在变量主要针对视觉预测优化，未被显式约束以保留跨视角几何结构或空间定位的目标相关语义。本文提出GaussianWAM这一训练阶段表征增强框架，通过3D高斯场整合几何与语义监督信号。给定同步多视角观测数据，冻结的几何与视觉基础模型提供深度、相机参数与稠密语义特征，GaussianWAM将这些异质信号绑定到共享高斯基元，渲染出空间对齐的语义、深度与覆盖度目标，将其蒸馏到WAM的当前观测表征中。训练完成后所有教师模型、高斯组件与辅助预测头均可移除，保留原始WAM推理路径，无需额外模块或前向计算开销。在LIBERO-Plus数据集上，GaussianWAM将FastWAM的性能从52.05%提升至71.29%，将Cosmos Policy的性能从71.52%提升至77.30%。直接通过CLIP与VGGT蒸馏可得到性能达69.37%的强FastWAM基线，经高斯场统一后性能进一步提升至71.29%，验证了空间组织异质教师信号的增益效果。GaussianWAM在标准LIBERO数据集上也实现了性能提升，在RoboTwin与真实世界操作场景下展现出正向迁移趋势。上述结果表明，训练阶段高斯蒸馏是一种实用方案，可在不改变部署架构的前提下，向WAM表征中注入几何与语义相关监督信号。

title: VIP: Variation-based Iterative-learning Planning for Robotic Navigation
title_zh: 面向机器人导航的基于变分迭代学习规划方法（VIP）
authors: Shuli Lv, Pengda Mao, Chen Min, Li Hong, Runxiao Liu, Shuai Wang, Quan Quan
abstract: Over the past decade, autonomous robotic systems have been increasingly deployed in applications such as surveying, search and rescue, and last-mile delivery. These applications require robots to generate safe and efficient motion plans in large, complex, and obstacle-dense environments, often under limited onboard computing resources. However, conventional planning methods commonly rely on finite-dimensional trajectory parameterization or increasingly long prediction horizons, leading to rapidly growing computational costs, particularly in multi-robot scenarios. This paper presents a novel variation-based iterative-learning planning (VIP) framework for efficient motion planning of both single robots and robotic swarms. Instead of optimizing a large number of discrete trajectory variables, VIP directly updates the planning command as a continuous function in an infinite-dimensional function space. The same variation-based update can be implemented in a model-in-the-loop manner for offline planning or in a robot-in-the-loop manner between online physical executions. By avoiding the computational burden associated with horizon expansion and high-dimensional trajectory discretization, VIP maintains a per-iteration computational complexity of $\mathcal{O}(n)$, where $n$ denotes the number of spatial discretization points. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework can efficiently generate and iteratively improve motion plans for different planning objectives, robotic platforms, and swarm configurations, highlighting its effectiveness, computational efficiency, and scalability as a general planning methodology.
summary_zh: 过去十年间，自主机器人系统已被逐步部署到测绘、搜救与末端配送等场景。这类应用要求机器人在大型复杂、障碍物密集的环境中生成安全高效的运动规划，且通常受机载计算资源限制。但传统规划方法普遍依赖有限维轨迹参数化或不断延长预测时域，导致计算成本快速上升，在多机器人场景下问题尤为突出。本文提出一种全新的基于变分迭代学习规划（VIP）框架，可实现单机器人与机器人群组的高效运动规划。VIP无需优化大量离散轨迹变量，直接在无限维函数空间中将规划指令更新为连续函数。该基于变分的更新可通过模型在环方式实现离线规划，也可在机器人两次在线物理执行之间通过机器人在环方式实现。由于避免了与时域扩展和高维轨迹离散化相关的计算负担，VIP的单轮迭代计算复杂度为O(n)，其中n为空间离散点数量。大量仿真与真实世界实验表明，该框架可针对不同规划目标、机器人平台与集群配置高效生成并迭代优化运动规划，作为通用规划方法具备优异的有效性、计算效率与可扩展性。

title: Gripper-aware Vision Language Action Models
title_zh: 夹爪感知型视觉语言动作模型
authors: Hanyi Zhang, Zihong Luo, Tianyu Li, Khang Nguyen, Basu Hela, Shreyas Kumar, Ngoc Duy Tran, Feng Dai, Charith Munasinghe, Jorge Pe\~na Queralta, Giovanni Toffetti, Khoa Vo, Ngan Le, Ravi Prakash, Quan Vuong, Tung D. Ta, Long Hu, Anh Nguyen, Baoru Huang
abstract: Vision language action models (VLAs) have advanced general purpose robotic grasping and manipulation by enabling robots to interpret visual observations and natural language instructions to generate executable action sequences. However, existing VLAs often implicitly assume gripper invariance, despite grasping strategies being inherently embodiment-dependent. Different gripper types, such as parallel-jaw and suction, usually require distinct interaction strategies to achieve the same grasping objective. Moreover, current datasets for VLAs predominantly rely on parallel-jaw grippers, limiting gripper-aware learning. To address this gap, we introduce MiGA, a multi-gripper-aware dataset spanning five distinct gripper types across multiple robots with 103,000 demonstrations, explicitly capturing strategy divergence under shared task objectives. We further propose GVLA, which combines a new multi-gripper tokenizer with adapter-based policy routing. Our new gripper encoding induces structured embedding information that balances parameter sharing and strategy differentiation, while layer-wise probing confirms meaningful gripper-conditioned representations for VLAs. Intensive experiments in both simulation and real-world robots show that our GVLA outperforms the current baselines across evaluated settings. Our method also improves zero-shot generalization or few-shot adaptation to new objects or unseen tasks, and enable more efficient gripper adaptation.
summary_zh: 视觉语言动作模型（VLA）通过让机器人理解视觉观测与自然语言指令生成可执行动作序列，推动了通用机器人抓取与操作任务的发展。但现有VLA通常隐式假设夹爪不变性，而抓取策略本质上与具身形态相关，不同夹爪类型（如平行夹爪与吸盘夹爪）通常需要不同的交互策略才能实现相同抓取目标。此外，当前VLA数据集主要基于平行夹爪构建，限制了面向多夹爪的感知学习。为解决该问题，本文构建了MiGA这一多夹爪感知数据集，覆盖5种不同夹爪类型与多台机器人，包含103000条演示数据，显式记录了相同任务目标下的策略差异。本文进一步提出GVLA模型，融合全新的多夹爪分词器与基于适配器的策略路由机制。新的夹爪编码生成结构化嵌入信息，可平衡参数共享与策略差异，逐层探测实验验证了该方法可为VLA生成具备明确语义的夹爪条件表征。大量仿真与真实机器人实验表明，GVLA在所有测试场景下性能均优于现有基线方法，可提升对新物体或未见过任务的零样本泛化能力或少样本自适应能力，实现更高效的夹爪适配。

title: Fiber Optic Sensing Glove for High Performance Dexterous Manipulation Capture
title_zh: 面向高性能灵巧操作捕捉的光纤传感手套
authors: J. D. Peiffer, Taylor Niehues, Li Guan, Ziyi Kou, Ergys Ristani
abstract: Capturing hand pose during dexterous manipulation remains difficult: vision-based methods degrade under occlusion and challenging lighting, while sensorized gloves, though occlusion-free, are prone to drift and magnetic interference and rarely match motion-capture accuracy. We introduce a fiber optic sensing glove for full hand pose tracking that targets these failure modes, using multi-core shape-sensing fibers that capture each fiber's full 3D shape rather than curvature alone. A novel pipeline registers each reconstructed fiber shape to a common hand reference frame, and a new inverse-kinematics solver reconstructs full hand pose at 60 Hz using curve constraints. Benchmarked on a 2-hour dataset of dexterous object manipulation tasks across 5 subjects, the glove achieves 7.2 mm mean fingertip position error against motion capture ground truth, reduced to 4.9 mm by a one-time factory calibration of the fiber routing hub that transfers across users and sessions. These capabilities enable high-fidelity data capture and bimanual virtual teleoperation - both essential to advancing the robotics field.
summary_zh: 灵巧操作过程中的手部姿态捕捉仍存在诸多难点：基于视觉的方法在遮挡与复杂光照条件下性能下降，而传感手套虽不受遮挡影响，但易出现漂移与磁干扰，精度难以达到动作捕捉系统的水平。本文研发了一款用于全手姿态跟踪的光纤传感手套，针对性解决上述缺陷，采用多芯形状传感光纤，可捕捉整根光纤的完整3D形状而非仅曲率信息。全新的流水线将每根重建的光纤形状配准到统一手部参考坐标系，新型逆运动学求解器可基于曲线约束以60 Hz频率重建全手姿态。在覆盖5名受试者、时长2小时的灵巧物体操作任务数据集上进行基准测试，该手套的指尖位置平均误差为7.2 mm，经一次跨用户跨会话通用的光纤路由集线器工厂校准后，误差可降至4.9 mm。该手套可实现高保真数据捕捉与双手虚拟遥操作，二者均是推动机器人领域发展的核心技术。

title: RoG-DAgger: Rollout-Guided Post-Training for End-to-End Driving
title_zh: RoG-DAgger（滚动引导数据集聚合算法）：面向端到端自动驾驶的滚动引导后训练方法
authors: Liangyu Zhong, Joachim Sicking, Fabian Hueger, Hanno Gottschalk
abstract: Recent end-to-end driving systems demonstrate strong performance on closed-loop benchmarks, yet are still predominantly trained on fixed expert-collected data using open-loop imitation learning. This training-inference mismatch leaves the policy vulnerable in policy-induced states, where accumulated errors can lead to safety-critical failures. A promising post-training approach to overcome this issue is Dataset Aggregation (DAgger), which gathers expert demonstrations in policy-induced states and subsequently fine-tunes the policy on the resulting aggregated dataset. Existing driving DAgger pipelines, however, face three challenges: i) the expert is restricted to a limited trajectory-and-speed solution space, ii) takeover may occur too early or too late relative to impending failures, and iii) privileged expert decisions may rely on information unavailable to the student. To address this, we introduce RoG-DAgger, a post-training framework that uses short-horizon kinematic rollouts to construct high-quality expert demonstrations in safety-critical states. Specifically, RoG-DAgger expands the expert's trajectory-and-speed solution space and evaluates candidate plans through rollout to construct preventive supervision. Moreover, it uses rollout solvability to time the takeover near the estimated point of no return. Lastly, it aligns the expert's field of view with that of the student to provide student-compatible supervision. Across in-distribution (including long-horizon) and out-of-distribution evaluations, RoG-DAgger improves the end-to-end model SimLingo by 5.3 driving-score points and 6.2 percentage points in success rate on Bench2Drive, doubles its driving score from 22 to 44 on Longest6 v2, and improves out-of-distribution success rate from 55\% to 66\% on Fail2Drive.
summary_zh: 现有端到端自动驾驶系统在闭环基准测试中表现优异，但大多仍采用开环模仿学习，在专家预先采集的固定数据集上训练。这种训练与推理的不匹配问题，使得策略在由自身动作诱导生成的状态下鲁棒性不足，累积误差可能引发危及安全的故障。数据集聚合算法（DAgger）是解决该问题的主流后训练方案，其通过在策略诱导状态下采集专家演示数据，在聚合后的数据集上对策略进行微调。但现有面向自动驾驶的DAgger流水线存在三大挑战：1）专家的轨迹与速度求解空间受限；2）人工接管动作相对于即将发生的故障时机过早或过晚；3）专家的决策依赖学生策略无法获取的特权信息。为解决上述问题，本文提出RoG-DAgger后训练框架，利用短时域运动学滚动机制在安全关键状态下构建高质量专家演示数据。具体而言，RoG-DAgger拓展了专家的轨迹与速度求解空间，通过滚动机制评估候选规划方案，构建预防性监督信号；同时利用滚动可解性指标，在预估的不可返回点附近触发接管动作；最后对齐专家与学生的视野范围，生成与学生感知兼容的监督信号。在分布内（含长时域场景）与分布外场景的测试中，RoG-DAgger在Bench2Drive基准上将端到端模型SimLingo的驾驶分数提升5.3分、成功率提升6.2个百分点，在Longest6 v2基准上将其驾驶分数从22提升至44，在Fail2Drive基准上将分布外场景成功率从55%提升至66%。

title: NeuralParker: A Reinforcement Learning Planner for Irregular Parking Environments
title_zh: NeuralParker：面向非规则泊车环境的强化学习规划器
authors: Zihan Wang, Bai Huang, Yang Guan, Xiao Li, Haoyu Xu, Naizheng Wang, Shengbo Eben Li
abstract: Automated parking commonly assumes marked slots and short approach maneuvers. Delivery and service vehicles, however, may need to reach an operator-specified pose in an irregular bounded environment from a distant start. Existing learning-based parking planners often rely on local observations, which can restrict long-range route reasoning. To address this problem, we present NeuralParker, a reinforcement learning-based hybrid planner for arbitrary-pose parking. NeuralParker encodes full-environment obstacle and boundary geometry in a target-relative vertex representation, allowing the policy to retain route-defining context throughout the approach. It further couples a learned curvature--length arc policy with an in-loop terminal ensemble that selects from diverse cubic Hermite connections using a curvature-regularized cost. We also establish factorial and long-range route-choice benchmarks to evaluate planning success and trajectory quality. Experiments on these benchmarks show that NeuralParker achieves higher planning success and better overall trajectory quality than the evaluated baselines, while ablation studies support the benefits of the target-relative global representation and terminal ensemble. Finally, a real-vehicle evaluation confirms that the planner transfers effectively to real delivery-vehicle perception at a working parking site, planning successfully at low computational cost.
summary_zh: 自动泊车场景通常预设存在标准车位、且泊车路径的接近机动距离较短，但配送与服务类车辆往往需要从较远的起始位置出发，在非规则的受限环境中抵达操作人员指定的任意位姿。现有基于学习的泊车规划器大多依赖局部观测，限制了长距离路径推理能力。针对该问题，本文提出NeuralParker，一种面向任意位姿泊车任务的强化学习混合规划器。NeuralParker采用相对于目标位姿的顶点表征方式，对全环境障碍物与边界几何信息进行编码，使策略在整个泊车接近过程中保留决定路径的关键上下文信息；同时将学习得到的曲率-弧长策略与闭环终端集成模块相结合，该模块通过曲率正则化代价函数从多样化的三次Hermite连接路径中择优。本文还构建了因子化长距离路径选择基准，用于评估规划成功率与轨迹质量。在该基准上的实验结果表明，NeuralParker的规划成功率与整体轨迹质量均优于对比基线方法，消融实验验证了目标相对全局表征与终端集成模块的增益效果。最后实车测试证实，该规划器可有效迁移至真实配送车辆的感知系统，在实际泊车场景中以极低的计算成本完成规划任务。

title: A Durable Vision-Based Tactile Fingertip for Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: 面向机器人操作的耐用型视觉触觉指尖
authors: F. Richard Cottrell, Megha H. Tippur, Edward H. Adelson
abstract: Currently available commercial vision-based tactile sensors provide rich contact information but remain vulnerable to abrasion and repeated concentrated loading, limiting their use in demanding robotic applications. This work presents a durable tactile fingertip comprising a soft silicone gel with a nonpigmented, textured, thin thermoplastic-polyurethane protective film and a replaceable sensing cartridge. Durability was evaluated using two accelerated laboratory procedures: a rotating-drum sanding test and a repetitive probe test applying 39.2 N (4.0 kgf) at 45 cycles per minute. Under the defined sanding conditions, the developed sensor reached the protective-film rupture endpoint after approximately 2-3 hours. During repetitive probe testing, all nine developed sensors remained functionally usable when testing was discontinued: seven after 5 days, one after 6 days, and one after 8 days. Commercial GelSight Mini and DIGIT specimens exhibited initial surface-film rupture after approximately 24-30 seconds of sanding and 25-35 minutes of repetitive loading. Damage to the developed sensor progressed gradually and produced little interference with tactile imaging at the test endpoints. These observations establish durability improvements of more than two orders of magnitude under the defined accelerated conditions. Combining increased durability, gradual degradation, and rapid cartridge replacement offers a practical approach to maintainable vision-based tactile sensing for demanding robotic applications.
summary_zh: 现有商用视觉触觉传感器可提供丰富的接触信息，但抗磨损与抗反复集中载荷能力较差，限制了其在高要求机器人场景中的应用。本文研发了一款耐用型触觉指尖，由内嵌软硅凝胶、无色素带纹理的热塑性聚氨酯防护薄膜以及可更换传感盒组成。本文通过两项实验室加速测试评估其耐用性：转鼓砂纸磨损测试、每分钟45次循环施加39.2N（4.0kgf）载荷的重复探针测试。在设定的磨损条件下，本文研发的传感器在约2-3小时后才达到防护薄膜破裂的失效终点；在重复探针测试中，9台原型传感器在测试终止时全部可正常工作：其中7台完成5天测试、1台完成6天测试、1台完成8天测试。商用GelSight Mini与DIGIT传感器在相同磨损测试中仅24-30秒就出现表面薄膜破裂，在重复载荷测试中仅25-35分钟就失效。本文研发的传感器损伤呈渐进式发展，在测试终点对触觉成像的干扰极小，在设定的加速测试条件下耐用性提升超过两个数量级。兼具高耐用性、渐进式失效特性与可快速更换传感盒的优势，为高要求机器人场景提供了可维护的视觉触觉传感实用方案。

title: CARO: Contact-Agnostic Residual Observation for Zero-Shot Robust Quadruped Locomotion
title_zh: CARO（接触无关残差观测框架）：面向四足机器人零样本高鲁棒性运动的接触无关残差观测方法
authors: Zihan Yang, Shixuan Han, Kexin Guo, Xiang Yu
abstract: We propose CARO, a contact-agnostic residual observation framework for policy adaptation. CARO embeds a fixed-base Euler--Lagrange model into the reinforcement learning control loop and constructs a torque-level residual observation without requiring torque sensors, explicit contact estimation, or vision-based measurements of the floating-base position and linear velocity. A disturbance observer extracts a structured signal representing dynamics mismatch, while the policy learns to exploit this feedback for online adaptation. CARO is trained under the same terrain, command, and domain-randomization conditions as the nominal policy, without specialized disturbance curricula or additional adaptation supervision. Nevertheless, it achieves substantially improved zero-shot robustness in simulation and sim-to-real transfer tasks involving out-of-distribution payloads, center-of-mass shifts, terrain geometries, abrupt dynamics changes, and elevated-platform landings.
summary_zh: 本文提出CARO，一种面向策略自适应的接触无关残差观测框架。CARO将固定基座欧拉-拉格朗日动力学模型嵌入强化学习控制闭环，无需扭矩传感器、显式接触估计或基于视觉的浮动基座位置与线速度测量，即可构建扭矩级残差观测信号。该框架通过扰动观测器提取表征动力学失配的结构化信号，由策略学习利用该反馈完成在线自适应。CARO在与基准策略完全相同的地形、指令与域随机化条件下训练，无需设计特殊的扰动课程或额外自适应监督信号，即可在仿真与仿真到现实迁移任务中实现显著提升的零样本鲁棒性，可有效应对分布外载荷、质心偏移、特殊地形几何特性、突发动力学变化与高台落地等复杂场景。

title: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Real-Time Generative Physics Simulation for Surgical Robotics
title_zh: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams：面向手术机器人的实时生成式物理仿真系统
authors: Javier Gamazo Tejero, Lukas Zbinden, Keyur Sheth, Raghavendra K M, Nadim Daher, Diego Granero Mara\~na, Filip Binkiewicz, Patrick Thornycroft, Mahdi Azizian, Sean D. Huver
abstract: Generative simulation for surgical robotics still lacks real-time interaction. Physical-robot experiments, often involving animal or cadaver labs, are time-consuming, costly, and difficult to reproduce, while classical simulators struggle to capture photorealistic appearance and deformable-tissue dynamics. We address this gap with Cosmos-H-Dreams, an integrated real-time surgical world-model system combining an action-conditioned generative model, a teacher-to-student distillation recipe, and a deployment stack built on the NVIDIA FlashDreams streaming-inference library. Starting from Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator, a multi-embodiment action-conditioned surgical video world model fine-tuned on the large-scale Open-H-Embodiment corpus, we post-train this checkpoint on embodiment- and procedure-specific data. By distilling the resulting bidirectional teacher into a causal, few-step student with Self Forcing, we turn a passive video generator into a controllable surgical simulator that streams at $\sim$160 inference FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell workstation GPU. Crucially, Cosmos-H-Dreams is controller-agnostic: any interface that emits a stream of robot kinematics can drive it. We demonstrate live control through a browser keyboard over WebRTC, a Meta Quest headset over WebXR, a commercial surgical robot console such as CMR Surgical's Versius, and learned policies operating in closed loop. To our knowledge, this is the first interactive surgical world model supporting live human and policy control. Human operators and policies alike can act inside the synthesized world and observe the consequences in real time. We release Cosmos-H-Dreams as an open surgical simulation system, providing a common foundation for surgical education, scalable synthetic data generation, and future intraoperative decision support.
summary_zh: 现有手术机器人生成式仿真系统普遍缺乏实时交互能力，实体机器人实验往往需要依托动物或遗体实验室，成本高、耗时长且难以复现，而传统仿真器难以同时实现照片级真实感渲染与可变形组织动力学模拟。针对该缺口，本文提出Cosmos-H-Dreams，一款集成式实时手术世界模型系统，融合动作条件生成模型、师生蒸馏方案与基于NVIDIA FlashDreams流推理库搭建的部署栈。研究团队以在大规模Open-H-Embodiment语料库上微调得到的多实体动作条件手术视频世界模型Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator为基础，针对特定实体与手术流程数据对该检查点进行后训练，通过自强制蒸馏方案将得到的双向教师模型蒸馏为因果少步学生模型，将被动视频生成器转化为可控制的手术仿真器，在单张NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell工作站GPU上可实现约160推理FPS的流输出。值得注意的是，Cosmos-H-Dreams与控制器无关，任何可输出机器人物理运动序列的接口均可驱动该系统。本文演示了通过WebRTC浏览器键盘、WebXR Meta Quest头显、CMR Surgical Versius商用手术机器人控制台以及闭环运行的学习策略实现的实时控制。据本文作者所知，这是首个支持人类与策略实时交互的手术世界模型，操作人员与学习策略均可在合成世界中执行动作并实时观测结果。本文将Cosmos-H-Dreams作为开源手术仿真系统发布，为手术教学、规模化合成数据生成与未来术中决策支持提供通用基础平台。

title: Robust Slip Detection and Material Classification via Spatiotemporal Transformers on a Uniformly-Illuminated Visuo-Tactile Sensor
title_zh: 基于均匀光照视觉触觉传感器与时序Transformer的鲁棒滑移检测与材料分类方法
authors: Ziyang Ma, Yuhao Sun, Zichen Ai, Xiangyang Ji, Bin Fang
abstract: Tactile sensing is central to robotic manipulation, among which slip detection stands out as a quintessential and critical task. However, existing slip datasets are predominantly limited to binary classification, lacking fine-grained directional perception. To address this limitation, we propose a visuo-tactile sensor featuring customized uniform RGB illumination, alongside a unified perception framework. At the hardware level, the sensor achieves high-precision, sub-millimeter depth reconstruction. Based on this capability, we collect a multi-task visuo-tactile dataset encompassing 15 objects, synchronously generating depth information for each data sample. Algorithmically, we design a dual-head TimeSformer network to process dynamic spatiotemporal slip. On unseen objects, this network achieves robust accuracies of 95.5% and 91.5% for 3-class contact state prediction and fine-grained 8-class slip direction classification, respectively. Furthermore, static tactile-based object class recognition utilizing a ResNet-50 backbone yields an outstanding accuracy of 98.8% across 15 categories. The proposed hardware-software framework provides high-fidelity feedback and a powerful multi-modal perception baseline for complex robotic manipulation.
summary_zh: 触觉感知是机器人操作的核心技术，其中滑移检测是最具代表性的关键任务。但现有滑移数据集大多仅支持二分类，缺乏细粒度的方向感知能力。针对该缺陷，本文研发了搭载定制化均匀RGB照明的视觉触觉传感器，同时提出了一套统一感知框架。硬件层面，该传感器可实现亚毫米级精度的深度重建。基于该能力，本文采集了包含15类物体的多任务视觉触觉数据集，每个数据样本同步生成深度信息。算法层面，本文设计了双头TimeSformer网络处理动态时空滑移信号，在未见过的物体上实现了95.5%的三类接触状态预测精度与91.5%的细粒度8类滑移方向分类精度。此外，基于ResNet-50骨干网络的静态触觉物体分类任务在15类物体上的识别精度可达98.8%。本文提出的软硬件框架为复杂机器人操作提供了高保真反馈与强大的多模态感知基线。

title: Coverage Planning for Robotic Tooth Preparation in Densely Constrained Environments
title_zh: 密集约束环境下机器人牙体预备的覆盖路径规划方法
authors: Yunwen Li, Chen Chen, Xiangjie Yan, Chang Shu, Jianxia Hou, Shiji Song, Xiang Li
abstract: Tooth preparation refers to the controlled removal of tooth structure to create an optimal substrate for fixed restorations and is a core procedure in restorative dentistry. Automating this task is particularly challenging for robots because the dental bur must operate within a densely constrained intraoral workspace, where even sub-millimeter deviations can compromise outcomes or damage adjacent structures. This paper presents a novel robotic system for autonomous full-crown tooth preparation. The proposed framework includes: 1) an anatomy-aware toolpath planning algorithm that conforms precisely to a technician-designed preparation model while protecting adjacent teeth, and 2) a clearance-oriented end-effector yaw assignment strategy that allows intraoral access while reducing the risk of soft-tissue interference. Together, these features enable the robot to accurately mill the irregular tooth surface with an average geometric deviation of 0.117 mm (RMSE), achieving both restoration quality and clinical safety. A series of simulations and phantom-head experiments validate the system's feasibility and effectiveness.
summary_zh: 牙体预备是指对牙体结构进行可控磨削，为固定修复体制备最优基底的操作，是口腔修复的核心流程。机器人自主完成该任务极具挑战性，因为牙科车针需要在空间极度受限的口腔内工作，亚毫米级的偏差就可能导致修复失败或损伤邻近组织。本文提出了一套面向全自动全冠牙体预备的新型机器人系统，该框架包含两部分：1）具备解剖感知能力的刀具路径规划算法，可完全贴合技师设计的预备模型，同时实现邻牙防护；2）面向间隙优化的末端执行器偏航角分配策略，在保障口腔可达性的同时降低软组织干涉风险。上述特性使机器人可精准磨削不规则牙面，几何偏差均方根值仅为0.117mm，同时满足修复质量与临床安全要求。系列仿真与仿头模实验验证了该系统的可行性与有效性。

title: PonderPounce: A Pretrained MLLM as an Episode Context Engine for Robot Control
title_zh: PonderPounce：采用预训练多模态大语言模型作为回合上下文引擎的机器人控制方法
authors: Suhwan Choi, Jaeyoon Jung, Sungkyung Kim, Yunsung Lee, Youngjae Yu
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate long visual histories, reason under partial observability, and infer behavior from a few examples. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) models generally inherit pretrained representations without using this contextual capacity as episode memory. Memory-dependent policies address this gap through purpose-built history mechanisms. PonderPounce instead reuses an MLLM's native causal context as robot memory. Ponder, a System2 MLLM, accumulates episode observations, demonstrations, and prior cognition in its native causal context and can generate subgoal text and demonstration reasoning for internal use. Pounce, a System1 VLA, receives the current observation, instruction, and proprioception directly; through the Ponder--Pounce interface, it asynchronously receives only the newest continuous cognition token and its age. Both are jointly trained end to end without a purpose-built memory module or separate bridge pretraining. Optimized serving achieves p50 latencies of 78ms for cognition refresh and 25ms for action-model invocation, supporting 20Hz action playback. On RoboMME with base-scale training data, PonderPounce reaches 60.83% with 9B and 50.04% with 0.8B under the same Pounce architecture and interface, versus 44.51% for FrameSamp+Modul and 17.93% for the current-observation \pi_{0.5}. With 9x data, it reaches 75.54% versus 57.88% for FrameSamp+Modul. On RoboCasa-DC, the same interface learns from action supervision alone and reaches 12.5% versus 11.6% for the strongest published demonstration-conditioned baseline, falling to 8.6% when cognition is replaced by a learned null state.
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）可整合长时序视觉历史、在部分可观测条件下推理、基于少量示例推断行为，但现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型大多直接继承预训练表征，未将MLLM的上下文能力用作回合记忆。依赖专用历史机制的记忆增强策略可填补该空白，而PonderPounce方案无需设计专用记忆模块，直接复用MLLM原生因果上下文作为机器人记忆。其中Ponder作为系统2型MLLM，将回合观测、演示数据与先验知识累积在其原生因果上下文中，可生成内部使用的子目标文本与演示推理内容；Pounce作为系统1型VLA，直接接收当前观测、指令与本体感知信号，通过Ponder-Pounce接口仅异步获取最新的连续认知令牌及其时间戳。两个模块可实现端到端联合训练，无需专用记忆模块或独立的桥接预训练流程。经优化部署后，认知刷新的p50延迟为78ms，动作模型调用的p50延迟为25ms，可支持20Hz的动作输出。在RoboMME基准上，相同Pounce架构与接口下，9B参数版本的PonderPounce准确率达60.83%，0.8B参数版本达50.04%，优于对比基线FrameSamp+Modul的44.51%与仅使用当前观测的π₀.₅的17.93%；在训练数据量提升9倍的条件下，PonderPounce准确率达75.54%，优于FrameSamp+Modul的57.88%。在RoboCasa-DC基准上，该接口仅通过动作监督训练即可达到12.5%的准确率，优于当前最优演示条件基线的11.6%，若将认知模块替换为学习得到的空状态，准确率将降至8.6%。

title: Trajectory-Level Continuous Action Representation for Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: 面向机器人操作的轨迹级连续动作表征方法CAT
authors: Tong Yang, Jingkai Jia, Yuecheng Xu, Xueyao Chen, Chi Zhang, Wenqiang Zhang
abstract: We propose CAT, a trajectory-level continuous action representation framework for robotic manipulation. Existing visuomotor systems often entangle action representation with control frequency or rely on fixed temporal parameterizations. This leads to representational redundancy at high sampling rates and limits the modeling of critical motion. CAT instead encodes action trajectories within a fixed real-time interval into a set of continuous latent tokens. To ensure temporal consistency across varying control frequencies, we further incorporate a frequency-aware positional encoding that establishs a shared temporal coordinate system. Trajectory-level regularization further stabilizes the latent representation. This approach prevents representation growth with timestep density and avoids reliance on predefined temporal parameterizations. Extensive system-level evaluations on LIBERO, MimicGen, and real-world long-horizon manipulation tasks demonstrate that CAT-based policies consistently outperform both competitive VQ-based and continuous visuomotor baselines under matched training settings. Across various model backbones and control frequencies, CAT consistently improves success rates. These results highlight the advantages of trajectory-level continuous action modeling for scalable robotic manipulation across varying control rates.
summary_zh: 本文提出CAT，一种面向机器人操作的轨迹级连续动作表征框架。现有视觉运动系统通常将动作表征与控制频率绑定，或依赖固定时序参数化，导致高采样率下的表征冗余，限制了关键运动的建模能力。CAT将固定实时区间内的动作轨迹编码为一组连续隐令牌，进一步引入频率感知位置编码构建共享时序坐标系统，保障不同控制频率下的时序一致性，同时通过轨迹级正则化提升隐表征的稳定性。该方法避免了表征规模随时步密度增长，无需依赖预定义的时序参数化方案。在LIBERO、MimicGen基准与真实世界长时序操作任务上的大量系统级评估表明，在相同训练设置下，基于CAT的策略性能始终优于对比的VQ基线与连续视觉运动基线，在不同模型骨干网络与控制频率下均可稳定提升任务成功率，验证了轨迹级连续动作建模在跨控制频率可扩展机器人操作场景中的优势。

title: TrAct: Bridging Robot Control and Visual Prediction with Visual Tracks
title_zh: TrAct：通过视觉轨迹桥接机器人控制与视觉预测的方法
authors: Zhi Cao, Howard Ji, Kevin Zhang, Kuangzhi Ge, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu, Huang Huang
abstract: Robot actions are inherently embodiment-specific and only weakly aligned with image-space visual changes, limiting their effectiveness as conditioning signals for robot world models. In contrast, visual tracks provide an embodiment-agnostic representation of how task-relevant points move through a scene, offering dense image-space guidance for accurate and spatially precise future video prediction. Building on this observation, we propose TrAct, a world-model-based robot decision-making framework that uses visual tracks as an intermediate interface between control and prediction. TrAct consists of three components: a Vision-Language-Action-and-Track model (VLAT) that jointly predicts candidate actions and corresponding visual tracks from the current observation and language instruction; a track-conditioned world model (TWM) that predicts future visual outcomes conditioned on the proposed tracks; and a vision-language reward model (VLAC) that scores the predicted outcomes. At inference time, VLAT generates candidate action-track pairs, TWM rolls out their visual consequences, and VLAC selects the track whose predicted outcome best satisfies the instruction; the action paired with the selected track is then executed by the robot. Experiments on the proposed LIBERO-INTEGRAL benchmark and real-world Franka manipulation show that TrAct improves success rates from 27% to 55% in simulation and from 49% to 76% on real-world tasks compared with the strong VLA baseline $\pi_{0.5}$. Furthermore, TWM consistently improves video prediction quality over the action-conditioned world model (AWM). These results demonstrate that visual tracks provide an effective shared interface between robot control and visual prediction, enabling more accurate world modeling and stronger robot generalization.
summary_zh: 机器人动作天然与实体平台强绑定，与图像空间的视觉变化对齐度较低，限制了其作为机器人世界模型条件信号的有效性。与之相比，视觉轨迹提供了与实体平台无关的表征方式，可描述任务相关关键点在场景中的运动规律，为高精度、空间精准的未来视频预测提供稠密图像空间引导。基于该特性，本文提出TrAct，一种基于世界模型的机器人决策框架，将视觉轨迹作为控制与预测之间的中间接口。TrAct包含三个组件：视觉-语言-动作-轨迹模型（VLAT），可基于当前观测与语言指令联合预测候选动作与对应视觉轨迹；轨迹条件世界模型（TWM），基于生成的轨迹预测未来视觉结果；视觉-语言奖励模型（VLAC），对预测结果进行打分。推理阶段，VLAT生成候选动作-轨迹对，TWM推演其视觉结果，VLAT选择预测结果最符合指令的轨迹，机器人执行该轨迹对应的动作。在本文提出的LIBERO-INTEGRAL基准与真实Franka机器人操作任务上的实验表明，与强VLA基线π₀.₅相比，TrAct将仿真场景任务成功率从27%提升至55%，真实场景任务成功率从49%提升至76%；同时TWM的视频预测质量始终优于动作条件世界模型（AWM）。上述结果表明，视觉轨迹可作为机器人控制与视觉预测之间的有效共享接口，支撑更精准的世界建模与更强的机器人泛化能力。

title: SIREN-Bench: Behavior-Driven Generation and Evaluation of Emergency-Vehicle Interactions
title_zh: SIREN-Bench：行为驱动的应急车辆交互生成与评估基准
authors: Yicheng Zhu, Tianmu Zhao, Haoxin Leng, Fan Zuo, Tao Li, Zilin Bian
abstract: Emergency vehicles (EMVs) can reorganize surrounding traffic as civilian vehicles brake, change lanes, or form rescue corridors in response to their passage. Evaluating these safety-critical interactions requires behavior-level control over both EMV privileges and civilian responses, together with consistent sensing and ground truth. Existing datasets and simulation benchmarks do not directly provide this combination. We present \textbf{SIREN}, a behavior-driven SUMO--CARLA co-simulation platform for generating EMV--civilian interactions. SIREN couples SUMO's network-level traffic evolution and behavior logic with CARLA's continuous vehicle control and synchronized onboard sensing; depending on the active behavior, the interaction is controlled by SUMO, CARLA, or jointly. We instantiate the platform as \textbf{SIREN-Bench-v1}, comprising seven parameterized interaction templates across emergency levels L1--L3 and three behavior families, with synchronized sensor observations and simulator-native annotations. We demonstrate the benchmark through three representative tasks: 3D object detection, trajectory prediction, and vision-language risk understanding. Evaluations of nine trajectory predictors, four LiDAR-based detectors, and five vision-language models reveal behavior-dependent failure modes. Traffic-clearance interactions are hardest for detection, privileged intersection traversal is hardest for prediction, and no learned predictor outperforms the constant-velocity reference on average. Vision-language models perform substantially better on normal traffic than on near-miss and collision events. These results demonstrate the value of behavior-centered benchmarking and establish SIREN as an extensible data-generation and evaluation platform for autonomous-driving and transportation safety research.
summary_zh: 应急车辆（EMV）通行时，民用车辆会采取制动、变道或形成救援走廊等响应行为，从而重构周边交通流。评估这类安全关键交互需要在行为层面对应急车辆的通行优先权和民用车辆的响应进行双重控制，同时保证感知数据的一致性与真值标注的完备性，现有数据集与仿真基准无法直接满足上述组合要求。本文提出SIREN，一款行为驱动的SUMO-CARLA联合仿真平台，用于生成应急车辆与民用车辆的交互场景。SIREN将SUMO的路网级交通演化与行为逻辑，和CARLA的连续车辆控制、同步车载感知能力相结合，可根据当前激活的行为模式，由SUMO、CARLA单独或二者协同完成交互控制。本文基于该平台实现了SIREN-Bench-v1基准，包含覆盖L1-L3三个应急等级、三类行为族的7个参数化交互模板，配套同步传感器观测数据与仿真原生标注。通过3D目标检测、轨迹预测、视觉语言风险理解三类代表性任务对该基准进行验证：对9个轨迹预测器、4个激光雷达检测器、5个视觉语言模型的评估结果揭示了各类方法存在的行为依赖型失效模式：交通清障类交互对检测任务难度最高，优先交叉口通行类交互对预测任务难度最高，且所有学习型预测器的平均表现均未超越恒速参考基线；视觉语言模型在常规交通场景下的表现远好于险肇事件与碰撞事件场景。上述结果验证了以行为为中心的基准测试的价值，也证明SIREN可作为面向自动驾驶与交通安全研究的可扩展数据生成与评估平台。

title: Hierarchical Skill Retrieval for Data-Efficient Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: 面向视觉-语言-动作模型数据高效适配的分层技能检索方法
authors: Haoran Hao, Shahram Najam Syed, Jeff Schneider, Jeffrey Ichnowski
abstract: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models pretrained on large-scale robot datasets provide a strong foundation for robot manipulation, their performance can degrade when adapted to new tasks with limited task-specific demonstrations. Retrieval offers a practical way to reuse existing demonstrations for data-efficient adaptation, but existing methods often rely on visual similarity, state-action representations, or task-level language matching. These approaches may overlook the hierarchical structure of long-horizon manipulation tasks, where complete task matches are rare but reusable skills are often abundant. To address this challenge, we propose Hierarchical Skill Retrieval (HSR), a retrieval framework for data-efficient VLA adaptation. Specifically, HSR first decomposes a target task into candidate skill sequences. It evaluates each plan based on both semantic plausibility and skill reliability estimated from the prior dataset. The selected decomposition is then used for hybrid retrieval. This combines subtask-level language retrieval with behavior-feature reranking to identify demonstrations that are both semantically relevant and compatible with the target task. Finally, we adapt the policy through a two-stage pretraining and finetuning pipeline, which separates general skill acquisition from task-specific adaptation. Experiments on the LIBERO benchmark and several real-world robot manipulation tasks show that HSR improves the average success rate by 10.3% and 21.3% over the strongest baseline, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of structured skill-level retrieval for data-efficient VLA adaptation. Videos and code are available at https://hoar012.github.io/HSR-Project.
summary_zh: 在大规模机器人数据集上预训练的视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型为机器人操作任务提供了强大基础，但在仅能获取少量任务专属演示数据的新任务上做适配时，其性能会出现下降。检索是复用现有演示数据实现数据高效适配的可行路径，但现有方法通常依赖视觉相似度、状态-动作表征或任务级语言匹配，这类方案容易忽略长周期操作任务的层级结构：完整任务匹配的样本十分稀缺，但可复用的技能样本往往非常充足。为解决该问题，本文提出分层技能检索（Hierarchical Skill Retrieval, HSR），一种面向VLA模型数据高效适配的检索框架。具体而言，HSR首先将目标任务分解为候选技能序列，结合语义合理性与从历史数据集估计的技能可靠性对每个分解方案进行评估，选中的最优分解方案将用于混合检索流程：该流程融合子任务级语言检索与行为特征重排序，筛选出既语义相关又与目标任务兼容的演示样本。最后通过两阶段预训练-微调流水线完成策略适配，将通用技能习得与任务专属适配过程分离。在LIBERO基准与多个真实机器人操作任务上的实验结果表明，HSR相比最优基线方法的平均成功率分别提升10.3%和21.3%，验证了结构化技能级检索对VLA模型数据高效适配的有效性。相关项目视频与代码可访问：https://hoar012.github.io/HSR-Project。

title: Design-to-Plan: A Large Language Model-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Manufacturing Process Planning from 3D CAD Models and 2D Engineering Drawings
title_zh: Design-to-Plan：基于大语言模型的多智能体端到端制造工艺规划框架，支持3D CAD模型与2D工程图输入
authors: Muhammad Tayyab Khan, Lequn Chen, Wenhe Feng, Seung Ki Moon
abstract: Manufacturing process planning transforms heterogeneous design information into coherent manufacturing decisions. However, existing approaches focus on isolated subtasks, such as feature recognition, drawing interpretation, or tool selection, and struggle to support the full reasoning chain from design artifacts to process plans. This is critical when planning must interpret 3D CAD models, 2D engineering drawings, materials, and domain-specific rules. To address this gap, this paper presents Design-to-Plan, a large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent framework for end-to-end manufacturing process planning. An orchestrator coordinates specialized agents for 3D feature recognition, 2D drawing analysis, 2D-3D context fusion, knowledge retrieval, process sequencing, tool selection, and report generation. Rather than using LLMs as standalone text generators, the framework deploys them as reasoning agents that interact with deterministic modules and knowledge sources to produce consistent and traceable decisions. In this hybrid design, deterministic modules and specialized agents extract structured information from CAD and drawing inputs, while LLM agents perform context-aware reasoning, retrieve manufacturing rules, resolve conflicts, and generate planning outputs. The framework is evaluated using 300 benchmark cases across three downstream ReAct-enabled agents, plus separate evaluations of CAD feature recognition, drawing analysis, and 2D-3D context fusion. The parallel architecture achieves 100% success across downstream agents, Tool F1 scores of 95.9%-97.6%, 90% source detection accuracy in conflict analysis, and a 60%-68% reduction in token usage for key planning tasks. Results show that structured LLM-based multi-agent coordination can bridge design representations and manufacturing knowledge, enabling scalable, efficient, and traceable design-to-plan automation.
summary_zh: 制造工艺规划需要将异构的设计信息转化为连贯的制造决策，但现有方法大多聚焦于特征识别、图纸解读、刀具选择等孤立子任务，难以支撑从设计产物到工艺方案的完整推理链，当规划过程需要同时解读3D CAD模型、2D工程图、材料属性与领域专属规则时，该缺陷尤为突出。为填补这一空白，本文提出Design-to-Plan，一款基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体端到端制造工艺规划框架：由一个调度器协调多个专用智能体，分别完成3D特征识别、2D图纸分析、2D-3D上下文融合、知识检索、工艺排序、刀具选择与报告生成任务。该框架没有将大语言模型作为独立文本生成器使用，而是将其部署为推理智能体，与确定性模块和知识库交互，生成一致且可追溯的决策。在这种混合架构中，确定性模块与专用智能体从CAD和图纸输入中提取结构化信息，大语言模型智能体完成上下文感知推理、制造规则检索、冲突消解与规划结果生成。本文采用覆盖三类下游ReAct（推理行动）智能体的300个基准用例对框架进行整体评估，同时单独开展CAD特征识别、图纸分析、2D-3D上下文融合的专项评估：并行架构下所有下游智能体的任务成功率达到100%，刀具选择任务的F1分数为95.9%-97.6%，冲突分析环节的源检测准确率达90%，核心规划任务的Token使用量降低60%-68%。实验结果表明，结构化的大语言模型多智能体协同机制可打通设计表征与制造知识的链路，实现可扩展、高效率、可追溯的从设计到工艺方案的自动化。

title: NeurRAFT: Robot Motion Planning via Anchor-Level Flow Matching with Clearance-Aware Preference Tuning
title_zh: NeurRAFT：基于锚点级流匹配与间隙感知偏好调优的机器人运动规划方法
authors: Sibo Tian, Chang Liu, Minghui Zheng, Xiao Liang
abstract: Recent end-to-end neural motion planners generate trajectories from raw sensor observations, avoiding the privileged geometric models required by classical planners. However, collision-free planning in cluttered environments remains challenging. We present NeurRAFT, a generative planning framework based on anchor-level flow matching and clearance-aware preference tuning. Unlike prior neural planners that model dense waypoint sequences and spend capacity on redundant local details and smoothness, NeurRAFT operates on compact anchor waypoints. We train the planner using a Jacobian-weighted loss that accounts for the task-space impact of each anchor. At inference, the anchors are generated in two integration steps, followed by cubic-spline interpolation to recover a smooth, full-resolution trajectory. Since imitation learning from positive demonstrations cannot distinguish collision-free from near-collision trajectories, collision-prone behaviors persist at test time. Rather than relying on post-hoc corrections, we directly reshape the pretrained planner's distribution toward safer solutions without augmenting inference. Specifically, Direct Preference Optimization shifts probability mass toward trajectories with larger obstacle clearance, with the resulting improvement directly absorbed into the planner parameters. Experiments show substantial improvements over state-of-the-art planners, while real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot transfer to a Franka robot under noisy and partially occluded depth observations. Video results available at https://neurraft.github.io/.
summary_zh: 近年提出的端到端神经运动规划器可直接从原始传感器观测生成轨迹，无需依赖传统规划器所需的先验几何模型，但在密集障碍物环境下实现无碰撞规划仍存在挑战。本文提出NeurRAFT，一款基于锚点级流匹配与间隙感知偏好调优的生成式规划框架。与以往建模密集路点序列、将算力浪费在冗余局部细节和平滑性上的神经规划器不同，NeurRAFT仅在紧凑的锚点路点集上开展运算。本文采用雅可比加权损失训练规划器，该损失可量化每个锚点对任务空间的影响程度。推理阶段，仅需两步积分即可生成所有锚点，随后通过三次样条插值还原出平滑的全分辨率轨迹。由于仅从正演示数据开展的模仿学习无法区分无碰撞轨迹与近碰撞轨迹，测试阶段仍会频繁出现易碰撞行为。本文不依赖事后修正方案，直接将预训练规划器的分布向更安全的解空间重塑，无需额外增加推理开销：具体通过直接偏好优化将概率质量向障碍物间隙更大的轨迹偏移，优化得到的改进效果直接固化到规划器参数中。实验结果表明，该方法性能大幅超越现有最优规划器，真实场景实验验证了该方法可在存在噪声、深度观测部分被遮挡的条件下零样本迁移到Franka机器人平台。项目演示视频可访问：https://neurraft.github.io/。

title: Trusted Polytopic Action Sets for Fast Planning in Underactuated Systems
authors: Akshay Jaitly, Siavash Farzan
abstract: Underactuated systems pose a challenge for convex motion planning because their dynamically feasible motions lie on a manifold of trajectories in function space. Building on our earlier formulation of polytopic action sets (PAS), this paper presents a method for rapidly generating, online, trusted convex sets of short-horizon actions for underactuated and potentially nonlinear systems. Around a nominal trajectory, we construct local finite-dimensional action coordinates in which each parameter vector encodes a complete nearby motion through an affine trajectory map, rendering collision-avoidance and control bounds linear. To remain consistent with the nonlinear dynamics, we introduce a dynamics-violation metric and extract a trusted convex inner approximation using an IRIS-inspired inflation procedure directly in action space. The resulting PAS are reusable convex families of actions that can be queried and composed with linear programs, and a PAS-guided tree expansion treats nodes as composed reachable families rather than single trajectories, coupling local nonlinear fidelity with convex reuse for longer-horizon planning. The planner solves cluttered planar scenes in tens of milliseconds (14-78x faster than a kinodynamic RRT baseline) and reduces terminal error on a nonlinear underactuated benchmark by 26-86% over sampling and NLP baselines.

title: Bridging Teacher Expectations and Robot Learning via Coupling Dynamics
title_zh: 通过耦合动力学衔接教师预期与机器人学习
authors: Evan Dallas, Sean Dallas, Wing-Yue Geoffrey Louie
abstract: Human-robot teaching focuses on enabling nontechnical experts to customize robots according to their needs after deployment. With recent advances in machine learning, human-robot teaching is no longer confined to offline learning where the data gathering step from a human teacher is separated from when the robot learns. Instead, more recent approaches for human-robot teaching focus on coupling human teaching with robot learning. This coupling impacts the structure, timing, and content of the teaching and learning interaction. However, it is currently unclear how such coupling dynamics affect humanrobot teaching effectiveness and human perceptions towards the teaching process. Informed by human learning theories, in this paper we propose a new scale for classifying human-robot teaching interactions according to coupling dynamics present between the human teacher and robot learner. We apply this scale to a subset of the human-robot teaching literature to identify how coupling dynamics and human teacher mental model mismatches with the ground truth robot learning system affect teaching effectiveness and human perceptions towards the teaching process
summary_zh: 人机示教的目标是让非技术领域的普通用户在机器人部署后，可根据自身需求对机器人的行为进行自定义。随着机器学习技术的发展，人机示教已经不再局限于离线学习范式——即人类教师采集数据的过程与机器人学习的过程完全分离。最新的人机示教研究方向聚焦于将人类示教过程与机器人学习过程耦合，这种耦合会改变示教与学习交互的结构、时序与内容，但目前学界尚不清楚这类耦合动力学如何影响人机示教的有效性，以及人类对示教过程的主观感知。本文借鉴人类学习相关理论，提出一套新的分类量表，可根据人类示教者与机器人学习者之间存在的耦合动力学特征对人机示教交互进行分类。将该量表应用于部分人机示教相关文献后，本文明确了耦合动力学、人类示教者的心智模型与真实机器人学习系统的不匹配程度，二者共同对示教有效性与人类对示教过程的感知产生影响。

title: Sensorless damage-safe grasping
title_zh: 无传感器损伤安全抓取
authors: Yusei Shuto, Danilo Vasconcellos Vargas
abstract: Robotic fruit harvesting must hold produce securely without bruising it, yet compression stiffness varies several-fold with ripeness within a single species, so no fixed grip force spans the range. Rather than tune force, we bound deformation: a controller closes the gripper until the object's estimated compression strain reaches a user-specified limit $\varepsilon$, using only the encoder position and motor-effort signal on every servo gripper---no tactile or force-torque sensor. Dividing an effort-based contact force by a lower bound on object stiffness makes the stop provably conservative---true compression stays at or below $\varepsilon$---for any $\varepsilon$ above a contact-detection strain floor we identify and quantify: robust detection itself spends compression, linearly in closing speed, making speed an explicit throughput--gentleness knob. Unlike a hand-tuned force threshold, $\varepsilon$ is a certified, size-scaling, operator-interpretable damage limit, and a ready safe-action parameter for learned grasping policies. In MuJoCo simulation over a realistic fruit-stiffness range, under a sensor-noise model calibrated to the real servo, the controller holds $\ge 98\,\%$ grasp at $0\,\%$ damage across all medium-to-firm stiffnesses for the entire certified $\varepsilon$ range, which neither fixed-force baseline attains; on stiffness-graded 3D-printed TPU cubes it matches baseline grasp success at roughly half the grip force and cuts soft-object damage from $100\,\%$ to $40\,\%$.
summary_zh: 机器人水果采摘作业需要在保证果实不被碰伤的前提下稳固握持果实，但同一品种的果实压缩刚度会随成熟度发生数倍变化，不存在可覆盖全刚度范围的固定夹持力方案。本文不采用夹持力调优思路，转而对形变量进行约束：控制器控制夹爪闭合，直到物体的估计压缩应变达到用户指定的阈值ε，整个过程仅依赖伺服夹爪自带的编码器位置信号与电机力矩信号，无需任何触觉或力/力矩传感器。将基于力矩估计的接触力除以物体刚度的下界，可保证夹爪的停止判定具备保守性：真实压缩量始终不超过ε，且ε的取值高于本文定义并量化的接触检测应变下限——鲁棒接触检测本身会产生压缩量，压缩量随夹爪闭合速度线性增长，因此速度可作为直接调节作业效率与抓取柔和度的参数。与人工调优的力阈值不同，ε是经过认证、可随物体尺寸自适应缩放、操作人员可直观理解的损伤上限，也可直接作为学习型抓取策略的安全动作参数。在符合真实水果刚度分布的MuJoCo仿真环境中，采用经过真实伺服系统噪声校准的噪声模型，该控制器在整个认证ε区间内，对所有中等硬度到高硬度的果实实现了≥98%的抓取成功率、0%的损伤率，两项指标均优于两个固定力基线方案；在刚度分级的3D打印TPU立方体抓取实验中，该方法的抓取成功率与基线相当，但所需夹持力仅为基线的一半，软质物体的损伤率从基线的100%降至40%。

title: Safety-aware Model Predictive Path Integral Control with Signal Temporal Logic
title_zh: 结合信号时序逻辑的安全感知模型预测路径积分控制
authors: Yiqi Zhao, Taekyung Kim, Hideki Okamoto, Bardh Hoxha, Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh, Lars Lindemann, Georgios Fainekos
abstract: Safety-aware motion planning remains a challenge in robotics, especially when missions are time-critical and are under complex specifications. In this paper, we propose safety-aware-stl-mppi, a computationally efficient sampling-based receding-horizon planning framework designed to promote satisfaction of constraints expressed in Signal Temporal Logic (STL). Our approach encodes discrete-time STL formulas into candidate time-varying control barrier functions (CBF), which are integrated into a model predictive path integral (MPPI) controller. Our method inherits the benefits of low computational cost from an efficiently parallelizable sampling based planner and utilizes CBF for constraints expressed in STL. We compare against several MPPI baselines using four artificial Mars Rover planning case studies with a diverse environment and cost setups, where we show our method consistently achieving high safety and efficiency. We show a quadcopter planning experiment with NVIDIA Isaac Lab.
summary_zh: 安全感知运动规划始终是机器人领域的难点，当任务对时间敏感且需要满足复杂规范时，该问题的挑战尤为突出。本文提出safety-aware-stl-mppi，一款计算高效的基于采样的滚动时域规划框架，用于提升满足信号时序逻辑（Signal Temporal Logic, STL）约束的概率。该方法将离散时间STL公式编码为候选时变控制屏障函数（Control Barrier Function, CBF），并将其集成到模型预测路径积分（Model Predictive Path Integral, MPPI）控制器中。该框架既继承了基于采样的可高度并行化规划器计算成本低的优势，又可通过CBF保证STL定义的约束被满足。本文采用4种不同环境与代价配置的火星车规划案例，与多个MPPI基线方法开展对比，结果表明本文方法可始终保持高安全性与高运行效率，同时在NVIDIA Isaac Lab中完成了四旋翼机器人规划实验验证。

title: CoDrift: Compositional Drifting for Offline Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: CoDrift：面向离线强化学习的组合式漂移方法
authors: Xiewei Ni, Ruofeng Mei, Xiangyu Xu
abstract: Offline reinforcement learning is intrinsically multi-objective: a policy must remain compatible with the behavioral support of a fixed dataset while preferentially selecting high-value actions. We recast these objectives in a common form by viewing each as an action-space motion field that specifies how generated actions should move. This perspective enables heterogeneous learning objectives to be combined directly through field composition. Inspired by drifting models, we propose CoDrift, a compositional framework for one-step generative policy learning. CoDrift combines three objective-level fields into a unified policy field. The conditional field preserves state-dependent behavioral structure, while the marginal field pools actions across states to provide a more stable generative signal in the single-positive-sample regime of continuous-control offline RL. The value field moves generated actions toward higher-value regions. The composed field is absorbed into a stochastic generator that produces an action with a single forward pass at deployment. We evaluate CoDrift on 73 tasks from OGBench and D4RL in both offline and offline-to-online settings. CoDrift compares favorably with state-of-the-art methods and achieves the best average rank in both settings.
summary_zh: 离线强化学习本质上是多目标任务：策略既要保证与固定数据集的行为支撑域兼容，又要优先选择高价值动作。本文将上述两个目标重构为统一形式：将每个目标视为动作空间中的运动场，定义生成动作的调整方向。该视角下可通过场的组合直接融合异构学习目标。受漂移模型启发，本文提出CoDrift，一款用于单步生成式策略学习的组合框架。CoDrift将三个目标层级的场融合为统一的策略场：条件场保留与状态相关的行为结构，边缘场聚合跨状态的动作，在连续控制离线强化学习的单正样本场景下提供更稳定的生成信号，价值场将生成动作向更高价值的区域偏移。组合得到的场被整合到随机生成器中，部署阶段仅需一次前向传播即可输出动作。在OGBench与D4RL数据集的共73项任务上，分别在纯离线与离线到在线两种设置下开展评估，结果表明CoDrift的表现优于现有最优方法，在两种设置下均取得了最低的平均排名。

title: Dynamical System-Based Imitation Learning and Neuroadaptive Control for Trajectory Recovery in Autonomous Ships
title_zh: 面向自主船舶轨迹恢复的动力学系统示教学习与神经自适应控制
authors: Yeyson A. Becerra-Mora, Jos\'e \'Angel Acosta
abstract: Repetitive maritime operations can be effectively learned using the Imitation Learning (IL) paradigm, which transfers human expertise directly to Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV) control systems. Dynamical Systems (DS) are widely used to model non-linear human demonstrations while offering inherent stability guarantees. However, real-world execution under persistent marine perturbations reveals a critical trade-off: standard DS-based IL approaches prioritize global target convergence at the expense of localized trajectory reproduction fidelity. To address this limitation, we present a hybrid learning-control architecture that integrates a DS-based IL reference generator with a neuroadaptive controller. Our approach introduces a control action that drives the USV back to the demonstrated path following exogenous disturbances, enabling dynamic human-like reactive alignment-termed behavioral tracking. The proposed methodology is validated using the Marine Systems Simulator (MSS) toolbox. Simulation results confirm that the framework generalizes complex maneuvering tasks while substantially improving trajectory tracking fidelity under disturbances compared to alternative control strategies.
summary_zh: 重复性海事作业可通过示教学习（Imitation Learning, IL）范式实现高效学习，直接将人类操作经验迁移到无人水面艇（Unmanned Surface Vehicle, USV）控制系统中。动力学系统（Dynamical Systems, DS）被广泛用于对非线性人类演示数据建模，同时具备固有稳定性保证。但在持续海洋扰动的真实场景下执行任务时，传统基于DS的示教学习方法暴露出关键权衡问题：这类方法优先保证全局目标点的收敛性，牺牲了局部轨迹复现的精度。为解决该缺陷，本文提出融合DS示教学习参考生成器与神经自适应控制器的混合学习-控制架构。该方法引入额外控制量，驱动无人水面艇在外生扰动作用下回归演示路径，实现类人动态响应对齐，本文将该特性定义为行为跟踪。所提方法通过海洋系统仿真器（Marine Systems Simulator, MSS）工具箱完成验证，仿真结果表明，该框架可泛化复杂机动任务，与其他控制策略相比，在扰动环境下的轨迹跟踪精度得到显著提升。

title: Interpreting Control Latents for System Identification via Conditional Flow Matching
title_zh: 基于条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching）的系统辨识控制隐变量可解释性研究
authors: Dingqi Zhang, Ruiqi Zhang, Mark W. Mueller
abstract: Latent-conditioned adaptive policies can control robots across changing dynamics, but their learned latents remain internal representations of the policy rather than physical models that can be inspected, rolled out, or used by other control modules. This limits closed-loop analysis, diagnosis, and further improvement of a fixed policy. A direct mapping from latent to physical parameters is also under-specified, because multiple systems can induce similar closed-loop behavior. We therefore decode each operational latent into a distribution of quadrotor models using conditional flow matching. The decoded distribution enables two downstream uses without modifying the policy: online predictive tuning of a high-level controller around the fixed low-level policy, and robustness analysis under specified disturbances. Under perturbed actuator dynamics, decoded-model predictive tuning reduces position tracking RMSE by $23\%$ and heading RMSE by $45\%$ relative to fixed gains. Under Gaussian force disturbances, decoded-model ensembles closely predict the lateral tracking-error evolution. Together, these results show that control latents can be converted into physical model ensembles for tuning, robustness analysis, and diagnosis of frozen adaptive policies.
summary_zh: 隐条件自适应策略可在动态变化场景下实现机器人控制，但这类策略学习得到的隐变量仍属于策略内部表征，并非可检验、可推演、可被其他控制模块调用的物理模型，这一缺陷限制了固定策略的闭环分析、故障诊断与进一步优化。由于多个不同系统可产生相似的闭环行为，从隐变量到物理参数的直接映射存在欠定问题。为此，本文采用条件流匹配方法将每个运行态隐变量解码为四旋翼模型的分布。该解码分布可在不修改原有策略的前提下支持两类下游应用：针对固定底层策略的高层控制器在线预测调优，以及指定扰动下的鲁棒性分析。实验结果显示，在执行器动态受扰场景下，解码模型预测调优相比固定增益方案将位置跟踪均方根误差（RMSE）降低23%，航向均方根误差降低45%；在高斯力扰动场景下，解码模型集成可精准预测横向跟踪误差的演化过程。上述结果表明，控制隐变量可转换为物理模型集成，用于冻结自适应策略的调优、鲁棒性分析与故障诊断。

title: DreamLedger: Execution-Settled Credit Files for World-Model Imagination in Robot Decision Loops
title_zh: DreamLedger：面向机器人决策回路中世界模型推演的执行结算信用档案
authors: Xianyao Li, Ruitong Tian, Rui Min, Fang Xu, Jing Du
abstract: Robots are beginning to act on world-model predictions, yet reliability is still expressed through instantaneous, model-internal signals. DreamLedger instead treats reliability as a persistent deployment object: an execution-settled credit file recording how often consumed predictions are borne out, indexed by operating condition, region, and prediction horizon, and consulted before each use. Each consumed prediction is registered as a claim; attributable outcomes are settled against arriving reality at zero labeling cost, an attribution stage excludes measurement-contaminated outcomes, and a settlement-supervised head complements sparse bins. The resulting credit gates consumption: low-credit predictions shorten the dependent horizon or trigger additional observation; every reliance event remains auditable via dependency tickets and replayable logs. We evaluate DreamLedger in three simulated domains (indoor flight, tabletop manipulation, 2D navigation), via mounts on unmodified DreamerV3, TD-MPC2, and V-JEPA 2-AC, and on a real Franka manipulator. Claim failure is dose-monotone in all 12 held-out condition-horizon cells. Credit-gated planning reduces burned imagination (consumed claims that later fail to redeem) by 62% (95% CI 43-81%) versus blind consumption, with equal success and comparable collision rates. At matched risk targets, persistent books cut verification probes from 1.00 to 0.36/episode in manipulation, at success 0.94 versus 0.98; settlement-grounded calibration retains moderate, seed-consistent operating points unlike raw instantaneous gates. The same trust layer operates across decoder-, latent-, and token-space interfaces, including V-JEPA 2-AC settled on real robot frames. On hardware, settlement remains operational under real sensing and contact noise, a deployment failure loop is re-priced online, and all 1,062 registered spends replay from the audit logs.
summary_zh: 当前机器人已开始基于世界模型的预测结果执行动作，但可靠性仍仅通过瞬时的模型内部信号表征。DreamLedger将可靠性视为一种持久化部署对象：即执行结算信用档案，该档案记录已使用的预测结果与现实相符的频次，按运行工况、区域、预测时域建立索引，在每次调用预测前都会被查询。每一条被使用的预测都会被注册为一个凭证；可归因的结果会与后续现实输出自动完成结算，无需标注成本，归因阶段会剔除被测量污染的结果，结算监督头可对稀疏分箱形成补充。最终生成的信用机制可对预测使用过程进行管控：低信用预测会缩短对应的依赖时域，或触发额外观测动作；每一次预测调用事件都可通过依赖凭证与可回放日志完成审计。本文将DreamLedger部署在未修改的DreamerV3、TD-MPC2与V-JEPA 2-AC算法上，在三个仿真域（室内飞行、桌面机械臂操作、2D导航）以及真实Franka机械臂平台上完成验证。在全部12个预留的工况-时域测试单元中，凭证失败率均呈现剂量单调性。与无约束使用预测的方案相比，信用门控规划将无效推演（后续无法兑现的已调用凭证）占比降低62%（95%置信区间43%-81%），任务成功率与碰撞率均与基线方案相当。在匹配风险目标的前提下，持久化档案将机械臂操作任务的验证探测次数从每轮1.00次降至0.36次，任务成功率为0.94，与基线的0.98接近；基于结算的校准机制可输出稳定、与随机种子无关的运行点，性能优于原始瞬时门控方案。该信任层可跨解码器空间、隐空间与令牌空间接口运行，包括部署在真实机器人帧数据上的V-JEPA 2-AC系统。在硬件测试中，结算机制可在真实传感与接触噪声下正常运行，部署失败回路可在线重新定价，全部1062条注册调用记录均可从审计日志中完整回放。

title: Resilience Matters for Embodied Agents System: New Metrics, Systematic Evaluation, and Optimization
title_zh: 具身智能体系统的弹性至关重要：全新指标体系、系统化评估与优化
authors: Yapeng Liu, Yuanzhao Zhai, Xudong Gong, Dawei Feng, Bo Ding, Lin Wang, Huaimin Wang
abstract: Embodied Agents System (EAS) are increasingly deployed in open-world physical domains, where reliability directly dictates deployment quality and human-agent trust. However, existing evaluations rely on outcome-centric metrics as success rate or safety scores that collapse diverse execution trajectories into coarse scores, obscuring the dynamic processes underlying agent behavior. Therefore, they ignore a critical property of EAS -- which we define as the Resilience -- that reflects how EASs recover, stabilize, and extend under perturbations and across iterative updates. The lack of resilience is particularly critical in open-world environments due to continuous unexpected disruptions, thus directly affecting the quality of EAS deployment. To address this problem, we gain insight from the resilience-engineering concepts to EAS groundings and propose a novel resilience evaluation framework that can be flexibly applied to any EAS. Specifically, we define the first comprehensive resilience metrics suite for EASs system that exposes Rebound, Stability, and Graceful Extensibility across embodied tasks execution, providing a practical grounding for EAS resilience analysis. We further implement the resilience evaluation layer that transforms execution process into assessments for diagnosis and optimization. Across 400 household tasks with 10 EAS, we reveal the process-level distinction hidden by outcome metrics, including recovery cost differences among successful episodes ($\Delta C_{rec}=25.2$), increased instability and task-family degradation. Metrics-guided optimizations reduce recovery cost and increase stability, graceful extensibility completion, showing the diagnostic effect of resilience evaluation. Our results reveal a trade-off among resilience characteristics, suggesting that a resilient EAS construction should be configured according to deployment-specific requirements.
summary_zh: 具身智能体系统（Embodied Agents System, EAS）正越来越多地部署在开放世界物理场景中，其可靠性直接决定部署质量与人类对智能体的信任度。但现有评估方案采用成功率、安全评分等以结果为中心的指标，将多样化的执行轨迹压缩为粗略分数，掩盖了智能体行为背后的动态过程，因此忽略了EAS的一项核心属性——本文将其定义为弹性（Resilience），该属性反映EAS在受到扰动时、以及在迭代更新过程中的恢复能力、稳定性与优雅可扩展性。开放世界环境中持续出现的意外扰动使得弹性缺失问题尤为突出，直接影响EAS的部署质量。为解决该问题，本文将弹性工程领域的概念引入EAS场景，提出一种可灵活适配任意EAS的全新弹性评估框架。具体而言，本文首次定义了面向EAS的完整弹性指标套件，可从具身任务执行过程中提取恢复能力、稳定性与优雅可扩展性三类维度，为EAS弹性分析提供可落地的依据。本文进一步实现了弹性评估层，可将执行过程转化为评估结果，支撑故障诊断与优化。在覆盖400个家庭任务、10种EAS的测试中，本文揭示了结果类指标所掩盖的过程层面差异：包括不同成功轮次间的恢复成本差（ΔC_rec=25.2）、不稳定性上升与任务族性能退化现象。指标引导的优化方案可降低恢复成本，提升稳定性与优雅可扩展性任务完成率，验证了弹性评估的诊断作用。研究结果还揭示了不同弹性特征间的权衡关系，表明弹性EAS的构建需要根据特定部署需求进行针对性配置。

title: Learning to Act While Waiting: RL Finetuning of Generalist Robot Policies Under Inference Latency
title_zh: 等待期间学习行动：推理延迟场景下通用机器人策略的强化学习（RL）微调
authors: Brian Zhu (Siemens), Momen Khalil (Siemens), E Harrison (UC Berkeley), Emanuele Poggi (Siemens), Philipp Schmitt (Siemens), Bernd Kast (Siemens), Philine Meister (Siemens), Pranav Atreya (UC Berkeley), Qiyang Li (UC Berkeley), Finn Ferchau (Siemens), Cesar Colmenero (Siemens), Yash Shahapurkar (Siemens), Gokul Narayanan (Siemens), Melih Erdogan (Siemens), Kai Wurm (Siemens), Georg von Wichert (Siemens), Oier Mees (Microsoft, ETH Zurich, UC Berkeley), Eugen Solowjow (Siemens), Andrew Wagenmaker (UC Berkeley), Sergey Levine (UC Berkeley)
abstract: We evaluate our approach across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, and find that it enables effective finetuning under inference delays where standard RL fails entirely, even matching or exceeding the performance of standard RL in idealized no-latency settings.
summary_zh: 本文在仿真与真实世界操作任务中对所提方法进行了评估，结果表明该方法可在标准强化学习完全失效的推理延迟场景下实现有效微调，其性能甚至可在无延迟的理想场景下匹配或超过标准强化学习的表现。

title: Concept-Guided Exploration: Building Persistent, Actionable Scene Graphs
title_zh: 概念引导式探索：构建可持续、可执行的场景图
authors: No\'e Zapata, Gerardo P\'erez, Alejandro Torrej\'on, Pedro N\'u\~nez, Pablo Bustos
abstract: The perception of 3D space by mobile robots is rapidly moving from flat metric grid representations to hybrid metric-semantic graphs built from human-interpretable concepts. While most approaches first build metric maps and then add semantic layers, we explore an alternative, concept-first architecture in which spatial understanding emerges from asynchronous concept agents that directly instantiate and manage semantic entities. Our robot employs two spatial concepts (room and door), implemented as autonomous processes within a cognitive distributed architecture. These concept agents cooperatively build a shared scene graph representation of indoor layouts through active exploration and incremental validation. The key architectural principle is hierarchical constraint propagation: Room instantiation provides geometric and semantic priors to guide and support door detection within wall boundaries. The resulting structure is maintained by a complementary functional principle based on prediction-matching loops. This approach is designed to yield an actionable, human-interpretable spatial representation without relying on any pre-existing global metric map, supporting scalable operation and persistent, task-relevant understanding in structured indoor environments.
summary_zh: 移动机器人的3D空间感知正快速从平面度量栅格表征向基于人类可理解概念构建的度量-语义混合图方向发展。绝大多数现有方案先构建度量地图再叠加语义层，本文探索了一种替代的概念优先架构：空间理解从异步概念智能体中生成，这类智能体可直接实例化并管理语义实体。本文的机器人系统采用房间与门两类空间概念，二者以自主进程的形式运行在分布式认知架构中。这些概念智能体通过主动探索与增量验证，协作构建室内布局的共享场景图表征。该架构的核心设计原则为分层约束传播：房间实例化过程输出几何与语义先验，可引导并支撑墙边界内的门检测任务。最终生成的场景图结构通过预测-匹配循环的互补功能原则完成维护。该方法无需依赖任何预先构建的全局度量地图，即可生成可执行、人类可理解的空间表征，可支撑结构化室内环境下的规模化运行与与任务相关的持久化空间理解。

title: Macro-Operator Generation and Predicate Selection for TAMP Operator Learning
title_zh: 面向任务与运动规划（Task and Motion Planning, TAMP）算子学习的宏算子生成与谓词筛选
authors: Can Emir Bora, Emre Ugur
abstract: Creating symbolic operators by hand is one of the main bottlenecks in deploying Task and Motion Planning systems (TAMP). Recent works show that these operators can instead be learned directly from demonstration data. Existing methods, however, typically learn each action in isolation and cannot capture the recurring multi-step structure of manipulation tasks, so the search becomes intractable on long sequential tasks. A further inefficiency arises in the symbolic state: every provided predicate is evaluated at every search node, even when it never appears in any learned operator. We present a system that addresses both problems together. Its central component is the automatic generation of macro-operators, composite actions that compress a recurring sequence of individual actions into a single planning step. Our system discovers causally linked action pairs directly from the training data, where one action produces exactly the condition that the next one requires, and turns each pair into a new operator. Alongside this, our system prunes every predicate that no learned operator references, which shrinks the symbolic state evaluated at each search node. Together, these changes shorten the effective planning horizon, and the benefit they bring grows with the length of the task. Across four TAMP domains, our method reaches up to a 4.6x planning speedup compared to the baseline method, namely Learning Operators for TAMP. More importantly, it solves a long sequential task that the baseline cannot solve. Macro-operator discovery thus not only accelerates planning but, in certain domains, determines solvability in practice.
summary_zh: 手动创建符号算子是部署任务与运动规划（TAMP）系统的主要瓶颈之一。近期研究表明这类算子可直接从演示数据中学习得到，但现有方法通常孤立学习每个动作，无法捕捉操作任务中反复出现的多步结构，导致长序列任务的搜索过程难以处理。符号状态层面还存在另一项效率问题：每个搜索节点都会对所有输入谓词进行求值，即便部分谓词从未出现在任何学习得到的算子中。本文提出的系统可同时解决上述两个问题，其核心组件为宏算子自动生成模块：宏算子是一类复合动作，可将反复出现的单动作序列压缩为单个规划步。该系统直接从训练数据中发现存在因果关联的动作对（即前一个动作的输出恰好是后一个动作的输入条件），并将每个动作对转换为新算子。与此同时，系统会裁剪掉所有未被任何学习算子引用的谓词，缩小每个搜索节点需要求值的符号状态规模。上述改进共同缩短了有效规划时域，且优化收益随任务长度增加而提升。在4个TAMP测试域中，本文方法相比基线方法Learning Operators for TAMP最高可实现4.6倍的规划加速，更重要的是，本文方法可解决基线方法无法处理的长序列任务。宏算子发现不仅可加速规划，在部分场景下还直接决定了任务的可解性。

title: Energy-Aware Performance Evaluation of Nonlinear Mechatronic Systems Under Matched-Tracking Conditions
title_zh: 匹配跟踪条件下非线性机电系统的能量感知性能评估
authors: Bhanuka Dayawansa
abstract: Trajectory-tracking metrics such as root-mean-square error (RMSE), overshoot, and settling time are widely used to evaluate control performance in mechatronic systems. However, these measures describe output tracking alone and do not account for the actuator effort required to produce the observed motion. This limitation becomes more pronounced in nonlinear systems, where stiffness and dissipation depend on the system state. This paper examines how these effects influence actuator energy under similar tracking conditions. An energy-aware evaluation framework is introduced that combines tracking error with cumulative actuator energy and enables comparison between systems with approximately matched performance. A simple index (EAPI) is used to capture both aspects in a single measure. Simulation results for linear and nonlinear systems under proportional-derivative control show that comparable tracking accuracy can correspond to significantly different actuator energy. The nonlinear system consistently requires more energy across matched operating points, reflecting the influence of nonlinear stiffness and friction. These results suggest that trajectory-based metrics alone may not fully capture differences in system effort, and that including energy provides a more informative basis for performance evaluation.
summary_zh: 轨迹跟踪指标如均方根误差（RMSE）、超调量、调节时间已被广泛用于评估机电系统的控制性能，但这类指标仅描述输出跟踪效果，未考虑生成对应运动所需的执行器能耗。该局限性在非线性系统中尤为突出，非线性系统的刚度与耗散特性均依赖系统状态。本文研究了上述特性在相似跟踪条件下对执行器能耗的影响，提出一种能量感知评估框架，该框架将跟踪误差与执行器累计能耗相结合，可对跟踪性能近似匹配的不同系统进行横向对比。本文采用一个简单指标EAPI在单一度量中同时覆盖跟踪精度与能耗两类维度。针对比例-微分控制下线性与非线性系统的仿真结果表明，相近的跟踪精度可对应差异极大的执行器能耗：在所有匹配的运行点下，非线性系统的能耗始终更高，反映了非线性刚度与摩擦的影响。研究结果表明，仅依靠轨迹类指标无法完整捕捉系统运行的能耗差异，纳入能耗维度可提供更具信息量的性能评估依据。

title: Pattern-Derived Visual Swarm Games: Multi-Scale Drone-Vision States for Interception and Sustainability Audits
title_zh: 模式衍生的视觉集群博弈：用于拦截与可持续性审计的多尺度无人机视觉状态
authors: Faruk Alpay, Levent Sarioglu
abstract: We convert drone-vision annotation streams into virtual swarm-game states without controlling physical drones. VisDrone and UAVSwarm metadata are compressed into a Bloom representation; deterministic probes produce bounded capability vectors, image-space formations, finite zero-sum payoffs, and human-readable visual overlays. The audit scales from $6\times 6$ to $32\times 32$ finite games and adds a repeated Markov layer with stock, fatigue, adaptation, exposure, stress, budget, data-growth, model-improvement, and entropy-budget state variables. Local screen tuning raises robust screen security from $0.526$ to $0.593$, and the $32\times 32$ tuned screen reaches value $0.616$. A field readout audit shows that fixed-pixel rasters do not improve monotonically: $128\times 128$ accuracy is $67.2\%$ and hotspot error is $0.136$. The diagnosed error is shrinking image-plane bandwidth. A finite empirical-risk encoder over scale-normalized Gaussian bandwidths selects a scale-normalized encoder with $\lambda=1.50$, reaching $77.6\%$ accuracy at $128\times 128$ and reducing joint loss by $0.185$. A server-side audit checks $16{,}777{,}216$ target-localization states, and a 32-round repeated-game audit over $16{,}777{,}216$ trajectories selects a budget-adaptive policy with value $0.461$.
summary_zh: 本文无需控制物理无人机，即可将无人机视觉标注流转换为虚拟集群博弈状态。VisDrone与UAVSwarm的元数据被压缩为布隆（Bloom）表征；确定性探测可生成有界能力向量、图像空间阵型、有限零和收益以及人类可读的视觉叠加层。该审计方案可从6×6规模扩展至32×32规模的有限博弈，还新增了带存量、疲劳度、自适应度、曝光度、压力、预算、数据增长、模型优化、熵预算等状态变量的重复马尔可夫层。本地屏幕调优将鲁棒屏幕安全性从0.526提升至0.593，调优后的32×32屏幕安全性可达0.616。现场读数审计显示固定像素光栅的性能并非单调提升：128×128分辨率下准确率为67.2%，热点误差为0.136，诊断得到的误差来源为像平面带宽收缩。基于尺度归一化高斯带宽的有限经验风险编码器选择了λ=1.50的尺度归一化编码器，在128×128分辨率下准确率可达77.6%，联合损失降低0.185。服务端审计共校验16777216个目标定位状态，针对16777216条轨迹的32轮重复博弈审计选出了价值为0.461的预算自适应策略。

title: Progressively Learning Heterogeneous Skills in a Unified Latent Space
title_zh: 统一隐空间下的异构技能渐进式学习
authors: Yue-Yi Zhang, Ming Gong, Linpu He, Wei-Shi Zheng, Zhilin Zhao
abstract: We propose HetSkills, a novel framework designed to progressively learn heterogeneous skills within a unified latent space for physics-based character control. The core idea is to treat this latent space as a shared executable interface, enabling seamless integration of skills learned from diverse data sources, supervision forms, and tasks. HetSkills begins by learning a tracking skill that establishes a strong foundation in motion control and creates a shared motion decoder, which can be reused across tasks without the need for retraining or separate controllers. To prevent the text-to-motion skill from exploiting shortcut pathways instead of learning language semantics, we introduce motion intuition distillation to ground text-to-motion generation in language semantics and a task-guidance module that dynamically adjusts actions based on high-level language instructions. This enables HetSkills to preserve natural motion while continuously expanding its skill repertoire, making it highly adaptable for long-horizon tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness in motion tracking, text-to-motion generation, motion completion, and downstream task adaptation, achieving impressive success rates even under challenging conditions.
summary_zh: 本文提出HetSkills这一全新框架，可在面向物理角色控制的统一隐空间中渐进式学习异构技能。其核心思路是将该隐空间作为共享可执行接口，实现从不同数据源、不同监督形式、不同任务中学习得到的技能的无缝集成。HetSkills首先学习跟踪技能，为运动控制打下坚实基础，同时生成可跨任务复用的共享运动解码器，无需重新训练或部署独立控制器。为避免文本到运动技能走捷径而非学习语言语义，本文引入运动直觉蒸馏机制，将文本到运动生成过程锚定在语言语义上，同时设计任务引导模块，可根据高层语言指令动态调整动作。该设计使得HetSkills在保留自然运动特性的同时可不断扩展技能库，在长时域任务中具备极强的适应性。实验结果验证了该框架在运动跟踪、文本到运动生成、运动补全与下游任务适配场景下的有效性，即便在挑战性条件下也可实现极高的任务成功率。

title: Recursive Experiential-Working Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses
title_zh: 面向长周期智能体框架的递归经验-工作记忆进化
authors: Zhaochen Yu, Yingcheng Wu, Zhenfei Yin, Kaiyuan Chen, Zhe Zhao, Mengdi Wang, Shuicheng Yan, Ling Yang
abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) remains hard in long-horizon tasks, where growing histories obscure the task state and misalign skill invocation. We introduce Recuris, a recursive Experiential-Working Memory architecture for long-horizon agent harnesses, in which Working Memory tracks task progress and guides skill selection from Experiential Memory, grounding skill use in current needs rather than the full history. This coupling also turns execution into structured evidence that localizes failures to specific memory components. Across tasks, a fixed Meta-Agent turns that evidence into localized, validation-gated updates to Skill Memory that reshape execution and yield new evidence, forming a bounded recursive memory-evolution loop. Across four long-horizon benchmarks and ten models, Recuris improves task success in 35 of the 37 completed model-benchmark pairs, carrying frontier models to SOTA-level task success: on tau-bench it adds +17.8 points to GPT-5.6 Sol and +15.6 to Claude Opus 5, taking Opus 5 to 87.9%, and +16.6/+13.5 points on Qwen3.6-27B/35B on SkillFlow. The advantage widens as the interaction horizon grows, to +32.2 points on the longest tasks, and common long-horizon failures fall by up to 80%. These results position recursively evolving memory as a scalable foundation for RSI, enabling agents to continuously transform accumulated experience into increasingly effective long-horizon behavior. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/Recuris
summary_zh: 在长时域任务场景下，不断增长的历史数据会掩盖任务状态、导致技能调用错位，递归自改进（Recursive Self-Improvement, RSI）的落地始终存在难度。本文提出Recuris这一面向长时域智能体框架的递归经验-工作记忆架构：其中工作记忆负责跟踪任务进度，引导从经验记忆中完成技能选择，让技能调用适配当前需求而非依赖全部历史数据。二者的耦合还可将执行过程转化为结构化证据，将故障定位到特定记忆组件。在跨任务场景下，固定元智能体可将上述证据转化为经过验证门控的技能记忆局部更新，重塑执行过程并生成新证据，形成有界的递归记忆进化回路。在4个长时域基准测试集、10个模型上的实验结果显示，在37组完成测试的模型-基准配对中，Recuris在35组上提升了任务成功率，将前沿模型的性能提升至SOTA水平：在tau-bench测试集上，GPT-5.6 Sol的性能提升17.8个点，Claude Opus 5的性能提升15.6个点，后者最终成功率达87.9%；在SkillFlow测试集上，Qwen3.6-27B与35B的性能分别提升16.6与13.5个点。该性能优势随时域增长进一步扩大，在最长任务上性能提升可达32.2个点，常见长时域故障发生率最高可降低80%。上述结果表明，递归进化记忆可作为递归自改进的可扩展基础，让智能体持续将积累的经验转化为更高效的长时域行为。代码开源地址：https://github.com/Gen-Verse/Recuris

title: SPO++: Stream-Aligned Policy Optimization for Asynchronous Agentic RL
title_zh: SPO++：面向异步智能体强化学习的流对齐策略优化
authors: Kai Ruan, Jinghao Lin, Qianshan Wei, Ziqi Zhou, Zihe Huang
abstract: Group-relative reinforcement learning waits for sibling rollouts of the same prompt, which is costly for long and variable tool-use trajectories. Single-stream Policy Optimization (SPO) removes this dependency with a persistent prompt-level value estimate, but its recipe whitens one advantage per trajectory before optimizing a token-mean actor loss. We show that trajectory centering generally does not center the token-weighted quantity consumed by the actor, and fix the mismatch by standardizing terminal-outcome advantages under the action-token measure. We additionally organize prompt evidence by the policy event that generated it rather than learner receipt order. Across matched runs on ALFWorld at two model scales and on Math-TIR, SPO++ improves online learning efficiency over SPO. A paired ablation identifies action-token-measure normalization as the strongest tested component.
summary_zh: 组相对强化学习需要等待同一提示的同源轨迹采样完成，对于长且可变的工具使用轨迹而言成本极高。单流策略优化（Single-stream Policy Optimization, SPO）通过持久化提示层级价值估计消除了该依赖关系，但其现有方案会在优化token均值策略损失前，对每条轨迹的单个优势值做白化处理。本文研究表明，轨迹中心化操作通常无法对策略所使用的token加权统计量实现中心化，我们通过在动作token度量下标准化终端结果优势值，解决了这一不匹配问题。此外，我们还按照生成提示证据的策略事件而非学习者接收顺序来组织提示证据。在两个模型规模下的ALFWorld数据集以及Math-TIR数据集的对照实验中，SPO++相比原始SPO提升了在线学习效率。配对消融实验证实，动作token度量归一化是所有测试组件中贡献最强的优化项。

title: FedV-KGQA: Multi-Hop Question Answering over Vertically Partitioned Knowledge Graphs
title_zh: FedV-KGQA：面向垂直分区知识图谱的多跳问答方法
authors: Md Saikat Islam Khan Bappy, Oshani Seneviratne
abstract: Real-world data for knowledge graph question answering is often distributed across different organizations due to governance and data sovereignty constraints. While centralized systems exist, they cannot answer multi-hop questions when the required facts are split across vertically partitioned silos. In this paper, we propose FedV-KGQA, a framework for multi-hop reasoning over knowledge graphs in which organizations share entities but own disjoint sets of relations. Our approach combines local graph enrichment and knowledge graph embeddings to ensure raw triples and relation parameters never leave each silo, establishing a structural data boundary without requiring centralized graph access. We further introduce a topic entity anchoring mechanism that grounds questions in the correct graph neighborhood without any runtime inter-silo communication. We evaluate 12 model configurations across three benchmarks and show that FedV-KGQA performs strongly, remains close to centralized performance, generalizes to 3-hop reasoning, and is robust to embedding perturbations.
summary_zh: 受治理规则和数据主权约束，现实世界中用于知识图谱问答的数据通常分散在不同机构中。现有中心化系统无法处理所需事实分散在多个垂直分区数据孤岛中的多跳问答任务。本文提出FedV-KGQA框架，支持在实体共享、关系集合互不相交的分布式知识图谱上完成多跳推理。该方法结合局部图增强与知识图谱嵌入技术，保证原始三元组和关系参数始终不会离开所属数据孤岛，在无需中心化图访问权限的前提下构建了结构化数据边界。我们进一步提出主题实体锚定机制，无需运行时跨孤岛通信即可将问题锚定到正确的图邻域范围内。在3个基准数据集上对12种模型配置的评估结果表明，FedV-KGQA性能优异，效果接近中心化方案，可泛化到3跳推理场景，且对嵌入扰动具有鲁棒性。

title: Reading Is Not Using: Retrieval, Judgment, and the Design of AI Financial Research Workflows
title_zh: 阅读不等于使用：检索、判断与AI金融研究工作流设计
authors: Miao Liu, Zhizhe Liu
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as AI analysts to process financial disclosures and support AI-assisted investment decisions. Yet such systems are usually evaluated by what they can retrieve, not whether retrieved information affects their judgments. We identify a retrieval-integration gap in long-context financial analysis. Holding focal-firm information fixed and varying only unrelated context from 2,000 to 128,000 tokens, we find that a risk disclosure's influence on investment judgments falls to the experimental noise floor even as direct retrieval remains accurate. The pattern replicates across model families and judgment tasks and in experiments removing real disclosures from actual 10-K filings. More capable models postpone but do not eliminate the gap. Causal memory interventions show that compressed summaries and source-text lookup jointly transmit disclosures into judgments.
