summary_zh: 遗留软件仓库在无文档代码中嵌入了数十年的领域知识，导致代码理解与现代化改造难度极大。本文将程序视为其计算过程的未被观测的陈述性描述的实现形式，探究将这类潜在陈述性表示显式化是否能够提升仓库级代码移植的效果。本文提出ADFD-Migrate（带注解数据流图驱动的代码迁移框架），通过包含进程、数据存储、外部实体、数据流与行为契约的带注解数据流图（ADFD）对上述潜在表示进行近似。该框架通过大语言模型（LLM）在静态分析覆盖度检查的引导下，从有限的仓库上下文中推断出源端ADFD，再通过感知依赖关系的分块策略对有限进程组排序，生成目标语言代码。随后源端ADFD与静态恢复得到的目标端ADFD之间的差异将引导代码重新生成。本文在全新基准数据集f2x50上对ADFD-Migrate进行评估，该基准包含50个Fortran仓库，代码规模覆盖1500行至160万行，分为三个复杂度层级，从两个维度评估生成的移植代码：一是移植可靠性，通过与源端预言机的行为一致性衡量；二是移植完备性，通过综合迁移结果指数衡量。在382个经过人工校准的Fortran预言机测试用例中，生成的Python代码通过了327个用例（占比85.6%），其中40个仓库通过了所有尝试的测试用例。ADFD-Migrate将全部382个规划行为都暴露为可运行目标，作为对比，直接翻译与仓库上下文翻译方法仅分别覆盖99和98个行为，静态剖面与依赖分块的消融实验仅分别覆盖69和30个行为。在47个仓库上，该方法的平均迁移结果指数达到93.1%，相比直接翻译方法的迁移结果指数高出17至59个百分点。上述结果表明，可检查的语义瓶颈能够提升仓库级迁移的覆盖度与集成效果，同时为大量仓库提供成本更低的代码生成方案。

title: Rebuild Dossier: Mechanically-Enforced Specs for Agentic App Rebuilds, and What Model-Tier Failures Reveal
title_zh: Rebuild Dossier：面向智能体应用重建的机械强制规范体系及模型层级失效的启示
authors: Parker Fawcett
abstract: These risks reproduce on a different model and toolchain: a stronger model followed our process three times running, something the weaker model never managed. The tool is public, MIT licensed, and reproduces end to end against our own applications.
summary_zh: 相关风险在不同模型与工具链下均可复现：性能更强的模型可按照本文流程连续三次完成任务，而性能较弱的模型始终无法实现该目标。该工具为公开工具，采用MIT许可协议，可针对自研应用实现端到端的完整复现。

title: REFINE: A Multi-Agent LLM Approach for Evidence-Guided Code Refactoring
title_zh: REFINE：基于多智能体大语言模型的证据引导式代码重构方法
authors: Muhammad Waseem, Aakash Ahmad, Pekka Abrahamsson
abstract: We evaluate REFINE on 450 Java files from 15 open-source systems, producing 1,350 model-pass outputs using OpenAI GPT-5.5, Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, and Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8. REFINE reduces detected code smells by 68.26%, 72.79%, and 68.49% across the three configurations, respectively, with the strongest reductions observed for major smells. A matched 150-file direct-prompt baseline shows that REFINE achieves a higher median code-smell reduction with smaller edits and fewer public-method removals. However, broader quality improvements are inconsistent, and preservation checks reveal residual risks, including assert/fail-call changes and public-method removal. Therefore, REFINE outputs should be treated as refactoring candidates requiring compilation, testing, dependency analysis, and human review before adoption in repository- or system-level settings.
summary_zh: 本文使用来自15个开源系统的450个Java文件对REFINE方法进行评估，基于OpenAI GPT-5.5、Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview与Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8生成1350个模型输出结果。在三种配置下，REFINE分别将检测到的代码坏味道降低68.26%、72.79%与68.49%，其中对严重坏味道的优化效果最为显著。设置匹配的150个文件的直接提示基线实验表明，REFINE能够以更小的编辑量、更少的公共方法移除操作实现更高的代码坏味道降低中位数。但该方法对更广泛质量属性的提升效果并不稳定，保留性检查发现其仍存在残余风险，包括断言/失败调用变更与公共方法移除问题。因此REFINE的输出应被视为重构候选方案，在仓库级或系统级场景中落地前，必须经过编译、测试、依赖分析与人工审核流程。

title: ESQ-Bench: A Multi-Tier Enterprise Oracle Benchmark for Evaluating NL2SQL Dialect Generalization and Silent Semantic Divergence
title_zh: ESQ-Bench：用于评估NL2SQL（自然语言转SQL）方言泛化性与隐性语义偏差的多层级企业级Oracle基准测试集
authors: Sanjay Mishra, Divya Chukkapalli, Ganesh R. Naik
abstract: State-of-the-art Natural Language to SQL (NL2SQL) models report execution accuracy exceeding 89 percent on established benchmarks such as Spider and BIRD. However, these benchmarks rely on simplified academic schemas and open-source SQL dialects that do not reflect the complexity of enterprise database environments. We introduce ESQ-Bench, an Oracle-first NL2SQL benchmark with systematic complexity tiers and silent-divergence evaluation across three enterprise schema complexity tiers. We constructed and released six populated schemas (465 tables, 164,682 rows, zero empty tables) with identical seed data on Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server, a four-metric evaluation harness (EM, EX, SR, SD), and 550 gold-validated question-query pairs (Tier-1: 95; Tier-2: 228; Tier-3: 227). Schema-linked prompting with GPT-4o shows monotonic execution-match degradation across tiers: 79.8, 60.3, and 57.2 percent EX on executed queries (June 2026), versus 75.6, 80.4, and 95.8 percent on an earlier 142-question pilot slice. EM stays below 7 percent tier-wide; operational silent-divergence reaches 73 to 99 percent among EX-passing queries. Failure analysis shows wrong-result semantics dominate at higher tiers. Claude Sonnet 4.6 with schema-linked prompts reaches 87.4, 74.9, and 68.7 percent EX (executed queries), exceeding GPT-4o schema-linked on every tier. GPT-4o zero-shot EX on executed queries (78.7, 73.5, and 77.8 percent) inverts schema-linked at Tiers 2 to 3 due to lower execution rates and survivor bias in the zero-shot versus schema-linked analysis. Local Llama 3.2 schema-linked reaches only 13.3 percent bank-wide EX (73 out of 550), underscoring the gap between closed API models and open-weight baselines on enterprise Oracle schemas.
summary_zh: 当前最先进的自然语言转SQL（NL2SQL）模型在Spider、BIRD等成熟基准测试集上的执行准确率已超过89%，但这类基准依赖简化的学术模式与开源SQL方言，无法反映企业数据库环境的真实复杂度。本文提出ESQ-Bench，这是首个以Oracle数据库为核心的NL2SQL基准测试集，设置了系统化的复杂度层级，可在三个企业级模式复杂度层级下开展隐性偏差评估。本文构建并发布了6个填充完成的数据库模式（共465张表，164682行数据，无空表），在Oracle、PostgreSQL、MySQL与SQL Server上配置了完全相同的种子数据，配套包含EM、EX、SR、SD四个指标的评估框架，以及550个经过人工校验的问题-查询对（层级1：95个；层级2：228个；层级3：227个）。基于GPT-4o的模式关联提示实验显示，随着层级提升，执行匹配率单调下降：2026年6月的测试结果显示，执行查询的EX指标分别为79.8%、60.3%与57.2%，而此前142个问题的试点切片测试结果为75.6%、80.4%与95.8%。全层级EM指标始终低于7%，在通过EX校验的查询中，运行态隐性偏差占比达到73%至99%。失效分析表明，高层级场景下错误结果类语义偏差占主导地位。采用模式关联提示的Claude Sonnet 4.6的EX指标分别达到87.4%、74.9%与68.7%，在所有层级上均超过采用模式关联提示的GPT-4o。GPT-4o零样本模式下的执行查询EX指标分别为78.7%、73.5%与77.8%，在层级2与层级3上的表现反超模式关联提示方案，原因是零样本方案的执行率更低，且分析过程存在幸存者偏差。本地部署的Llama 3.2采用模式关联提示的全库EX指标仅为13.3%（550个查询中仅73个通过），凸显了闭源API模型与开源权重基线模型在企业级Oracle模式场景下的性能差距。

title: RENDER: Controlling Reader-Facing Evidence in LLM Memory Evaluation
authors: Yuan Si, Simeng Han, Daming Li, Jialu Zhang
abstract: Memory and RAG evaluations often treat the answering model's input as an implementation detail, even though systems may render the same history as a memory entry, summary, typed record, or raw excerpt. We introduce RENDER, a benchmark control that fixes the conversation while varying the reader-facing artifact. RENDER combines a five-level packet ladder, localizing when answer-bearing content enters the input, with deterministic templates approximating ChatGPT-style entries, LangChain summaries, MemGPT-style typed records, and raw conversation. On 500 LongMemEval questions and nine models, matched-budget resolved packets beat recency-truncated raw dialogue by 42.4-72.6 points. In deployed-style templates, best-worst spread is 24.6-48.8 points per model; under the primary scorer, ChatGPT-style entries have higher point estimates than raw conversation on 7 of 9 models. Judge rescoring preserves the positive aggregate effect, but model-specific significance is mixed. Three models scoring 0 percent on formal ledger packets answer the same facts from natural-language entries at 45.4-53.4 percent. The effect persists under retrieval noise and transfers to HotpotQA, suggesting that memory/RAG evaluations should report or control the reader-facing artifact.

title: What FID Hides: Detecting, Ranking, and Diagnosing Deviations in Generative Evaluation
title_zh: FID（弗雷歇Inception距离）的隐藏局限：生成式评估中偏差的检测、排序与诊断
authors: Hao Chen
abstract: Generative models are commonly ranked by Fr\'echet Inception Distance (FID) and Kernel Inception Distance (KID), yet FID's first-two-moment summary can miss distributional differences, and a reported scalar gap alone is not a calibrated test against sampling variation. FID's moment restriction has concrete consequences: on ImageNet, visually unrecognizable images optimized only to match the reference Inception mean and covariance obtain FID $24.7$ versus $58.6$ for held-out real images (lower is better). Moreover, FID and KID are scalar discrepancies that are unchanged when the two samples are exchanged and therefore do not encode the direction of a dispersion change: under-dispersion, as can occur in mode collapse, versus over-dispersion. We introduce \textbf{ZID} (\emph{Z-resolved Integrated Diagnostic}), which combines six standardized location- and dispersion-sensitive arms from a rank graph (RISE) and Gaussian kernels (GPK at two bandwidths). Rather than asking one scalar to serve incompatible roles, ZID reports three linked outputs: an index for ranking departure magnitude, a permutation $p$-value for testing distributional equality, and a signed dispersion readout for diagnosis. In controlled experiments, ZID detects a broad range of departures, and its score tracks increasing severity along the corresponding sweeps, including cases in which FID is flat or reversed. On DiT-XL/2 and SiT-XL/2 guidance sweeps, ZID detects departure from real data, and its signed readout labels the high-guidance diversity collapse as under-dispersion.
summary_zh: 生成模型通常通过FID（弗雷歇Inception距离）与KID（核Inception距离）进行排序，但FID仅基于前两阶矩的汇总特性会遗漏分布差异，报告的标量差值本身也无法作为针对采样波动的校准测试。FID的矩限制特性会带来实际影响：在ImageNet数据集上，仅针对参考Inception特征的均值与协方差优化得到的视觉上无法识别的图像，FID值仅为24.7，而留出的真实图像的FID值为58.6（FID值越低性能越好）。此外，FID与KID均为标量差异指标，交换两个样本后数值不会发生变化，因此无法表征离散度变化的方向：即模式崩溃场景下可能出现的欠离散，以及过离散。本文提出ZID（Z解析集成诊断指标），该指标整合了来自排序图（RISE）与两个带宽下高斯核（GPK）的6个标准化位置与离散度敏感分支。不同于用单个标量承担多个不兼容的角色，ZID输出三个关联结果：用于对偏差幅度排序的指数、用于检验分布等价性的置换p值，以及用于诊断的带符号离散度读数。在对照实验中，ZID能够检测到广泛的偏差类型，其得分随对应扫描过程中的偏差严重程度同步上升，包括FID指标保持平稳甚至反向的场景。在DiT-XL/2与SiT-XL/2的引导强度扫描实验中，ZID能够检测到生成结果与真实数据的偏差，其带符号读数可将高引导强度下的多样性崩溃标记为欠离散。

title: Parameterized Complexity of $L_p$-Lipschitz Constants for Input Convex Neural Networks and $L_p$-Norm Maximization over Zonotopes
title_zh: 输入凸神经网络的Lp-Lipschitz常数与 zonotope（带状多面体）上的Lp范数最大化问题的参数化复杂度
authors: Aritra Das, Vincent Froese, Moritz Grillo, Debayan Gupta, Christoph Hertrich, Tharrshann Jayan Logarajah, Georg Loho, Mihir More, Moritz Stargalla
abstract: Our paper resolves an open problem posted at COLT'25. There are several independent concurrent papers resolving the same problem. Our paper prioritizes a clear exposition of the underlying mathematics and conceptual intuitions behind the proof. Additionally, we explicitly describe our research process including the use of LLMs.
summary_zh: 本文解决了COLT'25会议上提出的一个公开问题，目前已有多个独立同期工作解决了同一问题。本文重点对证明背后的基础数学原理与概念直觉进行清晰阐述，此外还明确描述了研究过程，包括大语言模型的使用情况。

title: Improving Cross-Problem Vehicle Routing with Locally Augmented Preferences and Representation Disentanglement
title_zh: 基于局部增强偏好与表征解耦的跨问题车辆路径问题优化
authors: Arthur Corr\^ea, Paulo Nascimento, Samuel Moniz
abstract: Multi-task vehicle routing problem (VRP) solvers seek to handle multiple VRP variants within a single unified model, avoiding the need to train a separate model for every variant. In spite of recent progress, current approaches remain limited on two fronts. On the training side, reinforcement learning suffers from reward-scale disparities and shrinking advantage signals as policies improve, whereas preference optimization stagnates once sampled tours become near-identical and thus fundamentally limited by the quality of the policy's own generated solutions, leaving both paradigms with weak supervision as training progresses. On the architecture side, existing fully shared encoders entangle constraint-dependent representations across heterogeneous variants, which limits generalization. We address these gaps with two model-agnostic contributions. First, we propose Preference Optimization with Locally Augmented Refinement (POLAR), a novel training algorithm that applies a local search refinement pass to the best decoded tour before forming preference pairs, yielding much more informative pairwise margins. Second, a Progressive Layered Extraction (PLE) encoder routes each encoder layer through one shared expert and a set of task-specific experts via a gating mechanism, progressively separating common routing structure from constraint-specific encodings. Through extensive experiments on various VRP variants, we show that POLAR and PLE together elevate the current state-of-the-art among neural multi-task solvers. We reduce the average gap to reference solutions by 21.3% relative to the strongest published baseline on 16 in-distribution variants, and outperform prior neural methods on 27 out of 32 unseen variants. Ablation studies confirm the efficacy of each contribution, showing that both improve cross-problem generalization across multiple backbone model architectures.
summary_zh: 多任务车辆路径问题（VRP）求解器旨在通过单个统一模型处理多种VRP变体，避免为每个变体单独训练模型。尽管近年相关研究取得了一定进展，现有方法仍存在两方面局限：训练层面，随着策略性能提升，强化学习会面临奖励尺度差异与优势信号收缩问题，而偏好优化在采样路径趋于一致后就会陷入停滞，性能上限受限于策略自身生成的解的质量，两种范式在训练后期都存在监督信号不足的问题；架构层面，现有全共享编码器会将不同异质变体的依赖约束表征纠缠在一起，限制了泛化能力。本文提出两个与模型无关的改进方案填补上述空白：第一，提出POLAR（局部增强精细化偏好优化算法），该新型训练算法在生成偏好对之前，对最优解码路径执行局部搜索精细化操作，生成的成对边距信息更加丰富；第二，提出PLE（渐进分层提取编码器），该编码器通过门控机制将每个编码层路由到一个共享专家与多个任务专属专家，逐步将通用路径结构与约束专属编码分离开。在多种VRP变体上开展的大量实验表明，POLAR与PLE结合后性能超过当前最先进的神经多任务求解器：在16个同分布变体上，与已发表的最优基线相比，本文方法将与参考解的平均差距相对降低21.3%，在32个未见过的变体中的27个上性能超过现有神经方法。消融实验验证了两项贡献各自的有效性，二者均能在多种骨干模型架构下提升跨问题泛化能力。

title: Bellman Calibration for Marginalized Importance Weighting in Offline Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 离线强化学习中边缘化重要性加权的贝尔曼校准方法
authors: Lars van der Laan, Nathan Kallus
abstract: Marginalized importance weighting evaluates a target policy by reweighting offline state-action samples with its discounted occupancy ratio, characterized by an adjoint Bellman equation. Existing minimax, primal-dual, and fitted fixed-point estimators can leave residual occupancy-balance violations because of function-class approximation, regularization, or incomplete optimization. These violations are difficult to diagnose and reduce because the objectives generally lack a direct supervised validation loss for hyperparameter tuning, model selection, and early stopping. We introduce isotonic Bellman calibration, a one-dimensional, model-agnostic post-processing method that reduces these violations while preserving the ranking information in any initial occupancy-ratio estimate. The method corrects the estimate's scale and shape by applying fitted occupancy-ratio evaluation (FORE) over a one-dimensional class of nondecreasing transformations. We characterize Bellman calibration as a conditional fixed-point property equivalent to occupancy-balance against every test function of the calibrated ratio. More generally, we derive a calibration-refinement bound showing that any fitted ratio with small calibration error performs nearly as well as the best post-processing based on its fitted values. For isotonic Bellman calibration, we establish finite-sample calibration guarantees and a KL oracle inequality relative to the best monotone transformation of the initial estimate. Consequently, isotonic Bellman calibration achieves small calibration error and KL risk within statistical error of the best monotone correction, with guarantees for downstream target-occupancy functionals, including policy-value estimation.
summary_zh: 边缘化重要性加权通过折扣占用比对离线状态-动作样本进行重加权，实现对目标策略的评估，该过程可通过伴随贝尔曼方程描述。现有的极小极大、原始-对偶与拟合不动点估计器由于函数类近似、正则化或优化不充分，会残留占用平衡偏差。这类偏差难以诊断与降低，因为对应的目标函数通常没有直接的监督验证损失，无法用于超参数调优、模型选择与早停。本文提出等渗贝尔曼校准方法，这是一种一维、与模型无关的后处理方法，能够在保留任意初始占用比估计中的排序信息的同时，降低上述偏差。该方法通过在一维非递减变换类上应用拟合占用比评估（FORE），校正估计值的尺度与形态。本文将贝尔曼校准表征为条件不动点属性，该校准属性等价于针对校准后比值的所有测试函数均满足占用平衡。更广泛地，本文推导了校准-细化边界，证明任意校准误差较小的拟合比值的性能几乎不逊于基于其拟合值的最优后处理方案。针对等渗贝尔曼校准，本文建立了有限样本校准保证与相对于初始估计最优单调变换的KL oracle不等式。因此，等渗贝尔曼校准能够在统计误差范围内实现较小的校准误差与KL风险，性能接近最优单调校正，同时为下游目标占用泛函（包括策略值估计）提供理论保证。

title: BioKERN: Biological Kernel Regularization for Histology-to-Transcriptomics Neighborhood Retrieval
title_zh: BioKERN：面向组织切片到转录组邻域检索的生物核正则化方法
authors: Seungik Cho, Betul Orcan-Ekmekci
abstract: Spatially resolved biology requires representations that preserve biological neighborhood structure rather than only exact cross-modal correspondences. Existing histology--transcriptomics objectives can emphasize instance-level matching even when non-paired spots share molecular or spatial context. We introduce BioKERN, a multimodal spatial representation-learning framework that incorporates biological structure as an explicit, learnable inductive bias. BioKERN constructs a training-time biological kernel by combining transcriptomic similarity and spatial proximity, then uses it to provide graded neighborhood supervision and regularize embedding geometry. Evaluation uses a fixed, model-independent biological neighborhood definition shared by all methods. Across Mouse Brain Visium and Human Liver GSE240429, BioKERN consistently improves biological-neighborhood retrieval over BLEEP in both single- and multi-scale settings. Controlled shared-architecture experiments show that most of the improvement arises from biological-kernel regularization rather than increased model capacity. These results support explicit biological geometry as an interpretable inductive bias for multimodal learning in spatial biology.
summary_zh: 空间生物学需要能够保留生物邻域结构的表征，而非仅实现精确的跨模态对应。现有的组织切片-转录组优化目标往往强调实例级匹配，即便非配对的 spot 共享分子或空间上下文也不例外。本文提出BioKERN，这是一种多模态空间表征学习框架，将生物结构作为显式可学习的归纳偏置引入模型。BioKERN在训练阶段结合转录组相似性与空间邻近性构建生物核，基于该核提供分级邻域监督，对嵌入空间的几何特性进行正则化。评估过程采用所有方法通用的、与模型无关的固定生物邻域定义。在Mouse Brain Visium与Human Liver GSE240429数据集上，无论是单尺度还是多尺度场景下，BioKERN的生物邻域检索性能始终优于BLEEP方法。控制架构一致的对照实验表明，性能提升主要来自生物核正则化，而非模型容量的增加。上述结果证明，显式的生物几何特性可作为空间生物学多模态学习中可解释的归纳偏置。

title: A Geometric Theory of Robust Fairness Audits
title_zh: 鲁棒公平性审计的几何理论
authors: Binita Maity
abstract: Neighborhood-based fairness audits evaluate individual fairness by comparing predictions among similar individuals in feature space. Despite their widespread use, little is known about the robustness of the auditing procedure itself. Because these audits rely on nearest neighbor relationships, small perturbations in feature space can alter local neighborhoods and produce different fairness assessments even when model predictions remain unchanged. We develop a geometric framework for analyzing the robustness of neighborhood-based fairness audits under bounded perturbations. Our analysis establishes sufficient conditions for neighborhood invariance, quantifies how neighborhood replacement propagates to audit instability, and introduces audit volatility, a measure of the expected sensitivity of fairness audits under repeated perturbations. Experiments on benchmark datasets support the theoretical analysis and show that the proposed framework explains the observed stability of neighborhood-based fairness audits.
summary_zh: 基于邻域的公平性审计通过比较特征空间中相似个体的预测结果评估个体公平性。尽管这类方法应用广泛，但学界对审计流程本身的鲁棒性仍知之甚少。由于这类审计依赖近邻关系，特征空间中的微小扰动就可能改变局部邻域，即便模型预测结果保持不变，也会产生截然不同的公平性评估结果。本文提出了一个几何框架，用于分析有界扰动下基于邻域的公平性审计的鲁棒性。我们的分析推导了邻域不变性的充分条件，量化了邻域替换如何传导为审计不稳定性，并提出了审计波动率这一指标，用于衡量公平性审计在重复扰动下的预期敏感度。在基准数据集上开展的实验验证了理论分析结论，表明所提出的框架能够解释观测到的基于邻域的公平性审计的稳定性表现。

title: Effective Learning Rate Governs Loss Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
title_zh: 有效学习率决定语言模型预训练的损失动态
authors: Zihan Liu, Ruiheng Zheng, Shaobo Zhang, Changxin Tian, Kunlong Chen, Zhiqiang Zhang, Lei Wu
abstract: We uncover ELR collapse in language model pretraining: learning rate (LR) and parameter norm govern loss dynamics primarily through their ratio, the effective learning rate (ELR). When ELR is matched across runs, their loss trajectories collapse throughout training despite substantially different LRs and parameter norms. Across optimizers, architectures, datasets, and model scales, mean collapse errors are typically a few x 10^-3, below the seed-to-seed variation measured in a representative configuration. Systematic ablations identify normalization design and the timescale of LR-norm variation as key determinants of collapse precision. Controlled interventions further show that weight decay and Hyperball shape loss dynamics primarily through the ELR schedules they induce. Replacing LR with ELR enables a fitted functional scaling law (FSL) to transfer across norm-control methods. The resulting ELR-based FSL also explains delayed acceleration, a recurring effect of norm control. Together, these results establish ELR as a common coordinate linking LR scheduling, norm control, and loss dynamics.
summary_zh: 本文揭示了语言模型预训练中的ELR坍缩现象：学习率（Learning Rate, LR）与参数范数主要通过二者的比值即有效学习率（Effective Learning Rate, ELR）共同决定损失动态。当不同训练运行的ELR匹配时，即便其学习率和参数范数存在显著差异，整个训练过程中的损失轨迹也会趋于重合。在不同优化器、架构、数据集和模型规模下，平均坍缩误差通常仅为10^-3量级，低于代表性配置下不同随机种子间的结果差异。系统的消融实验表明，归一化设计以及学习率-范数变化的时间尺度是决定坍缩精度的核心要素。受控干预实验进一步证明，权重衰减和Hyperball主要通过其诱导的ELR调度方案来影响损失动态。将学习率替换为ELR后，拟合得到的函数标度律（Functional Scaling Law, FSL）可在不同范数控制方法之间迁移。基于ELR得到的函数标度律还能解释范数控制中常见的延迟加速效应。上述结果共同证明，ELR是连接学习率调度、范数控制与损失动态的通用核心变量。

title: MDTE: Minority-Aware Diffusion over Temporal Edge Events for Imbalanced Node Classification
title_zh: MDTE：面向不平衡节点分类的感知少数类时序边事件扩散模型
authors: Zhou Zelong, Zhang Tianming, Yang Zhengyi, Tang Yifu, Hou Chenyu, Cao Bin, Fan Jing
abstract: Class-imbalanced node classification on temporal graphs is challenging because majority-dominated temporal propagation progressively assimilates minority representations, while conventional node and neighborhood information provides insufficient discriminative evidence for minority classes. To address these issues, we propose MDTE, a minority-aware diffusion framework that reconstructs stable and discriminative temporal edge-event representations through conditional diffusion denoising. Specifically, MDTE introduces Distribution-Aware Selective Propagation, which combines Local Outlier Factor (LOF)-based propagation filtering with cluster-aware low-frequency propagation. The module preserves informative neighborhood dependencies while mitigating harmful propagation and majority-class information assimilation. It further develops Multi-View Discriminative Fusion, which exploits feature reconstruction and topology prediction to characterize class-wise differences in distribution learning and extracts complementary discriminability signals to guide denoising. Experiments on five real-world datasets demonstrate that MDTE consistently achieves the best performance on minority-class-oriented metrics, improving minority-class recall by up to 23.53 percentage points, minority-class F1 by 8.68 percentage points, and AUPRC by 2.67 percentage points over the strongest baselines.
summary_zh: 时序图上的类别不平衡节点分类任务极具挑战性，原因在于占主导地位的多数类时序传播会逐步同化少数类的表征，而传统的节点与邻域信息无法为少数类提供足够的判别性证据。针对上述问题，本文提出MDTE这一感知少数类的扩散框架，通过条件扩散去噪重构稳定且具有判别性的时序边事件表征。具体而言，MDTE提出了分布感知选择性传播模块，将基于局部离群因子（Local Outlier Factor, LOF）的传播过滤与感知簇的低频传播相结合，在保留有效邻域依赖关系的同时，抑制有害传播和多数类信息的同化效应。该框架进一步提出多视图判别融合模块，利用特征重构和拓扑预测刻画分布学习中的类别差异，提取互补的判别性信号以引导去噪过程。在5个真实数据集上的实验结果表明，MDTE在面向少数类的指标上始终取得最优表现，与最优基线方法相比，少数类召回率最高提升23.53个百分点，少数类F1值最高提升8.68个百分点，AUPRC值最高提升2.67个百分点。

title: LION: A Clifford Neural Paradigm for Multimodal-Attributed Graph Learning
title_zh: LION：面向多模态属性图学习的Clifford神经范式
authors: Xunkai Li, Zekai Chen, Zhengyu Wu, Henan Sun, Daohan Su, Guang Zeng, Hongchao Qin, Rong-Hua Li, Guoren Wang
abstract: Recently, the rapid advancement of multimodal domains has driven a data-centric paradigm shift in graph ML, transitioning from text-attributed to multimodal-attributed graphs. This advancement significantly enhances data representation and expands the scope of graph downstream tasks, such as modality-oriented tasks, thereby improving the practical utility of graph ML. Despite its promise, limitations exist in the current neural paradigms:(1) Neglect Context in Modality Alignment: Most existing methods adopt topology-constrained or modality-specific operators as tokenizers.These aligners inevitably neglect graph context and inhibit modality interaction, resulting in suboptimal alignment.(2) Lack of Adaptation in Modality Fusion: Most existing methods are simple adaptations for 2-modality graphs and fail to adequately exploit aligned tokens equipped with topology priors during fusion, leading to poor generalizability and performance degradation.To address the above issues, we propose LION (c\underline{LI}ff\underline{O}rd \underline{N}eural paradigm) based on the Clifford algebra and decoupled graph neural paradigm (i.e., propagation-then-aggregation) to implement alignment-then-fusion in multimodal-attributed graphs. Specifically, we first construct a modality-aware geometric manifold grounded in Clifford algebra.This geometric-induced high-order graph propagation efficiently achieves modality interaction, facilitating modality alignment.Then, based on the topology-aware Clifford components of aligned tokens, we propose adaptive holographic aggregation. This module integrates component-wise energy and propagation-scale information with learnable parameters to improve modality fusion. Extensive experiments on 9 text-image MAG datasets demonstrate that LION significantly outperforms SOTA baselines across 3 graph and 3 modality downstream tasks.
summary_zh: 近年来多模态领域的快速发展推动图机器学习领域出现了以数据为中心的范式转变，研究对象从文本属性图逐步转向多模态属性图。这一进展极大提升了数据表征能力，拓展了图下游任务（如面向模态的任务）的适用范围，进而提升了图机器学习的实用价值。尽管前景广阔，现有神经范式仍存在两点局限：1）模态对齐中忽略上下文：多数现有方法采用拓扑约束或模态专属算子作为分词器，这类对齐器不可避免地忽略了图上下文，抑制了模态交互，最终导致对齐效果欠佳；2）模态融合中缺乏自适应能力：多数现有方法仅能简单适配双模态图场景，无法在融合过程中充分利用具备拓扑先验的对齐token，最终导致泛化能力差、性能下降。针对上述问题，本文基于Clifford代数和解耦图神经范式（即先传播后聚合），提出LION（Clifford神经范式），在多模态属性图上实现先对齐后融合的流程。具体而言，我们首先构建基于Clifford代数的模态感知几何流形，这种由几何诱导的高阶图传播可以高效实现模态交互，助力模态对齐。随后，基于对齐token的拓扑感知Clifford分量，提出自适应全息聚合模块，该模块将分量级能量和传播尺度信息与可学习参数相融合，提升模态融合效果。在9个图文多模态属性图数据集上开展的大量实验表明，LION在3类图下游任务和3类模态下游任务上的表现均显著优于当前最优基线方法。

title: Optimal Alternating Regret for Online Learning and Games
title_zh: 数据泄露夸大了停电预测模型的泛化能力
authors: Yixin Tao, Weiqiang Zheng
abstract: For general OCO over a $d$-dimensional compact convex set, we give an algorithm with $O(d\log (1+T/d))$ alternating regret, improving the previous best of $\widetilde{O}(d^{2/3}T^{1/3})$. We also prove a matching lower bound of $\Omega(d\log (1+T/d))$, showing that the $\Omega(\log T)$ factor is unavoidable.
summary_zh: 停电预测模型越来越多地被用于气候驱动的基础设施风险评估，但现有评估实践无法明确这类模型能否泛化到实际应用所需的未知场景。本文识别出停电预测模型中三类常见的方法学选择，它们会影响模型在空间、时间和事件维度上的泛化能力。我们使用2018-2023年美国东海岸的公开数据，结合天气再分析数据、土地覆盖数据衍生的特征集，以及地理AI基础模型Prithvi WxC的嵌入，对比不同方法学决策对预测性能的影响。具体而言，我们在多种测试集划分策略下评估模型性能，包括无过滤随机划分、留一州划分和留一事件划分，这些策略逐步逼近真实部署场景。尽管随机训练-测试划分得到的性能表现优异，但我们证明这类结果被空间和时间自相关性夸大了。在空间和时间留出实验中，预测精度大幅下降，多数模型的表现甚至无法超过简单的空基线。引入地理AI基础模型嵌入仅能带来有限且不稳定的性能提升，且主要作用于空间泛化，无法解决事件层面的可迁移性差的问题。上述结果表明，在当前的数据可得性和评估实践下，公开训练的停电预测模型的实用价值有限且存在不确定性。未来的进展需要提升数据覆盖度，采用更贴近现实的评估协议，将研究重点从边际模型性能提升转向解决结构性数据约束问题。

title: Parameter-Level Attribution of Symmetry in Trained Networks Though Parameter-Wise Functional Sensitivity
title_zh: 基于逐参数功能敏感度的训练网络对称性参数级归因
authors: Alan Muriithi, Vedanta Thapar, Torben Berndt
abstract: When a network has learned a function with a known symmetry, can that symmetry be moved through the parametrisation---is there a motion in parameter space realising the group action in function space? We formulate this as a lifting problem for the realisation map $\Phi:\theta\mapsto f_\theta$, and show that a smooth parameter-space action exists only if the tangent space to the function's symmetry orbit lies within the image of $\mathrm d\Phi_\theta$, whose columns are the \emph{functional sensitivities} of individual parameters. This condition is also sufficient for pointwise first-order lifting. Relaxing it in least squares yields two local parameter directions: one following the symmetry orbit, one descending towards the equivariant subspace, with residuals measuring what the parametrisation cannot reach. On a rotationally invariant classifier we find these directions induce their predicted function-space motion, but only locally: recomputed directions track the orbit and reduce the equivariance defect, while directions held fixed depart from both after training. The same holds for Hamiltonian neural networks trained on a rotationally symmetric potential, even though the architecture does not explicitly enforce the symmetry.
summary_zh: 当神经网络已经习得一个具备已知对称性的函数时，能否通过参数化过程传递该对称性——即是否存在参数空间中的运动，在函数空间中实现群作用？我们将该问题表述为实现映射Φ:θ↦f_θ的提升问题，并证明只有当函数对称轨道的切空间位于dΦ_θ的像空间内时，才存在光滑的参数空间作用，而dΦ_θ的列向量就是各个参数的功能敏感度。该条件也是逐点一阶提升的充分条件。通过最小二乘松弛该条件，可以得到两个局部参数方向：一个沿对称轨道运动，另一个朝等变子空间下降，二者的残差可以衡量参数化无法覆盖的范围。在旋转不变分类器上的实验表明，这些方向确实能实现预期的函数空间运动，但仅在局部有效：重新计算得到的方向可以跟踪轨道并降低等变缺陷，而固定不变的方向在训练后会同时偏离轨道和等变子空间。即便在架构未显式强制对称性的、基于旋转对称势训练的哈密顿神经网络上，该结论依然成立。

title: Single State Update Predictive Coding training for Time Series Forecasting and Anomaly Detection
title_zh: 面向时间序列预测与异常检测的单状态更新预测编码训练方法
authors: Matteo Cardoni, Sam Leroux
abstract: Predictive Coding (PC) is a neural learning paradigm that enables parallelizable neural network layer updates. However, the main bottleneck of PC Networks (PCN) is the sequential backwards error propagation. To tackle this, we introduce a training technique that pairs a Generative PCN with a support Encoding PCN. The two PCNs are trained in parallel to match their neural activations, without sequential propagation. We apply this to time series anomaly detection and show that our approach results in more stable, continuous, online learning.
summary_zh: 预测编码（Predictive Coding, PC）是一种支持神经网络层并行更新的神经学习范式。但现有预测编码网络（Predictive Coding Networks, PCN）的主要瓶颈在于串行的反向误差传播过程。为解决该问题，本文提出一种训练技术，将生成式预测编码网络与支撑编码预测编码网络配对使用。两个预测编码网络并行训练，使二者的神经激活相互匹配，无需串行传播。我们将该方法应用于时间序列异常检测任务，结果表明该方法可实现更稳定、连续的在线学习。

title: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Longitudinal Patient Representation and Scalable Insight Generation in Oncology
title_zh: 面向肿瘤纵向患者表征与可扩展洞察生成的多模态基础模型
authors: Eugene Vorontsov, Yi Kan Wang, Alican Bozkurt, Adam Casson, Ludmila Tydlitatova, Michal Zelechowski, Ezra E. W. Cohen, Jyoti D. Patel, Max Banaszak, Caitlin McWilliams, Shane Colley, Kate Sasser, Ryan Fukushima, Eric Lefkofsky, Razik Yousfi, Siqi Liu
abstract: Precision oncology necessitates a longitudinal model of patient state that captures cancer evolution and treatment over time, integrating multimodal observations. We introduce the oFM, a foundation model developed on a real-world oncology cohort of 1.67 million cancer patients that integrates clinical trajectories with DNA, RNA, and H&E pathology. Patient-level partitions were reserved for training, validation, and testing, with over one million patients used for training. The oFM encodes daily clinical and molecular episodes and, along with pathology images, integrates them over time to produce a patient state embedding. We evaluate frozen oFM embeddings against expert-curated clinical and molecular baseline features. In prognostic benchmarks, the oFM improved AUC for treatment response, progression-free survival, and overall survival (0.774 vs. 0.563 for overall survival). Across 11 comparative-treatment cohorts, the oFM embeddings achieved a three-fold higher pooled and scale-normalized treatment-benefit AUTOC than baseline features with improved benefit ranking in 9 of 11 cohorts, and provided stronger prognostic discrimination within both treatment arms. We also evaluated a mechanism discovery framework that interprets downstream models built on oFM embeddings by linking their predicted outcomes to clinically and biologically grounded mechanisms through an evidence-grounded temporal graph, enabling evaluation in clinical and drug-development applications.
summary_zh: 精准肿瘤学需要能够随时间捕捉癌症进展与治疗过程的患者状态纵向模型，整合多模态观测数据。本文提出oFM这一基础模型，基于包含167万癌症患者的真实世界肿瘤队列训练，整合了临床轨迹与DNA、RNA、H&E病理数据。研究预留了独立的患者级划分用于训练、验证和测试，其中超过100万患者的数据用于模型训练。oFM对每日临床和分子事件进行编码，并与病理图像一同随时间整合，生成患者状态嵌入。我们使用冻结的oFM嵌入与专家标注的临床和分子基线特征进行对比评估。在预后基准测试中，oFM在治疗响应、无进展生存期和总生存期任务上的AUC均有提升，其中总生存期任务的AUC从基线的0.563提升至0.774。在11个对比治疗队列中，oFM嵌入的合并归一化治疗获益AUTOC比基线特征高出3倍，11个队列中有9个的获益排序结果更优，且在两个治疗组内均实现了更强的预后区分能力。我们还评估了一个机制发现框架，该框架通过基于证据的时序图将基于oFM嵌入构建的下游模型的预测结果与临床和生物学层面的可解释机制相关联，可支持临床与药物研发场景下的评估工作。

title: Data Leakage Inflates Generalizability of Power Outage Prediction Models
authors: Yamil Essus, Ranga Raju Vatsavai, Benjamin Rachunok
abstract: Power outage prediction models are increasingly used in assessments of climate-driven infrastructure risk, yet current evaluation practices obscure whether these models generalize to the novel conditions such applications require. We identify three common methodological choices in power outage prediction models that influence their ability to generalize across spatial, temporal, and event-based settings. We compare the predictive performance impacts of different methodological decisions using publicly available data for the U.S. East Coast from 2018 to 2023 and feature sets derived from weather reanalysis and land-cover data, and embeddings from a GeoAI foundation model (Prithvi WxC). Specifically, we assess model performance under multiple test selection strategies, including unfiltered random splits, leave-one-state-out, and leave-one-event-out designs, which increasingly approximate real-world deployment conditions. While random train-test splits yield strong performance, we show that these results are inflated by spatial and temporal autocorrelation. Under spatial and temporal holdout experiments, predictive accuracy degrades substantially, with models often failing to outperform a simple null baseline. Incorporating GeoAI foundation model embeddings yields limited and inconsistent improvements, primarily for spatial generalization, and does not resolve poor event-level transferability. These findings suggest that, given current data availability and evaluation practices, publicly trained outage prediction models offer limited and uncertain operational value. Progress will likely require improved data coverage, more realistic evaluation protocols, and a shift in focus from marginal modeling advances toward addressing structural data constraints.

title: When Similarity Is Interaction-Driven: Quantum Kernels for Regime-Sensitive Learning
title_zh: 当相似性由交互驱动：面向敏感机制学习的量子核
authors: Hanqiu Peng, Jianlong Lu, Ying Chen
abstract: Similarity in many decision systems is governed not by distance alone but by interactions among variables. In fraud and anomaly detection, small local perturbations can cross interaction-sensitive decision boundaries while leaving ambient distance almost unchanged. Motivated by this setting, we introduce a thin-slab interaction model and an interaction-driven quantum kernel constructed from entangled Pauli-string feature maps. The feature map explicitly encodes sparse high-order block interactions. We show that the resulting fidelity kernel is positive semidefinite, admits an exact block-factorized formulation, and induces a geometry sensitive to changes in interaction regime. Across balanced and imbalanced synthetic experiments spanning third-, fourth-, sixth-, and eighth-order interactions, the proposed kernel consistently outperforms linear, radial basis function, Laplacian, and polynomial kernels, as well as an engineered-interaction linear baseline supplied with the planted block products. On real fraud-detection benchmarks, it achieves the highest mean accuracy and F1 on Credit Card Fraud Detection and ranks second on IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection. These findings show that quantum-kernel performance depends on alignment between feature-map geometry and the underlying predictive structure, rather than on Hilbert-space dimension alone. Because the prescribed block-factorized kernel can also be evaluated exactly on a classical computer, the results establish predictive and representational value rather than computational quantum speedup.
summary_zh: 许多决策系统中的相似性并非仅由距离决定，而是由变量间的交互作用主导。在欺诈与异常检测场景中，微小的局部扰动可以穿过交互敏感的决策边界，同时几乎不改变环境距离。受该场景启发，本文提出了薄板交互模型，以及由纠缠泡利串特征映射构建的交互驱动量子核。该特征映射显式编码了稀疏的高阶块交互。我们证明，得到的保真度核是半正定的，具备精确的块因子分解形式，可诱导出对交互机制变化敏感的几何结构。在覆盖三阶、四阶、六阶和八阶交互的平衡与不平衡合成实验中，所提出的核的表现始终优于线性核、径向基函数核、拉普拉斯核、多项式核，以及配备了植入块乘积的工程交互线性基线。在真实欺诈检测基准上，该模型在信用卡欺诈检测数据集上取得了最高的平均准确率和F1值，在IEEE-CIS欺诈检测数据集上排名第二。上述结果表明，量子核的性能取决于特征映射几何与底层预测结构的匹配度，而非仅由希尔伯特空间维度决定。由于所设计的块因子分解核也可在经典计算机上精确计算，该结果证明的是量子核的预测与表征价值，而非计算层面的量子加速。

title: Bandit Submodular Maximization under Matroid Constraints: Learning Compressed Exchange Policy
title_zh: 拟阵约束下的多臂老虎机子模最大化：学习压缩交换策略
authors: Zongqi Wan, Zhijie Zhang
abstract: Technically, we view the problem as learning an exchange policy for the Poisson base walk. This connects the problem to contextual bandits and gives an information-theoretic sublinear-regret guarantee, but directly learning the exponentially many policies requires exponential time and space. We therefore introduce \emph{balanced fractional exchanges}, which compress the policy mixture into a single fractional base while retaining the exchange information needed by the Poisson analysis. This leads to an polynomial time algorithm with the same regret guarantee.
summary_zh: 从技术层面看，本文将该问题视为泊松基游走的交换策略学习问题。这一设定将该问题与上下文多臂老虎机关联起来，得到了信息论层面的次线性遗憾保证，但直接学习数量呈指数级增长的策略需要指数级的时间与空间开销。为此，本文提出了**平衡分数交换**方法，该方法可将策略混合压缩为单个分数基，同时保留泊松分析所需的全部交换信息，最终得到了具备相同遗憾保证的多项式时间算法。

title: Conditional GraphGANFed: Optimizing Graph-Structured Molecule Generation in Federated Generative Adversarial Networks
title_zh: 条件GraphGANFed（条件图生成对抗联邦网络）：面向联邦生成对抗网络的图结构分子生成优化
authors: Daniel Manu, Abee Alazzwi
abstract: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have garnered considerable attention in molecular discovery for their ability to generate novel and high-quality molecules. To efficiently train a GAN model while preserving data privacy, GraphGANFed has been proposed to incorporate federated learning and graph convolutional networks into GAN. Yet, GraphGANFed cannot produce synthetic molecules that only optimize a user-defined metric(s) to facilitate the new drug discovery process. To address this issue, we introduce a novel extension to GraphGANFed, namely conditional GraphGANFed (cGraphGANFed), by incorporating the critic network to assess generated molecules using user-defined metric(s). The evaluation results from both the critic network and discriminator are integrated into the loss function of the generator, guiding it to generate novel molecules that maintain similar chemical properties to real ones while optimizing user-defined metrics. Extensive simulations are conducted in two scenarios. First, cGraphGANFed endeavors to optimize all seven commonly used metrics, and the results show that cGraphGANFed significantly outperforms GraphGANFed in Validity and LogP, with a slight advantage in QED, across different settings. Second, cGraphGANFed focuses solely on optimizing QED, and the results show that the synthetic molecules produced by cGraphGANFed can achieve more than 10% improvement in QED than GraphGANFed. Also, the results demonstrate cGraphGANFed has enhanced resilience against mode collapses and performance reduction caused by non-IID data.
summary_zh: 生成对抗网络（GAN）因具备生成新颖高质量分子的能力，在分子发现领域受到广泛关注。为在保护数据隐私的前提下高效训练GAN模型，现有研究提出了GraphGANFed（图生成对抗联邦网络），将联邦学习与图卷积网络集成到GAN框架中。但GraphGANFed无法生成仅针对用户自定义指标优化的合成分子，难以满足新药研发流程的需求。为解决该问题，本文对GraphGANFed进行扩展，提出了全新的条件GraphGANFed（cGraphGANFed）方法，引入评判网络通过用户自定义指标对生成分子进行评估，将评判网络与判别器的评估结果共同纳入生成器的损失函数，引导生成器产出既保留与真实分子相近化学性质、又能优化用户自定义指标的新颖分子。本文在两类场景下开展了大量仿真实验：第一类场景中cGraphGANFed针对7种常用指标同时优化，结果显示在不同设置下，cGraphGANFed的有效性和LogP指标表现显著优于GraphGANFed，在QED（药物综合性质定量估计）指标上也略有优势；第二类场景中cGraphGANFed仅针对QED指标优化，结果显示其生成的合成分子QED值相比GraphGANFed提升超过10%。此外实验结果表明，cGraphGANFed对非独立同分布（非IID）数据引发的模式崩溃与性能下降问题具备更强的鲁棒性。

title: Delayed Optimizer-State Transport Shapes Short-Horizon Training Decisions
title_zh: 延迟优化器状态传输塑造短视界训练决策
authors: Jinhui Guo
abstract: Adaptive optimizers retain gradient history in moment variables, allowing a local change in loss weighting to alter later updates. We examine whether this delayed transport is large enough to change prospective short-horizon decisions. On committed future-minibatch sequences, we differentiate eight-step AdamW trajectories through the complete model--optimizer state and select exposure-matched Math--Code loss schedules before independent evaluation. Across 12 unused 0.3M Transformer histories, full transport lowers token-disjoint loss relative to an optimizer-aware immediate derivative in 10/12 histories (mean benefit $4.71\times10^{-4}$; exact one-sided sign test, $p=0.0193$). The two controllers act equally often but select different schedules in 60/96 windows. Crossed checkpoint--future-path tests attribute this reordering to the interaction between optimizer state and near-future data, while an independent Ising--CNN experiment shows that deleting moment-state transport destroys accurate response prediction. Full-transport scores also concentrate exact-rollout winners in larger candidate libraries, focusing finite-amplitude evaluation on a shortlist. On these committed short paths, optimizer memory and near-future data order are therefore actionable components of the training state, providing a mechanism-based criterion for when finite-horizon rather than one-step intervention is required.
summary_zh: 自适应优化器在矩变量中保留梯度历史，使得损失权重的局部变化能够改变后续的更新过程。本文研究这种延迟传输的影响是否足够大，足以改变预期的短视界决策。针对已确定的未来小批量序列，本文通过完整的模型-优化器状态对8步AdamW轨迹进行微分，在开展独立评估前选择曝光匹配的数学-代码损失调度。在12个未使用的0.3M参数量Transformer历史记录中，全传输设置下的令牌不相交损失相比感知优化器的直接导数设置在10/12的历史记录中更低（平均增益为4.71×10^-4；精确单侧符号检验p值为0.0193）。两类控制器的触发频率相当，但在96个窗口中的60个窗口选择了不同的调度方案。跨检查点-未来路径测试表明，这种排序变化源于优化器状态与近未来数据的交互作用，独立的Ising-CNN实验也证实，删除矩状态传输会破坏准确的响应预测。全传输得分还能将精确滚动的优胜结果集中到更大的候选库中，将有限幅度评估聚焦到候选短名单上。因此在这些已确定的短路径上，优化器记忆与近未来数据顺序是训练状态中可利用的组成部分，本文也为判断何时需要有限视界干预而非单步干预提供了基于机制的判别准则。

title: IAPO: Influence-Aware Policy Optimization for Credit Assignment in Multi-Turn Service Agents
title_zh: IAPO（影响力感知策略优化）：面向多轮服务智能体的信用分配方法
authors: Bo Ren, Yirong Mao, Yi Yang, Wenhui Que
abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly solve long-horizon tasks through multi-turn interactions with users and external tools. In these settings, relevant task information often unfolds over time rather than being fully specified at the initial prompt. Service agents make this challenge especially concrete: users may clarify or revise their goals, while tool responses provide information needed for subsequent decisions. Thus, a final reward alone cannot indicate which actions contributed to resolving the task. Recent methods rely on comparative evidence from other trajectories or resampled continuations, or on separately constructed step-level learning signals, to refine credit. However, a completed rollout already records how information and errors flow between agent actions. We introduce Influence-Aware Policy Optimization (IAPO), which represents each rollout as a typed influence-dependency graph over trainable agent actions, with user and tool observations serving as evidence. IAPO converts support-use and failed-use structure into routing weights that redistribute the same trajectory-level advantage. Experiments with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B demonstrate superior performance over multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) baselines across three service-agent benchmarks: {\tau^2}-Bench, UserBench, and AgentChangeBench. BFCL-v4 Multi-Turn further shows that these gains do not compromise multi-turn function-calling performance. This work advances the understanding of credit assignment in multi-turn user interactions and provides a principled approach to training service agents from sparse outcome feedback.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地通过与用户及外部工具的多轮交互来解决长视界任务。这类场景下，相关任务信息通常随时间逐步显现，而非在初始提示中就完全给定。服务智能体场景将这一挑战体现得尤为突出：用户可能会澄清或修正自身目标，而工具返回的响应会为后续决策提供必要信息。因此仅靠最终奖励无法判断哪些动作对任务完成做出了贡献。现有相关方法大多依赖来自其他轨迹的对比证据、重采样的延续序列，或是单独构建的步级学习信号来优化信用分配，但一次完整的滚动过程已经记录了智能体动作之间的信息与误差流动路径。本文提出IAPO（影响力感知策略优化）方法，将每一段滚动过程表示为可训练智能体动作上的类型化影响力依赖图，以用户和工具的观测值作为证据。IAPO将支持使用与失败使用的结构转化为路由权重，对同一轨迹级优势值进行重新分配。在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B模型上开展的实验表明，在三个服务智能体基准测试集{τ²}-Bench、UserBench和AgentChangeBench上，该方法的性能优于多轮强化学习（RL）基线方法，BFCL-v4多轮测试进一步证明，该性能提升不会损害多轮函数调用的表现。本研究深化了学界对多轮用户交互场景下信用分配问题的理解，为基于稀疏结果反馈训练服务智能体提供了一套原则性方案。

title: SeisMamba: Low-Latency Single-Station Seismic Magnitude Estimation for Spatially Distributed Earthquake Early Warning
authors: Quenton Yeo, Zhaoge Bi, Linghan Huang, Luke Stephen Higgins, Flora Salim, Huaming Chen
abstract: Rapid earthquake magnitude estimation is central to earthquake early warning, yet many operational systems depend on dense regional seismic networks and region-specific calibration. This creates a spatial coverage barrier for high-risk areas with sparse sensing infrastructure. Single-station learning offers a lower-cost alternative, but existing models often face an accuracy--latency trade-off and may degrade under regional distribution shift. We present SeisMamba, a lightweight Mamba-based architecture for low-latency magnitude estimation from minimally processed three-component seismic waveforms recorded at a single station. SeisMamba combines hierarchical convolutional encoding, sparse selective state-space modelling, multi-scale feature fusion, and an auxiliary temporal prediction head to support efficient long-sequence waveform analysis. On the STEAD benchmark, SeisMamba achieves the best MSE, RMSE, and $R^2$ among tested baselines while requiring only 0.55 ms for a batch of 32 waveforms on an NVIDIA T4 GPU, making it about three times faster than transformer-based baselines. We further conduct a Chile--Taiwan regional hold-out experiment as a diagnostic test of cross-region deployment, where SeisMamba retains useful performance on geographically unseen seismic regions. These results suggest that selective state-space waveform modelling provides a promising accuracy--latency backbone for spatially distributed, low-cost earthquake early warning.

title: Persistent Cross Entropy
title_zh: 持久交叉熵
authors: Sijin Yeom, Jae-Hun Jung
abstract: Persistent entropy is the Shannon entropy of a persistence-based probability measure defined on a persistence diagram. However, its cross-entropy version is not naturally defined because two persistence diagrams generally have different event spaces. To bridge these event spaces, we combine a similarity function with persistence weighting to define an induced probability. The induced probability reflects information from one diagram on the event space of the other diagram and assigns unexplained probability mass to the unexplained event. Using the induced probability, we extend cross entropy to persistence diagrams, called persistent cross entropy (PCE). We establish the main properties of both the induced probability and PCE and prove stability theorems for both. Through three numerical studies, we show that PCE distinguishes diagrams with the same persistent entropy, separates causal directions in dynamical systems without constructing a joint persistent diagram, and can be used as a directional topology loss for knowledge distillation.
summary_zh: 持久熵是定义在持久图上、基于持久性的概率测度对应的香农熵。但由于两个持久图的事件空间通常不同，其交叉熵版本无法自然定义。为了桥接两类事件空间，本文将相似度函数与持久性加权相结合，定义了诱导概率。该诱导概率能够在一个持久图的事件空间上反映另一个持久图的信息，并将无法解释的概率质量分配给未解释事件。基于该诱导概率，本文将交叉熵扩展到持久图场景，提出了持久交叉熵（PCE）方法。本文推导了诱导概率与PCE的核心性质，证明了二者的稳定性定理。通过三项数值研究，本文验证了PCE可以区分具有相同持久熵的不同持久图，无需构建联合持久图即可分离动力系统中的因果方向，还可作为定向拓扑损失函数用于知识蒸馏任务。

title: From Numerical Simulators of PDEs to Neural Emulators and Back
title_zh: 从偏微分方程数值模拟器到神经仿真器的双向映射研究
authors: Felix Koehler
abstract: Simulation is central to modern engineering and science, but the cost of numerical solvers for partial differential equations (PDEs) remains a bottleneck whenever fast or many-query evaluations are required. Neural emulators trained on solver-generated data promise significant speedups, yet they are usually framed as opaque alternatives to the very methods that produce their training signal. This thesis argues the two paradigms are more alike than different: neural architectures mirror classical discretizations, their errors are amenable to the same spectral analysis, and insight flows profitably in both directions. We approach the relationship by disentangling the multiple roles a solver plays in the emulator learning pipeline. Mode-wise Fourier analysis then provides a common language in which solver errors, architectural inductive biases, and training objectives can all be read off simultaneously. Taken together, this allows synthesizing three contributions. (1) APEBench, a comprehensive benchmarking suite for autoregressive neural emulators of PDEs that uses fast differentiable pseudo-spectral solvers in JAX. (2) Progressively Refined Differentiable Physics, an investigation of the effect of unconverged solvers on surrogate training. (3) Neural Emulator Superiority, an analysis of the influence of numerical errors and architectural inductive biases.
summary_zh: 仿真在现代工程与科学领域中处于核心地位，但当需要快速评估或大量查询时，偏微分方程（PDE）数值求解器的开销始终是瓶颈问题。基于求解器生成数据训练的神经仿真器有望实现显著加速，但现有研究通常将其视为生成自身训练信号的传统数值方法的不透明替代方案。本文指出两类范式的共通性远大于差异性：神经架构可映射到经典离散化方法，二者的误差可采用相同的谱分析方法开展研究，两类范式之间的知识双向流动能够带来增益。本文通过解耦求解器在仿真器学习流水线中承担的多重角色来探究二者的关联，随后采用模态傅里叶分析作为统一框架，可同时对求解器误差、架构归纳偏置与训练目标进行解读。基于上述工作，本文形成了三项研究贡献：（1）APEBench，一套面向PDE自回归神经仿真器的综合基准测试套件，采用基于JAX的快速可微伪谱求解器；（2）渐进式精细化可微物理，针对未收敛求解器对代理模型训练的影响开展的研究；（3）神经仿真器优势分析，针对数值误差与架构归纳偏置的影响开展的分析工作。

title: MoRF-AST: Calibrated Probabilistic Virtual Sensing for Structural Monitoring under Changing Operating Conditions
title_zh: MoRF-AST（带上下文条件仿射扩展传输的模态残差流匹配）：运行工况变化下面向结构监测的校准概率虚拟传感方法
authors: Wingho Feng, Quanwang Li, Ming Zhong, Jingyu Yang, Chen Wang
abstract: Probabilistic full-field reconstruction provides uncertainty-aware response evidence for structural reliability assessment, yet inference from sparse and noisy measurements remains underdetermined. Most existing methods overlook shifts between offline training and operational distributions. Under such shifts, posterior intervals may become miscalibrated, causing the reported uncertainty to lose its probabilistic meaning. This study proposes Modal Residual Flow Matching with Context-Conditioned Affine Spread Transport (MoRF-AST) for calibrated structural virtual sensing under changing operating conditions. MoRF constructs an analytic Gaussian reference posterior in normalized modal coordinates and trains a conditional flow only on posterior-whitened residuals. At deployment, AST estimates response scale from historical measurements at installed sensors and uses gated, mean-preserving Bures-Wasserstein transport to adjust posterior spread. On a bridge-deck benchmark, MoRF achieves a posterior-mean normalized root-mean-square error (NRMSE) of 7.20%, compared with 16.1% and 17.9% for two direct conditional flows. Across eight shifted traffic domains, AST reduces MoRF's cross-domain average coverage error from 0.0535 to 0.0236, a 55.9% reduction, while preserving posterior-mean accuracy. The same transport does not improve the tested alternatives in aggregate, showing that calibration gains require its direction to match the base posterior's dispersion bias. MoRF-AST provides a data-efficient framework for probabilistic full-field reconstruction whose uncertainty remains interpretable under scale-dominated operational distribution shifts. More broadly, this work highlights the need to calibrate uncertainty under changing operational distributions, thereby supporting trustworthy probabilistic modeling and reliability-informed decision-making in civil and infrastructure engineering.
summary_zh: 概率全场重构可为结构可靠性评估提供具备不确定性感知能力的响应依据，但基于稀疏带噪测量的推理问题长期处于欠定状态。现有大多数方法忽略了离线训练分布与运行分布之间的偏移问题，在这类偏移下，后验区间可能出现校准失准，导致报告的不确定性失去概率意义。本研究提出MoRF-AST（带上下文条件仿射扩展传输的模态残差流匹配）方法，可在运行工况变化下实现经过校准的结构虚拟传感。MoRF在归一化模态坐标下构建解析高斯参考后验，仅在后验白化的残差上训练条件流模型。部署阶段，AST通过已安装传感器的历史测量值估计响应尺度，采用门控、保均值的Bures-Wasserstein传输方法调整后验扩展度。在桥面板基准测试集上，MoRF的后验均值归一化均方根误差（NRMSE）为7.20%，对比之下两种直接条件流方法的误差分别为16.1%和17.9%。在8个偏移交通域的测试中，AST将MoRF的跨域平均覆盖误差从0.0535降至0.0236，降幅达55.9%，同时保留了后验均值的精度。该传输方法无法从整体上提升其他对比方法的表现，说明校准增益要求传输方向与基础后验的离散偏差相匹配。MoRF-AST提供了一套数据高效的概率全场重构框架，在以尺度偏移为主的运行分布偏移场景下，其输出的不确定性仍具备可解释性。更广泛地说，本研究强调了在运行分布变化场景下开展不确定性校准的必要性，可为土木与基础设施工程领域的可信概率建模与可靠性导向决策提供支撑。

title: Provable Quantum--Classical Separation for Continuous Gibbs Sampling
title_zh: 连续吉布斯采样的可证量子-经典分离
authors: Enrico Olivucci, Mariia Sobchuk, Sehmimul Hoque, Jeffrey Hnybida, Kyungho W. Kim, Ala Shayeghi, Pooya Ronagh
abstract: We prove the first quantum--classical separation for a sampling problem over a continuous domain. For a class of Gibbs states $p\propto e^{-\beta E}$ on the torus $\mathbb{T}^d$ with smooth ($s$-Gevrey) potential and barrier amplitude $\alpha=e^{\beta\Delta}$, where $\Delta = \max E-\min E$, every classical algorithm---querying the value, gradient, or any higher-order derivatives of the log-density---requires $\Omega(\alpha)$ queries to sample at constant accuracy in total variation distance, while a quantum algorithm based on quantum singular value thresholding and temperature annealing samples with $\tilde{O}\left(\sqrt{\alpha}\right)$ queries to an oracle for the gradient. The advantage is quadratic in the barrier amplitude, which becomes exponential in the dimension, $e^{\Omega(d)}$, at low temperature. The classical bound is information-theoretic, holding for every classical algorithm with query access to the Gibbs potential and its derivatives at any order.
summary_zh: 本文首次证明了连续域采样问题存在量子-经典分离特性。针对定义在环面T^d上、势函数满足s-Gevrey光滑性、势垒幅度α=e^{βΔ}（其中Δ=最大势能-最小势能）的一类吉布斯态p∝e^{-βE}，每一个查询对数密度值、梯度或任意高阶导数的经典算法，若要在全变差距离下达到恒定采样精度，需要Ω(α)次查询；而基于量子奇异值阈值与温度退火的量子算法，仅需对梯度预言机进行Õ(√α)次查询即可完成采样。该优势在势垒幅度上呈二次关系，在低温下维度层面可达到指数级优势e^{Ω(d)}。该经典下界是信息论层面的结果，对任意可查询吉布斯势及其任意阶导数的经典算法均成立。

title: SatDL: Jointly Optimizing Data Redistribution and Training for Satellite-Based Distributed Learning
title_zh: SatDL：面向星载分布式学习的数据重分配与训练联合优化框架
authors: Hao Wu, Kin Whye Chew, Yizhan Han, Han Li, Jingxian Wang
abstract: We present SatDL, a data-redistribution framework designed to minimize total end-to-end learning time. At its core, SatDL develops a Distributor-Critic framework that jointly models and optimizes data-transfer delay and training time. Evaluations through trace-driven simulations of a 1,584-satellite Starlink constellation and hardware emulations using NVIDIA Jetson and A100 GPUs across five datasets show SatDL reduces total end-to-end learning time by up to 18.6% and onboard energy consumption by 12.23-88.00%, while maintaining inference accuracy within a few percentage points of state-of-the-art baselines.
summary_zh: 本文提出了SatDL这一数据重分配框架，旨在最小化端到端总学习时间。该框架的核心是提出了Distributor-Critic（分发器-评判器）架构，可对数据传输延迟与训练时间进行联合建模与优化。基于1584星Starlink星座的轨迹驱动仿真，以及在NVIDIA Jetson与A100 GPU上跨5个数据集的硬件仿真结果表明，SatDL可将端到端总学习时间最高降低18.6%，星载能耗降低12.23%~88.00%，同时推理精度与当前最优基线的差距仅在数个百分点以内。

title: Where Entropy Is Measured Matters: Policy Geometry in Bounded Continuous-Control PPO
title_zh: 熵的测量位置至关重要：有界连续控制近端策略优化（PPO）中的策略几何
authors: Yiyang He, Zhichun Zhou, Ziwei Wang, Tao Xue, Haolin Fei
abstract: Many continuous-control policies are optimized as unbounded Gaussians and then mapped into bounded actions. We show that where entropy is measured changes the policy geometry learned by proximal policy optimization (PPO). In an 80-muscle MyoLeg task, a clipped Gaussian executes 89.07% of actions within 5% of a bound. A same-state decomposition shows that this is not due to variance alone: setting variance to zero still leaves 83.83% of actions near a bound, while 82.12% of state-conditioned means lie outside the executable interval. Replacing clipping with a tanh map does not remove the high-variance regime. For latent Gaussian entropy H(u), the entropy loss has zero gradient with respect to the mean and a constant variance-increasing gradient. For executed-action entropy H(a), the transform Jacobian adds an inward gradient on the mean. Across three matched MyoLeg seeds, near-boundary occupancy is 71.42%, 29.76%, and 18.83% under latent entropy, no entropy, and executed-action entropy. A 38-dimensional Dog-Stand replication with an independent CleanRL-based PPO implementation reproduces the ordering in mean geometry, which also survives shared-state evaluation and boundary margins from 1% to 10%. Direct mean penalties can match or exceed the centering produced by H(a), showing that interior means are not unique to executed entropy. However, matched mean geometry can coexist with substantially different variance and return. Entropy measurement space is therefore a coupled mean-variance design choice, and task return alone does not characterize bounded-policy geometry.
summary_zh: 许多连续控制策略会先被优化为无界高斯分布，再映射到有界动作空间。本文研究表明，熵的测量位置会改变近端策略优化（PPO）学习到的策略几何特征。在包含80块肌肉的MyoLeg任务中，经过裁剪的高斯策略生成的动作有89.07%落在距离动作边界5%的范围内。同状态分解实验表明该现象并非仅由方差导致：将方差置零后仍有83.83%的动作靠近边界，同时82.12%的状态条件均值落在可执行区间之外。用tanh映射替代裁剪操作也无法消除高方差区间。对于隐空间高斯熵H(u)，熵损失对均值的梯度为零，仅存在使方差增大的恒定梯度；对于执行动作熵H(a)，变换雅可比矩阵会为均值引入指向区间内部的梯度。在三组匹配的MyoLeg随机种子下，隐空间熵、无熵约束、执行动作熵三种设置对应的近边界动作占比分别为71.42%、29.76%和18.83%。基于独立实现的CleanRL版PPO在38维Dog-Stand任务上的复现实验，重现了上述均值几何特征的排序规律，该规律在共享状态评估、边界裕度从1%到10%的调整下依然成立。直接对均值施加惩罚可以达到甚至超过H(a)实现的区间中心化效果，说明均值处于动作空间内部并非执行动作熵的独有特性。但匹配的均值几何特征可以与差异极大的方差和任务回报共存。因此熵测量空间是一个同时耦合均值与方差的设计选择，仅靠任务回报无法完整表征有界策略的几何特征。

title: WarpSAC: Towards the Pinnacle of Scalable Off-policy RL by Rethinking Exploration and Exploitation
title_zh: WarpSAC：通过重新审视探索与利用实现可扩展离线强化学习的巅峰性能
authors: Zihao Wu, Hongyao Tang, Yi Ma, Huizhong Song, Pengyi Li, Yifu Yuan, Fei Ni, Jinyi Liu, Wei Wei, Jianrong Wang, Yan Zheng, Jianye Hao
abstract: Based on these findings, we propose WarpSAC, a regime-aware family of off-policy RL algorithms. WarpSAC uses Sample Weight Decay for efficient exploitation and provides two variants: WarpSAC-L (Norm ON, clipped double-Q) for data-limited CPU-scale training, and WarpSAC-A (Norm OFF, single-Q) for data-abundant GPU-parallel training. WarpSAC improves normalized score--step AUC over FlashSAC by 4.5% across nine CPU-scale environments and 23.1% across fourteen GPU-parallel environments. It increases UnitreeG1TransportBox-v1 success rate from 19.8% to 96.4%, improves mean normalized wall-time AUC on MuJoCo Playground by 19.1%, and achieves 36.4% faster sim-to-real deployment on Unitree G1 than FlashSAC. These results show that scalable off-policy RL should adapt its stabilizers to the available data regime.
summary_zh: 基于上述研究结论，本文提出WarpSAC，这是一类感知运行区间的离线强化学习算法族。WarpSAC采用样本权重衰减机制实现高效利用，并提供两个变体：面向数据受限CPU规模训练的WarpSAC-L（开启归一化、裁剪双Q网络），以及面向数据充足GPU并行训练的WarpSAC-A（关闭归一化、单Q网络）。在9个CPU规模环境下，WarpSAC的归一化得分-步长曲线下面积（AUC）相比FlashSAC提升4.5%；在14个GPU并行环境下，该指标提升23.1%。它将UnitreeG1TransportBox-v1任务的成功率从19.8%提升至96.4%，在MuJoCo Playground环境下的平均归一化墙钟时间AUC提升19.1%，在Unitree G1机器人上的 sim-to-real 部署速度比FlashSAC快36.4%。上述结果表明，可扩展离线强化学习应当根据可用数据区间自适应调整自身的稳定器组件。

title: Predictability of El Ni\~no from Delayed Observations
title_zh: 基于延迟观测的厄尔尼诺可预测性研究
authors: Francisco J. Beron-Vera
abstract: Using monthly Ni\~no-3.4 anomalies through July 2026, we investigate how much predictive information is contained in delayed observations of the index. Ridge regression identifies informative delays, while multilayer perceptron and sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) models test whether nonlinear complexity provides additional direct forecast skill; gated recurrent unit (GRU) and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks provide a complementary test in which the temporal representation is learned internally. Delayed observations substantially improve forecasts over persistence and climatology at leads of up to six months, but increasing model complexity provides no systematic improvement. Historical recursive experiments favor a simple explicit SINDy recurrence and select shallow recurrent architectures, with no appreciable gain from learning the temporal representation internally. These results support a compact predictive representation of Ni\~no-3.4 evolution in which the representation of past information is more consequential than model complexity. As a prospective application, the selected models are used to forecast the developing 2026 event beyond the last available observation and to compare its predicted evolution with completed historical El Ni\~no events.
summary_zh: 本文使用截至2026年7月的月际Niño-3.4异常指数，探究该指数的延迟观测值中包含的预测信息量。研究采用岭回归识别具有预测价值的延迟项，通过多层感知机和非线性动力学稀疏辨识（SINDy）模型检验非线性复杂度能否带来额外的直接预测技巧；同时采用门控循环单元（GRU）和长短期记忆网络（LSTM）开展互补测试，这类模型可以在内部自主学习时序表征。在提前期最长为6个月的场景下，延迟观测相比持续性预测和气候态预测可以显著提升预报效果，但提升模型复杂度不会带来系统性的性能改善。历史递归实验更偏好结构简单的显式SINDy递推模型，选择浅层循环架构，从内部自主学习时序表征无法带来可感知的性能增益。上述结果支持Niño-3.4演化存在紧凑预测表征的结论，其中历史信息的表征方式比模型复杂度更为重要。作为前瞻性应用，研究使用筛选得到的模型在最新可用观测之外对2026年正在发展的厄尔尼诺事件进行预测，并将其预测演化路径与已发生的历史厄尔尼诺事件进行对比。

title: Sequential operator learning under dependent data
title_zh: 相依数据下的序贯算子学习
authors: Rafael Oliveira
abstract: Learning operators from sequentially collected data arises in adaptive experimental design, Bayesian optimization, and dynamical-system modelling, where observations may be dependent, and future inputs or sensing operators may depend on preceding data. We derive time-uniform self-normalized concentration bounds for stochastic processes in Hilbert spaces with vector-valued noise. We use these bounds to obtain regression-error guarantees for linear operators, including targets outside the Hilbert estimation space, and for nonlinear parametric operators trained with strongly convex losses and regularizers. Our results allow possibly infinite-dimensional inputs and outputs without independence or mixing assumptions, providing a major step towards convergence guarantees for adaptive operator learning and learning from stochastic dynamical data.
summary_zh: 从序贯采集数据中学习算子的场景广泛存在于自适应实验设计、贝叶斯优化和动力学系统建模领域，这类场景下的观测值可能存在相依性，后续的输入或传感算子可能依赖于之前采集的数据。本文针对带向量值噪声的希尔伯特空间随机过程，推导了时间一致的自归一化集中边界。利用这些边界，本文得到了线性算子的回归误差保证，覆盖希尔伯特估计空间之外的目标，同时也得到了采用强凸损失和正则项训练的非线性参数化算子的回归误差保证。本文的结果允许输入和输出为任意无限维，且无需独立性或混合假设，为自适应算子学习和随机动力学数据学习的收敛性保证研究迈出了重要一步。

title: When Does Self-Supervised Pretraining Help Tabular Models? A Study of Label Scarcity and Missing Data
title_zh: 自监督预训练何时有益于表格模型？针对标签稀缺与缺失数据的研究
authors: Sahand Mazrouei
abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising approach for tabular data, yet its efficacy under extreme label scarcity and test-time missingness remains under-explored. In this paper, we evaluate a mask-and-recover SSL pretraining objective against training from scratch and classical baselines across 14 diverse classification tasks. First, while SSL outperforms training from scratch on average and remains competitive with state-of-the-art tree ensembles (achieving ~0.8954 AUC vs. Random Forest's 0.9015 at 10% labels), the SSL-vs-scratch gains exhibit high inter-task variance and lack significance (p = 0.626 at both 5% and 10% labels). Second, contrary to the hypothesis that missing-value imputation objectives universally benefit datasets with native missingness, SSL yields the most reliable improvements on clean datasets, while frequently degrading performance on datasets with high inherent missingness. Third, despite this training variance, SSL-pretrained models achieve a higher average AUC than scratch-trained models under both test-time missingness completely at random (MCAR) injection (+0.0245 AUC, positive on 11 of 14 tasks) and structured missingness shifts (MNAR, +0.0418 AUC, positive on 8 of 14 tasks), though neither difference remains statistically significant after Holm-Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons (adjusted p = 0.118 and p = 0.518, respectively). Fourth, comparing our mask-and-recover objective against three established tabular SSL baselines (VIME, SCARF, SubTab) under an identical encoder architecture, we find no significant difference from any of them (adjusted p = 0.459, p = 1.000, p = 1.000), indicating our findings reflect general properties of tabular SSL rather than idiosyncrasies of one particular pretext task.
summary_zh: 自监督学习（SSL）已成为表格数据领域极具潜力的技术路径，但它在极端标签稀缺和测试时数据缺失场景下的有效性仍有待深入探索。本文在14个不同的分类任务上，将掩码恢复式SSL预训练目标与从零开始训练、经典基线方法进行对比评估。首先，虽然SSL平均性能优于从零开始训练，且与当前最优的树集成模型性能相当（在标签占比10%时AUC可达0.8954，与随机森林的0.9015接近），但SSL相对从零训练的性能增益在不同任务间差异极大，且不具备统计显著性（标签占比5%和10%时p值均为0.626）。其次，与“缺失值插补目标会天然对存在原生缺失的数据集更友好”的假设相反，SSL在干净数据集上能带来最可靠的性能提升，反而经常在原生缺失率高的数据集上造成性能下降。第三，尽管存在上述训练方差，在测试时注入完全随机缺失（MCAR）的场景下，SSL预训练模型的平均AUC比从零训练模型高0.0245，14个任务中有11个任务性能为正；在结构化缺失偏移（MNAR）场景下，平均AUC高0.0418，14个任务中有8个任务性能为正。但经过多重比较的Holm-Bonferroni校正后，两种场景下的性能差异均不再具备统计显著性（校正后p值分别为0.118和0.518）。第四，在完全相同的编码器架构下，将本文的掩码恢复目标与三种主流表格SSL基线方法（VIME、SCARF、SubTab）对比，发现性能不存在显著差异（校正后p值分别为0.459、1.000、1.000），说明本文得到的结论反映了表格SSL的通用属性，而非某一种特定前置任务的独有特性。

title: A Structural FHMM for Interpretable Disease Trajectories in T2DM
title_zh: 面向2型糖尿病（T2DM）可解释疾病轨迹的结构化因子隐马尔可夫模型（FHMM）
authors: Alessandro Mari, Ekaterina Krymova, Guillaume Obozinski, Maria Luisa Marques de Sa Faquetti, Adrian Martinez de la Torre, Andrea Burden
abstract: In this work, we propose a structural variant of the Factorial Hidden Markov Model (FHMM) for the analysis of disease trajectories in patients with Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). The model represents a patient's latent health state as a combination of multiple independent, simultaneously evolving components, associated with comorbidities and lab results. This structured latent representation facilitates the identification of clinically meaningful patient states and clustering of common disease trajectories. We evaluate the proposed approach using The IQVIA Medical Research Data incorporating data from THIN, a Cegedim database of anonymized electronic health records (EHR), identifying patients with a first-ever prescription for a non-insulin antidiabetic drug (NIAD) between January 2006 and December 2019. The model identifies multiple clinically coherent latent components corresponding to known patterns of diabetes-related complications and reveals heterogeneous progression pathways, including distinct microvascular-dominant and multi-organ trajectories associated with elevated comorbidity burden and mortality. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework captures meaningful longitudinal structure in EHR data and provides interpretable insights into the evolution of T2DM and its comorbidities.
summary_zh: 本研究提出因子隐马尔可夫模型（FHMM）的一个结构化变体，用于分析2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者的疾病轨迹。该模型将患者的潜在健康状态表示为多个独立、同步演化的组件的组合，这些组件分别对应不同的合并症和实验室检验结果。这种结构化潜在表征可以辅助识别临床意义明确的患者状态，对常见疾病轨迹进行聚类。研究采用IQVIA医疗研究数据（整合自Cegedim旗下匿名化电子健康记录数据库THIN）开展评估，筛选出2006年1月至2019年12月期间首次开具非胰岛素类降糖药（NIAD）处方的患者。该模型识别出多个临床逻辑自洽的潜在组件，对应已知的糖尿病相关并发症模式，同时揭示了异质性的疾病进展路径，包括以微血管病变为主的轨迹、与合并症负担升高和死亡率上升相关的多器官病变轨迹。上述结果表明，本文提出的框架可以有效捕捉电子健康记录（EHR）数据中具有临床意义的纵向结构，为理解2型糖尿病及其合并症的演化规律提供可解释的洞见。

title: Causal Analysis for Time Series Foundation Models
title_zh: 时间序列基础模型的因果分析
authors: Mathis Jander, Wouter van Heeswijk, Martijn Mes
abstract: Transitioning from bespoke time series models towards time series foundation models changes the relationship of model and application from one-to-one to one-to-many. This shift introduces concentration risk as many, potentially high-risk, forecasting applications are exposed to the same biases and failure modes of a single time series foundation model. At the same time, this centralization allows for economies of scale in model development and validation. In this study we investigate how biases and failure modes of time series foundation models can be identified before deployment. We propose a causal analysis framework to investigate the ability of a time series foundation model to preserve time series patterns. To achieve this, we intervene on parameterized synthetic time series generators and measure the corresponding change in model output under ceteris paribus conditions. We apply our causal analysis framework to Chronos-2 and TimesFM-2.5 and test them across six distinct time series patterns. We find safe configurations for trend and harmonic oscillation patterns. The results also indicate a bias in both models towards overestimating persistence, sudden failures for both models against the regime switch pattern and failure for TimesFM-2.5 against the energy-release pattern. Our review of the original works for both models indicates that the findings might be explained by the data used for pretraining. We conclude our study with suggestions for further model development, recommendations for application-specific model selection, and a discussion of limitations and further research directions.
summary_zh: 从定制化时间序列模型转向时间序列基础模型，使得模型与应用的关系从一对一变为一对多。这种转变引入了集中风险：大量可能属于高风险场景的预测应用，都会暴露于同一个时间序列基础模型的相同偏差和失效模式下。与此同时，这种中心化也为模型开发和验证带来了规模经济效应。本研究探索如何在部署前识别时间序列基础模型的偏差和失效模式，提出一套因果分析框架，用于评估时间序列基础模型保留时序模式的能力。为实现该目标，研究对参数化合成时间序列生成器施加干预，在其他条件完全不变的前提下测量模型输出的对应变化。将该因果分析框架应用于Chronos-2和TimesFM-2.5两个模型，在6种不同的时间序列模式上开展测试，得到了趋势模式和谐波振荡模式的安全配置。结果同时表明，两个模型都存在高估持续性的偏差，在面对状态切换模式时都会突发失效，而TimesFM-2.5在面对能量释放模式时也会失效。对两个模型原始论文的回溯表明，上述发现可以通过预训练使用的数据集特性解释。本研究最后给出了模型后续开发的建议、面向特定应用的模型选型指南，同时讨论了研究的局限性和未来的研究方向。

title: Validation of HRV Studio: A Transparent and Quality-Control-Aware Platform for Heart Rate Variability Analysis
title_zh: HRV Studio验证：面向心率变异性（HRV）分析的透明化、支持质量控制的平台
authors: Cyrus Mexon Evrard Djindot, Faliang Liu, Sylvain Laborde, Yinjia Zhang, Jessie Chen, Ming Li, Congrong Wang, Weixiong Rao, Qinpei Zhao
abstract: Reproducibility of heart rate variability (HRV) analysis is limited by differences in preprocessing and computational conventions across software platforms. We developed HRV Studio, an open-source PyQt6-based desktop application integrating transparent HRV analysis with automated quality-control (QC) diagnostics. Validation included large-scale agreement with NeuroKit2, targeted Kubios benchmarking, spectral-method comparison, synthetic perturbation testing, recording-duration sensitivity analysis, and arrhythmia-focused QC stress testing. HRV Studio showed near-identical agreement for the widely used time-domain indices RMSSD and SDNN under matched conditions. In the primary five-minute NeuroKit2 comparison, frequency-domain median relative errors were 1.35% for LF, 0.18% for HF, and 1.41% for LF/HF, while VLF remained more convention-sensitive (37.79%). Nonlinear Poincar\'e indices also demonstrated high consistency. Sequence-harmonized Kubios benchmarking confirmed near-identical agreement for time-domain and nonlinear indices and strong agreement for most frequency-domain measures. Extended ten-minute analyses reproduced the same overall pattern with lower disagreement for some convention-sensitive spectral outputs. Synthetic and arrhythmia stress tests maintained 100% numerical stability while consistently triggering QC warnings. Overall, HRV Studio provides a transparent and reproducible platform for HRV research, with strong cross-platform consistency when NN sequences, preprocessing, and analytical conventions are harmonized. Stress-test results indicate computational robustness rather than clinical validation.
summary_zh: 不同软件平台的预处理和计算规则差异，限制了心率变异性（HRV）分析的可复现性。本文开发了HRV Studio，这是一款基于PyQt6的开源桌面应用，整合了透明化HRV分析功能与自动化质量控制（QC）诊断模块。验证环节包括与NeuroKit2的大规模一致性对比、针对Kubios的基准测试、谱分析方法对比、合成扰动测试、记录时长敏感性分析，以及面向心律失常的QC压力测试。在条件匹配的前提下，HRV Studio与对比工具在广泛使用的时域指标RMSSD和SDNN上几乎完全一致。在5分钟时长的NeuroKit2主对比实验中，频域指标LF的中位相对误差为1.35%，HF为0.18%，LF/HF为1.41%，仅VLF指标对计算规则更敏感，相对误差为37.79%。非线性庞加莱指标也表现出极高的一致性。经过序列对齐的Kubios基准测试证实，时域指标和非线性指标几乎完全一致，大多数频域指标也表现出强一致性。扩展的10分钟时长分析复现了整体规律，部分对规则敏感的谱输出的不一致程度进一步降低。合成扰动测试和心律失常压力测试中，平台始终保持100%的数值稳定性，且能正确触发对应的QC警告。总体而言，HRV Studio为HRV研究提供了透明、可复现的平台，在NN序列、预处理流程和分析规则对齐的前提下，跨平台一致性表现优异。压力测试结果验证了平台的计算鲁棒性，本研究未涉及临床有效性验证。

title: A Theory of Finite-Noise Optima and Generalization in Quantum Machine Learning
title_zh: 量子机器学习中的有限噪声最优解与泛化性理论
authors: Ziyu Zhang, Zikang Jia, Xiaosong Li, Yulong Dong
abstract: Quantum noise is expected to degrade quantum machine learning by driving circuits away from their noiseless implementations. Yet recent studies show moderate noise can reduce testing error, a behavior unexplained by weak-noise perturbative error accumulation or strong-noise trainability collapse. Here we develop a statistical learning theory connecting microscopic noise processes to macroscopic learning performance. At its heart is a noise-order purity parameter, derived from a surrogate model analysis, that predicts the noise-induced reduction in model complexity and the consequent reduction in the generalization gap. Noise simultaneously increases prediction bias. Their competition explains the intermediate-noise regime left open between these limits. It produces a finite-noise optimum whose location depends on the learning setup and can disappear in the large-sample limit. Numerical experiments validate these predictions. Noise programming can move a model towards this optimum. These results make the non-monotonic effect of noise predictable and provide a route to harness it.
summary_zh: 通常认为量子噪声会使量子电路偏离无噪声实现，进而降低量子机器学习的性能。但近期研究表明，中等强度的噪声反而可以降低测试误差，这种现象无法用弱噪声微扰误差累积或强噪声可训练性坍塌理论解释。本文建立了一套统计学习理论，将微观噪声过程与宏观学习性能关联起来。该理论的核心是从替代模型分析中推导得到的噪声阶纯度参数，该参数可以预测噪声引发的模型复杂度下降，以及随之而来的泛化间隙缩小。同时噪声也会增大预测偏差，偏差与泛化间隙的竞争关系解释了上述两种极限场景之间的中等噪声区间，该区间存在一个有限噪声最优解，其位置取决于学习设置，且在大样本极限下会消失。数值实验验证了上述所有预测，通过噪声编程可以将模型调整到该最优解附近。这些结论使得噪声的非单调效应变得可预测，为利用该效应提供了可行路径。

title: A Data-dependent Early Stopping Rule using Rademacher Complexity with L1-norm
title_zh: 基于L1范数拉德马赫复杂度（RC）的数据依赖型早停规则
authors: Duy Hoang, Bastien Berret, Olivier Bruneau, Laurent Fribourg
abstract: Training neural networks requires balancing the trade-off between fitting the training data and achieving robust performance on unseen inputs. This ability, commonly referred to as generalizability, is determined by the gap between the empirical risk on the training set (``empirical loss'') and the expected risk over the data distribution (``generalization error''). Existing approaches typically estimate the generalization error numerically, requiring gradient descent training and an ``early stopping'' strategy. In this work, we introduce an analytic framework that estimates the optimal time of early stopping without the need for training. Several works in the literature also give such analytical estimations, but they are generally based on random matrix theory and often make assumptions on the distribution of the data or the eigenvalue distribution of the covariance matrix. In contrast, our work is based on Rademacher complexity (RC) without needing such probabilistic assumptions. For both theoretical and numerical reasons, it is more relevant to express RC with the L1- norm rather than with the L2-norm. We focus on the case of linear models and the problem of linear regression. Thanks to the ``linear probing'' method, our results can, however, be successfully applied to nonlinear neural networks, as illustrated in the classification MNIST example.
summary_zh: 训练神经网络需要在拟合训练数据和在未见输入上获得鲁棒性能之间做好权衡，这种能力通常被称为泛化性，由训练集上的经验风险（经验损失）和数据分布上的期望风险（泛化误差）之间的差距决定。现有方法通常采用数值方式估计泛化误差，依赖梯度下降训练和“早停”策略。本文提出一套解析框架，无需实际训练即可估计最优早停时刻。现有部分文献也提出了类似的解析估计方法，但这类方法通常基于随机矩阵理论，往往需要对数据分布或协方差矩阵的特征值分布做出假设。与之不同，本文的方法基于拉德马赫复杂度（RC），无需这类概率假设。出于理论和数值层面的多重考虑，用L1范数表示RC比用L2范数更符合实际需求。本文聚焦线性模型和线性回归问题，借助“线性探测”方法，本文的结果可以成功推广到非线性神经网络，文中基于MNIST分类任务的示例验证了这一点。

title: PRQ-KMeans: Projection Residual Quantization for Semantic ID Tokenization
title_zh: PRQ-KMeans：面向语义ID令牌化的投影残差量化方法
authors: Yunxiao Luo, Siyuan Wang, Ben Chen, Chenyi Lei
abstract: Semantic identifiers (SIDs) represent entities as hierarchical token sequences for generative retrieval and recommendation. Residual-quantization tokenizers construct these sequences by selecting a codeword at each level and passing a residual to the next. We view this process as progressive commonality removal: each token captures a component shared within its group, while later tokens should model the remaining differences. This view reveals three limitations: a corpus-wide shared component can consume first-level capacity, hard assignment ignores graded similarities to nearby codewords, and full-codeword subtraction can leave variation along the selected-codeword direction in the next residual. We therefore develop our solution in the post-hoc setting, where residual construction is not constrained by input reconstruction. Specifically, we propose PRQ-KMeans, which removes the global-mean component, refines centroids with Top-k similarity-weighted updates, and replaces full-codeword subtraction with a projection residual that removes each representation's selected-centroid component. Experiments on a large-scale industrial search dataset and four public recommendation benchmarks show that PRQ-KMeans achieves the strongest overall performance among the evaluated tokenizers, including gains of up to 7.4% in HitRate and 11.8% in MRR on the industrial dataset.
summary_zh: 语义标识符（SIDs）将实体表示为分层令牌序列，用于生成式检索与推荐场景。残差量化分词器通过在每一层选择一个码字并将残差传递到下一层来构建上述序列。本文将该过程视为渐进共性移除：每个令牌捕获其组内共享的组件，后续令牌则对剩余差异进行建模。该视角揭示了现有方法的三点局限：语料库级全局共享组件会占用第一层的容量、硬分配忽略了与邻近码字的分级相似度、全码字减法会导致下一个残差中仍保留所选码字方向的变异。因此本文在残差构建不受输入重构约束的事后场景下提出解决方案，具体提出PRQ-KMeans算法：移除全局均值组件、采用Top-k相似度加权更新优化质心、用可移除每个表征对应所选质心组件的投影残差替代全码字减法。在大规模工业搜索数据集与4个公开推荐基准上的实验表明，PRQ-KMeans在所有参评分词器中整体性能最优，在工业数据集上的命中率（HitRate）最高提升7.4%，平均倒数排名（MRR）最高提升11.8%。

title: A Heterogeneous Mixture of Experts Framework for Interpretable Machine Learning
title_zh: 面向可解释机器学习的异构混合专家框架
authors: Soham Chatterjee, Rwitobroto Dey, Smarajit Bose
abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models provide a flexible framework for partitioning complex prediction problems into simpler local learning tasks through an input-dependent gating mechanism. Existing interpretable MoE approaches, such as Mixture of Decision Trees (MoDT), achieve transparency by employing homogeneous decision-tree experts, but this restricts the model to a single inductive bias across all regions of the feature space. We extend the MoDT framework by introducing heterogeneous expert families comprising decision trees, linear support vector machines, and quadratic discriminant analysis under a common probabilistic gating mechanism. To ensure coherent likelihood-based inference, non-probabilistic experts are calibrated to produce conditional class probabilities, allowing parameter estimation within the generalized Expectation-Maximization framework of MoDT. We further establish theoretical monotone ascent guarantees for the proposed heterogeneous gating updates, providing a justification for the optimization procedure. Experiments on a diverse collection of synthetic and real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework adaptively specializes experts according to local data geometry, yielding interpretable expert assignments while achieving predictive performance competitive with homogeneous MoDT and Random Forests. The proposed approach combines interpretability, adaptive inductive bias selection, and probabilistic coherence within a unified mixture-of-experts framework.
summary_zh: 混合专家（MoE）模型提供了灵活框架，可通过依赖输入的门控机制将复杂预测问题拆分为更简单的局部学习任务。现有可解释MoE方法例如决策树混合模型（MoDT），通过采用同质决策树专家实现透明性，但这会限制模型在特征空间所有区域只能使用单一归纳偏置。本文扩展MoDT框架，在统一概率门控机制下引入由决策树、线性支持向量机、二次判别分析组成的异构专家族。为保证基于似然的推理一致性，本文对非概率类专家进行校准以输出条件类别概率，使得参数估计可在MoDT的广义期望最大化框架内完成。本文进一步为所提异构门控更新建立了理论单调上升保证，为优化流程提供了理论依据。在多类合成与真实基准数据集上的实验表明，所提框架可根据局部数据几何特征自适应分配专家，在输出可解释专家分配结果的同时，预测性能可与同质MoDT及随机森林相媲美。该方法在统一混合专家框架内融合了可解释性、自适应归纳偏置选择与概率一致性三大特性。

title: From Relaxed Indexability to Exact Indexability: A $t$-Step Approach for Partially Observable Restless Bandits
title_zh: 从松弛可索引性到精确可索引性：面向部分可观测不安定摇臂问题的t步方法
authors: Qizhen Jia, Keqin Liu
abstract: We extend this framework to a \emph{$t$-step lookahead threshold policy}. For each subsidy $m$, the threshold is defined by the active-minus-passive advantage under $t$-step finite-horizon value iteration. At $t=1$, the threshold is $m$-independent and recovers the linear threshold of Liu [10]; for $t>1$, it becomes subsidy-dependent through the induced first-crossing structure and tracks the exact decision boundary more closely. The proposed algorithm does not require indexability as an input and includes an indexability verification. Under the original Whittle indexability, we prove that the $t$-step approximate Whittle index converges geometrically to the exact Whittle index, \[ |\widehat W_t(\omega)-W(\omega)|=O(\beta^t). \] Numerically, all 2,715 tested three-state instances are verified as indexable according to the proposed criterion. The P95 index error decreases from $2.18\times10^{-2}$ at $t=1$ to $8.93\times10^{-4}$ at $t=8$. In an exact-comparable instance with $\beta=0.9999$, $t=2$ already recovers the exact Whittle-index ordering. Moderate-depth threshold policies also outperform the one-step baseline and remain close to the optimal dynamic-programming benchmark, while runtime grows mildly with $t$.
summary_zh: 本文将现有框架扩展为t步前瞻阈值策略。对于每个补贴值m，阈值由t步有限时域值迭代下的动作-非动作优势差定义。当t=1时，阈值与m无关，可还原Liu[10]提出的线性阈值；当t>1时，阈值会通过诱导的首达结构随补贴值变化，更贴近精确决策边界。所提算法无需将可索引性作为输入，内置可索引性验证环节。在原始惠特尔（Whittle）可索引性条件下，本文证明t步近似惠特尔索引以几何速率收敛于精确惠特尔索引，满足$|\widehat W_t(\omega)-W(\omega)|=O(\beta^t)$。数值实验中，所有2715个测试三状态实例均通过所提标准验证为可索引，95分位索引误差从t=1时的$2.18\times10^{-2}$降至t=8时的$8.93\times10^{-4}$。在$\beta=0.9999$的精确可比实例中，t=2即可还原精确惠特尔索引排序。中等深度阈值策略的表现优于单步基线，接近最优动态规划基准，且运行时间随t仅呈温和增长。

title: Robust Data-Collection Policy Learning for Low-Variance Online Policy Evaluation
title_zh: 面向低方差在线策略评估的鲁棒数据收集策略学习
