authors: Claire Chen, Shuze Daniel Liu, Licheng Luo, Rohan Chandra, Nan Jiang, Shangtong Zhang
abstract: In reinforcement learning policy evaluation, classic on-policy methods often suffer from high variance when estimating policy performance. To mitigate this issue, behavior policy search has been proposed to learn data-collecting policies tailored to reduce online evaluation variance. However, these approaches do not account for uncertainties in the transition functions. In practice, simulator transitions often differ from the real world due to modeling errors or approximation limitations. As a result, behavior policies trained in simulation may still yield high variance when deployed in real environments, leading to costly reliance on real-world evaluation samples. In this work, we propose a double-loop gradient-based algorithm for learning behavior policies that are both efficient and robust to transition uncertainty. Theoretically, we derive novel transition-variance gradient expressions and establish global convergence guarantees for the algorithm. Numerically, we demonstrate that our method is less sensitive to transition perturbations than existing approaches, providing supportive evidence for its practical utility.
summary_zh: 在强化学习策略评估场景中，经典同策略方法估计策略性能时往往存在方差过高的问题。为缓解该问题，现有研究提出行为策略搜索方法，学习专门用于降低在线评估方差的数据收集策略。但这类方法未考虑转移函数的不确定性。实际场景中，受建模误差与近似限制，模拟器转移过程往往与真实环境存在偏差，导致在仿真环境中训练的行为策略部署到真实环境后仍会产生高方差，需要依赖成本高昂的真实世界评估样本。本文提出一种基于双循环梯度的算法，用于学习兼具高效性与转移不确定性鲁棒性的行为策略。理论层面，本文推导了全新的转移方差梯度表达式，证明了算法的全局收敛性。数值实验表明，相比现有方法，本文所提方法对转移扰动的敏感度更低，验证了其实际应用价值。

title: Steering Recurrent Reasoners at Inference Time with Readout Feedback
title_zh: 诈骗电话剖析：10000通真实诈骗与骚扰电话揭示的电话诈骗分子运作模式
authors: Shunsuke Kamiya, Masanori Koyama, Seongcheol Jeong, Fumiya Uchiyama, Kenji Kubo, Kohei Hayashi, Masahiro Suzuki, Yutaka Matsuo
abstract: Recurrent models, which repeatedly update latent states with shared computation blocks, have emerged as powerful architectures for solving complex reasoning tasks. Existing inference-time methods scale computation by running more steps or sampling more trajectories, but ignore information revealed within each trajectory. Here we show that recurrent models can be improved at inference time by using their own readout probabilities to steer latent dynamics without retraining. We introduce Readout Feedback (RoFB), a test-time intervention that converts intermediate predictions into token-wise pairwise coupling forces injected into the latent dynamics. Across three recurrent models (AKOrN, ItrSA++, TRM) on Sudoku and Maze, RoFB yields clear gains in four of six model-task pairs, achieving performance unattainable by merely running more steps or selecting from multiple trajectories, at comparable or lower computational cost. These results suggest that closed-loop steering of latent dynamics can serve as a complementary inference-time control mechanism for recurrent reasoning models.
summary_zh: 电话诈骗泛滥且造成巨大损失，但大规模场景下其内部运作机制极少被观测。本文分析了由AI语音代理蜜罐在54天内收集的完整语料库，包含10211通呼入诈骗与骚扰电话，共计913小时音频、来自5780个不同号码的330956条转录对话轮次，该蜜罐可接听来电并引导通话持续，相关数据已在配套数据描述论文中公开。本文将直接骗取敏感信息的纯诈骗行为，与为前者引流、规模更大的掠夺性合法获客行为（即“骚扰电话”）区分开来。研究发现诈骗运营存在固定办公时间：工作日的通话量是周末的6.6倍；数千个 disposable 号码运行少量循环复用的脚本，共识别出30个开场话术簇，流量占比最高的前5个簇覆盖了一半通话；诈骗分子索要身份锚点（家庭住址、出生日期）的频率远高于支付凭证，其施压手段主要依靠持续纠缠与伪造权威身份，而非公开威胁。核心实验探究接听对象是否会影响诈骗行为：每一个引流线索都随机分配了10个虚构身份中的一个，诈骗分子接触到的身份在通话发起前就已固定。在1823通随机通话样本中，诈骗分子与目标的表观年龄每相差10岁，平均多消耗15%的对话轮次（比率比1.15，95% CI 1.08-1.23；随机化检验p=0.005），但诈骗分子索要的信息类型没有变化：26.3%的通话最终提出敏感信息索要请求，每增加10岁的优势比为0.99，95% CI 0.90-1.08。第二个实验将早期检测作为基准：在通话者不相交的划分下，仅通过诈骗分子的开场话术，第一句的ROC-AUC即可达0.72，到第八句时可达0.87，简单的词袋分类器性能可与微调后的端侧语言模型相媲美。研究表明电话诈骗是高度模板化的产业，其会根据目标调整投入精力的多少，但索要的核心目标始终不变。

title: Anatomy of a Scam Call: What 10,000 real scam and spam calls reveal about how phone scammers operate
authors: Ethan Traister, Ankit Raj, Jiaqi Gan, Xingyu Shen, Tyler Wu, Yuchen Zhou, Tommy Duong, Kidus Zewde, Siying Chen, Simiao Ren
abstract: Telephone fraud is pervasive and costly, but its inner workings are rarely observed at scale. We analyze a complete corpus of 10,211 inbound scam and spam calls -- 913 hours of audio and 330,956 transcribed turns from 5,780 distinct numbers -- collected over 54 days by an AI voice-agent honeypot that answered callers and kept them talking, and introduced in a companion data descriptor. We separate outright scams, which solicit sensitive information, from the larger stream of predatory but legal lead generation ("spam") that feeds them. Scam operations keep office hours (6.6x more calls per weekday than weekend day); thousands of disposable numbers run a small catalog of recycled scripts (thirty opening clusters, half the traffic in the top five); and callers solicit identity anchors -- a home address and a date of birth -- far more often than payment credentials, pressing through persistence and manufactured authority rather than overt threats. Our central experiment asks: does it matter who picks up? Every seeded lead carried one of ten fictitious identities drawn uniformly at random, so the identity a fraud operation reaches is fixed before the caller exists. Across 1,823 randomized calls, scammers spent about 15% more conversational turns per decade of the target's apparent age (rate ratio 1.15, 95% CI 1.08-1.23; randomization p = 0.005) -- yet what they asked for did not change (26.3% of calls reached a request for sensitive information; odds ratio 0.99 per decade, 95% CI 0.90-1.08). A second experiment casts early detection as a benchmark: from a scammer's opening lines alone, on a caller-disjoint split, escalation is predictable at 0.72 ROC-AUC from the first line and 0.87 by the eighth, and a plain bag-of-words classifier matches a fine-tuned on-device language model. Telephone fraud emerges as a templated industry that varies how hard it works a target, but not what it wants.

title: A mesh-free multiresolution deep energy method with phase-field modeling of brittle fracture
title_zh: 面向脆性断裂相场建模的无网格多分辨率深度能量法
authors: Han Zhang, Mehrisadat Makki Alamdari, Babak Shahbodagh, Mohammad Vahab, Cosmin Anitescu, Timon Rabczuk, Elena Atroshchenko
abstract: Phase-field modeling of brittle fracture removes the need to track cracks explicitly by recasting their evolution as the minimization of an energy functional. In return it requires a discretization dense enough to resolve a localization band whose width is set by a regularization length and whose path is not known in advance. We propose a mesh-free discretization in which a single neural network represents the displacement and phase fields and is trained by minimizing the incremental energy directly. The coordinates enter the network through a multiresolution feature encoding built from $C^1$ quadratic B-spline grids, so the finest scale the representation can express is set by choice rather than reached through slow training, and the energy is estimated by stratified Monte Carlo integration on points redrawn at every optimizer iteration. This pairing proves critical, since the crack fails to advance both when the integration points are held fixed and when the encoding is too coarse to represent the band, while each ingredient tolerates a wide range of settings once the other is in place. Because the representation is globally $C^1$, the second- and the fourth-order fracture energy densities run on the identical discretization. Across six problems, from single-edge-notched tension and shear to a thick-walled ring on a single spline patch, the computed load-displacement curves follow staggered finite element references at matched regularization length, with peak loads within about 1% on the single-edge-notched tests and within 8% where the crack pattern changes topology. On a public benchmark dataset of random multi-crack configurations the method classifies the active or dormant state of 90% of the seeded cracks in twenty zero-shot runs, where the deep Ritz baseline of the dataset authors fails.
summary_zh: 脆性断裂相场建模将裂纹演化重构为能量泛函最小化问题，无需显式追踪裂纹。但该方法要求离散化精度足够高，以解析宽度由正则化长度决定、路径未知的局部化带。本文提出一种无网格离散方法，用单个神经网络同时表征位移场与相场，直接通过最小化增量能量完成训练。网络的坐标输入通过基于C1连续二次B样条网格构建的多分辨率特征编码实现，因此表征可表达的最细尺度可人为选择，无需经过缓慢训练过程逐步达到；能量通过分层蒙特卡洛积分估计，每轮优化迭代都会重新采样积分点。上述组合设计至关重要：若积分点固定、或编码精度不足以表征局部化带，裂纹都无法正常扩展，两个组件互相适配后，各自均可在较大参数设置范围内稳定工作。由于表征全局满足C1连续，二阶与四阶断裂能量密度可在同一离散化方案上计算。在6个测试问题（从单边缺口拉伸、剪切到单样条补丁上的厚壁环场景）中，计算得到的载荷-位移曲线与正则化长度匹配的交错有限元参考结果吻合，单边缺口测试的峰值载荷误差约1%，裂纹拓扑发生变化的场景误差在8%以内。在随机多裂纹配置的公开基准数据集上，本文方法在20次零样本运行中可正确分类90%预置裂纹的激活/休眠状态，而数据集作者提出的深度里兹基线方法无法实现该性能。

title: qshap: Fast Shapley Decomposition of $R^2$ for Gradient-Boosted Trees
title_zh: qshap：梯度提升树R²值的快速沙普利分解方法
authors: Zhongli Jiang, Min Zhang, Dabao Zhang
abstract: Numerous methods have been developed to quantify feature attributions in individual predictions for tree ensembles. However, many applications require global measures of feature contributions to overall model performance. Although local attribution scores can be aggregated to characterize feature importance, such summaries do not directly decompose measures of predictive performance, such as $R^2$. This article introduces qshap, available in both R and Python, which provides Shapley decomposition of $R^2$ values for gradient-boosted decision trees (GBDTs) to quantify feature-specific contributions to model performance. By decomposing the quadratic loss of individual observations, qshap provides flexible tools to explore the importance of individual features and observations. qshap currently supports widely used GBDT implementations, including xgboost, lightgbm, and catboost, through a unified tree representation and efficient C++ backends. Its modular design can accommodate other GBDT implementations built from binary decision trees. In addition, we introduce a specialized backend for oblivious trees that exploits their symmetric structure to substantially accelerate computation.
summary_zh: 目前学界已提出大量方法用于量化树集成模型单条预测的特征贡献度，但诸多应用场景需要衡量特征对整体模型性能的全局贡献度。尽管可通过聚合局部归因分数得到特征重要性，但这类汇总结果无法直接分解R²等预测性能指标。本文提出qshap工具包，同时支持R与Python环境，可为梯度提升决策树（GBDT）输出R²值的沙普利分解结果，量化各特征对模型性能的专属贡献。通过分解单样本的二次损失，qshap提供了灵活工具用于探索单个特征与单条样本的重要性。qshap目前通过统一树表征与高效C++后端，支持xgboost、lightgbm、catboost等主流GBDT实现，其模块化设计可兼容其他基于二叉决策树构建的GBDT实现。此外本文针对 oblivious 树设计了专用后端，利用其对称结构大幅提升计算速度。

title: The Sharp Tail of Uniform Stability
title_zh: 均匀稳定性的尖锐尾界
authors: Pahan Dewasurendra
abstract: Uniform stability controls how much one training example can change the loss at any test point. A new logarithmic-free upper bound shows that a $\gamma$-uniformly stable algorithm with loss in $[0,L]$ has generalization gap at most $O \left(\gamma\log(1/\delta) +L\sqrt{\frac{\log(1/\delta)}{n}}\right)$ with probability $1-\delta$. Whether an actual bounded-loss learning algorithm can realize the linear dependence on $\log(1/\delta)$ has remained open. The known construction realizes it only for auxiliary weakly dependent random variables whose pointwise range grows with $n$. The known learning lower bound holds only at constant probability. We close this gap. For every $n$, stability level $\gamma$, and loss bound $L$, we construct one deterministic $\gamma$-uniformly stable learning problem whose tail satisfies, simultaneously for $1\le p\le c n$, $\mathbb P \left( R(A_S)-R_S(A_S) \ge c'\min \left\{L,\gamma p+L\sqrt{p/n}\right\} \right)\ge e^{-p}.$ The construction is ordinary bounded absolute-loss regression with constant labels. Its key is a multiscale collection of rare Rademacher features. A coordinatewise ramp is stable in sup norm, while an odd symmetrized maximum converts a unique extreme feature into a gap of order $\gamma p$ without violating the loss bound. Geometrically spaced ramps put all confidence levels into the same problem. Together with the logarithmic-free upper bound, this determines the optimal high-probability and moment dependence of uniform stability up to universal constants.
summary_zh: 均匀稳定性用于控制单个训练样本可对任意测试点损失产生的最大影响。本文提出一个新的无对数上界，证明损失取值范围为[0,L]的γ-均匀稳定算法，在概率1-δ下的泛化间隙不超过$O \left(\gamma\log(1/\delta) +L\sqrt{\frac{\log(1/\delta)}{n}}\right)$。此前学界尚未明确是否存在实际的有界损失学习算法，可实现对$\log(1/\delta)$的线性依赖。现有构造仅能在逐点范围随n增长的辅助弱相关随机变量场景下实现该特性，已有的学习下界仅在常数概率下成立。本文填补了这一空白：对任意n、稳定性水平γ与损失上界L，本文构造了一个确定性γ-均匀稳定学习问题，其尾界对所有满足1≤p≤cn的p同时满足$\mathbb P \left( R(A_S)-R_S(A_S) \ge c'\min \left\{L,\gamma p+L\sqrt{p/n}\right\} \right)\ge e^{-p}$。该构造为标签恒定的普通有界绝对损失回归问题，核心是多尺度的稀有拉德马赫特征集合：坐标斜坡函数在无穷范数下稳定，奇对称最大值可将唯一的极端特征转化为量级为γp的间隙，且不违反损失上界。几何间隔分布的斜坡函数可将所有置信水平纳入同一问题。结合无对数上界，本文在不引入通用常数的前提下，确定了均匀稳定性的最优高概率与矩依赖关系。

title: RetrievalFormer: A Dual-Encoder Transformer for Efficient Approximate Nearest Neighbor Retrieval and Cold-Item Recommendation
title_zh: RetrievalFormer：面向高效近似最近邻检索与冷启动物品推荐的双编码器Transformer
authors: Theodore Rogers, Joe Standerfer, Dmitrii Timoshenko, Haoxue Li, Zuhaib Akhtar, Soyoung Yang
abstract: A shared search-and-recommendation index must score new items from features alone because search has no exploration slot. In a public log covering both surfaces over one catalog, $38.6\%$ of held-out query-search impressions show an item never previously shown or visited. For user-cold engagements, the feature-based tower serves this demand without measurable loss against $99$ sampled negatives ($0.9595$ Recall@20 versus $0.9510$ warm). A lexical baseline reaches similar parity, while a full-catalog check remains statistically undecided. Dual-encoder retrieval therefore keeps the index \emph{open} to new items, unlike an ID-softmax recommender that requires retraining. We price this openness on recommendation against six sequential baselines, each retrained and tuned through five rounds on corrected targets. A float32 timestamp bug had reordered leave-one-out targets for $19.7\%$ of users. On MovieLens-1M, warm accuracy trails the strongest retrained baseline by $5.2\%$ Recall@20 and $11.4\%$ NDCG@20. On MIND, the gap narrows to $0.8$--$3.6\%$ relative to the five strongest baselines, though the model ranks sixth of seven. Under strict zero-leakage cold-start evaluation, the content tower achieves $0.172 \pm 0.006$ Recall@20, $1.4\times$ the strongest retrained dedicated method ($0.124 \pm 0.007$) and $3\times$ a training-free floor, without cold-specific training. Exact full-softmax training raises Recall@20 by $54\%$ on MIND-small and $6.9\%$ on MovieLens-1M over sampled InfoNCE, but recomputes the full catalog each step and exhausts accelerator memory at $240$K items. Approximate nearest-neighbor search explains none of the remaining gap, serving cost does not regress against ID-softmax retrieval, and a history-window sweep explains half the post-recipe remainder. Exact-quality training at catalog scale remains the open problem.
summary_zh: 统一的搜索推荐索引必须仅依靠特征为新物品打分，因为搜索场景不存在探索曝光位。在覆盖同一目录下两个场景的公开日志中，38.6%的留出查询-搜索曝光对应的物品此前从未被展示或访问过。针对用户冷交互场景，基于特征的塔模型可在不使用99个负采样样本的情况下满足该需求，性能无明显损失（Recall@20为0.9595，对比热启动场景的0.9510）。词法基线方法可达到相近性能，而全目录检索的性能差异在统计上不显著。因此双编码器检索可保持索引对新物品开放，无需像ID-softmax推荐器那样重新训练。本文在推荐场景下对比了该开放特性的开销，与6个序列基线方法进行对照，所有基线均在校正后的目标上完成5轮重训练与调优。研究发现一个float32时间戳bug导致19.7%用户的留一法目标被错误重排。在MovieLens-1M数据集上，热启动精度比性能最优的重训练基线低5.2%的Recall@20与11.4%的NDCG@20。在MIND数据集上，与5个最强基线的相对差距缩小至0.8%~3.6%，模型整体性能在7个参评方法中排第6位。在严格无泄漏的冷启动评估下，内容塔模型的Recall@20可达$0.172 \pm 0.006$，是性能最优的专用重训练方法（$0.124 \pm 0.007$）的1.4倍，是无训练基线的3倍，且无需针对冷启动做专门训练。相比采样InfoNCE损失，精确全softmax训练可在MIND-small上将Recall@20提升54%，在MovieLens-1M上提升6.9%，但每步都需要重新计算全目录表征，当物品数达24万时就会耗尽加速器显存。近似最近邻检索无法解释剩余性能差距，服务成本相比ID-softmax检索没有上升，历史窗口调优可解释剩余差距的一半。在全目录规模下实现精确级别的训练仍是待解决的开放问题。

title: A Feature-Major Codebook for Memory-Efficient Sparse-Binary Self-Organizing Maps: Scaling a MEDLINE Atlas to 1.05 Million Neurons on a Single Consumer GPU
title_zh: 面向内存高效稀疏二值自组织映射的特征主序码本：在单块消费级GPU上将MEDLINE文献图谱扩展至105万个神经元
authors: Andrew James Amos
abstract: A self-organising map turns a large corpus into a browsable two-dimensional atlas, but building one at MEDLINE scale has been impractical: the best-matching-unit (BMU) search that dominates training is bound by the bandwidth needed to read the codebook every epoch. I show that this bottleneck is largely an artefact of codebook layout. Storing it feature-major with each feature's weights contiguous, W[v.M+i], recasts the search as a tiled sparse-dense product in which every loaded weight column is reused across a tile of samples. Varying only the layout, with implementation, precision and update rule held fixed, accelerates the BMU search by 4.5-8.5x. Because an exact-argmin BMU is invariant to how the codebook is stored, this gain costs nothing: held-out quantisation error agrees with a cuSPARSE baseline to within 0.5% at every map size. Against that baseline the advantage is a crossover rather than a constant: cuSPARSE.SOM is faster at small maps, SparseBin.SOM is 1.5x faster at 128x128 and 2.6x at 256x256, and at 512x512 it is the only one that runs at all on 24 GB. Paired with a radius-independent box-blur update and a convergence-based stopping rule, it trains a converged map over 29.9 million MEDLINE articles in about 72 s at 64x64 on one 24 GB GPU, and accommodates 262,144 neurons (512x512 edges) where every alternative algorithm I tested exceeds memory constraints. On a 141 GB H200 it reaches 1,048,576 neurons (1024x1024 edges) - to my knowledge the largest self-organising map yet reported. Held-out error follows a smooth power law with no elbow across three decades of map size, so the limit on resolution is compute rather than any breakpoint in the data. At matched work the design is ~82x faster than MedSOM, the CUDA implementation behind our earlier MEDLINE atlases and, at 128x128, 621x faster than the best available multicore-CPU library.
summary_zh: 自组织映射可将大规模语料库转换为可浏览的二维图谱，但构建MEDLINE规模的自组织映射此前一直难以实现：在训练过程中占耗时主导地位的最佳匹配单元（Best-Matching-Unit, BMU）搜索，受限于每个训练轮次读取码本所需的带宽。本文证明该瓶颈很大程度上是码本布局不合理导致的人为限制。采用特征主序方式存储码本，将每个特征的权重连续排布为W[v.M+i]，可将搜索过程重构为分块稀疏-稠密乘积运算，使得每个加载的权重列都能在一个样本分块中被重复利用。仅调整码本布局、保持实现方式、精度和更新规则完全不变的前提下，BMU搜索速度可提升4.5~8.5倍。由于精确最小参数BMU的计算结果不受码本存储方式影响，该性能提升无任何额外代价：在所有尺寸的映射下，本方法的留出集量化误差与cuSPARSE基线的偏差均不超过0.5%。该优势并非恒定值而是存在性能交叉点：cuSPARSE.SOM在小尺寸映射上速度更快，SparseBin.SOM在128×128尺寸下速度是前者的1.5倍，在256×256尺寸下是2.6倍，而在512×512尺寸下它是唯一可在24GB显存设备上运行的方案。结合与半径无关的盒式模糊更新规则和基于收敛性的停止准则，本方法可在单块24GB GPU上，仅用约72秒完成基于2990万篇MEDLINE文献的64×64尺寸收敛映射训练，还可支持262144个神经元（512×512边缘），而测试的所有其他替代算法均超出内存限制。在141GB显存的H200 GPU上，该方法可实现1048576个神经元（1024×1024边缘）的自组织映射——据我们所知这是目前已公开的规模最大的自组织映射。在跨越三个数量级的映射尺寸范围内，留出集误差遵循平滑幂律分布且无拐点，说明分辨率的上限由计算资源决定，而非数据本身存在断点。在同等计算量下，该设计的速度比此前MEDLINE图谱采用的CUDA实现MedSOM快约82倍，在128×128尺寸下比当前最优的多核CPU库快621倍。

title: PhysicsBench: A Unified Leaderboard for Generative and Predictive Models in Engineering Design and Simulation
title_zh: PhysicsBench：面向工程设计与仿真领域生成式与预测模型的统一基准排行榜
authors: Sang Won Lee, Hyogu Jeong, Namwoo Kang
abstract: Generative and predictive artificial intelligence models are increasingly used to generate geometry and to predict physical fields and scalar quantities in engineering design and simulation. Yet these models are typically evaluated in isolation, on academic datasets at unconstrained scales, with inconsistent metrics and procedures. We present PhysicsBench, a unified benchmark and leaderboard that evaluates generative and predictive models under one standardized procedure. PhysicsBench spans seven generation and prediction tasks across 1D, 2D, and 3D domains and ranks 66 models on nine datasets, comprising industrial-scale CAD/CFD/FEA simulations and public references, expanded into 28 configurations. One procedure and ranking apply to both families, each ranked within its own tasks. Evaluation spans realistic, limited data scales from S to XL rather than the unlimited training sets common in academic benchmarks. A common metric suite captures geometric fidelity with distributional distances, physical-field and scalar accuracy, and engineering-specific field- and shape-validity. BenchRank debiases correlated metrics and ranks by PageRank over a head-to-head dominance graph, so every reported quality metric is also ranked, with computational cost in a separate efficiency view. Across tasks, an architecture's large-scale academic standing weakly predicts its small-data ranking. The top model changes with data scale in six of the seven tasks, and no model leads more than one task. PhysicsBench turns "state-of-the-art" from a self-reported claim into an openly published foundation for model selection.
summary_zh: 生成式与预测人工智能模型正越来越多地用于生成几何结构、预测工程设计与仿真中的物理场和标量参数。但目前这类模型通常在无约束规模的学术数据集上单独评估，采用的指标和流程互不统一。本文提出PhysicsBench，这是一套在标准化流程下评估生成式与预测模型的统一基准与排行榜。PhysicsBench覆盖1D、2D、3D域下的7项生成与预测任务，在9个数据集上对66个模型进行排名，数据集包含工业级CAD（计算机辅助设计）/CFD（计算流体动力学）/FEA（有限元分析）仿真数据与公开参考数据，共扩展为28种配置。同一套评估流程与排名规则适用于两类模型，每类模型在各自对应的任务内单独排名。评估采用从S到XL的真实有限数据规模，而非学术基准中常见的无限训练集设置。统一的指标套件通过分布距离衡量几何保真度，同时覆盖物理场与标量预测精度、工程领域特有的物理场有效性与形状有效性指标。BenchRank算法通过基于两两支配图的PageRank（佩奇排名）算法消除相关指标的偏差并完成排序，因此所有报告的质量指标都附带排名，计算成本则在独立的效率视图中展示。跨任务统计结果显示，模型在大规模学术数据集上的表现几乎无法预测其在小数据场景下的排名。7项任务中有6项的最优模型随数据规模变化而改变，且没有模型能在超过1项任务中占据领先地位。PhysicsBench将“当前最优”从自宣式的结论转变为可公开使用的模型选型基础。

title: ALPHABET: A Laplace-Pole History Aggregator with Banked Exponential Transport
title_zh: XP-JEPA：面向可预测潜态动力学的交叉预测物理锚定方法
authors: Daehwa Ko, JaeHyeon Kim, Oh Seong Kwon, Jay Hoon Jung
abstract: Can a sequence model remain competitive with only a few thousand parameters and an explicitly auditable prediction interface? We introduce ALPHABET, a compact linear-time model that compresses temporal history into stable complex pole modes: a direct bank synthesizes its modal states back into the feature trajectory, an independent cascaded bank analyzes the transformed trajectory without resynthesis, and an affine head reads only modal energies and lag moments from both banks. We characterize the temporal information this descriptor retains: for a stationary, fully observed feature process, each mode energy is a frequency-localized measurement of the second-order spectrum, the continuum of such measurements identifies the spectrum, and almost every mode separates any fixed finite set of spectrally distinct classes. On a Gaussian control with matched low-lag statistics, the learned descriptor approaches the Bayes oracle where raw autocovariances remain at chance. Across the fixed 82-task registry, ALPHABET attains mean rank 3.97 in the complete ten-family comparison. At the common-width D=64 runtime anchor, its 6,437 parameters deliver 5.02 times faster inference and 3.93 times faster complete training steps than the nine baselines on average.
summary_zh: 潜态世界模型通过预测候选动作如何变换学习到的表征来实现规划。但在自预测模型中，编码器与预测器联合优化，容易共同适配那些预测难度低、但仅受场景物理演化弱约束的潜态转移。本文提出交叉预测联合嵌入预测架构（Cross-Predictive Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture, XP-JEPA），将视觉潜态动力学锚定到特权物理轨迹上。XP-JEPA分别编码视觉观测和物理状态，通过共享的动作条件预测器推进两者的状态，将每个预测结果与两种模态的未来表征进行匹配。该优化目标可促进两种模态形成统一的潜态动力学，且锚定到底层物理转移过程。训练完成后可丢弃物理分支，部署阶段仅保留纯视觉模型。在覆盖6个评估子类的多任务测试集上，XP-JEPA将新拟合预测器的推演漂移从0.361降至0.104，平均控制成功率从53.6%提升至78.2%。直接对物理状态进行回归可提升位置解码能力，但预测性和控制性能与纯视觉基线基本持平。因此交叉预测物理锚定方法可在测试阶段无需特权输入的前提下，为基于推演的控制任务生成预测性更强的潜态动力学。

title: Physics-Integrated Operator Learning via Gaussian Splatting Representations
title_zh: 基于高斯泼溅表示的物理集成算子学习
authors: Jihao Zhang, Junyi Guo, Jian-Xun Wang
abstract: Neural operators provide efficient surrogates for spatiotemporal PDE systems, but purely data-driven formulations often accumulate substantial errors during long-horizon autoregressive prediction and may fail to exploit available governing-equation structure. Existing approaches incorporate physics primarily through residual-based training objectives or PDE-specific architectural constraints, which can introduce optimization difficulties or limit architectural generality. In this work, we introduce a representation-level approach to physics integration in which a feed-forward Gaussian splatting (FFGS) representation serves as a continuous interface between discretized solution fields and governing operators. The FFGS representation reconstructs the state as a continuous Gaussian field with closed-form spatial derivatives, allowing available physical PDE operators to be integrated directly within the learned evolution map without introducing a physics-residual loss. We evaluate the framework across two- and three-dimensional PDE systems, including advection, diffusion, nonlinear self-advection, and reaction dynamics. Over long-horizon autoregressive rollouts, the proposed framework reduces relative $\ell_2$ error by $1.5\times$--$2.2\times$ compared with the strongest purely data-driven baseline across the benchmark suite, while consistently improving spectral fidelity. The framework also remains effective when the governing equations are partially known, demonstrating robustness to incomplete physics. These results demonstrate that continuous field representations can provide a practical interface for incorporating known physical structure into generic neural-operator surrogates.
summary_zh: 神经算子可为时空偏微分方程（PDE）系统提供高效代理模型，但纯数据驱动的建模方法在长程自回归预测过程中往往会累积大量误差，且无法充分利用已知的控制方程结构。现有方法主要通过基于残差的训练目标或PDE专属的架构约束嵌入物理信息，容易引入优化难题，或限制架构的通用性。本文提出一种表示层的物理集成方法，采用前馈高斯泼溅（Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting, FFGS）表示作为离散求解场与控制算子之间的连续接口。FFGS表示将状态重构为连续高斯场，具备闭式空间导数，可在不引入物理残差损失的前提下，将已知的物理PDE算子直接嵌入学习到的演化映射中。本文在二维和三维PDE系统上对该框架进行评估，涵盖平流、扩散、非线性自平流和反应动力学场景。在长程自回归推演任务中，与基准套件中性能最优的纯数据驱动基线相比，本文提出的框架将相对ℓ₂误差降低1.5~2.2倍，同时持续提升频谱保真度。当控制方程部分未知时，该框架仍能保持有效，证明其对物理信息不完备场景的鲁棒性。上述结果表明，连续场表示可为通用神经算子代理模型嵌入已知物理结构提供实用接口。

title: XP-JEPA: Cross-Predictive Physics Grounding for Forecastable Latent Dynamics
title_zh: PinSieve：面向企业内容质量分级的生产级选择性视觉语言模型服务与可控内存飞轮机制
authors: Kehan Wen, Ziming Li, Siyuan Luo, Fan Shi
abstract: Latent world models plan by predicting how candidate actions transform learned representations. In self-predictive models, however, the encoder and predictor are optimized jointly and can co-adapt to latent transitions that are easy to predict but only weakly constrained by the physical evolution of the scene. We introduce the cross-predictive JEPA (XP-JEPA), which grounds visual latent dynamics in privileged physical trajectories. XP-JEPA separately encodes visual observations and physical states, advances both through a shared action-conditioned predictor, and matches each prediction to both future representations. This objective encourages unified latent dynamics across the two modalities, grounded in the underlying physical transitions. The physical branch is discarded after training, leaving a visual-only model at deployment. On a multi-task suite spanning six evaluation subfamilies, XP-JEPA reduces rollout drift of a newly fitted predictor from $0.361$ to $0.104$ and increases mean control success from $53.6\%$ to $78.2\%$. Direct physical-state regression raises position decodability but leaves forecastability and control near the visual-only baseline. Cross-predictive physical grounding can therefore produce more forecastable latent dynamics for rollout-based control without privileged inputs at test time.
summary_zh: 生产环境中的企业AI智能体通常需要满足边界可控、有状态、可观测、可治理的要求，而非完全自主运行。本文介绍PinSieve，这是一套面向大规模内容质量流水线的生产级案例研究。其已部署的核心组件是选择性视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Model, VLM）服务智能体，仅处理上游轻量模型无法判定的灰色区间样本，在线输出标量路由分数，同时保留可控的人工升级审核通道。在该灰色区间样本集上，已部署系统过滤出的无效内容数量是此前生产模块的2.05倍，同时估计漏检率略有下降；上线后，人工审核生产率提升25.7%，归一化运营成本降低16.2%，信号交付从次日级缩短至当日级。本文进一步研究了选择性反馈下的可控内存飞轮维护机制：默认对升级审核的样本进行复核，对自动通过的样本主要通过审计采样完成标注。反馈内存模块记录路由轨迹、观测路径、审计倾向和重放元数据，用于评估与调试。数据策管智能体采用带边界约束的提议-验证循环，覆盖代表性样本、不确定性样本、近期样本和新复核样本的重放集，在批量接收样本前设置阳性率和分数分桶防护栏。在基于6个月生产数据的链式月度更新实验中，该机制将代表性随机重放场景下的平均FNR@50%（漏报率）从17.73%降至13.29%。推理审核智能体负责审计教师生成的推理依据，支持保留/修正/丢弃三类决策。生产效果统计仅归属已部署的服务智能体；重放和推理审核结果属于离线或采样治理环节的证据。该服务智能体方案已被复用到多个其他内部信号场景，证明其具备跨任务迁移能力。

title: PinSieve: Production Selective VLM Serving and a Governed Memory Flywheel for Enterprise Content-Quality Triage
authors: Chuqing Gao, Yuanfang Song, Jonathan Zhang, Yifan Wu, Vishwakarma Singh, Qinglong Zeng, Andrey Gusev
abstract: Enterprise AI agents in production often need to be bounded, stateful, observable, and governable rather than fully autonomous. We present PinSieve, a production case study in a large-scale content-quality pipeline. Its deployed component is a selective vision-language-model (VLM) Serving Agent that operates only on the grey-zone slice left unresolved by lightweight upstream models, exposes a scalar routing score online, and preserves controlled human escalation. On this slice, the deployed system filters 2.05x more non-actionable items than the previous production module while slightly reducing estimated miss rate; after promotion, it improves review productivity by 25.7%, reduces normalized operating cost by 16.2%, and moves signal delivery from next-day to same-day. We then study maintenance through a governed memory flywheel under selective feedback, where escalated items are reviewed by default and auto-passed items are labeled mainly through audit sampling. Feedback Memory records routing traces, observation paths, audit propensities, and replay metadata for evaluation and debugging. The Data Curation Agent uses a bounded proposal-verifier loop over representative, uncertainty, recency, and fresh-review replay, with positive-rate and score-bin guardrails before batch acceptance. In chained monthly refresh over six months of production data, this design reduces average FNR@50% from 17.73% under representative random replay to 13.29%. A Reasoning Review Agent audits teacher-generated rationales and supports keep/repair/drop decisions. Production claims are attributed only to the deployed Serving Agent; replay and rationale-review results are offline or sampled-governance evidence. The same serving-agent recipe has been adopted to several additional internal signals, suggesting transferability beyond one task.

title: Revenge of Monosemanticity: Specialized Neurons Improve Data Efficiency in MLPs
title_zh: 单语义性的回归：专用神经元提升多层感知器的数据效率
authors: Amirhesam Abedsoltan, Enric Boix-Adsera, Fivos Kalogiannis, Mikhail Belkin
abstract: Understanding how neural networks learn and organize features is central to understanding their behavior. Much existing theory of feature learning has focused on the emergence of a global low-dimensional predictive geometry. We show that this picture is incomplete. In regression problems with clustered data, we demonstrate that multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) naturally develop monosemantic specialized neurons: individual neurons become strongly aligned with a specific predictive feature relevant to a particular region of the input space. Rather than learning a single global low-dimensional representation, MLPs learn a collection of local low-dimensional representations that can collectively span a high-dimensional space. This specialization provably gives MLPs a data-efficiency advantage over feature-learning methods based on a global low-dimensional representation.
summary_zh: 理解神经网络如何学习和组织特征是解析其行为的核心。现有特征学习理论大多聚焦于全局低维预测几何结构的涌现。本文证明该认知框架并不完整。在带聚类数据的回归问题中，本文发现多层感知器（Multilayer Perceptron, MLP）会自然形成单语义专用神经元：单个神经元会与输入空间特定区域相关的某一特定预测特征强对齐。MLP并未学习单一的全局低维表征，而是学习了一组局部低维表征，这些局部表征组合后可覆盖高维空间。理论证明，这种神经元特化特性让MLP相比基于全局低维表征的特征学习方法具备数据效率优势。

title: Low-Latency Activation-Regularized Sparse Neural Operators with Distillation Assistance Towards Real-Time Edge-Deployable Virtual Sensing
title_zh: 面向实时端侧部署虚拟传感的低延迟激活正则化稀疏神经算子及蒸馏辅助方法
authors: William Howes, Farid Ahmed, Syed Bahauddin Alam
abstract: Virtual sensing enables digital twins and safety-critical systems to reconstruct and forecast spatial-temporal physics in real time. However, conventional computational and data-driven methods often face challenges in generalization, latency, and energy efficiency for edge deployment. Neural operators offer a promising alternative but remain reliant on power-intensive hardware. Spiking neurons and neuromorphic computing can improve efficiency, yet surrogate-gradient training and multi-step spiking introduce convergence and latency challenges. We propose the Sparse-Activation-ReLU (SAR) layer, a single-step alternative that promotes activation sparsity without surrogate-gradient training while remaining compatible with event-based computing. Within a trunk-based NOMAD architecture, SAR achieves over a fivefold improvement in the combined Latency-Error-Energy (LEE) metric compared with Variable Spiking Neuron (VSN) and Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) implementations. We further analyze spiking entropy and feature usage and introduce synthetic knowledge distillation, reducing the LEE score by more than twofold. Finally, we improve VSN through a ReLU-based spiking loss and graph-neighbor thresholding. On the Heat Exchanger dataset, these approaches reduce L2 error by more than twofold and nearly sevenfold, respectively, while reducing spiking and spatial aggregation. Overall, the work presented is a step towards energy-efficient virtual sensing by providing an alternative framework that can be positioned towards neuromorphic or other edge device integration that can be a gold standard to compare latency, energy, and error performance for future efficient designs that are sparsity or brain-inspired spiking based.
summary_zh: 虚拟传感可支撑数字孪生与安全关键系统实时重建和预测时空物理场，但传统计算与数据驱动方法在端侧部署时往往面临泛化性、延迟和能效方面的挑战。神经算子是极具潜力的替代方案，但仍依赖高功耗硬件。脉冲神经元与神经形态计算可提升能效，但代理梯度训练和多步脉冲过程会引入收敛与延迟问题。本文提出稀疏激活ReLU（Sparse-Activation-ReLU, SAR）层，这是一种单步替代方案，无需代理梯度训练即可实现激活稀疏性，同时兼容基于事件的计算。在基于主干网络的NOMAD架构中，与可变脉冲神经元（Variable Spiking Neuron, VSN）和泄漏积分放电（Leaky Integrate-and-Fire, LIF）实现相比，SAR将延迟-误差-能效（Latency-Error-Energy, LEE）综合指标提升5倍以上。本文进一步分析了脉冲熵与特征使用情况，引入合成知识蒸馏方法，将LEE得分进一步降低2倍以上。最后，本文基于ReLU脉冲损失和图邻域阈值化对VSN进行优化。在换热器数据集上，上述方法分别将L2误差降低2倍以上和近7倍，同时减少脉冲数量与空间聚合开销。总体而言，本研究提供了一套可集成到神经形态或其他端侧设备的替代框架，为面向稀疏或类脑脉冲的未来高效设计提供了可统一对比延迟、能效与误差性能的基准，是实现高能效虚拟传感的重要进展。

title: Generalization, memorization, and overfitting for diffusion models trained in the lazy high-dimensional regime
title_zh: 惰性高维区域下训练的扩散模型的泛化、记忆与过拟合特性
authors: Hugo Latourelle-Vigeant, Sinho Chewi, Aram-Alexandre Pooladian, John Sous, Theodor Misiakiewicz
abstract: Modern score-based generative models have achieved remarkable empirical success in high-dimensional tasks such as image, audio, and video synthesis. These models reduce distribution learning to a sequence of regression problems that, if solved exactly on finite data, would ultimately reproduce the training samples. Their ability to generalize must therefore arise from the implicit or explicit regularization during training. In this work, we develop a generative counterpart to the theory of benign overfitting and algorithmic regularization for overparameterized neural networks in the supervised lazy-training regime. We study denoising score matching in a vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert space with an inner-product kernel. In the proportional high-dimensional regime $n\asymp d$, we derive exact risk trajectories under gradient flow training. These trajectories exhibit three phases governed by qualitatively distinct estimators: a spectral estimator that generalizes, a pure-noise score with localized peaks that interpolate the training objective, and an empirical Bayes estimator that memorizes the data. We then analyze how these estimators combine along the reverse-time SDE and characterize the distribution of the resulting samples. The analysis reveals familiar mechanisms from supervised learning, including kernel linearization and self-induced regularization from the nonlinear part of the kernel, but also reveals a distinct phenomenology specific to generative modeling.
summary_zh: 现代基于分数的生成模型在图像、音频、视频合成等高维任务中取得了显著的实证成功。这类模型将分布学习转化为一系列回归问题，如果在有限数据集上完全求解这些回归问题，最终会复现训练样本。因此这类模型的泛化能力必然来自训练过程中的隐式或显式正则化。本文针对监督惰性训练场景下过参数化神经网络的良性过拟合与算法正则化理论，提出了对应的生成模型版本。本文在内积核的向量值再生核希尔伯特空间中研究去噪分数匹配问题。在n≍d的比例高维区域下，推导了梯度流训练下的精确风险轨迹。该轨迹呈现三个阶段，分别对应性质完全不同的三类估计器：具备泛化能力的谱估计器、生成带局域峰值的纯噪声分数且可插值训练目标的估计器、以及可记忆数据的经验贝叶斯估计器。随后分析了这些估计器在反向随机微分方程（SDE）中的组合方式，表征了最终生成样本的分布。该分析揭示了监督学习中的常见机制，包括核线性化、核非线性部分带来的自诱导正则化，同时也发现了生成建模场景下特有的现象规律。

title: MnemoDyn: Learning Resting State Dynamics from 40K FMRI sequences
title_zh: MnemoDyn：基于4万组功能磁共振成像序列学习静息态动力学
authors: Sourav Pal, Viet Luong, Hoseok Lee, Tingting Dan, Guorong Wu, Richard Davidson, Won Hwa Kim, Vikas Singh
abstract: We present a dynamical-systems based model for resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), trained on a dataset of roughly 40K rs-fMRI sequences covering a wide variety of public and available-by-permission datasets. While most existing proposals use transformer backbones, we utilize multi-resolution temporal modeling of the dynamics across parcellated brain regions. We show that MnemoDyn is compute efficient and generalizes very well across diverse populations and scanning protocols. When benchmarked against current state-of-the-art transformer-based approaches, MnemoDyn consistently delivers superior reconstruction quality. Overall, we find that with such large-scale pre-training on (non-proprietary) rs-fMRI datasets, we get a highly performant model for various downstream tasks. Our results also provide evidence of the efficacy of the model on small sample size studies which has implications for neuroimaging studies at large where resting state fMRI is a commonly acquired imaging modality.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向静息态功能磁共振成像（rs-fMRI）的动力学系统模型MnemoDyn，在覆盖大量公开与授权数据集的约4万组rs-fMRI序列上完成训练。现有多数相关研究采用Transformer骨干网络，本文则对脑区分割后的动力学进行多分辨率时序建模。实验结果表明MnemoDyn计算效率高，在不同人群和扫描协议下的泛化性能优异。与当前最优的基于Transformer的方法相比，MnemoDyn始终能获得更优的重建质量。总体而言，通过在非专有大规模rs-fMRI数据集上进行预训练，可得到在各类下游任务上性能优异的模型。研究结果也证明了该模型在小样本研究场景下的有效性，对广泛采用静息态fMRI作为成像模态的神经影像研究具有重要参考价值。

title: GATNextHop: A GAT for Shortest Path Routing with Cross-Topology Generalization
title_zh: GATNextHop：面向跨拓扑泛化最短路径路由的图注意力网络（GAT）
authors: Chia-Hong Chou, Katerina Potika
abstract: Common shortest-path algorithms, such as Dijkstra's (SPF), that OSPF uses, provide exact routing solutions but must be recomputed for each network topology, limiting scalability in dynamic or large-scale networks. This paper proposes the GATNextHop model to determine whether a Graph Neural Network, namely the Graph Attention Network, can approximate shortest paths and generalize across topologies. By training on synthetic graphs and evaluating on real-world Internet Service Provider networks from the Internet Topology Zoo, we aim to benchmark our model's ability to learn routing heuristics that transfer across network structures. Performance will be evaluated in terms of accuracy, inference speed, and generalization, comparing the GNN against Dijkstra's algorithm to quantify trade-offs between learned and classical routing approaches.
summary_zh: 开放最短路径优先（OSPF）协议所采用的常见最短路径算法（如Dijkstra算法，即SPF）可提供精确路由解决方案，但必须针对每个网络拓扑重新计算，限制了其在动态或大规模网络中的可扩展性。本文提出GATNextHop模型，旨在验证图神经网络（具体为图注意力网络）能否拟合最短路径并实现跨拓扑泛化。研究基于合成图开展训练，在互联网拓扑动物园（Internet Topology Zoo）中的真实互联网服务提供商网络上进行评估，目标是测试该模型学习可跨网络结构迁移的路由启发式规则的能力。研究从准确率、推理速度、泛化性三个维度评估性能，将该图神经网络与Dijkstra算法进行对比，量化基于学习的路由方法与经典路由方法之间的权衡关系。

title: The Loss Floor of Denoising Score Matching: Fisher Geometry from Schr\"odinger Bridges
title_zh: 去噪得分匹配的损失下界：源自薛定谔桥的费希尔几何
authors: Avinash Raju, Kai Zhang
abstract: Denoising score matching trains diffusion models by regressing onto a conditional score, although generation ultimately requires the marginal score. The two objectives share the same population minimizer, but the conditional target remains random at fixed noisy state and introduces an irreducible excess in the training loss. We isolate this excess and show that, for a general corruption kernel under mild regularity assumptions, it is exactly the trace of the Fisher--Rao metric of the conditional endpoint family, integrated along the diffusion trajectory. This gives an exact conditional-variance decomposition of the denoising objective and identifies the information geometry observed in diffusion latent spaces as an intrinsic component of the training loss. We derive the result from a Schr"odinger bridge variational principle, in which the ideal objective arises as excess path-space relative entropy. For corruption diffusions, the Fisher term is proportional to the rate at which the noisy state loses mutual information about the clean data, separating the loss floor into an information flow determined by the data and a weight determined by the corruption schedule and objective. In the Gaussian case, this yields a closed form for the floor, recovers reparametrization invariance of the continuous-time objective, and relates its high-SNR divergence to the information dimension of the data. Finally, we show that raw losses obtained with different noise ranges or weightings need not rank models consistently because they contain different additive floors, and contrast the second-order geometry seen by training with the third-order conditional statistics entering numerical sampling error.
summary_zh: 去噪得分匹配通过对条件得分进行回归来训练扩散模型，尽管生成任务最终需要用到边际得分。两个优化目标的总体极小值一致，但在固定噪声状态下，条件目标仍具有随机性，会在训练损失中引入不可约的额外损失项。本文分离出该额外损失项并证明：在温和正则性假设下，对于通用的破坏核，该项恰好是条件端点族的费希尔-罗（Fisher-Rao）度量的迹沿扩散轨迹的积分。该结果给出了去噪目标的精确条件方差分解，将扩散隐空间中观测到的信息几何识别为训练损失的固有组成部分。本文从薛定谔桥变分原理推导出该结论，其中理想目标表现为路径空间上的额外相对熵。对于破坏扩散过程，费希尔项与噪声状态丢失关于干净数据的互信息的速率成正比，可将损失下界拆分为由数据决定的信息流，以及由破坏调度和目标决定的权重两部分。在高斯场景下，该结果可得到损失下界的闭式解，还原出连续时间目标的重参数化不变性，并将其高信噪比下的发散特性与数据的信息维度关联起来。最后本文指出，不同噪声范围或权重设置下得到的原始损失无法对模型进行一致排序，因为它们包含不同的附加下界，同时对比了训练过程中观测到的二阶几何与数值采样误差中涉及的三阶条件统计量。

title: Partial Optimal Transport on the Circle for All Transported Masses in O(N log N)
title_zh: 面向所有传输质量的圆周部分最优运输O(N log N)算法
authors: Soheil Kolouri
abstract: Partial optimal transport compares two measures while leaving part of the mass unmatched, which is what makes it robust to outliers, occlusion, and clutter. The quantity of interest is usually the whole profile - the optimal cost at every transported cardinality - because the right amount to transport is rarely known in advance, and on the real line the PAWL algorithm returns that profile in $O(N\log N)$. Much data is periodic rather than linear: angles, phases, orientations, time of day, hue, and every direction obtained by projecting onto a great circle. On the circle the same problem acquires a global circulation, or equivalently an optimized cut, which the naive exact method handles by running the line algorithm once per support gap, at $O(N^{2}\log N)$. We show that this factor $N$ is unnecessary. The line structure survives in cut-free form, and a free-gap invariant supplies, at every step, a cut at which all previous local updates remain valid line updates. This yields PAWC: an exact $O(N\log N)$ time, $O(N)$ memory algorithm returning all $K+1$ costs, nested active sets and plans in one run, together with a single gap that is simultaneously optimal for every cardinality. Slicing over great circles extends it to $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}$. Empirically the whole profile costs $0.56$ms at $N=4096$ against $1.5$s for a single transported fraction from a general solver; on occluded, cluttered mpeg-7 shapes, holding the descriptor fixed and varying only the cost, it retains $66\%$ of the clean-data retrieval score against $16\%$ for balanced circular OT, and on $\mathbb{S}^{2}$ it halves the fitting error of spherical sliced Wasserstein against contaminated targets, synthetic and real. Code is available at https://github.com/mint-vu/Partial_Wasserstein_on_Circles.
summary_zh: 部分最优运输在对比两个测度时允许部分质量不匹配，这一特性使其对异常值、遮挡和杂波具有鲁棒性。研究通常关注完整轮廓（即每个传输基数对应的最优代价），因为预先很难获知准确的传输量，而在实线上PAWL算法可在O(N log N)时间复杂度下返回该轮廓。大量数据具备周期性而非线性特征：例如角度、相位、方向、一天中的时刻、色相，以及所有投影到大圆上得到的方向。在圆周场景下，该问题存在全局循环特性，等价于一个优化的切割操作，朴素精确方法需要针对每个支撑间隙运行一次线性算法，时间复杂度为O(N² log N)。本文证明该N倍的复杂度开销是不必要的：线性结构可在无切割的形式下保留，自由间隙不变量可在每一步提供一个切割点，使得所有之前的局部更新都保持为有效的线性更新。基于该发现本文提出PAWC算法：一种精确的O(N log N)时间复杂度、O(N)内存复杂度的算法，可单次运行返回所有K+1个代价、嵌套活动集和运输方案，以及一个对所有基数都同时最优的单一间隙。通过在大圆上切片可将该算法扩展到ℝ^{d-1}空间。实验结果显示，当N=4096时，完整轮廓的计算耗时仅为0.56毫秒，而通用求解器计算单个传输占比就需要1.5秒；在存在遮挡和杂波的mpeg-7形状数据集上，固定描述符仅改变代价时，该算法保留了干净数据检索得分的66%，而平衡圆周最优运输仅能保留16%；在ℝ²球面上，针对合成和真实的受污染目标，该算法将球面切片瓦瑟斯坦距离的拟合误差降低了一半。代码开源地址为https://github.com/mint-vu/Partial_Wasserstein_on_Circles。

title: Dimensionless Controls of Plasticity Under Alternating Tasks: From Evolutionary Biology to Continual Learning
title_zh: 交替任务下可塑性的无量纲控制：从进化生物学到持续学习
authors: Owen Skriloff
abstract: Plasticity under changing environments is central to both evolutionary biology and continual learning. Motivated by recent work on genotype--phenotype maps, we study a minimal deep-learning analogue where a network is trained alternately on two Boolean label sets, and ask which biological controls of plasticity survive the translation to gradient descent. Reinterpreting four proposed biological factors as quantities of training dynamics, we find the system reduces to two dimensionless controls: the task disagreement $r$, the fraction of disagreeing labels, and the reach $\eta T$, the product of learning rate and switching period. We derive two bounds on plasticity: $r$ alone fixes an extremal geometric floor on the utopia distance, while $r$ and $\eta T$ jointly bound forgetting. Across 9,720 trajectories, an ANOVA confirms that $r$, $\eta$, and $T$ dominate, while the effect of neutral-set size (emphasized in the biological setting) is negligible. The optimal reach itself follows an approximate inverse power law $\eta T^{*}\propto r^{-1.18}$, yielding a heuristic that sets the optimal reach $\eta T^*$ from the task disagreement alone. The analogy that survives is therefore dynamical rather than geometric, and our setting enables a view of plasticity through the lens of other driven systems in physics and engineering.
summary_zh: 变化环境下的可塑性是进化生物学与持续学习两个领域的核心问题。受近期基因型-表型映射相关研究的启发，本文研究了一个极简深度学习模拟场景：网络在两个布尔标签集上交替训练，探究哪些生物学层面的可塑性控制机制可以在梯度下降范式下保留。本文将4种已提出的生物学因子重新解读为训练动力学的相关量，发现系统可简化为两个无量纲控制量：任务不一致性r（即不一致标签的占比），以及覆盖范围ηT（学习率与切换周期的乘积）。本文推导得到两个可塑性边界：仅r就可确定乌托邦距离的极端几何下界，而r和ηT共同约束遗忘程度。在9720条训练轨迹上的方差分析证实，r、η和T是主导影响因素，而生物学场景中强调的中性集大小的影响可忽略不计。最优覆盖范围本身服从近似逆幂律ηT*∝r^{-1.18}，由此得到仅通过任务不一致性设置最优覆盖范围ηT*的启发式规则。因此该跨领域可迁移的类比是动力学层面而非几何层面的，本文的研究框架支持从物理和工程领域其他驱动系统的视角来研究可塑性。

title: Every Layer Counts: An Exponential $L_2$ Depth Hierarchy for ReLU Networks
title_zh: 每一层都至关重要：ReLU网络的指数级L2深度层级结构
authors: Itay Safran
abstract: We prove a depth hierarchy for ReLU neural networks in which every additional ReLU layer can save exponentially many neurons. For every $\ell\geq 3$, a globally $[0,1]$-valued, $1$-Lipschitz function is realized by a depth-$\ell$ network of width $\mathcal{O}(d^4)$, whereas every depth-$(\ell-1)$ network with unrestricted weights and width at most $2^d/[2d(\ell-2)]$ has squared $L_2$ error at least $1/24$ under an absolutely continuous distribution. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first exponential separation for ReLU networks between two fixed depths whose shallower depth is at least $3$, and the first exponential hierarchy across all adjacent fixed depths. The lower bound also immediately yields the corresponding hierarchy for exact computation. Moreover, the case $\ell=3$ gives a compactly supported depth-$3$-versus-depth-$2$ separation with unrestricted shallow-network weights, answering a question raised by Safran, Eldan, and Shamir (2019, Sec. 2.3). The corresponding distribution nevertheless has all its mass at exponential radius, so the construction falls outside the regularity regime in which such a separation would imply major threshold-circuit lower bounds. We also prove an exact separation for a more benign function. It is computed by a polynomial-width depth-$4$ network, whereas every depth-$3$ network agreeing with it on the unit hypercube requires exponentially many neurons in its first hidden layer, again without any restriction on the weights. The function is globally $[0,1]$-valued and $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt d)$-Lipschitz, and maps the unit hypercube onto $[0,1]$.
summary_zh: 本文针对ReLU神经网络证明了一个深度层级性质：每增加一个ReLU层，就可以指数级减少所需的神经元数量。对于任意ℓ≥3，一个全局取值在[0,1]区间的1-利普希茨函数可由宽度为O(d⁴)的深度ℓ网络实现；而在绝对连续分布下，任意深度为ℓ-1、权重无限制且宽度不超过2ᵈ/[2d(ℓ-2)]的网络，其L²误差平方至少为1/24。据本文作者所知，这是首个针对两个固定深度（其中较浅深度至少为3）的ReLU网络的指数级分离结果，也是首个覆盖所有相邻固定深度的指数级层级结构。该下界可直接推导出精确计算场景下的对应层级性质。此外，ℓ=3的场景给出了权重无限制的深度3网络与深度2网络之间的紧支撑分离结果，回答了Safran、Eldan和Shamir在2019年论文第2.3节提出的问题。不过对应的分布所有质量都集中在指数半径处，因此该构造不属于可推导出主要阈值电路下界的正则性范畴。本文还针对一个性质更优的函数证明了精确分离结果：该函数可由多项式宽度的深度4网络计算，而任意在单位超立方体上与该函数取值一致的深度3网络，其第一个隐藏层需要指数级数量的神经元，且对权重无任何限制。该函数全局取值在[0,1]区间，是O(√d)-利普希茨函数，可将单位超立方体映射到[0,1]区间。

title: Differential Learning for Robust Prediction of Thermal Stability with Application to Energetic Materials
title_zh: 面向热稳定性鲁棒预测的差分学习及其在含能材料中的应用
authors: Megan C. Davis, R. Seaton Ullberg, Jeremy N. Schroeder, Andrew H. Salij, Marc J. Cawkwell, Christopher J. Snyder, Ivana Matanovic, Wilton J. M. Kort-Kamp
abstract: Predicting thermal stability during handling and storage is essential for the design of safe and reliable energetic materials. However, experimental measurements vary significantly across laboratories due to differences in protocols and analysis methods, making it difficult to train reliable predictive models. We address this challenge through differential learning. Rather than predicting absolute decomposition temperatures, we instead train message passing neural networks to predict relative differences between pairs of molecules. This approach reduces sensitivity to systematic experimental errors and achieves >85% accuracy in ranking compounds by thermal stability, outperforming conventional regression methods on the same heterogeneous dataset. To understand what drives these predictions, we compare neural network models with interpretable alternatives built from descriptors derived from ab initio calculations and cheminformatics software. This analysis identifies bond dissociation enthalpy as a key determinant of thermal stability rankings, providing further insight into the complex chemistry of thermal decomposition. The differential learning framework generalizes across model architectures, from graph neural networks to classical descriptor-based approaches. Our results demonstrate that learning relative properties rather than absolute values offers a practical solution for modeling noisy experimental data, with direct applications in materials design where thermal stability predictions inform safety protocols.
summary_zh: 在处理和存储环节预测热稳定性是设计安全可靠含能材料的核心需求。然而由于实验方案和分析方法的差异，不同实验室的测量结果存在显著差异，难以训练出可靠的预测模型。本文通过差分学习解决该挑战：不直接预测绝对分解温度，而是训练消息传递神经网络预测成对分子之间的相对差异。该方法降低了对系统性实验误差的敏感度，在基于热稳定性对化合物排序的任务上实现了超过85%的准确率，在相同异构数据集上的表现优于传统回归方法。为了理解预测的驱动因素，本文将神经网络模型与基于从头算和化学信息学软件得到的描述符构建的可解释替代模型进行对比，分析结果表明键解离焓是热稳定性排序的关键决定因素，为热分解的复杂化学机制提供了新的洞见。差分学习框架可推广到不同模型架构，从图神经网络到传统基于描述符的方法均适用。研究结果表明，学习相对属性而非绝对值是对噪声实验数据建模的实用方案，可直接应用于材料设计场景，为热稳定性预测支撑安全协议制定提供支持。

title: UHI-Bench: Benchmarking Dual-Source Urban Heat Island Modeling Across Cities in Diverse Climate Regimes
title_zh: UHI-Bench：面向多气候带跨城市双源城市热岛建模的基准测试集
authors: Wanyun Ling, Chenxi Liu, Yi Xie, Aopu Xu, Zhuoqi Zeng, Ziyue Li
abstract: Urban heat islands (UHIs) are intensifying under climate change, exacerbating thermal exposure risks. Their two primary observations, land surface temperature UHI (LST-UHI) and near-surface air temperature UHI (AirT-UHI), capture physically distinct aspects of urban heat. However, most studies rely on a single source, and substituting one for the other can substantially bias the magnitude and spatial variability of human heat exposure. Accurate UHI modeling also requires dynamic meteorological drivers and static urban morphology features, but spatiotemporal incompatibilities hinder their alignment. Cloud gaps in LST observations and sparse AirT station networks further limit dual-source UHI modeling, motivating cross-city transfer across diverse climates. To bridge these gaps, we introduce UHI-Bench, the first UHI benchmark for dual-source UHI modeling that integrates dynamic and static environmental context. Following a unified signal, mechanism, and transfer framework, it evaluates over 20 baselines from four model families on five tasks across 20 cities and nine K\"oppen climate classes. Results show that no model is uniformly best, although foundation models remain consistently competitive and stable. Environmental covariates generally improve performance, but their utility varies across sources and tasks. Cross-city transferability is better explained by overlap in UHI regimes than by climate-zone similarity. With the dataset and standardized pipeline, our work provides practical guidance for urban heat modeling, promotes climate data equity, and supports future advances in climate research.
summary_zh: 在气候变化背景下，城市热岛（UHI）效应不断加剧，热暴露风险持续上升。两类核心观测数据——地表温度城市热岛（LST-UHI）和近地表气温城市热岛（AirT-UHI）分别刻画了城市热环境物理层面完全不同的特征。但现有多数研究仅依赖单一数据源，将两类数据互相替代会导致人体热暴露的量级和空间变异性估计出现显著偏差。精准的城市热岛建模还需要动态气象驱动数据和静态城市形态特征，但时空不匹配问题阻碍了两类数据的对齐。地表温度观测的云隙问题和气温站点网络的稀疏性进一步限制了双源城市热岛建模的发展，推动了跨不同气候区的跨城市迁移学习需求。为填补上述空白，本文提出UHI-Bench，首个整合动态和静态环境上下文的双源城市热岛建模基准测试集。该基准遵循统一的信号、机制和迁移框架，在20个城市、9个柯本气候类别的5项任务上对4类模型家族的20余个基线方法进行评估。结果显示没有任何模型在所有场景下表现最优，但基础大模型始终保持有竞争力的稳定表现。环境协变量通常可提升模型性能，但其效用随数据源和任务的不同存在差异。跨城市迁移性可通过城市热岛分布的重叠度得到更好解释，而非气候区相似度。借助该数据集和标准化流水线，本文为城市热建模提供了实践指导，推动了气候数据公平性，可为未来气候研究的发展提供支撑。

title: FlowNeg: GFlowNet-Guided Diverse Hard Negative Sampling for Knowledge Graph Embedding
title_zh: FlowNeg：面向知识图谱嵌入的GFlowNet引导式多样化难负采样方法
authors: Ibne Farabi Shihab, Naoshin Anzum Hridi, Joyanta Jyoti Mondal
abstract: Negative sampling determines whether a knowledge graph embedding (KGE) model learns from informative counterexamples or wastes updates on implausible corruptions. Uniform negatives are diverse but easy, whereas hard-negative miners concentrate on few entities and collide more with held-out positives. We introduce FlowNeg, a context-conditioned hierarchical generative flow network that amortizes reward-proportional sampling without normalizing a composite reward over the entity set: given a positive triple and corruption side, it selects a type, then an entity. Its terminal reward combines bounded model-based hardness with a training-only structural score for held-out-positive collision, over a relation-specific type-compatible support. We derive the reward, specialize standard trajectory balance, and bound multiplicatively how residual imbalance perturbs terminal and mode probability. Across a descriptive five-seed grid of five architectures and five benchmarks, FlowNeg has higher mean MRR than EMU and than IF-NS in 24 of 25 cells ($+0.0172$ and $+0.0160$ on average). A separate 15-seed FB15k-237/RotatE control fixing negative count, diagnostic budget, and compute gives FlowNeg $0.359\pm0.001$ MRR against $0.346\pm0.002$ for EMU, with near-uniform fixed-partition diversity, high gradient informativeness, and low collision. The evidence supports mode-covering negative generation without treating structural similarity as an open-world truth oracle.
summary_zh: 负采样决定了知识图谱嵌入（KGE）模型是能从有价值的反例中学习，还是将更新浪费在不可信的错误样本上。均匀采样得到的负样本多样性高但难度低，而难负采样方法往往集中在少数实体上，与留出正样本的冲突概率更高。本文提出FlowNeg，一种上下文条件化的分层生成流网络，可实现与奖励成正比的摊销采样，无需在实体集上归一化复合奖励：给定一个正三元组和待替换的位置，该模型先选择实体类型，再选择对应实体。其最终奖励结合了有界的基于模型的难度值，以及针对留出正样本冲突的训练专属结构得分，且采样范围被限制在与关系类型兼容的支撑集内。本文推导了该奖励函数，对标准轨迹平衡方法进行了适配，并给出了残差不平衡对终端概率和模式概率的乘性扰动边界。在覆盖5种架构、5个基准数据集的5随机种子对照实验中，FlowNeg在25组对照中的24组下平均倒数排名（MRR）高于EMU和IF-NS方法，平均提升分别为0.0172和0.0160。在固定负样本数量、诊断预算和计算资源的15随机种子FB15k-237/RotatE对照实验中，FlowNeg的MRR为0.359±0.001，而EMU仅为0.346±0.002，同时FlowNeg具备接近均匀的固定分区多样性、高梯度信息量和低冲突率。实验结果表明，该方法可在不将结构相似度视为开放世界真值预言机的前提下，实现覆盖所有模式的负样本生成。

title: PuzzleKV: Page-Wise Low-Rank Decomposition for KV Cache Compression
title_zh: PuzzleKV：面向KV缓存压缩的逐页低秩分解方法
authors: Zizhong Wang, Jieying Wang, Zhao Zhang, Jiajia Li
abstract: Long-context inference in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly limited by the memory required for the key-value (KV) cache. KV cache compression addresses this problem by reducing the storage cost of previous tokens. Among existing approaches, low-rank compression is particularly attractive because it represents every token in reduced dimensions. Previous low-rank methods typically derive fixed projection spaces from model weights, construct fixed spaces from calibration activations, or construct a shared basis over a broad cache region. Such representations may not capture detailed but important information. We partition each per-head KV cache into fixed-length logical pages and observe substantial low-rank structure within individual pages. Based on this observation, we propose PuzzleKV, a training- and calibration-free method that treats each completed page as an independent compression unit. PuzzleKV decomposes pages within each layer and KV head, computes attention directly over dense and factorized pages, and incrementally compresses newly eligible pages during autoregressive decoding. Experiments across models, context lengths, and benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of PuzzleKV under matched storage budgets. At approximately 60% of the original KV cache storage, PuzzleKV achieves more than 96% of Full KV performance across both evaluated models and all benchmark settings, with substantial gains over Global SVD on RULER and competitive performance on LongBench. To achieve a more aggressive compression ratio, PuzzleKV can be further combined with quantization while retaining more than 93% of Full KV performance using only 18.7% of the original storage.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的长上下文推理性能日益受到键值（KV）缓存所需内存的限制。KV缓存压缩通过降低历史token的存储开销解决该问题。在现有方法中，低秩压缩技术极具吸引力，因为它可将每个token表示到更低维度空间。现有低秩方法通常从模型权重推导固定投影空间，或基于校准激活构建固定空间，又或者在大范围缓存区域上构造共享基，这类表示难以捕捉细节层面的重要信息。本文将每个头的KV缓存划分为固定长度的逻辑页，发现单个页内部存在显著的低秩结构。基于该发现本文提出PuzzleKV，一种无需训练、无需校准的压缩方法，将每个已完成的页作为独立压缩单元。PuzzleKV在每一层和每个KV头内对页进行分解，可直接在稠密页和因子化页上计算注意力，在自回归解码过程中增量式压缩新生成的符合条件的页。跨不同模型、上下文长度和基准的实验表明，在相同存储预算下PuzzleKV表现优异：当KV缓存存储量仅为原始的60%时，在所有评估模型和基准设置下，PuzzleKV可保留超过96%的全量KV缓存性能，在RULER基准上相比全局奇异值分解方法有显著提升，在LongBench基准上也具备有竞争力的表现。为实现更高压缩比，PuzzleKV可进一步与量化技术结合，仅使用原始18.7%的存储量即可保留超过93%的全量KV缓存性能。

title: Pipeline-Native Transformers: Co-Designing Model Architecture and CPU Inference for Bandwidth-Efficient Autoregressive Decode
title_zh: 流水线原生Transformer：面向带宽高效自回归解码的模型架构与CPU推理协同设计
authors: Tom Poperszky
abstract: cflow stores weights as L2-sized tiles in compute-consumption order, reads only the top-k experts of each mixture-of-experts layer, fuses projections, and executes a delay-aware schedule from per-model dependency parameters. Across five architectures trained on TinyStories, one (arch2_4_combined) achieves a 2.00x reduction in critical-path weight bandwidth (9.00 to 4.50 MB/token) within 0.24 perplexity of the best candidate, and the tile layout incurs 7.29x fewer L1-data read misses than a row-major baseline. On a 30.9-billion-parameter pipeline-native MoE, cflow decodes at 5.94 tokens/s (tok/s) on a 32-vCPU Ice Lake server, ahead of llama.cpp (4.75) and the vLLM CPU backend (1.65) on comparably sized dense models. Realizing the expert-delay window as asynchronous I/O overlap on a disk-resident expert tier yields a further net win of up to 1.68x, matching the overlap model within 1%. Measurement refutes one of the eight design claims and leaves a second inconclusive; both are reported in full, with the conditions under which they would hold.
summary_zh: cflow方法将权重按计算消耗顺序存储为L2大小的块，仅读取混合专家层中得分最高的k个专家，对投影操作进行算子融合，并基于每个模型的依赖参数执行延迟感知调度。在TinyStories数据集上训练的5种架构中，arch2_4_combined架构可将关键路径权重带宽降低2.00倍（从9.00MB/令牌降至4.50MB/令牌），其困惑度与最优候选架构的差距仅为0.24，且该块布局的L1数据读取缺失数比行主序基线低7.29倍。在一个309亿参数的流水线原生混合专家模型上，cflow在32 vCPU的Ice Lake服务器上可实现5.94令牌/秒的解码速度，优于同规模稠密模型上的llama.cpp（4.75令牌/秒）和vLLM CPU后端（1.65令牌/秒）。将专家延迟窗口实现为磁盘驻留专家层的异步I/O重叠，可进一步实现最高1.68倍的净加速，与重叠模型的理论值误差在1%以内。实测结果否定了8项设计主张中的1项，另有1项无法得到证实，本文完整报告了这两项结果及其成立的前提条件。

title: Generating Intervention Hypotheses using Explainable Explanations on Graphs: G2I, a Two-Stage Greedy Framework
title_zh: 基于图的可解释性解释生成干预假设：两阶段贪心框架G2I
authors: Mulin Tian, Ajitesh Srivastava
abstract: Real-world decision-making in public health and social science can greatly benefit from predictive models, yet translating predictions into effective interventions requires explaining the model behavior. While Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are well-suited for modeling relational data, existing explanation methods largely operate at the node level and fall short of supporting actionable, network-level intervention design. Existing counterfactual GNN explainers, such as CF-GNNExplainer and CF$^2$, rely on continuous mask optimization over features and edges, which implicitly assume feasible edge manipulation, may allocate effort to immutable or non-actionable attributes, and incur substantial computational overhead. Further, the method of arriving at the explanation itself is difficult to explain to a domain specialist who is not an AI expert. Can simple methods generate good explanations? To explore this, we reframe counterfactual explanation as an intervention design problem. At the local level, we generate counterfactuals via a greedy search that directly identifies minimal, actionable changes to node features and neighbor-level conditions. We derive conditions under which the greedy search provides guarantees, and empirically show that these conditions are approximately met. These counterfactuals are converted into interpretable rules suitable for real-world intervention. At the network level, we formulate intervention selection as a Disjunctive Normal Form (DNF) coverage problem under a budget constraint, which is nondecreasing and approximately submodular, enabling a greedy algorithm with theoretical guarantees. Experiments on synthetic graphs and real-world suicide risk networks demonstrate that our approach produces scalable, cost-effective intervention strategies with significantly improved efficiency over mask-based counterfactual methods.
summary_zh: 公共卫生与社会科学领域的现实决策可从预测模型中获益良多，但要将预测结果转化为有效干预措施，需要对模型行为进行解释。图神经网络（Graph Neural Networks, GNN）非常适合对关系数据建模，但现有解释方法大多仅在节点层面运行，难以支撑可落地的网络级干预设计。现有的反事实GNN解释器，例如CF-GNNExplainer和CF²，依赖于对特征和边的连续掩码优化，这类方法隐式假设边的操作是可行的，可能会将计算资源分配给不可修改或不可操作的属性，还会产生极高的计算开销。此外，这类方法生成解释的过程本身很难向非AI领域的专业人员阐释清楚。简单方法能否生成优质解释？为探究该问题，本文将反事实解释重构为干预设计问题。在局部层面，我们通过贪心搜索生成反事实结果，直接识别出对节点特征和邻域条件的最小可操作改动。我们推导了贪心搜索具备理论保证的条件，并通过实验证明这些条件在实际场景中可近似满足。这些反事实结果会被转化为适用于现实干预的可解释规则。在网络层面，我们将干预选择问题建模为预算约束下的析取范式（Disjunctive Normal Form, DNF）覆盖问题，该问题满足非递减且近似子模的性质，可支撑具备理论保证的贪心算法。在合成图和真实世界自杀风险网络上开展的实验表明，本文提出的方法可生成可扩展、高性价比的干预策略，与基于掩码的反事实方法相比效率有显著提升。

title: Mitigating Exploration Bias in RL for Multi-Instruction Following
title_zh: 缓解多指令遵循场景下强化学习的探索偏差
authors: Mian Zhang, Yueqin Yin, Kaiyu He, Peilin Wu, Xinlu Zhang, Mingyuan Zhou, Zhiyu Zoey Chen
abstract: RL has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing the instruction following capabilities of LLMs. While existing training recipes achieve substantial gains, we find that they suffer from exploration bias towards easy instructions when the training data has multiple instructions in a prompt. This bias is caused by two main reasons: 1) the policy model's initial ability to satisfy hard instructions is too low to trigger successful exploration during RL training, so the optimization is biased towards easy instructions; and 2) canonical RL training recipes typically employ a cumulative reward (the number of instructions fulfilled), treating all instructions equally, which biases the policy model towards fulfilling easy instructions to obtain the same amount of reward. To address these issues, we first propose two metrics to measure the exploration bias in instruction following and then introduce a two-stage framework to alleviate it: 1) Behavioral Bootstrapping, a lightweight rejection sampling fine-tuning stage before RL to activate hard instructions; and 2) Scarcity-Aware Rewards, a new RL reward function that assigns rewards to instructions based on their empirical scarcity. Experiments show that the proposed metrics are highly correlated with model performance, and our methods unleash the potential of RL training: our best models outperform the baselines by a significant margin across three verifiable instruction following benchmarks. We release codes at https://github.com/mianzhang/MulIF.
summary_zh: 强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）已成为提升大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）指令遵循能力的主流范式。现有训练方案虽然能取得显著效果，但我们发现当训练数据的提示词中包含多条指令时，模型会出现偏向简单指令的探索偏差。该偏差主要由两点原因导致：1）策略模型初始满足困难指令的能力过低，无法在RL训练过程中触发有效探索，因此优化过程会偏向简单指令；2）标准RL训练方案通常采用累计奖励（即完成的指令数量），对所有指令一视同仁，这会引导策略模型优先完成简单指令以获取同等规模的奖励。为解决上述问题，本文首先提出两个用于衡量指令遵循场景下探索偏差的指标，随后引入两阶段框架缓解该偏差：1）行为引导（Behavioral Bootstrapping）：RL训练前的轻量级拒绝采样微调阶段，用于激活困难指令的探索；2）稀缺感知奖励（Scarcity-Aware Rewards）：全新的RL奖励函数，根据指令的经验稀缺性为其分配奖励。实验结果表明，本文提出的两个指标与模型性能高度相关，所提方法充分释放了RL训练的潜力：在三个可验证的指令遵循基准测试中，最优模型的表现显著优于基线方法。相关代码已开源至https://github.com/mianzhang/MulIF。

title: AQLoRA: A Zero-Search Recipe for Fast Quantized LoRA Fine-Tuning
title_zh: AQLoRA：面向快速量化低秩适配（LoRA）微调的零搜索方案
authors: Md Romyull Islam
abstract: We validate the recipe with controls and report the two that failed. Choosing adapter layers by weight density is no better than random. Choosing protected layers by quantization error is not either. The count of protected layers, not their identity, carries the speed effect.
summary_zh: 本文通过对照实验验证了该方案，并报告了两个失败的对照结论：通过权重密度选择适配器层的效果并不优于随机选择；通过量化误差选择受保护层的效果同样不优于随机选择。对速度产生影响的是受保护层的数量，而非受保护层的具体位置。

title: A Theory of Speciation in Generative Diffusion Models on Compact Riemannian Manifolds
title_zh: 紧黎曼流形上生成扩散模型的物种形成理论
authors: Alessio Marta, Paola Causin
abstract: Speciation in generative diffusion models denotes the emergence of distinct stable branches during denoising, through which initially undifferentiated trajectories progressively commit to different data classes. In this work we develop an intrinsic theory of speciation for diffusion models supported on compact Riemannian manifolds: the aim is to go beyond existing theoretical descriptions, which usually identify speciation with a symmetric pitchfork bifurcation and assume to work in a large-dimensional space. We characterize speciation by bifurcations of the critical points of the evolving probability density. A spectral heat-kernel representation makes explicit the role of the manifold geometry, while Poincar\'e-Hopf and Morse theory impose global constraints on the number and type of score equilibria and reveal topologically-imposed geometrical modes. For mixtures of heat kernels, we prove that generic speciation events have a one-dimensional critical kernel and admit an A2 fold normal form; pitchforks and simultaneous multidirectional transitions arise from nongeneric symmetric configurations. We derive geometry-dependent estimates of speciation times for bimodal mixtures and Riemannian regular simplices. We further establish structural stability of nondegenerate folds under score perturbations and show that the first-order time shift is determined solely by the component of the score error along the critical direction. The theory is illustrated on the sphere using mixtures of von Mises-Fisher distributions, where pitchfork and saddle-node bifurcations, topological modes, and hierarchical multiple speciations are observed. Finally, a chart-based intrinsic score-learning scheme based on neural networks contrasts the theoretically predicted transitions on prototypal and more complex datasets.
summary_zh: 生成扩散模型中的物种形成指的是去噪过程中出现不同稳定分支的现象，原本无差别的采样轨迹会逐步收敛到不同的数据类别。本文针对支撑在紧黎曼流形上的扩散模型，建立了物种形成的内禀理论：现有理论通常将物种形成等同于对称叉式分岔，且假设场景处于高维空间，本文旨在突破这类理论描述的局限。本文通过演化概率密度的临界点分岔来刻画物种形成现象：谱热核表示明确了流形几何的作用，而庞加莱-霍普夫理论与莫尔斯理论对分数平衡点的数量和类型施加了全局约束，揭示了拓扑决定的几何模式。针对热核混合场景，本文证明通用物种形成事件具备一维临界核，可表示为A2折叠正规型；叉式分岔和多方向同步跃迁仅会出现在非通用的对称配置中。本文推导了双峰混合分布与黎曼正则单形场景下与几何相关的物种形成时间估计值，进一步证明非退化折叠在分数扰动下的结构稳定性，且一阶时间偏移完全由分数误差沿临界方向的分量决定。本文在球面上通过冯·米塞斯-费舍尔分布混合对该理论进行了验证，观测到了叉式分岔、鞍结点分岔、拓扑模式和层级多物种形成现象。最后，本文提出基于神经网络的图内禀分数学习方案，在原型数据集和更复杂的数据集上验证了理论预测的跃迁过程。

title: Accelerating the Adoption of Residential Solar Power Systems: Policy Analysis using a Dynamic Structural Model
title_zh: 推动住宅光伏系统普及：基于动态结构模型的政策分析
authors: Sebasti\'an Souyris, Jason A. Duan, Anantaram Balakrishnan, Varun Rai
abstract: Managerial implications: A rebate offered for a limited period generates more adoption and emissions reductions than a prolonged, costlier program. This counterintuitive result arises from forward-looking behavior, neighbor influence, and accelerated adoption before the rebate expires. We also evaluate phased reductions and rebates differentiated by household segment. A two-step reduction outperforms multiple small reductions. Geographic differentiation improves policy performance, whereas differentiation by home value offers little advantage over a uniform rebate.
summary_zh: 管理启示：限时推行的补贴政策比持续时间更长、成本更高的政策更能提升光伏系统普及率、降低碳排放。这一反直觉的结果源于用户的前瞻性行为、邻里效应，以及补贴到期前的 adoption 加速效应。本文还评估了阶梯式退坡补贴和针对不同家庭群体的差异化补贴方案：两步退坡的效果优于多次小幅退坡，地理差异化政策可提升政策效能，而按房屋价值差异化的补贴相比统一补贴几乎没有优势。

title: GAP-Prompt: Gated Adaptive Prompting for Efficient Continual Learning
title_zh: GAP-Prompt：面向高效持续学习的门控自适应提示方法
authors: Trung-Anh Dang, Duy-Cuong Bui, Ngoc-Son Vu, Christel Vrain, Vincent Nguyen
abstract: Continual learning faces the persistent challenge of catastrophic forgetting, where sequential task updates degrade previously acquired knowledge. While prompt-based methods integrated with pre-trained models offer a compelling solution by freezing the backbone, they often rely on static, task-level prompting strategies that overlook fine-grained intra-task diversity. In this paper, we propose Gated Adaptive Prompting (GAP-Prompt), a novel method that introduces instance-level adaptability to the prompting process. GAP-Prompt consists of three synergistic modules: (1) instance-conditioned gating, which dynamically determines optimal prompt injection layers for each individual image; (2) dynamic knowledge fusion, which performs instance-aware aggregation of current and historical prompts, enabling knowledge integration across tasks; and (3) shared prompt distillation, which anchors foundational knowledge in early shared layers to mitigate forgetting. Extensive evaluations on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200 benchmarks demonstrate that GAP-Prompt consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, on the fine-grained CUB-200 dataset, GAP-Prompt reaches 87.29% accuracy, approaching the joint training upper bound (88.00%) and outperforming existing methods by a significant margin.
summary_zh: 持续学习长期面临灾难性遗忘的挑战：顺序更新新任务会导致模型遗忘之前习得的知识。将提示方法与预训练模型结合、冻结骨干网络的方案是极具潜力的解决思路，但这类方法大多采用静态的任务级提示策略，忽略了任务内部细粒度的样本多样性。本文提出门控自适应提示方法GAP-Prompt，是一种为提示过程引入样本级自适应能力的全新方法。GAP-Prompt由三个协同模块组成：（1）样本条件门控模块：针对每张图像动态确定最优的提示注入层；（2）动态知识融合模块：以样本感知的方式聚合当前提示与历史提示，实现跨任务的知识整合；（3）共享提示蒸馏模块：将基础知识锚定在早期共享层中，缓解遗忘问题。在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-R和CUB-200基准测试上开展的大量评估表明，GAP-Prompt始终能达到当前最优性能。值得注意的是，在细粒度数据集CUB-200上，GAP-Prompt的准确率达到87.29%，接近联合训练的性能上限（88.00%），显著优于现有方法。

title: Tight Majorizations and Convergence Rates of Nuclear Norm Minimization IRLS
title_zh: 核范数最小化迭代重加权最小二乘的紧优超与收敛速率
authors: Christian K\"ummerle, Tomas Masak, Dominik St\"oger
abstract: Iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS) methods constitute a natural approach to nuclear norm minimization, but their convergence rates and the role of the weight operator have remained poorly understood. This paper establishes sharp convergence rates for IRLS methods for constrained nuclear norm minimization in low-rank recovery. A central ingredient is a new majorization analysis for the smoothed nuclear norm: we prove that the harmonic-mean weight operator defines a valid global quadratic majorizer. Furthermore, we show that this weight operator is optimal within the family of power-mean weights, clarifying why it improves over classical one-sided reweighting schemes that use only row- or column-space information. Under a Schatten-1 null space property, we prove global linear convergence of IRLS algorithms using a variety of weight operators, including the harmonic-mean weights. For IRLS with harmonic-mean weights, we prove a dimension-independent, locally linear convergence rate. We provide a counterexample showing that this dimension-independent local rate cannot in general be obtained for IRLS algorithms using one-sided weight operators, which predominate in the literature. Numerical experiments corroborate the theoretical results and illustrate the practical advantage of harmonic-mean reweighting across square, rectangular, and adversarially initialized recovery problems.
summary_zh: 迭代重加权最小二乘（Iteratively reweighted least squares, IRLS）是求解核范数最小化问题的自然思路，但这类方法的收敛速率以及权重算子的作用长期以来未得到充分阐释。本文针对低秩恢复场景下的约束核范数最小化问题，推导了IRLS方法的精确收敛速率。核心创新点是针对平滑核范数提出了全新的优超分析：本文证明调和均值权重算子可定义有效的全局二次优超。此外，本文还证明该权重算子在幂均值权重族中是最优的，解释了其性能优于仅使用行空间或列空间信息的经典单向重加权方案的原因。在施坦1零空间性质条件下，本文证明使用各类权重算子（包括调和均值权重）的IRLS算法可实现全局线性收敛。针对使用调和均值权重的IRLS方法，本文推导了与维度无关的局部线性收敛速率。本文还给出了反例，证明文献中广泛使用的单向权重算子对应的IRLS算法通常无法获得与维度无关的局部收敛速率。数值实验验证了理论结论，证明调和均值重加权在方阵、长方阵和对抗初始化的恢复问题中均具备实际优势。

title: (Mis)Understanding Benign Overfitting in Equity Return Prediction
title_zh: （误）理解股票收益预测中的良性过拟合
authors: Hui Guo, Jiawei Huang, Runze Li, Yan Yu
abstract: Highly overparameterized models often predict well despite interpolating training data in complex domains, challenging the classical bias--variance tradeoff. We investigate whether this ``benign overfitting'' phenomenon extends to equity return prediction. Consistent with recent statistical theory, we document two key phenomena: first, a double descent pattern in the ridgeless model's prediction risk; and second, that while the optimal ridge model consistently outperforms its ridgeless counterpart, this performance gap becomes negligible at large parameter-to-observation ratios. Ultimately, however, both models fail to outperform a simple historical average. This empirical evidence aligns with our asymptotic results under the null hypothesis of zero slope coefficients, suggesting that standard equity predictors lack true forecasting power---even within highly flexible, nonlinear machine learning architectures. These findings reconcile modern and classical machine learning in asset pricing: in the absence of a true signal, they asymptotically collapse to the historical average benchmark.
summary_zh: 在复杂场景中，高度过参数化的模型即使完全拟合训练数据也能保持良好的预测效果，这一现象对经典的偏差-方差权衡理论提出了挑战。本文研究该“良性过拟合”现象是否同样存在于股票收益预测场景中。与近期统计理论结论一致，本文观测到两个核心现象：第一，无岭回归模型的预测风险呈现双下降模式；第二，虽然最优岭回归模型的表现始终优于无岭回归模型，但当参数与观测值的比值足够大时，二者的性能差距可忽略不计。但最终两类模型的表现均无法超过简单的历史平均基准。该实证结果与零斜率系数原假设下的渐近结论吻合，说明即使在高度灵活的非线性机器学习架构中，标准的股票预测因子也不具备真实的预测能力。这些发现调和了资产定价领域现代机器学习与经典机器学习的结论：在不存在真实信号的场景下，两类方法的渐近结果都会收敛到历史平均基准。

title: S-matrix informed neural networks for amplitude analysis
title_zh: 用于振幅分析的S矩阵引导神经网络
authors: Wyatt A. Smith, Arkaitz Rodas, Marius D. Thomas, C\'esar Fern\'andez-Ram\'irez, Giorgio Foti, Lin Qiu, Adam P. Szczepaniak, Alessandro Pilloni
abstract: Reconstructing scattering amplitudes from finite, noisy, and mutually inconsistent measurements is an ill-posed inverse problem common to many reactions relevant to particle physics. We introduce S-matrix informed neural networks (SINNs), and demonstrate their ability to learn scattering amplitudes directly from data while respecting first principles. We further develop a novel data selection procedure, which uses the response of constrained neural network ensembles to identify a set of experiments compatible with first principles, and with each other. We apply this framework to $\pi\pi$ scattering, producing reusable amplitudes and correlated uncertainties without relying on a fixed functional form. We validate our results against residual model dependencies and training biases through closure tests and ablations. We find negligible impact of model architecture on our results. Our workflow unifies physics-constrained representation learning, data selection, and uncertainty quantification. Our strategy is transferable to other scattering processes, and other constrained physics problems limited by inconsistent data.
summary_zh: 从有限、带噪声且互不一致的测量数据中重建散射振幅是粒子物理领域大量相关反应普遍存在的不适定逆问题。本文提出S矩阵引导神经网络（S-matrix informed neural networks, SINNs），证明该方法可在遵循第一性原理的前提下直接从数据中学习散射振幅。本文进一步提出全新的数据选择流程，利用约束神经网络集成的响应识别出一组既符合第一性原理、彼此之间也兼容的实验数据。本文将该框架应用于ππ散射场景，无需依赖固定函数形式即可生成可复用的振幅结果与关联不确定性。本文通过闭包测试和消融实验验证了结果不受残余模型依赖和训练偏差的影响，发现模型架构对结果的影响可忽略不计。本文提出的工作流统一了物理约束表征学习、数据选择和不确定性量化三个环节，该策略可迁移到其他散射过程，以及其他受数据不一致问题限制的物理约束问题中。

title: Calibration-Preserving Pruning: Compression as a Reliability Contract
title_zh: 保校准剪枝：作为可靠性契约的模型压缩方法
authors: Ibne Farabi Shihab, Adria Binte Habib, Anuj Sharma
abstract: Split conformal prediction, not the pruning rule, supplies finite-sample marginal coverage once a pruned model is fixed independently of the conformal calibration split. We study the separate efficiency problem: can pruning preserve score geometry well enough to obtain smaller valid prediction sets? Calibration-Preserving Pruning (CPP) augments a base pruning score with nonconformity-gradient saliency and uses disjoint pruning, validation-selection, conformal-calibration, and test splits. Bounded score perturbations imply bounded conformal-quantile shifts and controlled set inflation, but do not make the generic coverage theorem CPP-specific. Final five-seed Qwen2.5-1.5B results at 50\% sparsity show the largest gains on large-label tasks. On DBpedia-14, CPP-SparseGPT reduces mean set size from \(10.1\) to \(8.6\) while changing accuracy from \(0.347\) to \(0.366\); CPP-Wanda reduces \(11.2\) to \(9.0\) with an accuracy trade-off from \(0.310\) to \(0.295\). Across 15 dataset--sparsity cells, CPP-SparseGPT produces smaller sets in 13 and higher accuracy in 11. Matched controls show that generic supervised gradients explain much of the gain: true-label CPP is not statistically resolved from matched Wanda+SNIP, whereas threshold-aware candidate-label CPP reaches \(7.8\) mean set size at explicit accuracy and offline-compute costs. RoBERTa-base and Llama-3-8B diagnostics support transfer, but our claims remain limited to reliability-sensitive classification.
summary_zh: 当剪枝后的模型独立于共形校准拆分确定时，拆分共形预测（而非剪枝规则）可提供有限样本边际覆盖保证。本文研究独立的效率问题：剪枝操作能否充分保留分数几何，以生成更小的有效预测集？保校准剪枝（Calibration-Preserving Pruning, CPP）在基础剪枝分数中加入非一致性梯度显著性，采用相互独立的剪枝拆分、验证选择拆分、共形校准拆分和测试拆分。有界的分数扰动意味着共形分位数偏移有界、预测集膨胀可控，但通用覆盖定理并非CPP独有。在50%稀疏度下针对Qwen2.5-1.5B模型开展的五种子实验结果显示，该方法在大标签任务上的增益最大：在DBpedia-14数据集上，CPP-SparseGPT将平均预测集大小从10.1降至8.6，准确率从0.347提升至0.366；CPP-Wanda将平均预测集大小从11.2降至9.0，准确率从0.310小幅降至0.295。在15个数据集-稀疏度组合中，CPP-SparseGPT在13个组合上实现了更小的预测集，在11个组合上实现了更高的准确率。对照实验表明，通用监督梯度可解释大部分性能增益：真实标签CPP的表现与匹配的Wanda+SNIP方案无统计显著差异，而阈值感知候选标签CPP可在明确的准确率和离线计算成本约束下实现7.8的平均预测集大小。RoBERTa-base和Llama-3-8B上的诊断实验验证了该方法的可迁移性，但本文结论的适用范围仍局限于对可靠性敏感的分类任务。

title: A Hybrid Two-Stage Machine Learning Pipeline for Fault Detection and Classification in Power Transmission Systems
title_zh: 面向输电系统故障检测与分类的混合两阶段机器学习流水线
authors: Sahil Manikshete, Atharva Gujarathi, Thanh Long Vu, Akhtar Hussain, Van-Hai Bui
abstract: Rapid and accurate fault detection in high-voltage transmission networks is essential for grid reliability and equipment protection. Transmission fault datasets are frequently imbalanced, and certain fault types produce electrical signatures that fall within the normal operating envelope, causing single-model classifiers to fail on safety-critical cases. This paper proposes a hybrid two-stage machine learning pipeline that decouples detection from classification. Stage 1 combines an Isolation Forest anomaly detector with an optional supervised binary detector through an OR-fusion rule; the supervised branch is allocated automatically during training for any fault class the anomaly detector cannot resolve, and is omitted when no such class exists. Stage 2 applies a Random Forest multiclass classifier only to samples flagged by Stage 1. Feature engineering is expressed as a per-measurement-point operator mapping six raw channels to eighteen features, including zero-sequence symmetrical components derived from Fortescue's theorem, yielding 18L features for L measurement points. On the TLFaultDataset, the pipeline raises Line-fault end-to-end accuracy from 31.3% to 95.8%. On an independent single-point dataset, the same framework attains 97.25% end-to-end accuracy across all classes including normal operation, exceeding the TLFed federated benchmark of 94.84% without GPU or federated infrastructure, at 0.05 ms per sample on CPU. Ablation on both datasets shows zero-sequence features resolving the three-phase versus three-phase-to-ground ambiguity, raising the F1-score of that class pair from 0.39 to 0.997. The direction of the zero-sequence signature is found to be system-dependent, motivating a learned decision boundary in place of a fixed relay threshold.
