summary_zh: 高压输电网络的快速精准故障检测对电网可靠性与设备保护至关重要。输电故障数据集通常存在类别不平衡问题，且部分故障类型产生的电气特征处于正常运行区间内，导致单模型分类器在安全关键场景下失效。本文提出一种混合两阶段机器学习流水线，将故障检测与分类任务解耦：第一阶段通过或融合规则将Isolation Forest（孤立森林）异常检测器与可选的监督式二分类检测器相结合；训练过程中会自动为异常检测器无法识别的故障类别分配监督分支，若不存在此类类别则省略监督分支。第二阶段仅对第一阶段标记出的样本执行Random Forest（随机森林）多分类器。特征工程被定义为逐测量点算子，将6个原始通道映射为18个特征，其中包含基于Fortescue定理推导的零序对称分量，最终L个测量点可生成18L个特征。在TLFaultDataset数据集上，该流水线将线路故障端到端准确率从31.3%提升至95.8%；在独立单点数据集上，同一框架在包含正常运行状态的所有类别上实现了97.25%的端到端准确率，在无需GPU或联邦基础设施的CPU环境下单样本推理耗时仅0.05ms，性能超过TLFed联邦基准的94.84%。两个数据集上的消融实验表明，零序特征可解决三相故障与三相接地故障的歧义问题，将该类别对的F1分数从0.39提升至0.997。研究还发现零序特征的方向与系统特性相关，因此可通过学习得到的决策边界替代固定的继电保护阈值。

title: Response Renormalization for Critical Deep Equilibrium Models
title_zh: 面向临界深度均衡模型的响应重归一化
authors: Jose Luis Lima de Jesus Silva
abstract: Deep Equilibrium Models (DEQs) compute predictions from a hidden representation unchanged by the model update. Training through this equilibrium uses implicit differentiation and requires solving an adjoint system built from the residual Jacobian. If this Jacobian is nearly singular along loss-sensitive directions, small perturbations can be strongly amplified in the adjoint response, producing large, highly sensitive gradients that can make optimization unreliable. We introduce Response Renormalization, a backward-pass framework that lifts selected near-pole denominators while leaving unlifted response channels unchanged. Collective Mode Response Renormalization (CMR) applies this correction in a low-dimensional critical subspace, while Phi-adaptive CMR computes a bounded response mass from a positive susceptibility rule. We derive dense and matrix-free collective formulations, distinguish exact gradients of a modified frozen-anchor residual from backward-response surrogates, and extend the construction to Structured Implicit Layers and Vector Attractors (SILVA). Across 23 multiphysics families spanning partial differential equations, three-dimensional fields, operator maps, complex geometries, and particle systems, CMR and Phi-CMR yield test errors no more than five percent higher than those from models trained with exact implicit differentiation in more than 98% of static and 95% of transient family-seed comparisons. Solver-index experiments show convergence toward the static adjoint, while physical-time rollouts retain predictive fidelity under the evaluated conditions. These results demonstrate that selective response renormalization can control near-critical adjoint amplification without globally damping well-conditioned sensitivity. Therefore, the method can make parameter updates more reliable while preserving the useful gradient information needed for learning.
summary_zh: Deep Equilibrium Models (DEQs，深度均衡模型)基于不受模型更新影响的隐藏表示计算预测结果，其训练过程通过隐式微分实现，需要求解由残差雅可比矩阵构建的伴随系统。若该雅可比矩阵沿损失敏感方向接近奇异，微小扰动会在伴随响应中被大幅放大，生成高敏感度的大梯度，导致优化过程不可靠。本文提出响应重归一化方法，这是一种反向传播框架，可提升选定的近极点分母的数值稳定性，同时保持未提升的响应通道不变。Collective Mode Response Renormalization (CMR，集体模式响应重归一化)在低维临界子空间中执行该修正，而Phi-adaptive CMR则基于正磁化率规则计算有界响应质量。本文推导了稠密形式与无矩阵形式的集体化公式，区分了修正后的冻结锚点残差的精确梯度与反向响应代理梯度，并将该方法扩展到Structured Implicit Layers and Vector Attractors (SILVA，结构化隐层与向量吸引子)架构。在覆盖偏微分方程、三维场、算子映射、复杂几何结构与粒子系统的23类多物理场任务中，超过98%的静态任务对比与95%的瞬态任务对比显示，CMR与Phi-CMR的测试误差比采用精确隐式微分训练的模型高出不超过5%。求解器索引实验验证了方法向静态伴随解的收敛性，物理时间推演实验也证明在评估条件下模型保留了预测保真度。上述结果表明，选择性响应重归一化可在不对条件良好的敏感度进行全局阻尼的前提下，控制近临界伴随放大效应，因此该方法可在保留学习所需的有效梯度信息的同时，提升参数更新的可靠性。

title: Renormalization Group Flow Matching for Scalable Local Generative Modeling
title_zh: 面向可扩展局部生成建模的重整化群流匹配
authors: Kanta Masuki, Yuto Ashida
abstract: Despite their remarkable success in modeling complex data, generative models face a fundamental tradeoff. Global approaches can capture full structural coherence but suffer from high computational costs, while local models are efficient but often fail to reproduce long-range correlations and global coherence. The renormalization group (RG) bridges this gap by seamlessly connecting spatial structures across different length scales, retaining quasi-local descriptions at each step while preserving long-range correlations. We introduce renormalization group flow matching (RGFM), a generative framework that systematically structures data generation across different spatial scales. By using an exact RG flow as the probability path, RGFM progressively generates data from long- to short-wavelength structures. To reconcile scalability with global structure, we exploit two key properties of the RG: quasi-locality and scale separation. We rigorously show that the RGFM probability flow can be accurately approximated by local velocity fields acting over a spatial range $O(\Lambda^{-1}[\ln L+\ln(1/\varepsilon)])$ for RG wavenumber scale $\Lambda$, linear system size $L$, and prescribed error tolerance $\varepsilon$. This property enables local generative modeling with patches of size $O(\ln L)$ and a computational cost that scales nearly linearly with the system volume. We numerically demonstrate that local RGFM reproduces long-range correlations far beyond its receptive field in representative one-dimensional distributions, while conventional local flow matching exhibits substantial errors at long distances. On FFHQ images, RGFM yields far more coherent and higher-quality samples than local flow matching at 64x64 and 256x256. Our results establish RG-guided probability flows as a promising route toward scalable generative modeling that captures long-range structure using only local computation.
summary_zh: 尽管生成模型在复杂数据建模任务中表现优异，但始终面临核心权衡问题：全局方法可捕捉完整的结构一致性，但计算成本极高；局部模型效率更高，但往往无法复现长程相关性与全局一致性。renormalization group (RG，重整化群)可无缝连接不同长度尺度的空间结构，在每一步保留准局部描述的同时维持长程相关性，为解决上述问题提供了思路。本文提出renormalization group flow matching (RGFM，重整化群流匹配)生成框架，可系统地在不同空间尺度上构建数据生成过程。该方法以精确的RG流作为概率路径，从长波结构到短波结构逐步生成数据。为兼顾可扩展性与全局结构特性，本文利用RG的两个核心性质：准局部性与尺度分离。本文严格证明，对于RG波数尺度Λ、线性系统尺寸L与预设误差容限ε，RGFM的概率流可由作用于空间范围O(Λ⁻¹[ln L + ln(1/ε)])的局部速度场精确近似。该性质支持采用尺寸为O(ln L)的补丁实现局部生成建模，计算成本与系统体积近似呈线性缩放关系。数值实验表明，在代表性一维分布任务中，局部RGFM可复现远超出其感受野范围的长程相关性，而传统局部流匹配方法在长距离处存在显著误差。在FFHQ图像数据集上，64×64与256×256分辨率下，RGFM生成的样本比局部流匹配生成的样本一致性更强、质量更高。研究结果证明，RG引导的概率流是实现可扩展生成建模的极具前景的方向，仅通过局部计算即可捕捉长程结构。

title: Contextual Embedding Evidence for Main--Light Verb Distinctions in Urdu
title_zh: 乌尔都语主动词-轻动词区分的上下文嵌入证据
authors: Farah Adeeba, Miriam Butt
abstract: Urdu light verbs contribute schematic event-structural meaning while remaining lexically related to corresponding main verbs. This study tests representational predictions derived from Butt's analysis using contextual embeddings from UrduBERT, DunbaaBERT, and multilingual BERT across 1,126 naturally occurring sentences containing seven Urdu verbs. Main and light uses show significant representational separation in all 21 verb--model comparisons. At the same time, same-lemma main and light centroids are consistently closer than mismatched main--light lemma pairs, supporting continued lexical relatedness. In a seven-way prediction task restricted to light uses, verb identity remains recoverable after the target is masked, with UrduBERT achieving 0.866 accuracy and 0.852 macro-F1. UrduBERT also retains 0.782 accuracy under a preceding-form-disjoint evaluation, indicating generalization beyond repeated local verb combinations. These findings provide computational evidence consistent with Butt's account that Urdu light verbs differ systematically from their main uses while retaining lemma-specific and verb-specific representational structure.
summary_zh: 乌尔都语轻动词可生成示意性的事件结构含义，同时在词汇层面与对应的主动词保持关联。本研究采用UrduBERT、DunbaaBERT与多语言BERT生成的上下文嵌入，在包含7个乌尔都语动词的1126条自然语句上，验证了Butt提出的分析理论对应的表征预测。在全部21组动词-模型对比中，主动词用法与轻动词用法均表现出显著的表征分离。与此同时，同一词元的主动词与轻动词表征中心的距离始终小于不同词元的主动词-轻动词对的距离，证明二者仍保持词汇层面的关联性。在仅针对轻动词用法的7分类预测任务中，目标词被掩码后仍可恢复动词身份，其中UrduBERT的准确率达到0.866，宏F1值达到0.852。在前序形式互斥的评估设置下，UrduBERT仍可达到0.782的准确率，证明模型具备超出重复局部动词组合的泛化能力。上述发现提供了与Butt理论一致的计算证据：乌尔都语轻动词与对应的主动词用法存在系统性差异，同时保留了特定词元、特定动词的表征结构。

title: Replicable Conformal Prediction
title_zh: 可复现共形预测
authors: Marios Papamichalis, Regina Ruane, Theofanis Papamichalis
abstract: Two analysts who calibrate the same predictive model on independent samples will deploy different prediction sets every time, because the calibration threshold inherits the randomness of the data. Wherever deployments must be audited, cached, or approved across sites, this instability is costly: no one can verify that two calibrations produced the same object. We ask two questions: when can independent calibrations yield the identical classifier, and what must that agreement cost? Perfect agreement is impossible, since a procedure that almost always returns one fixed answer cannot remain valid for every distribution, and exact agreement through shared randomness forces the procedure to ignore its data. Sharing a single random seed and rounding the calibrated threshold up to a coarse shared grid resolves the tension: the deployed classifier becomes identical across analysts with any desired probability, coverage guarantees survive, and the price is a quantified increase in set size and calibration data. Matching lower bounds show that no threshold method can pay less, and the method's one tuning constant vanishes asymptotically. Without any shared seed, a fixed grid still confines all analysts to two adjacent classifiers, and no method does better. Replicability also blocks gaming: selecting the most favorable of many recalibrations barely moves a replicable classifier, while the same selection silently undercovers standard conformal prediction. Experiments on real ImageNet outputs, a four-hospital site split, and four language-model families match the theory, including the measured sample-cost frontier.
summary_zh: 两名分析师在独立样本上对同一预测模型进行校准后，部署得到的预测集始终存在差异，因为校准阈值继承了数据的随机性。在部署结果需要跨站点审计、缓存或审批的场景下，这种不稳定性会带来高昂成本：无法验证两次校准生成的结果完全一致。本文围绕两个核心问题展开研究：独立校准何时可生成完全相同的分类器？实现该一致性需要付出什么代价？研究证明完全一致是不可能实现的：几乎总是返回固定结果的过程无法在任意分布下保持有效性，而通过共享随机性实现完全一致的方法会迫使过程忽略输入数据。本文提出的方案通过共享单个随机种子，并将校准阈值向上取整到粗粒度共享网格，解决了上述矛盾：所有分析师部署的分类器可按任意期望概率保持完全相同，同时覆盖率保证仍然成立，代价是预测集尺寸与校准数据量的可量化增长。匹配的下界证明不存在阈值方法的代价比该方法更低，且该方法的唯一调优常数在渐近场景下可消失。在不共享任何种子的情况下，固定网格仍可将所有分析师的结果限制在两个相邻分类器范围内，且不存在性能更优的方法。可复现性还可抵御作弊行为：多次重校准后选择最优结果的操作几乎不会改变可复现分类器的性能，而相同操作会导致标准共形预测的实际覆盖率低于理论值。在真实ImageNet输出、四医院站点划分与四类语言模型系列上的实验结果与理论推导完全匹配，验证了样本成本边界的有效性。

title: StateTune: Transforming LLM-Assisted EDA Flow Tuning into a Stateful, Closed-Loop Process
title_zh: StateTune：将大语言模型辅助EDA流程调优转化为有状态闭环过程
authors: Kunlong Li, Shangshang Yao, Su Zheng, Lingli Wang
abstract: EDA flow parameter tuning is critical for quality-of-results~(QoR), yet the parameter space is large, tightly coupled, and full evaluations are prohibitively expensive. Prior LLM-assisted tuners mainly use the LLM as an external proposer with transient working context; we instead present \textbf{StateTune}, which reformulates LLM-assisted EDA tuning as a closed-loop, state-carrying process. Its optimizer state is a typed, evidence-gated \emph{persistent optimization memory} that is updated by every evaluation and shared between candidate generation and budget allocation. On top of this optimizer state, an expected hypervolume improvement (EHVI)-guided, runtime-aware promotion policy ranks quick-stage candidates by expected Pareto frontier gain per unit of runtime cost. Evaluated on a Cadence industrial flow across six benchmark blocks (two technology nodes \(\times\) three designs), against five baselines including LLM+retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and preference-based Bayesian optimization (BO) tuners, StateTune achieves the strongest final hypervolume on all six benchmark blocks, showing a stable improvement in frontier quality across the full matrix; it also matches or surpasses the strongest baselines on worst negative slack (WNS), area, and power across the same set. Ablation shows persistent memory is the largest contributor: removing it costs 58.5\% of the hypervolume. Dedicated analyses of evidence-gating sensitivity, memory poisoning, cross-design transfer, and three-seed reproducibility (CV\,\(<\)\,7\% on five of six blocks) further validate the memory design.
summary_zh: EDA（电子设计自动化）流程参数调优对结果质量（QoR）至关重要，但参数空间庞大、耦合性强，全量评估的成本极高。现有大语言模型（LLM）辅助调优工具大多将LLM作为外部提议器，仅使用临时工作上下文。本文提出StateTune框架，将LLM辅助EDA调优重构为带状态的闭环过程。其优化器状态为带类型、证据门控的持久化优化记忆，每次评估都会更新该记忆，且记忆在候选生成与预算分配模块之间共享。在该优化器状态之上，框架采用由期望超体积改进（EHVI）引导、感知运行时的晋升策略，根据单位运行时成本对应的帕累托前沿期望增益，对快速阶段候选进行排序。在Cadence工业流程的6个基准模块（2个工艺节点×3个设计）上开展测试，与LLM+检索增强生成（RAG）、基于偏好的贝叶斯优化（BO）调优器等5种基线方法对比，StateTune在全部6个基准模块上均取得了最高的最终超体积，在全矩阵范围内实现了稳定的前沿质量提升；同时在最差负时序裕量（WNS）、面积与功耗指标上均达到或超过最优基线性能。消融实验表明，持久化记忆是性能提升的最大贡献因素：移除该模块会损失58.5%的超体积。针对证据门控敏感度、记忆污染、跨设计迁移与三种子可复现性（6个模块中5个的变异系数小于7%）的专项分析进一步验证了记忆设计的有效性。

title: Transformer Accelerator (TFA): A Macro-Op INT8 Hardware Chip for Transformer Inference and Machine Translation
authors: Shashank
abstract: We compiled the t5-small encoder-decoder pipeline for English-to-French, German, and Romanian translation. On ten multilingual proverbs, TFA executed 70,320 descriptors and matched 37.9 MB of golden-model output with zero mismatches. INT8 output matched the floating-point reference token-for-token on five sentences; the rest produced valid alternative translations. Randomized-Hadamard reparameterization recovered about 11 dB of per-tensor INT8 signal-to-noise ratio across layers. The verification configuration achieved about 20x end-to-end speedup over a 22-thread CPU, while larger designs are projected to reduce energy per token by about 1000x. After RAM inference recoding, logic area fell to 2.73 mm2, and the design completed design-rule-clean synthesis and place-and-route on SkyWater sky130. TFA demonstrates end-to-end, bit-exact execution of pretrained transformers using compact hardware and compiler-managed quantization.

title: Data Predictability Shapes Weibull Weight-Scale Growth in Transformer Training
title_zh: Transformer训练中数据可预测性塑造威布尔权重尺度增长规律
authors: Tiexin Ding
abstract: A trained transformer's weight magnitudes can be summarized by a two-parameter Weibull distribution whose shape $k \approx 1.2$ is stable across layers and models, so the scale $\lambda$ carries most training-induced movement. What corpus property sets how much $\lambda$ grows? Using the bigram conditional entropy $D = H(\text{next} \mid \text{prev})$, a training-free statistic computed before training, we find across controlled corruption families a learning-rate-conditioned law, $\lambda^2 - \lambda_0^2 = C_0(\eta) + C_1(\eta)(H_r - D)^{0.59}$, where $H_r$ is a matched-budget shuffle baseline. The convex exponent is inherited from an independently measured data-side saturation relation rather than fitted directly to the growth curve. After removing the two per-$\eta$ coefficients, 23 runs spanning an order of magnitude in learning rate collapse onto $(H_r - D)^{0.59}$ with unit slope ($R^2 = 0.941$; direct per-$\eta$ fits are weaker, $R^2 \approx 0.82$). Because $D$ is computed before training, the law is a forward predictor: an end-to-end self-validation recovers held-out within-family weight growth with 5.7% relative error. The readout holds at model and per-layer resolutions and across two tested architectures, with the functional form preserved and only the coefficients changing. It also marks its boundary: cross-corpus prediction over-predicts code, implicating redundancy as a second axis of a broader $\Phi(D,R,A,H)$ data-to-weight framework.
summary_zh: 训练完成的Transformer权重幅值可由双参数Weibull（威布尔）分布描述，其形状参数k≈1.2在不同层与不同模型中均保持稳定，因此尺度参数λ承载了训练过程带来的绝大多数变化。本文研究了决定λ增长幅度的语料属性：采用训练前即可计算的免训练统计量——二元条件熵D=H(下一词|前一词)，在受控的不同数据损坏系列中，得到了与学习率相关的规律：λ²-λ₀²=C₀(η)+C₁(η)(Hᵣ-D)^0.59，其中Hᵣ是匹配预算的打乱基线。该凸指数直接来源于独立测量的数据侧饱和关系，而非直接对增长曲线拟合得到。移除每个学习率对应的两个系数后，覆盖一个数量级学习率的23组实验结果可坍缩到斜率为1的(Hᵣ-D)^0.59曲线上，R²=0.941；而直接针对每个学习率单独拟合的效果更差，R²约为0.82。由于D可在训练前计算，该规律可作为前向预测器：端到端自验证实验中，该规律对同系列未参与训练的权重增长的预测相对误差仅为5.7%。该规律在模型整体与单层层级上均成立，在测试的两种架构上保持函数形式不变，仅系数发生变化。该规律也存在边界：跨语料预测时对代码数据的预测值偏高，说明冗余度是更广义的数据-权重框架Φ(D,R,A,H)的第二个维度。

title: Equivariant Cellular Sheaves for Molecular Electronic Structure: Bridging Sheaf Cohomology and E(3)-Equivariant Hamiltonian Learning
title_zh: 面向分子电子结构的等变细胞层：连通层上同调与E(3)等变哈密顿量学习
authors: Krishna Harish
abstract: Equivariant message-passing networks are the standard model for molecular property and interatomic-potential prediction, and recent work predicts the electronic Hamiltonian itself in an E(3)-equivariant way. Separately, topological deep learning has extended graph networks to cellular sheaves. Our central observation is structural: in a localized atomic-orbital basis, the molecular single-particle Hamiltonian, after a constant shift that makes it positive semidefinite, is the Laplacian of a cellular sheaf on a regular cell complex built from the molecule. Making the restriction maps O(3)-steerable two-center kernels from bond geometry recovers the Slater-Koster form as a special case and yields an E(3)- and permutation-equivariant operator. Three consequences follow. First, the zeroth sheaf cohomology H^0 = ker L is a topological invariant equal to the non-bonding (zero-mode) orbitals, recovering the classical alternant non-bonding-orbital count as a lower bound. Second, the Hodge 1-Laplacian lets higher cells (rings) carry cycle and delocalization information through H^1. Third, the model strictly generalizes E(3)-equivariant message-passing networks and CW networks, and inherits the anti-oversmoothing of non-trivial sheaf diffusion. We prove equivariance, expressivity, and cohomological-correspondence results for the Equivariant Cellular Sheaf Networks, and validate them numerically: the Hamiltonian-to-sheaf embedding is exact to machine precision, the cohomology dimension reproduces non-bonding-orbital counts across eleven conjugated molecules, the sheaf Laplacian is O(3)-equivariant to machine precision, and the equivariant model attains lower error and rotation generalization on a directional electronic target. Our contribution is this sheaf-theoretic formalization and its invariants, not equivariant Hamiltonian prediction itself.
summary_zh: 等变消息传递网络是分子性质与原子间势预测的标准模型，近期研究已实现了E(3)等变方式直接预测电子哈密顿量。另一方面，拓扑深度学习已将图网络扩展到细胞层架构。本文的核心结构性发现为：在局域原子轨道基下，分子单粒子哈密顿量经过常数偏移变为半正定矩阵后，等价于在分子构建的正则复形上定义的细胞层的拉普拉斯算子。将限制映射设置为由键几何生成的O(3)可操纵双中心核，可将Slater-Koster形式作为特殊情况复现，得到满足E(3)等变与置换等变的算子。该架构可推导出三个结论：第一，第0层上同调H⁰=ker L是拓扑不变量，等价于非键（零模）轨道，可将经典交替烃非键轨道计数作为下界复现；第二，Hodge 1-拉普拉斯算子可通过H¹让高阶胞元（环）携带循环与离域信息；第三，该模型是E(3)等变消息传递网络与CW网络的严格推广，继承了非平凡层扩散的抗过平滑特性。本文对等变细胞层网络证明了等变性、表达性与上同调对应性相关结论，并开展数值验证：哈密顿量到层的嵌入在机器精度下完全精确，上同调维度在11种共轭分子上可准确复现非键轨道计数，层拉普拉斯算子在机器精度下满足O(3)等变，该等变模型在定向电子目标任务上取得了更低的误差与更优的旋转泛化性能。本研究的核心贡献是该层论形式化体系及其对应的不变量，而非等变哈密顿量预测本身。

title: DiD It in 87 Minutes: A Label-Free Softmax-to-Linear Adaptation of Vision Transformers for Object Detection
title_zh: DiD仅用87分钟完成：面向目标检测的无标签视觉Transformer Softmax到线性注意力适配
authors: Huaiyuan Qin, Gabriel James Goenawan, Zihang Lin, Muli Yang, Hongyuan Zhu
abstract: While linear attention is a compelling mechanism for high-resolution object detection due to its reduced cost for global token mixing, converting the Softmax-attention ViT backbone of a trained detector into a linear-attention one is not a trivial drop-in replacement. Directly swapping the attention operator leads to severe performance degradation, and generic label-free distillation, though effective for classification, often fails on detection tasks. We argue that the central challenge is \textit{detector-interface preservation}: the converted backbone must reproduce the exact feature tensors expected by the fixed downstream detector, rather than merely imitating internal Softmax hidden states. To address this, we introduce Detector-Interface Distillation (DiD), a label-free conversion method that exclusively trains the linear-attention backbone by aligning detector-facing interface tensors with those of a frozen Softmax teacher. On DOTA-v1.5, DiD substantially outperforms established baselines and matches supervised, fully trained linear models. Adaptation completes in roughly 87 minutes on 4 GPUs, and the linearized backbone cuts inference latency by ~62% and peak memory by ~49%. We hope our findings offer the community a simple, label-free route to reusing trained Softmax detectors as efficient linear ones, and encourage interface-aware objectives in future architecture-conversion work.
summary_zh: 线性注意力由于全局token混合的成本更低，是高分辨率目标检测任务中极具吸引力的机制，但将训练完成的检测器的Softmax注意力视觉Transformer骨干网络转换为线性注意力版本并非简单的即插即用替换。直接替换注意力算子会导致性能严重下降，而通用无标签蒸馏方法尽管在分类任务中效果优异，在检测任务中往往失效。本文指出核心挑战是检测器接口保留：转换后的骨干网络必须复现固定下游检测器期望的精确特征张量，而非仅模仿内部Softmax隐藏状态。为解决该问题，本文提出Detector-Interface Distillation (DiD，检测器接口蒸馏)无标签转换方法，仅通过将面向检测器的接口张量与冻结的Softmax教师模型的对应张量对齐，训练线性注意力骨干网络。在DOTA-v1.5数据集上，DiD的性能大幅超过现有基线，与经过全监督充分训练的线性注意力模型性能相当。在4张GPU上完成适配仅需约87分钟，转换后的线性化骨干网络将推理延迟降低约62%，峰值内存占用降低约49%。本研究为社区提供了一种简单的无标签方案，可将训练完成的Softmax检测器复用为高效的线性注意力检测器，也为未来架构转换工作提供了接口感知优化目标的设计思路。

title: Finite-Sample Metric Non-Collapse for Geometrically Supervised Latent World Models in Control
title_zh: 控制场景下几何监督隐式世界模型的有限样本度量非坍缩性研究
authors: Alain Bensoussan, Minh-Nhat Phung, Minh-Binh Tran
abstract: We establish a finite-sample learning-to-control theory for geometrically supervised latent models of nonlinear deterministic systems. Geometric supervision is used only during training: simulator state, proprioception, or state estimates with independently validated metric and directional error bounds supply observable-state distances and tangent directions, while deployment remains observation- and action-conditioned. We introduce an encoder-only local--global metric hinge that enforces directional resolution and separated-state discrimination. Under regular observable-factor, coverage, finite-capacity approximation, and uniform $C^{1,1}$ hypotheses, a computable one-sided regularization regime has a strong selection property: with high probability, every approximate empirical minimizer is simultaneously pointwise co-Lipschitz and uniformly approximately semiconjugate to the controlled dynamics. Approximation, sampling, and optimization errors remain explicit and separate. Norm-constrained tensor-product B-spline classes constructively realize the approximation hypotheses, and the interpolation exponent converting mean residual control into a uniform bound is sharp. A modular deterministic corollary transfers the learned certificates to trajectory, finite-horizon cost, learned-cost-head, and optimizer guarantees, while a validated finite-net result enables sharper model-specific certification. Controlled experiments isolate collapse and folding, quantify the analytic certificate's reserve, and demonstrate the control benefit of restored metric resolution. The principal contribution is a complete finite-sample implication from approximate empirical optimization to metric faithfulness, uniform controlled dynamics, and reliable planning for the same learned model.
summary_zh: 本文针对非线性确定性系统的几何监督隐式模型，建立了有限样本学习控制理论。几何监督仅在训练阶段使用：模拟器状态、本体感知、或经过独立验证具备度量与方向误差边界的状态估计值，可提供可观测状态距离与切线方向，而部署阶段仍保持基于观测与动作的条件约束。本文提出一种仅含编码器的局部-全局度量铰链损失函数，用于强制实现方向分辨率与分离状态判别能力。在可观测因子正则性、覆盖性、有限容量近似、以及一致$C^{1,1}$等假设条件下，可计算的单侧正则化机制具备强选择属性：在高概率下，所有近似经验极小化子同时满足逐点共利普希茨性质，且与受控动力学一致近似半共轭。近似误差、采样误差与优化误差均保持显式可分离状态。受范数约束的张量积B样条类可构造性地满足近似假设，将平均残差控制转换为一致边界的插值指数达到最优。模块化的确定性推论可将学习得到的保证结果迁移至轨迹、有限时域代价、学习代价头与优化器保证场景，同时经过验证的有限网结果可实现更精准的模型专属认证。对照实验分离了坍缩与折叠现象，量化了解析认证的余量，证明了恢复度量分辨率对控制性能的增益。本研究的核心贡献是建立了完整的有限样本推导链条：从近似经验优化出发，为同一学习模型同时实现度量保真度、一致受控动力学与可靠规划提供理论支撑。

title: Symbolic Classification-Enabled LHC Limits Online BSM Global Fits
title_zh: 支持符号分类的大型强子对撞机（LHC）极限在线超标准模型全局拟合
authors: Shehu AbdusSalam
abstract: Global fits of Beyond the Standard Model (BSM) physics often involve a two-way interplay between theory and experiment. Theoretical models provide guidance for experimental searches, while experimental results, in turn, constrain theoretical frameworks. A crucial aspect of this feedback loop is the direct inclusion of measurements and exclusion limits ``online'' global fits, i.e. during the parameter scans aspects of the global fits. However, incorporating the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) limits into such analyses has been computationally prohibitive, often due to time taken per parameter point exceeding the scales acceptable for global fit frameworks. In this study, we show that LHC limits can be incorporated ``online'' global fits by leveraging approximations derived from symbolic regression techniques. We utilize a dataset of ATLAS constraints from searches for electroweakino productions to derive a mathematical expression capable of classifying the phenomenological Minimal Supersymmetric Standard Model (pMSSM) parameter space as allowed or excluded. This is subsequently incorporated for making a global fit of the pMSSM to data, including the LHC Run-2 limits.
summary_zh: 超出标准模型（Beyond the Standard Model, BSM）物理的全局拟合通常涉及理论与实验的双向交互：理论模型为实验搜索提供指导，实验结果反过来约束理论框架。该反馈回路的核心环节之一是将测量值与排除限直接纳入「在线」全局拟合，即在全局拟合的参数扫描阶段完成约束计算。但将大型强子对撞机（Large Hadron Collider, LHC）极限纳入这类分析的计算成本极高，单个参数点的耗时往往超出全局拟合框架可接受的范围。本研究表明，借助符号回归技术得到的近似方法，可将LHC极限纳入在线全局拟合流程。我们利用从电弱伴子产生搜索中得到的ATLAS约束数据集，推导了可对现象最小超对称标准模型（phenomenological Minimal Supersymmetric Standard Model, pMSSM）参数空间进行允许/排除分类的数学表达式，随后将该表达式集成到全局拟合流程中，完成了pMSSM对包含LHC Run-2极限在内的数据集的全局拟合。

title: BrowserForge: Scaling Web Episode via Parallel Browser Sandboxes
title_zh: BrowserForge：通过并行浏览器沙箱扩展Web交互片段生成规模
authors: Fei Tang, Huawen Shen, Zhiqiong Lu, Zhengxi Lu, Pengyuan Lyu, Chengquan Zhang, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen
abstract: Web agents that act from rendered pixels avoid the fragility and heavy token cost of reading a page's HTML or accessibility tree, but training them depends on large amounts of high-quality interaction trajectories, and how to produce such data at scale remains an open problem. Public datasets typically contain only a few thousand trajectories drawn from a fixed and narrow set of websites, and even recent automated synthesis pipelines stay bound to predefined site lists or tutorial sources, so the number of distinct websites the agent ever sees barely grows. We present BrowserForge, a framework that generates web interaction data at scale by driving many browser sandboxes in parallel over the open web. BrowserForge couples three components: an open-web sourcing stage that exposes the agent to hundreds of thousands of real, openly reachable websites; a sandbox cluster manager that schedules hundreds of concurrent browsers with high utilization; and a Proposer-Solver dual-agent loop that turns a raw page into an executable task and then collects a verified trajectory for it. A rule-plus-model cleaning pipeline removes failed runs and rewrites the surviving reasoning into a single unified chain-of-thought style. Page structure such as the accessibility tree is used only as a synthesis-time signal; the agent we train and release acts purely from the screenshot. The resulting corpus contains 203,238 trajectories, each collected from a distinct website, larger and more diverse than prior trajectory datasets. Fine-tuning a compact multimodal model on this corpus raises its success rate on the live Online-Mind2Web from 25.66% to 33.33% and consistently improves step accuracy on the static Multimodal-Mind2Web, with the gain growing as the corpus scales. Controlled analyses further confirm that open-web sourcing and broad website coverage are key contributors to the observed improvement.
summary_zh: 基于渲染像素执行动作的Web智能体可避免读取页面HTML或可访问性树带来的脆弱性与高额token开销，但这类智能体的训练依赖大量高质量交互轨迹，如何规模化生成这类数据仍是待解决的开放问题。现有公开数据集通常仅包含数千条来自固定窄范围网站的轨迹，即便最新的自动合成流水线也受限于预定义网站列表或教程资源，导致智能体可接触到的不同网站数量几乎无法增长。本文提出BrowserForge框架，可通过并行驱动大量浏览器沙箱在开放Web上规模化生成Web交互数据。BrowserForge包含三个组件：开放Web源采集模块，可让智能体接触到数十万个真实、可公开访问的网站；沙箱集群管理器，可高利用率调度数百个并发浏览器；提议-求解双智能体闭环，可将原始页面转换为可执行任务并采集经过验证的对应轨迹。由规则与模型结合构成的清洗流水线会移除失败运行结果，并将留存的推理过程重写为统一的思维链格式。页面结构（如可访问性树）仅作为合成阶段的信号使用，我们训练并发布的智能体完全基于截图执行动作。最终生成的数据集包含203238条轨迹，每条轨迹均来自不同网站，比现有轨迹数据集规模更大、多样性更强。在该数据集上对紧凑多模态模型进行微调，可将其在真实Online-Mind2Web数据集上的成功率从25.66%提升至33.33%，同时持续提升其在静态Multimodal-Mind2Web数据集上的步准确率，性能增益随数据集规模扩大而提升。对照分析进一步证实，开放Web源采集与广泛的网站覆盖是观测到性能提升的核心原因。

title: Structurally-bounded Agentic Graph Exploration for Evidence-Grounded Scholarly DeepSearch
title_zh: 面向证据支撑的学术深度搜索的结构受限智能体图探索方法
authors: Rima Hazra, Sayan Layek, Somnath Banerjee, Soumen Chakrabarti, Animesh Mukherjee
abstract: We present Crase, a bounded and inspectable alternative to deep research agents for scholarly search. Instead of an open-ended search loop, Crase queries a search engine once for seed papers, expands them along their 1.5-hop citation neighborhood, prunes citation edges whose claims lack entailment support, and ranks the remaining papers with a recency-aware random walk. This makes the candidate set, the reason each paper is kept, and the stopping condition explicit and fixed before inference. On LitSearch and one further benchmarks over a 500K-paper arXiv corpus, Crase outperforms deep research agents built on proprietary models by up to 3$\times$ recall@50 at roughly a third of the cost.
summary_zh: 本文提出Crase系统，作为深度研究智能体的受限、可审计替代方案用于学术搜索。不同于开放式搜索循环，Crase首先向搜索引擎查询一次得到种子论文，随后沿种子论文的1.5跳引用邻域进行扩展，裁剪掉声明不具备蕴含支撑的引用边，最后通过考虑时效性的随机游走对剩余论文排序。这使得候选集、每篇论文被保留的原因、以及停止条件在推理前就已明确固定。在基于50万篇arXiv论文构建的LitSearch及另外一个基准测试集上，Crase的召回率@50最高比基于闭源模型构建的深度研究智能体高出3倍，而计算成本仅为后者的约三分之一。

title: Linear Probing Provides Robust and Efficient Detection of Machine-Generated Text
title_zh: 线性探测可实现鲁棒且高效的机器生成文本检测
authors: Gerrit Quaremba, Hanqi Yan, Elizabeth Black, Denny Vrandecic, Elena Simperl
abstract: Distinguishing machine-generated text (MGT) from human-written text (HWT) becomes increasingly important due to potential misuse. However, most supervised detectors often degrade out-of-domain (OOD) and require large, diverse training sets. In this work, we analyze the linearity and quality of MGT representations and show that simple linear probes outperform a wide range of detectors while being substantially more sample-efficient. We first show that MGT and HWT latent representations are linearly separable in low-dimensional space, and provide a plausible explanation for this separability through systematic differences in their representation quality. Motivated by these insights, we train two variants of simple linear probes and evaluate them across 4 benchmarks against 16 baselines. Probes consistently improve OOD detection (+11 AUC), requiring solely ${<}100$ samples to reach near-peak performance. We show that this transferability arises because probes recover a shared latent MGT direction that generalizes across diverse settings. Finally, we demonstrate that probing vectors capture a continuous spectrum of ``machineness'', highlighting their potential for fine-grained estimation of AI-edited text. Overall, our work provides insights into latent-space differences between MGT and HWT and demonstrates the potential of linear probes as as robust and sample-efficient MGT detectors. We release our code on~\href{https://github.com/gerritq/mgt_probes}{github}.
summary_zh: 由于潜在滥用风险，区分机器生成文本（Machine-Generated Text, MGT）与人类撰写文本（Human-Written Text, HWT）的重要性日益凸显。但现有大多数监督检测器在分布外（Out-of-Domain, OOD）场景下性能会出现下降，且需要大规模多样化训练集。本研究分析了MGT表征的线性性与质量，证明简单的线性探测器在性能上优于大量现有检测器，同时具备极高的样本效率。我们首先证明MGT与HWT的隐空间表征在低维空间中线性可分，并通过二者表征质量的系统性差异为该可分性提供了合理解释。基于该发现，我们训练了两种变体的简单线性探测器，在4个基准测试集上与16种基线方法进行对比。线性探测器持续提升了分布外检测性能（AUC提升11个百分点），仅需不足100个样本即可达到接近峰值的性能。我们证明该泛化能力源于探测器恢复出了共享的MGT隐空间方向，可在不同场景下泛化。最后，我们发现探测向量可捕捉连续的「机器生成程度」谱，证明其在AI编辑文本细粒度估计场景下的应用潜力。总体而言，本研究揭示了MGT与HWT的隐空间差异，证明线性探测器可作为鲁棒、样本高效的MGT检测方案。我们已在https://github.com/gerritq/mgt_probes 开源相关代码。

title: ExpConCAD: Experience-Guided Text-to-CAD Generation from Shape Descriptions with Implicit Spatial Constraints
title_zh: ExpConCAD：面向含隐式空间约束形状描述的经验引导文本转CAD生成
authors: Jingyao Liu, Jinkang Tang, Chen Huang, Wenqiang Lei, See-Kiong Ng
abstract: Text-to-CAD aims to generate executable CAD programs from natural-language descriptions. However, real-world descriptions are often underspecified and omit critical spatial constraints required for valid CAD construction, a challenge that has been largely overlooked by existing methods. In this paper, we argue that missing spatial constraints should be inferred with respect to the underlying construction structure and informed by reusable design experience. Based on this insight, we propose ExpConCAD, an experience-enhanced framework for implicit spatial constraint completion. ExpConCAD first recovers the intended construction structure and constraint scopes, then retrieves relevant constraint-completion experience for similar scopes to complete the missing spatial constraints, and finally generates executable CadQuery programs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of ExpConCAD and provide insights into the role of construction structure understanding and experience memory in spatial constraint completion. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Hotjiashell/ExpConCAD.
summary_zh: 文本转CAD技术旨在从自然语言描述生成可执行的CAD程序。但真实场景下的描述通常信息不足，会省略有效CAD构建所需的关键空间约束，该挑战在现有方法中尚未得到充分关注。本文指出，缺失的空间约束应当结合底层构建结构进行推断，并参考可复用的设计经验。基于该思路，我们提出ExpConCAD，一种面向隐式空间约束补全的经验增强框架。ExpConCAD首先恢复目标构建结构与约束范围，随后检索相似范围的相关约束补全经验以补全缺失的空间约束，最终生成可执行的CadQuery程序。大量实验证明了ExpConCAD的有效性，同时揭示了构建结构理解与经验记忆在空间约束补全中的作用。相关代码已开源至：https://github.com/Hotjiashell/ExpConCAD。

title: SkillForge: Evolving Verifiable Skills for Reinforcement Learning Agents
title_zh: SkillForge：面向强化学习智能体的可验证技能演化框架
authors: Shidong Yang, Ziyu Ma, Tongwen Huang, Xucong Wang, Renda Li, Yiming Hu, Yong Wang, Xiangxiang Chu
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are trained with reinforcement learning (RL) for complex decision-making tasks. However, most RL-trained agents remain episodic and cannot accumulate reusable knowledge across episodes. Recent skill-based approaches, such as SkillRL, attempt to address this issue by extracting skills from raw trajectories, but treat the skill bank as an append-only repository without verifying whether stored skills remain effective. In this paper, we propose SkillForge, a framework for continuous skill evolution that enables skills to be verified and refined through environment interaction. By making skill usage explicit during agent interaction, RL can directly optimize both environment actions and skill invocation decisions. SkillForge further introduces evidence-based skill verification and multi-pathway skill induction, allowing the skill bank to continuously grow while maintaining its quality. Extensive experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and AppWorld show that SkillForge consistently outperforms SkillRL, demonstrating the effectiveness of continuously verified skills in training stronger LLM agents.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）智能体通过强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）训练以完成复杂决策任务。但大多数经过RL训练的智能体仍保持单episode属性，无法跨episode积累可复用知识。近期的基于技能的方法（如SkillRL）尝试通过从原始轨迹中提取技能解决该问题，但将技能库视为仅追加存储库，未验证存储的技能是否持续有效。本文提出SkillForge，一种支持技能持续演化的框架，可通过环境交互完成技能的验证与优化。通过在智能体交互过程中显式化技能使用，RL可同时直接优化环境动作与技能调用决策。SkillForge进一步引入基于证据的技能验证与多路径技能归纳机制，使得技能库可在保持质量的前提下持续扩容。在ALFWorld、WebShop与AppWorld数据集上的大量实验表明，SkillForge性能持续优于SkillRL，证明经过持续验证的技能可训练出性能更强的LLM智能体。

title: Design and Empirical Characterization of a Hardware-Realized Turing Machine with Automated Card-Based Programming
title_zh: 基于自动卡片编程的硬件实现图灵机设计与实证表征
authors: Agrima Regmi, Jenish Pant, Pratistha Sapkota, Sanskriti Khatiwada, Binod Sapkota
abstract: Physical implementations of Turing Machines remain rare, and existing electromechanical demonstrators and mechanical logic games typically require manual operator intervention, either to trigger each computational step or to reconfigure the state table, or both. This restricts prior physical models to short, operator-paced demonstrations and prevents autonomous execution of extended computations. This paper addresses that gap with a hardware Turing Machine that enables autonomous multi-step execution and reprogrammable optical input without manual intervention between programs. The system integrates an Arduino Mega for state-transition logic, dual NEMA 17 stepper motors for bidirectional tape actuation, infrared reflectance sensors for symbol detection, and an ESP32-CAM-based optical punched-card reader for automated state-table loading. Hole detection under non-uniform illumination used a Breadth-First Search flood-fill algorithm with local adaptive thresholding rather than fixed global thresholding, driven by the memory and library constraints of the ESP32-CAM's microcontroller environment; this improved card-decoding accuracy from 75% to 90% (100% with mechanical card flattening) on a 20-card test set. Mechanical evaluation showed fabrication accuracy of +/-0.15 mm, rack-and-pinion positional error below 0.3 mm across 50 trials, and voltage supply stability within +/-0.2 V under full system load. End-to-end computation was validated against a parallel software simulator (tlang), with all hardware outputs matching the simulated reference exactly across multiple test programs. The system advances prior physical Turing Machine demonstrations through autonomous execution, reprogrammable optical input, and quantitative evaluation of its mechanical, optical, and computational performance.
summary_zh: 图灵机的物理实现方案十分罕见，现有机电演示器与机械逻辑游戏通常需要人工干预，要么触发每一步计算，要么重新配置状态表，或二者都需要。该限制导致现有物理模型仅能完成短时长、由操作员节奏控制的演示，无法自主执行长时长计算。针对该问题，本文实现了一款硬件图灵机，可在程序切换期间无需人工干预，自主执行多步计算并支持通过光学输入重新编程。该系统集成了负责状态转移逻辑的Arduino Mega、驱动双向纸带的双NEMA 17步进电机、用于符号检测的红外反射传感器，以及基于ESP32-CAM的光学穿孔卡阅读器，可自动加载状态表。针对非均匀光照下的孔洞检测，本文采用结合局部自适应阈值的广度优先搜索（BFS）泛洪填充算法，而非固定全局阈值，适配ESP32-CAM微控制器的内存与库限制，在20张测试卡上将卡片解码准确率从75%提升至90%（对卡片进行机械压平后准确率可达100%）。机械性能评估显示，系统制造精度为±0.15mm，50次测试中齿轮齿条定位误差低于0.3mm，全系统负载下供电电压稳定性保持在±0.2V以内。端到端计算结果与并行软件模拟器tlang完成校验，多个测试程序的所有硬件输出与模拟参考值完全匹配。本系统通过自主执行、可重编程光学输入、以及对机械、光学与计算性能的定量评估，对现有物理图灵机演示方案进行了改进。

title: Arbitrary Polygon Oscillator: Generalizing Polygonal Synthesis to Arbitrary Shapes, Morphing, and Three-Dimensional Polyhedra
title_zh: 任意多边形振荡器：将多边形波形合成泛化至任意形状、平滑变形与三维多面体场景
authors: Antonio Argentieri, Francesco Scagliola
abstract: This paper generalizes polygonal synthesis around a unified arc-length engine: vertex data of any origin feed the same DSP pipeline. First, we adapt the oscillator to accept arbitrary vertex configurations from an external buffer, opening the possibility for a broad class of closed polygons -- regular, irregular, or star-shaped -- to function as a waveform generator. Second, a hybrid interpolation algorithm enables smooth morphing between polygons with unequal vertex counts, passing through intermediate shapes that have no parametric description. Third, we extend the paradigm to three dimensions: a convex polyhedron rotated about three axes is sliced by a fixed horizontal plane, and the resulting cross-section yields a continuously variable polygon controlled by the solid's orientation. The system runs in RNBO (Cycling~'74) with a geometry caching strategy that avoids per-sample recomputation. Antialiasing combines a four-point polyBLAMP correction derived from runtime B\'ezier tangents with adaptive oversampling, adapting the correction geometrically to general vertex configurations without per-shape analytical derivation.
summary_zh: 本文基于统一弧长引擎实现了多边形合成的泛化：任意来源的顶点数据均可输入同一数字信号处理（DSP）流水线。首先，我们对振荡器进行改造，使其可接收来自外部缓冲区的任意顶点配置，支持包括正多边形、不规则多边形、星形多边形在内的各类闭合多边形作为波形生成器。其次，本文提出的混合插值算法可在顶点数不等的多边形之间实现平滑变形，变形过程经过的中间形状不存在参数化描述。第三，我们将该范式扩展至三维场景：绕三个轴旋转的凸多面体被固定水平面切割，得到的横截面是可由多面体朝向控制的连续可变多边形。该系统在Cycling'74的RNBO环境中运行，采用几何缓存策略避免逐样本重新计算。抗锯齿方案结合了从运行时贝塞尔切线推导的四点polyBLAMP校正与自适应过采样，可针对通用顶点配置完成几何适配的校正，无需针对每个形状单独推导解析表达式。

title: Lost in Speech: Trilingual Spoken Hallucination Detection Across Audio and Transcripts
title_zh: Lost in Speech：跨音频与转录文本的三语语音幻觉检测
authors: Meruyert Aristombayeva, Jason S. Lucas, Chaewan Chun, Dongwon Lee
abstract: While text-based hallucination detection has been extensively studied, spoken hallucination detection remains largely unexplored, particularly for low-resource languages. We present the first multilingual spoken hallucination benchmark comprising 12,013 news samples across English, Russian, and Kazakh with controlled hallucinations of three types and three severity levels. Samples comprise original articles and aligned hallucinated counterparts in text and audio. We complement the synthetic corpus with 290 fact-checked fake news items collected natively in Russian (225) and Kazakh (65), translated into the other language and rendered through the same TTS-ASR pipeline. We assess fine-tuned multilingual encoders and, in zero-shot in-context settings, multimodal decoder models on transcript-based versus direct audio processing. Transcript-based detection generally outperforms direct audio processing, with binary-task degradation for strong encoders tracking per-language ASR error. On real-world fakes, synthetic-trained detectors transfer strongly (macro-F1 0.82-0.88 on original text), while Russian provenance analysis reveals both veracity-related and model-dependent machine-style signals, quantifying a key confound in synthetic hallucination benchmarks.
summary_zh: 尽管文本幻觉检测已得到广泛研究，但语音幻觉检测仍处于未充分探索的状态，针对低资源语言的相关研究尤为稀缺。本文提出首个多语言语音幻觉基准数据集，包含12013条覆盖英语、俄语、哈萨克语的新闻样本，可控生成的幻觉包含三种类型与三种严重程度。样本包含原始文章与对应的幻觉版本，同时提供文本与音频格式。我们在合成数据集之外补充了290条原生采集的经过事实校验的假新闻样本，其中俄语样本225条、哈萨克语样本65条，所有样本均翻译为另外两种语言并通过相同的TTS-ASR流水线生成音频。我们针对基于转录文本的处理与直接音频处理两种方案，对经过微调的多语言编码器、以及零样本上下文场景下的多模态解码器模型进行了评估。结果显示基于转录文本的检测性能整体优于直接音频处理，性能优异的编码器在二分类任务上的性能下降与对应语言的ASR错误率正相关。在真实世界假新闻样本上，基于合成数据训练的检测器泛化性能优异（原始文本上宏F1值可达0.82-0.88），同时针对俄语原生样本的分析同时识别出与事实性相关、以及与模型相关的机器风格信号，量化了合成幻觉基准中的关键混淆因素。

title: The Annotation Bottleneck in Persian Text NLP: Persian as an Annotation-Scarce Language
title_zh: 波斯语文本自然语言处理中的标注瓶颈：作为标注稀缺语言的波斯语
authors: MohammadHossein Mortazavi, Mostafa Salehi, Hadi Veisi
abstract: Persian (Farsi) is often described as a low-resource language in natural language processing, but that label collapses distinct shortages into a single category. This paper argues that Persian is more precisely described as annotation-scarce, provided that the term is understood as a property of its NLP resource ecology rather than an intrinsic property of the language. The review covers 34 representative Persian text resources available by July 2026 and adds three quantitative cross-checks. First, independent web measurements place Persian among roughly the twenty most visible content languages: W3Techs reports Persian on about 0.9% of websites with a known content language, while Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-30 identifies Persian as the primary language of 0.7039% of HTML pages. Second, a selective speech review shows a long resource trajectory from FARSDAT to recent corpora containing hundreds or thousands of hours of speech. Third, a matched Persian-English comparison normalizes task-specific annotation volumes by relative Common Crawl web presence. The resulting ratios vary sharply: Persian syntax and news NER are comparatively dense, whereas natural-language inference falls below the web-proportional baseline. The evidence therefore does not support a simple claim that Persian is globally deficient in labeled volume. Instead, annotation scarcity is expressed through uneven task and domain coverage, incompatible schemes, access and documentation friction, and limited supervision for specialist domains, preference data, and varieties beyond standard Iranian Persian.
summary_zh: 波斯语（Farsi）在自然语言处理领域常被归类为低资源语言，但该标签将各类资源短缺问题归为单一类别，忽略了差异。本文提出，更准确的描述是波斯语属于标注稀缺语言，该属性指向其NLP资源生态的特征，而非语言本身的固有属性。本综述梳理了截至2026年7月可获取的34项代表性波斯语文本资源，并补充了三项定量交叉校验：第一，独立网络测量结果显示波斯语属于全球内容可见度最高的约20种语言之一：W3Techs统计显示，在内容语言已知的网站中，约0.9%的网站使用波斯语；Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-30数据集识别出0.7039%的HTML页面以波斯语为主要语言。第二，针对性的语音资源综述显示，波斯语语音资源的发展脉络从FARSDAT一直延伸到近期包含数百至数千小时语音的语料库。第三，通过匹配的波斯语-英语对比实验，基于相对Common Crawl网络占比对特定任务的标注总量做归一化处理。最终得到的占比差异极大：波斯语句法分析和新闻领域命名实体识别（NER）的标注密度相对较高，而自然语言推理任务的标注占比低于网络占比对应的基线水平。上述证据并不支持“波斯语整体标注总量不足”这一简单论断。相反，波斯语的标注稀缺性体现在任务和领域覆盖不均衡、标注方案不兼容、获取和文档说明存在阻碍、专业领域、偏好数据以及标准伊朗波斯语之外的其他变体的监督资源有限等方面。

title: One Timeline, Many Renderings: A Wolfram Language Paclet for heterogeneous musical output
title_zh: 单时间线多渲染：面向异构音乐输出的Wolfram Language Paclet（Wolfram语言插件包）
authors: Francesco Vitucci, Michele Lorusso, Francesco Scagliola
abstract: One algorithmic composition may require a Csound score, engraved notation, real-time control, and a rehearsal click. Authored separately, their timelines drift. Temporal System is a Wolfram Language paclet that instead compiles one immutable store of typed entities on a rational beat timeline through backend-specific contracts. It emits Csound synthesis, beta MusicXML 4.0, OSC control, and click artifacts that remain synchronized because they share that store. Conversion to seconds, samples, or hertz occurs only at render time. Csound notes use stable named instruments in external .orc files; curves become k-rate signals declared against score p-fields. The click backend derives rehearsal audio from the same meter and tempo and reuses the Csound serializer. We describe the temporal, semantic, and rendering-contract layers, their practical trade-offs, and the limits of this proprietary authoring environment within an otherwise open-source ecosystem. The archived supplement exposes the reported outputs pending paclet release.
summary_zh: 单首算法作曲作品可能需要同时生成Csound乐谱、雕刻版乐谱、实时控制信号和排练节拍音轨。如果分别独立创作这些内容，它们的时间线会出现偏移。Temporal System是一款Wolfram Language paclet（Wolfram语言插件包），可通过后端特定契约，在有理节拍时间线上编译不可变的类型化实体存储库。该插件包可输出Csound合成内容、beta版MusicXML 4.0格式乐谱、OSC控制信号和节拍产物，所有输出内容共享同一实体存储库，因此可保持完全同步。向秒、采样点或赫兹单位的转换仅在渲染阶段执行。Csound音符使用外部.orc文件中定义的稳定命名乐器；控制曲线会转换为对应乐谱p字段声明的k-rate信号。节拍音轨后端可基于完全相同的拍号和速度生成排练音频，且复用了Csound序列化器。本文阐述了时间层、语义层和渲染契约层的设计，分析了实际应用中的权衡，以及该专有创作环境在开源生态系统中的局限性。在插件包正式发布前，归档补充材料将公开所有报告的输出结果。

title: From local kernels to global form: modeling the emergence of musical content
title_zh: 从局部核到全局形态：音乐内容涌现的建模研究
authors: Francesco Vitucci, Michele Lorusso, Francesco Scagliola
abstract: Markov models are established tools for symbolic music, including non-homogeneous formulations. The narrower contribution examined here is an observation-driven estimation mechanism: overlapping sliding windows derive a trajectory of local transition kernels from one symbolic sequence rather than from an exogenous formal partition. We test this mechanism on 273 logical note events from Debussy's Syrinx (1913), using the often-proposed A-B-A' reading as a reference rather than ground truth. We apply the same validation to absolute-pitch and notated-duration kernels. At $L=6$, both reference boundaries attain the Jensen--Shannon maximum in both dimensions; the duration plateau is substantially narrower (64 of 267 comparisons) than the pitch plateau (210 of 267). Because the theoretical maximum for consecutive sliding-window comparisons is set by window geometry and equals $1/\sqrt{L-1}$ for maximal turnover of the entering/leaving transition, the pitch value at $L=6$ and its broad plateau are not, by themselves, strong evidence. Their cross-dimensional alignment is consistent with boundary sensitivity, while the broad plateaus preclude treating either curve alone as a unique automatic segmenter. Five-hundred-draw re-synthesis experiments quantify departure from the source in both dimensions and expose an exact-copy degeneracy at $L=2$.
summary_zh: 马尔可夫模型是符号音乐领域的成熟工具，也已衍生出非齐次的变体形式。本文的核心贡献是提出一种观测驱动的估计机制：通过重叠滑动窗口，从单条符号序列中推导局部转移核的轨迹，而非依赖外部的人工形式分区。我们以德彪西1913年的作品《西琳克斯》（Syrinx）中的273个逻辑音符事件为测试对象，采用学界普遍提出的A-B-A'结构解读作为参考标准而非真值标注。我们将相同的验证流程应用于绝对音高核和记谱时长核。当窗口长度L=6时，两个维度下的参考边界均达到詹森-香农散度的最大值；其中时长维度的平台区间（267次对比中的64次）远窄于音高维度的平台区间（267次对比中的210次）。由于连续滑动窗口对比的理论最大值由窗口几何特性决定，进出转移完全切换时的最大值为1/√(L-1)，因此L=6时的音高数值及其宽平台本身并不构成强证据。两个维度的边界对齐现象符合边界敏感性特征，而宽平台的存在说明无法仅通过单条曲线实现唯一的自动分段。500次重合成实验从两个维度量化了生成结果与源作品的差异，同时发现当L=2时存在完全复制的退化现象。

title: Expectation, Backlash, Recovery, and Excitement: How Model Releases Shape Reddit Perceptions of Conversational AI Systems
title_zh: 期望、反弹、复苏与兴奋：模型发布如何塑造Reddit平台用户对对话式人工智能系统的认知
authors: Vahid Rahimzadeh, Yury Zhauniarovich, Savvas Zannettou
abstract: Conversational AI systems (CAISes) continuously change through model releases, feature updates, safety interventions, and access-policy shifts, yet user perceptions are often studied as static snapshots. We conduct a long-term, large-scale analysis of Reddit discussions to examine how users perceive CAIS model release interventions across providers. By combining sentiment classification and thematic concept analysis, we show that CAIS perceptions are dynamic and intervention-sensitive. Anthropic exhibits the clearest positive release profile through Claude Code and product-model fit, OpenAI shows backlash-and-recovery dynamics around GPT-5 and GPT-5.1, Grok-3 is shaped by provider identity and political discourse, and DeepSeek-R1 combines engineering praise with concerns about censorship, access, and reliability. These findings show that model releases are not merely technical updates, but user-facing interventions that reshape sentiment, expectations, and public discussion.
summary_zh: 对话式人工智能系统（CAISes）会通过模型发布、功能更新、安全干预和访问策略调整持续迭代，但现有研究大多将用户认知作为静态快照开展分析。我们针对Reddit平台的相关讨论开展长期大规模分析，研究不同厂商发布CAIS模型的干预行为如何影响用户认知。结合情感分类和主题概念分析方法，我们发现用户对CAIS的认知是动态变化的，且对发布干预高度敏感：Anthropic通过Claude Code和产品-模型匹配度呈现出最清晰的正向发布特征；OpenAI围绕GPT-5和GPT-5.1呈现出“反弹-复苏”的动态变化；Grok-3的用户认知受厂商身份和政治话语的显著影响；DeepSeek-R1则同时收获了工程层面的好评，也引发了关于内容审查、访问权限和可靠性的担忧。上述结果表明，模型发布并非单纯的技术更新，而是面向用户的干预行为，会重塑公众的情感倾向、预期和讨论方向。

title: Beyond Semantic Accuracy: Consequence-Aware Evaluation for Safety-Critical Language Understanding
title_zh: 量化对大语言模型孟加拉语语言理解的影响：一项系统性评估
authors: Yujing Chang, Thinh Pham, Van-Phat Thai, Chunyao Ma, Yash Guleria, Pham Nhut Huy, Sameer Alam
abstract: Can language models be trusted in safety- critical operations? In such settings, strong per- formance on semantic metrics does not guaran- tee operational reliability: a misread altitude, a dropped execution condition, or a confused call- sign may score well under standard F1 yet carry sharply asymmetric operational consequences. We study this problem in air traffic control (ATC), where controller-pilot communication demands near-zero error tolerance, and use consequence-aware evaluation to test whether semantic scores misstate operational reliabil- ity. The framework is instantiated in a con- trolled diagnostic ATC benchmark grounded in aviation standards and feedback from 40 air traffic controllers across three countries. Evaluating 8 models, we uncover a system- atic semantic-safety gap: conventional scores give substantially higher performance estimates than consequence-aware evaluation, even for models that appear reliable under standard met- rics. Risk-aware fine-tuning narrows but does not close this gap, showing that consequence- aware evaluation is a necessary complement to standard NLP metrics before any real safety- critical deployment claim
summary_zh: 训练后量化技术可降低大语言模型（LLMs）的内存占用并加快推理速度，目前已广泛应用于端侧部署场景。但现有关于量化效果的认知大多来自英语基准测试，尚不清楚形态复杂的低资源语言（如孟加拉语）是否符合相同规律，本文针对这一研究空白展开探索。我们选取Qwen-2.5-7B、LLaMA-3.1-8B和GPT-OSS-20B三个模型系列，在全精度模式和三种量化格式（GPTQ-Int8、GPTQ-Q8、GGUF-W8A16）下，基于5个孟加拉语自然语言理解基准（Bangla MMLU、CommonsenseQA-BN、OpenBookQA-BN、PIQA-BN和BoolQ-BN），通过lm-evaluation-harness开展零样本评估。据我们所知，这是首次针对孟加拉语自然语言理解任务开展的不同量化格式对照实验。三个模型系列对量化的响应存在明显差异：GPT-OSS在GGUF-W8A16格式下，高推理复杂度任务的准确率最高下降57.35%；而Qwen和LLaMA在GPTQ量化下性能保持稳定，部分场景下量化版本的表现甚至优于全精度版本。作为理解类任务的BoolQ-BN在所有三个模型系列中，无论采用何种量化格式性能均保持稳定。整体结果表明，量化技术完全可以支撑孟加拉语的端侧部署，但模型架构和量化方法的选择比位宽本身的影响更大。本文最后讨论了该结论对在资源受限硬件上部署模型的从业者的参考价值。

title: Quantization Effects on Bangla Language Understanding in Large Language Models: A Systematic Evaluation
authors: Ismail Hossain, Nafi Ullah Shafin, Mohammad Abdullah Al Mumin
abstract: Post-training quantization lowers the memory footprint of Large Language Models (LLMs) and speeds up inference, which is why it is now common for on-device deployment. Most of what we know about its effects, however, comes from English benchmarks. It is not clear whether the same holds for morphologically complex, low-resource languages such as Bangla, and this gap is what we address here. We evaluate three model families---Qwen-2.5-7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, and GPT-OSS-20B---in full precision and in three quantized formats (GPTQ-Int8, GPTQ-Q8, GGUF-W8A16) across five Bangla natural language understanding benchmarks (Bangla MMLU, CommonsenseQA-BN, OpenBookQA-BN, PIQA-BN, and BoolQ-BN), using zero-shot evaluation through lm-evaluation-harness. To our knowledge this is the first controlled comparison of quantization formats on Bangla NLU. The three families do not respond the same way: GPT-OSS loses up to 57.35% accuracy on reasoning-heavy tasks under GGUF-W8A16, while Qwen and LLaMA hold steady under GPTQ, and in a few cases the quantized version edges out the full-precision one. BoolQ-BN, a comprehension task, stays stable across all three families regardless of format. Taken together, these results suggest quantization can work well for Bangla deployment, but the choice of architecture and quantization method matters more than the bit width alone. We discuss what this means for practitioners choosing a model to run on constrained hardware.

title: Is Discrete Difficulty Sufficient? Leveraging Continuous Difficulty for Efficient Self-Consistency in LLMs
title_zh: 离散难度足够吗？利用连续难度实现大语言模型高效自一致性
authors: Sihyeong Yeom, Geon Park, Geunyeong Jeong, Taewoong Yoon, Jaewook Lee, Harksoo Kim
abstract: Self-Consistency (SC) is a decoding strategy that samples diverse reasoning paths and selects the most consistent answer, demonstrating strong performance on complex reasoning problems. However, the excessive token consumption incurred by generating multiple reasoning paths has been identified as a major limitation of SC. To improve computational efficiency, several studies have proposed strategies that adjust the number of reasoning paths or allocate resources differentially according to problem difficulty. Nevertheless, most existing methods categorize difficulty into a few fixed levels, failing to fully capture the continuously varying nature of reasoning complexity. In this work, we propose Flexible Self-Consistency (FSC), which estimates problem difficulty as a continuous signal and dynamically adjusts the number of generated reasoning paths accordingly. FSC predicts the output entropy of an input question using a pre-trained probe and leverages it as an indicator of model uncertainty to flexibly control the sampling budget. Experimental results show that, across various models and benchmarks, FSC maintains accuracy comparable to SC while achieving token savings of up to 76%.
summary_zh: 自一致性（Self-Consistency, SC）是一种经典解码策略，通过采样多条不同的推理路径并选择一致性最高的答案，在复杂推理问题上表现出优异性能。但生成多条推理路径带来的过量token消耗是SC的核心局限性。为提升计算效率，现有研究提出了多种策略，根据问题难度调整推理路径数量或差异化分配资源，但绝大多数现有方法将难度划分为少数固定等级，无法充分捕捉推理复杂度的连续变化特性。本文提出柔性自一致性（Flexible Self-Consistency, FSC）方法，将问题难度估计为连续信号，并据此动态调整生成推理路径的数量。FSC通过预训练探针预测输入问题的输出熵，将其作为模型不确定性的指标，灵活控制采样预算。实验结果表明，在不同模型和基准测试集上，FSC可保持与SC相当的准确率，同时最高可节省76%的token消耗。

title: Beyond Information Seeking: Severity-Aware Question Supervision for Proactive Medical Dialogue
title_zh: 超越信息检索：面向主动式医疗对话的严重程度感知问答监督机制
authors: Chenxuan Li, Xinrong Chen, Luyan Zhang, Peidong Jia, Zhongyu Zhao, Xuecheng Shang, Peixing Wan
abstract: Proactive medical dialogue requires an agent to decide what to ask from incomplete patient information. Existing information-seeking approaches commonly prioritize questions that most reduce diagnostic uncertainty. While effective for acquiring informative evidence, this criterion overlooks an important property of medical diagnosis: different diagnostic errors can carry substantially different consequences. Missing a severe condition may matter more than reducing uncertainty among less consequential alternatives. Question acquisition should therefore consider not only how informative new evidence is, but also how it is expected to affect the downstream diagnostic decision. To this end, we propose Expected-Severity-Risk (ESR), a consequence-aware question-supervision objective that values each candidate by its expected reduction in severity-aware terminal risk. Because questions must be selected before their answers are observed, ESR marginalizes over possible answers using train-only population statistics. Its rankings are then distilled into a prefix-only language policy, so next-question selection requires no teacher-side computation at deployment. Across three Qwen3-4B training seeds on DDxPlus, matched ESR supervision reduces mean high-severity diagnostic miss from .0645 to .0455 (-29.5%) and improves mean diagnostic accuracy from .9123 to .9320 while requiring only 0.14 additional questions per dialogue. Fixed-budget analyses show that the two objectives remain behaviorally distinct when question count is controlled, while a matched expected-0/1-risk control shows that severity-aware weighting improves the high-severity error profile beyond generic decision-aware supervision. These results support moving proactive medical dialogue beyond uncertainty reduction toward consequence-aware evidence acquisition.
summary_zh: 主动式医疗对话要求智能体在患者信息不完整的情况下自主决定需要询问的问题。现有信息检索类方法通常优先选择能最大程度降低诊断不确定性的问题，这类方法虽然能高效获取信息证据，但忽略了医疗诊断的核心特性：不同诊断错误的后果差异极大，漏诊重症的严重程度远高于在低风险备选诊断之间降低不确定性的价值。因此问题选择机制不仅要考虑新证据的信息量，还要评估其对后续诊断决策的预期影响。基于该思路，本文提出预期严重程度风险（Expected-Severity-Risk, ESR）机制，这是一种后果感知的问答监督目标，根据候选问题对严重程度感知的最终风险的预期降低幅度来评估其价值。由于问题选择必须在获取答案前完成，ESR仅使用训练集的群体统计量对所有可能的答案做边际化处理。ESR生成的问题排序可蒸馏为仅依赖前缀的语言策略，因此部署阶段选择下一个问题时无需额外的教师侧计算。在DDxPlus数据集上基于3个不同的Qwen3-4B训练种子开展实验，匹配ESR监督后，重症漏诊的平均占比从0.0645降至0.0455（降幅29.5%），平均诊断准确率从0.9123提升至0.9320，每轮对话仅平均多询问0.14个问题。固定预算对照实验表明，控制问题数量的前提下，ESR与传统目标的行为差异仍然显著；匹配的0/1风险预期对照实验显示，严重程度感知的权重设置相比通用决策感知监督，可进一步优化重症错误的表现。上述结果证明，主动式医疗对话应当从单纯的不确定性降低转向后果感知的证据获取模式。

title: Dataset Scarcity Limits Robust Evaluation of Multilingual Embedding Models: A Case Study of Slavic Languages
title_zh: 数据集稀缺限制多语言嵌入模型的鲁棒性评估：以斯拉夫语族语言为例
authors: Ana Gjorgjevikj, Barbara Korou\v{s}i\'{c} Seljak, Tome Eftimov
abstract: Multilingual text embedding models enable cross-lingual transfer of knowledge across a wide range of NLP tasks, but their evaluation remains highly uneven across high-, mid- and low-resource languages. In this paper, we propose a two-dimensional framework, specifically tailored for analyzing multilingual embedding benchmarks under dataset scarcity, and apply it on the Slavic-language subset of the MTEB benchmark. The framework distinguishes between task-specific and cross-task evaluation, while jointly analyzing three complementary aspects: (1) ranking robustness, (2) model consistency, and (3) evidence strength. At the task-specific level, we evaluate the stability of model rankings under changes in ranking methodology and benchmark dataset composition. At the cross-task level, we assess the ability of models to generalize across diverse tasks within a language. To quantify the reliability of benchmark conclusions, we introduce an Evidence Strength Score that accounts for dataset availability, diversity, and robustness assessability. Our analysis reveals severe benchmark sparsity, with many Slavic language-task pairs relying on a single dataset or highly correlated benchmark collections, limiting the ability to draw robust conclusions. The cross-task analysis reveals a small group of highly transferable models, most notably llama-embed-nemotron-8b, multilingual-e5-large-instruct, and Qwen3-Embedding variants, that consistently perform well across Slavic languages and tasks. Overall, the results demonstrate that benchmark rankings and robustness conclusions must be interpreted jointly with certain notation of their evidence strength and highlight benchmark scarcity as a major obstacle to trustworthy multilingual evaluation.
summary_zh: 多语言文本嵌入模型可支撑大量NLP任务下的跨语言知识迁移，但不同资源等级（高、中、低）语言的评估工作极不均衡。本文提出一套专门针对数据集稀缺场景下多语言嵌入基准分析的二维框架，并将其应用于MTEB基准的斯拉夫语子集。该框架区分任务特定评估和跨任务评估，同时从三个互补维度开展分析：（1）排序鲁棒性，（2）模型一致性，（3）证据强度。在任务特定层面，我们评估排序方法和基准数据集组成发生变化时，模型排名的稳定性；在跨任务层面，我们评估模型在同一语言的不同任务之间的泛化能力。为量化基准结论的可靠性，本文提出证据强度评分，综合考虑数据集的可用性、多样性和鲁棒性可评估性。分析结果显示当前基准存在严重的稀疏问题：大量斯拉夫语-任务配对仅依赖单个数据集或高度相关的基准集合，无法支撑鲁棒的评估结论。跨任务分析识别出一组泛化能力极强的模型，最具代表性的包括llama-embed-nemotron-8b、multilingual-e5-large-instruct和Qwen3-Embedding系列变体，它们在所有斯拉夫语言和任务上均表现稳定。整体结果表明，解读基准排名和鲁棒性结论时必须同步参考其证据强度，基准数据集稀缺是当前可信多语言评估的核心阻碍。

title: Ockhamareto: Pareto-Gated Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Concise Unit-Test Generation with Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Ockhamareto：面向强化学习生成简洁单元测试的帕累托门控段级信用分配方法
authors: Dong Huang, Mark Harman, Jie M. Zhang, Zhijiang Guo, Mingzhe Du, See Kiong Ng
abstract: We introduce \textbf{Ockhamareto}, a single-shot GRPO framework for unit-test generation and selection, based on the principles of \emph{Ockham's Razor} and \emph{Pareto Optimality}. Ockhamareto has two principal components: (i)~a \emph{Pareto-gated Bonus} that rewards only rollouts non-dominated in~(mutation, $-$\#tests) space, and (ii)~\emph{Token-level Segment Credit}, which attributes each test's marginal mutation kills back to the tokens of its unit-test block. On the \emph{UnLeakedTestBench~(ULT)}, Ockhamareto \emph{strictly Pareto-dominates} the strongest RL baseline~(\emph{MIST-RL}). Furthermore, it dominates on {\em each and all} optimization objectives, catching more bugs ($49.9\%$ vs $31.3\%$ mutation score at $N{=}5$), using \emph{fewer} tests ($2.60$ vs $4.67$ on average), thereby achieving $3.4\times$ the per-test trade-off improvement. The advantage is found in all four benchmarks~(\emph{HumanEval+}, \emph{MBPP+}, \emph{CodeContests}, \emph{TestGenEval-Lite}): Ockhamareto leads both mutation and coverage metrics on every one, always with the smallest suite. Ockhamareto also outperforms the state-of-the-art at all model scales, adding $+30$--$35$~pp mutation at 4B, 9B, and 27B model sizes. We also show that the knee point of the optimal trade-off between efficiency and effectiveness on the Pareto front is not correlated with obvious more easily computed proxy metrics, such as function size. This finding motivates the Pareto front computation; it is needed to identify this crucial engineering trade-off for each function under test.
summary_zh: 本文提出Ockhamareto，这是一款基于奥卡姆剃刀原理和帕累托最优思想的单步GRPO框架，用于单元测试的生成和筛选。Ockhamareto包含两个核心组件：（1）帕累托门控奖励机制，仅对（变异得分、负测试数量）空间内的非支配轨迹给予奖励；（2）token级段信用分配机制，将每个测试带来的边际变异杀死数归因到对应单元测试块的每个token上。在UnLeakedTestBench（ULT）基准上，Ockhamareto严格帕累托占优性能最强的强化学习基线方法MIST-RL，且在所有优化目标上均实现全面领先：当N=5时，Ockhamareto可发现更多bug（变异得分49.9%对比31.3%），同时使用的测试数量更少（平均2.60个对比4.67个），单测试的综合性能提升达到3.4倍。该优势在所有四个基准（HumanEval+、MBPP+、CodeContests、TestGenEval-Lite）上均成立：Ockhamareto在所有基准上的变异得分和覆盖率指标均领先，同时测试套件规模始终最小。在所有模型规模下，Ockhamareto的表现均优于现有最优方法：在4B、9B、27B模型规模下，变异得分可提升30-35个百分点。本文同时发现，帕累托前沿上效率与效果最优权衡的拐点，与函数规模等易于计算的代理指标不存在相关性。该结论证明了帕累托前沿计算的必要性：只有通过帕累托前沿计算，才能为每个被测函数识别出这一关键工程权衡点。

title: UTS at CheckThat! 2026: Cite-Frame Engineering for Generated Fact-Checking Articles
title_zh: UTS参加CheckThat! 2026赛事：面向生成式事实核查文章的引用框架工程
authors: Dima Galat, Marian-Andrei Rizoiu
abstract: CheckThat! 2026 Task 3 asks systems to generate fact-checking articles, graded by an unweighted mean of four sub-metrics (M4). Our UTS submission placed 2nd of 11 teams (M4 = 0.484). The shipped system is a deterministic stub drafter wrapped by two single-lever interventions: a domain-attribution cite frame (HostCite) and a shadow-validated anchor picker (ShadowVal) that use Llama-3.2:1B only as a per-cite validator, never as a body-prose generator. The stack lifts M4 by +0.027 over the stub on the WatClaimCheck validation split, beats the field on entailment and coverage, and follows two design rules our ablation matrix made unambiguous. Scorer conservatism: credit only tokens the references entail - templates pay; LLM prose, reviewer names, and raw evidence all fail. Auxiliary anchor signals are miscalibrated against the Llama judge: every anchor proxy we tried (cross-encoder, length, lead position) picks anchors the judge rejects - gate on the judge itself. The remaining +0.062 gap to the winner sits on citation precision/recall (0.299 vs 0.671), consistent with a selective-emission policy that drops low-confidence cites.
summary_zh: CheckThat! 2026任务3要求参赛系统生成事实核查文章，评分采用4个子指标的非加权均值（M4）。UTS提交的系统在11支参赛队伍中位列第2，M4得分为0.484。最终上线的系统是一个确定性草稿生成器，外层封装了两个单杠杆干预模块：领域归属引用框架HostCite，以及影子验证锚点选择器ShadowVal，二者仅将Llama-3.2:1B作为单引用验证器使用，不将其作为正文生成器。在WatClaimCheck验证集上，该技术栈相比仅使用草稿生成器的基线将M4指标提升了0.027，在蕴含度和覆盖率指标上优于其他参赛方案，且完全符合我们通过消融实验矩阵明确的两条设计规则：第一是评分保守性原则：仅对参考文献可推导出的内容分配得分——使用模板生成内容可获得得分，而大语言模型生成的散文、评审人姓名和原始证据均无法获得得分；第二是辅助锚点信号存在与Llama裁判的校准偏差：我们测试的所有锚点代理（交叉编码器、长度、句首位置）选出的锚点都会被裁判否决，因此必须直接以裁判本身作为门控条件。当前与冠军方案仍存在0.062的差距，该差距集中在引用精确率/召回率维度（0.299 vs 0.671），与丢弃低置信度引用的选择性输出策略的表现一致。

title: Shortcut Before Circuit: Document Statistics Time In-Context Conflict Resolution
title_zh: 电路之前的捷径：文档统计时间下的上下文冲突消解
authors: Yijun Liao, Fanwei Liang
abstract: When a context asserts two values for one fact, a model commits to a cue -- recency, repetition, position -- but natural data rarely makes these disagree, so behavior cannot reveal which. We train 26M-parameter transformers on a synthetic language where recency and rarity are exactly coextensive, and separate them with a minimal causal edit that inverts one cue while holding the truth, token count and answer position fixed. All 75 runs reach accuracy >= 0.999, including where the trivial heuristic fails, so no held-in evaluation distinguishes them. Under intervention the per-cell readout does not replicate: 13 of 25 cells differ by more than 0.3 in sign fraction across three seeds, the largest by 0.879 against a standard error of 0.025. The construction predicts this -- coextensive rules leave the objective indifferent between them -- and the variance is ordered by how much of the optimization each comparison releases. What replicates is timing: escape from a positional shortcut with a closed-form ceiling, monotone in redundancy. Probed before that escape, attribution reverses sign in 32 of 75 runs at unchanged accuracy, and gating on circuit formation is necessary but not sufficient. The corpus fixes when a mechanism appears, not which one -- a criterion for when mechanistic attribution to data is available at all, and our construction makes the unavailable case exact.
summary_zh: 当上下文对同一事实给出两个不同取值时，模型会依赖近因性、重复度、位置等线索做出判断，但自然数据中这些线索很少出现冲突，因此无法通过行为观测确定模型实际依赖的线索。我们在合成语言数据集上训练参数量为26M的Transformer模型，该数据集中近因性和稀有性两个线索完全共现，随后我们通过最小因果编辑操作分离两个线索：在保持事实、token数量和答案位置不变的情况下反转其中一个线索。全部75次实验的准确率均达到0.999以上，包括简单启发式规则失效的场景，因此通过预留评估集无法区分模型实际使用的线索。在干预条件下，单元级读出结果无法复现：3个不同随机种子的实验中，25个单元里有13个的符号占比差异超过0.3，最大差异达0.879，而标准误差仅为0.025。该结果可由我们的构造方式预测：共现的规则会让优化目标对二者无偏好，且方差大小与每次对比能释放的优化空间正相关。可复现的结果体现在时间维度：模型从位置捷径逃逸的过程存在闭式上限，且与冗余度呈单调关系。在逃逸前进行探针测试，75次实验中有32次的归因符号发生反转，但准确率保持不变，对电路形成过程施加门控是必要条件但非充分条件。语料决定了机制出现的时机，而非具体出现哪一种机制——这是判断是否可对数据进行机械归因的核心标准，我们提出的构造方法可让归因不可行的场景变得完全可量化。

title: Words, Spaces and Generative AI: Layers of language in contemporary architecture
title_zh: 文字、空间与生成式AI：当代建筑中的语言层级
authors: Anca-Simona Horvath
abstract: Language can be considered a design material in architecture, and in the context of text-to-X generative AI models becoming a common tool for architectural practice, looking more closely at language is more important now than in the past. After describing some of the important developments in linguistics starting from Wittgenstein, and including the work of Chomsky, Lakoff, conceptual and generative metaphors as proposed by Sch\"on, this chapter connects them to contemporary architectural design and generative text-to-X tools. The chapter builds on the idea that three main forms of language intertwine in architectural design done using generative AI, namely (I) discourse (or natural language which can contain professional terminology specific to our field), (II) programming languages (which are artificial languages sitting at the basis of all computational systems), and (III) annotations (as language elements attached to pieces of data). It concludes by outlining a research agenda for connecting generative metaphors to generative AI: (a) conducting corpus linguistics studies on architectural texts (using quantitative tools such as topic modelling, and qualitative tools such as discourse analysis); (b) bringing communication theory and information studies closer to architectural research and (c) taking into account that different (natural) languages come with different affordances meaning generative and conceptual metaphors differ in relation to this.
summary_zh: 语言可被视为建筑学中的一种设计材料，在文本转任意内容的生成式AI模型逐渐成为建筑实践常用工具的背景下，对语言本身的深入研究比以往任何时候都更加重要。本文首先梳理了始于Wittgenstein、涵盖Chomsky、Lakoff相关研究，以及Schön提出的概念隐喻与生成隐喻等重要语言学发展成果，随后将这些理论与当代建筑设计、生成式文本转任意内容工具相关联。本文的核心观点是，三类主要语言形式在基于生成式AI的建筑设计中相互交织：（1）话语（即包含建筑领域专属专业术语的自然语言）；（2）编程语言（作为所有计算系统基础的人工语言）；（3）标注（附着在数据片段上的语言元素）。最后本文提出了将生成隐喻与生成式AI相结合的研究议程：（a）针对建筑文本开展语料语言学研究，结合主题建模等定量工具和话语分析等定性工具；（b）将传播理论与信息研究更紧密地融入建筑研究领域；（c）考虑不同自然语言具备不同的可供性，生成隐喻和概念隐喻也会随之产生差异。

title: SteerCheck: Attribution Specificity and Alignment Leakage in Activation-Steering Audits
title_zh: SteerCheck（归因特异性与对齐泄露检测框架）：激活引导审计中的归因特异性与对齐泄露问题
authors: Daming Luo, Christy Liang, Junyu Xuan
abstract: Activation steering can change behaviour without establishing that the effect is specific to the intended concept. We introduce SteerCheck, a preregistered attribution audit that matches off-target KL and separates mean, protected-tail, polarity, transfer, and semantic claims. Exact replay of 960 Qwen3-14B interventions reveals complementary limits of common controls: isotropic directions occupy a narrow near-orthogonal region, whereas sign-randomized same-construction directions often retain substantial target alignment. Effect is strongly associated with signed cosine within the sign-randomized family ($\rho=.94$); $25.3\%$ of its draws exceed cosine $.5$, and every draw exceeding the observed mean effect has cosine above $.80$. This alignment leakage does not by itself invalidate a conditional randomization test; it limits what the comparator can distinguish and motivates reporting exchangeability assumptions, a construction diagnostic $A$, and the empirical cosine distribution. The primary Qwen complete gate remains negative because the protected tail fails all families. On independent data, continuous margin transfers only in Qwen and accuracy transfers in no selected cell. Prospectively registered language controls pass the complete gate in Qwen and DeepSeek, while a passing DeepSeek detox comparator rules out categorical separation; all nominal passes are sensitive to $\Gamma=1.10$. Frozen three-rater open-generation evaluation supports factual correction in DeepSeek but not Qwen; the automatic judge fails calibration (macro-F1 $.562$), so null-wide semantic results remain descriptive. SteerCheck makes these conditional and mixed conclusions auditable.
summary_zh: 激活引导技术可以改变模型行为，但无法证明该效果是针对目标概念的特异性效果。本文提出SteerCheck，一项经过预注册的归因审计框架，可匹配非目标KL散度，分离均值、受保护尾部、极性、迁移性和语义五类验证目标。对960次Qwen3-14B干预操作的精确复现结果显示，常用的控制方法存在互补性局限：各向同性方向仅分布在狭窄的近正交区域，而符号随机化的同结构方向往往保留大量目标对齐信息。在符号随机化方向族中，效果与带符号余弦相关性极强（ρ=0.94）；25.3%的采样结果余弦值超过0.5，所有超过观测平均效果的采样结果余弦值均高于0.80。这种对齐泄露本身不会使条件随机化检验失效，但它限制了对照实验可区分的范围，因此有必要报告可交换性假设、构造诊断指标A以及经验余弦分布。Qwen模型的主完全门控结果仍为阴性，因为受保护尾部在所有方向族上均未通过验证。在独立数据集上，连续边际效应仅在Qwen模型上存在迁移，没有任何选定单元的准确率存在迁移。经过前瞻性注册的语言控制在Qwen和DeepSeek模型上均通过了完全门控，但DeepSeek的解毒对照实验通过的结果排除了类别分离的可能性；所有名义上通过的结果对Γ=1.10的混淆程度均敏感。由三名标注者完成的开放生成冻结评估结果支持DeepSeek具备事实校正能力，但Qwen不具备该能力；自动评估器的校准失效（宏F1值为0.562），因此全零假设下的语义结果仍属于描述性结论。SteerCheck可让这类条件性、混合性结论具备可审计性。

title: Speech-to-SOAP: End-to-End Summarization of Medical Dialogues: KIT@BeTraC 2026
title_zh: Speech-to-SOAP（端到端医疗对话转SOAP笔记系统）：医疗对话端到端摘要生成：KIT@BeTraC 2026
authors: Enes Yavuz Ugan, Fabian Retkowski, Yuka Ko, Thai-Binh Nguyen, Maike Z\"ufle, Jan Niehues, Alexander Waibel
abstract: With the advent of Large Language Models and its instruction following capabilities a promising application is the task of summarization. Within this domain of task the extractive sub-task of clinical protocolling has emerged as a topic of particular interest as it can significantly reduce the downtime and protocolling burden of health-care workers thus enabling them to focus on their core work helping humans. A further step towards automation is the direct generation of clinical notes from speech without intermediate transcripts, reducing processing time while preserving information such as coughing or other paralinguistic cues that may be lost in transcript-based systems. To this end, we present KIT's submission to this years BeTraC challenge in the lightweight track. Our main contribution is a scalable data augmentation pipeline that unifies heterogeneous medical dialogue datasets through synthetic speech generation and automatically generated SOAP supervision, enabling robust adaptation of a speech foundation model for end-to-end speech-to-SOAP generation.
summary_zh: 大语言模型及其指令遵循能力的兴起催生了一个极具前景的应用方向：摘要生成。在该领域中，临床记录生成这一抽取性子任务受到广泛关注，它可以大幅降低医护人员的非工作耗时和记录负担，让医护人员能够专注于核心的诊疗工作。自动化的下一步是直接从语音生成临床笔记，无需中间转录文本，既可以缩短处理时间，还能保留咳嗽等在基于转录文本的系统中容易丢失的副语言线索。针对该目标，本文介绍了KIT团队在今年BeTraC挑战赛轻量级赛道的提交方案。核心贡献是提出了一个可扩展的数据增强流水线，通过合成语音生成和自动生成的SOAP（主观-客观-评估-计划）标注，统一异构的医疗对话数据集，实现语音基础模型对端到端语音转SOAP生成任务的鲁棒适配。

title: Who is the Agent to Blame? Localizing Faithfulness and Citation Mistakes in Agentic Deep Research
title_zh: 谁是应追责的智能体：智能体深度研究中的忠实度与引用错误定位
authors: Eran Hirsch, David Wan, Han Wang, Elias Stengel-Eskin, Mohit Bansal, Ido Dagan
abstract: Deep research (DR) systems produce long-form cited reports by orchestrating multiple agents that search and synthesize information from the web. Citations are the primary mechanism for evaluating the faithfulness of these reports, yet current DR systems exhibit poor citation recall. Moreover, improving citation recall is challenging because DR systems are complex multi-agent architectures where information passes through agents like a telephone game, and both content and citations can get corrupted along the way. We propose an evaluation method that pinpoints which agent introduced each error by locally testing agent invocations for faithfulness and verifiability relative to their own inputs. Furthermore, we propose a four-type taxonomy to categorize the discovered errors: hallucination, uncited input reliance, uncited output, or insufficient citations. Applying our method to three top-ranked open-source DR systems, we obtain actionable diagnostics. Almost every agent makes a lot of mistakes with the exception being those that summarize a single document. We find that the dominant error type varies systematically across agents, where the orchestrator mistakes are mostly citation-related. We find that 84.7% of final-report errors in AI-Q originate at the orchestrator, roughly 31% of them hallucinations and the rest citation mistakes. Guided by these insights, we demonstrate that two simple interventions raise citation recall by 5% without degrading output quality.
summary_zh: 深度研究（DR）系统通过编排多个智能体从互联网搜索并合成信息，生成带引用的长文本报告。引用是评估这类报告忠实度的核心机制，但当前深度研究系统的引用召回率普遍较低。此外，提升引用召回率的难度极大，因为深度研究系统是复杂的多智能体架构，信息在多个智能体之间传递的过程类似传话游戏，内容和引用都可能在传递过程中被损坏。本文提出了一种评估方法，通过本地测试智能体调用过程相对于其输入的忠实度和可验证性，精准定位每个错误是由哪个智能体引入的。此外本文提出了四类错误分类体系：幻觉、未引用输入依赖、未引用输出、引用不足。将该方法应用于三个排名靠前的开源深度研究系统，我们得到了可落地的诊断结论：除了仅负责单文档摘要的智能体外，几乎所有智能体都会产生大量错误；不同智能体的主导错误类型存在系统性差异，其中编排智能体的错误大多与引用相关。实验发现，AI-Q系统最终报告中84.7%的错误源自编排智能体，其中约31%是幻觉，其余为引用错误。基于这些结论，我们验证了两个简单的干预方案可以在不降低输出质量的前提下将引用召回率提升5%。

title: ROBE: Reversed-Order-Biased-Experts for Extracting Extreme Long-tail Events from Historical Texts
title_zh: ROBE（逆序偏置专家模型）：从历史文本中提取极端长尾事件
authors: Stella Verkijk, Piek Vossen
abstract: This paper proposes methods to extract over 50 types of events from a Dutch historical corpus spanning the 17th and 18th centuries. The methods we propose aim to tackle the impossible: extracting the long-tail of the long-tail. Historic data from before the 19th century is in itself a niche domain not covered in the pre-training of Large Language Models, and we aim to extract events only very scarcely annotated in the training data available for this domain. We propose creating expert classifiers for subgroups of the events present in the training data. We make these groupings based on similar frequency in the training data or on semantic relatedness. Experts trained on underrepresented events are assigned higher priority when predicting to avoid being dominated by frequency biases. We refer to this new way of combining classifiers, specifically tailored to protect the long-tail, as ROBE: Reversed-Order-Biased-Experts. We also propose a controlled method to create domain-specific synthetic data. Our two implementations of ROBE outperform a simple fine-tuned encoder model with a .10 increase in recall and a .16 increase in precision respectively. The best model achieves a .10 increase in f1 for a group of long-tail classes in our niche data set.
summary_zh: 本文提出了可从17-18世纪荷兰历史语料库中提取超过50类事件的方法，旨在攻克从长尾数据中提取长尾事件的难题。19世纪之前的历史数据本身属于大语言模型预训练未覆盖的小众领域，而我们的目标是提取该领域可用训练数据中极少被标注的事件。本文提出为训练数据中的事件子组构建专属专家分类器，分组依据为训练数据中的相似频率或语义相关性。针对低代表性事件训练的专家分类器在预测阶段被赋予更高优先级，避免被频率偏置主导。这种专门为保护长尾性能设计的分类器组合新范式被命名为ROBE：Reversed-Order-Biased-Experts（逆序偏置专家模型）。本文还提出了一种生成领域专属合成数据的受控方法。我们实现的两个ROBE变体性能均优于简单微调的编码器基线模型，召回率分别提升0.10，精确率分别提升0.16，最优模型在小众数据集的长尾类别分组上F1值提升了0.10。

title: RecurSE: Bounded Recursive Self-Evaluation for LLM Rubric Judges
title_zh: RecurSE（有界递归自评估框架）：面向大语言模型评分裁判的有界递归自评估方法
authors: Kaiyuan Liu, Ziyuan Zhuang, Rongxiang Weng, Jieping Ye
abstract: LLM-as-judge is essential for evaluating open-ended text and steering post-training, yet improving the judge itself typically relies on expensive annotations, reward models, or distillation from stronger teachers. In this work, we eliminate external gold supervision from the RL training reward: the model's own evaluative capability generates learning signals for its optimization -- a closed-loop setting of bounded recursive self-improvement (RSI) termed Recursive Self-Evaluation (RecurSE). We study two central questions: when can self-improvement occur, and when must it stop? First, RecurSE pairs a trainable judge evaluating candidate responses under per-rule rubrics (Pass 1) with a synchronized policy-copy checker that audits the judge's reasoning against meta-rubrics to supply a scalar process reward (Pass 2). To enable learning, interface decoupling structurally isolates the checker's scalar score from the judge's verdict tokens, eliminating a degenerative token-copying shortcut that inflates self-assigned rewards. Second, because unanchored recursive learning is inherently bounded, Pairwise Advantage Validity (PAV) serves as an unbiased validation monitor that jointly tracks judge accuracy and checker fidelity to reliably identify the optimal early-stopping window. Across Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma-4-E4B-it, and Qwen3.6-27B, RecurSE achieves consistent generalization gains across held-out medical, pairwise, summarization, and professional benchmarks. Ablations demonstrate that synchronized judge-checker co-evolution outperforms frozen checkers, external meta-judges, self-consistency, and scaled teacher distillation. Furthermore, preference pairs curated by our judge effectively enhance downstream policy alignment. Bounded RSI for LLM-as-judge is thus viable when self-produced reward validity is explicitly decoupled and monitored.
summary_zh: 大语言模型作为裁判是评估开放式文本和引导后训练过程的核心技术，但提升裁判模型性能通常依赖昂贵的人工标注、奖励模型或更强教师模型的蒸馏。本研究从强化学习训练奖励中完全移除外部黄金标注：利用模型自身的评估能力生成优化所需的学习信号，构建有界递归自提升（RSI）的闭环场景，该方法被命名为Recursive Self-Evaluation（RecurSE，递归自评估）。本研究围绕两个核心问题展开：自提升何时能够发生，以及自提升何时必须停止。首先，RecurSE包含两个阶段：第一阶段由可训练裁判按照单条评分规则评估候选响应；第二阶段由与裁判策略同步更新的副本检查器对照元评分规则审计裁判的推理过程，输出标量过程奖励。为了实现有效学习，接口解耦操作从结构上将检查器的标量分数与裁判的判决token隔离开，消除会导致自分配奖励虚高的退化性token复制捷径。其次，由于无锚定递归学习天然存在边界，本文提出的Pairwise Advantage Validity（PAV，成对优势有效性）指标可作为无偏验证监控器，同时跟踪裁判准确率和检查器保真度，可靠地识别最优早停窗口。在Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-4-E4B-it和Qwen3.6-27B三个模型上的实验结果显示，RecurSE在预留的医疗、成对比较、摘要生成和专业任务基准上均实现了一致的泛化性能提升。消融实验证明，同步更新的裁判-检查器协同进化方案性能优于冻结检查器、外部元裁判、自一致性和大规模教师蒸馏方案。此外，由本研究提出的裁判筛选出的偏好对可有效提升下游策略的对齐性能。综上，只要对自生成奖励的有效性进行显式解耦和监控，面向大语言模型裁判的有界递归自提升是完全可行的。

title: Measuring Digital Labour Market Transitions with a Digital Semantic Score: An AI-Based Methodology Applied to the Dutch Labour Market
title_zh: 基于数字语义分的数字劳动力市场转型测度：应用于荷兰劳动力市场的人工智能方法
authors: Sadegh Shahmohammadi, Xavier Pinho, Mairi Bowdler, Suhendan Adiguzel-van Zoelen, Joost van Genabeek
abstract: The digital transformation of the Dutch labour market is reshaping occupational language, career pathways, and job-related skills.
